subject: HW-0801
content:

subject: HW-0801
content:
In these years, Taiwan has an problem that has never occured before, large numbers of colleges and universities are showing face. It affects us high school students very much.
First, as high school student our biggest goal here used to be to achieve a great academic in school and go go to university, then start making contact in society. Now, our goal has been extended, other from a great college we have to go for higher levels of education. This is in cause of the loads of universities and all the graduated students it brings out. My father used to tell me I should do my best in junior high to go to a better senior high, and do my best in senior high to go to a better college, then I can find a stable job which has a fine payment. But now, I have to go all the way up Doctor or higher to get a job like that.
Second, the more colleges that there are, the more people hold college degrees. But are those who have the degrees really have the ability? I think not, so thats why in our society there are so many un-emploed workers 90% of them have college degrees but they still can't find a job.
In conclusion, I think all the colleges and universities in Taiwan have caused a great deal of problems. Like the saying in Taiwan, I would rather have none than have too much. So why do we need all those colleges?

subject: HW-0801
content:
Once upon a time the minister of education in Nitherland came to visit Taiwan, when he found out the quantity of colleges and universities here are 16 times to theirs, he was too shocked to say a word. Why did he have such a jaw-dropping reaction? I think it is a clue to examine this phenonenon.
There might be two possible concerns which made the minister responded in this way. First, what is the goal to set up those colleges and universities? If the goal is to produce some intellectual elite, so as in Taiwan's case, does it mean Taiwanese want to level-up the whole social structure? If it is so, it is not surprising to feel impressed.
The above leads to the second concern, which is also a meaningful doubt, that is: how can Taiwanese manage to take care of the necessary demand of human resource for the level-up project, once so many colleges and universities are set up?
In terms of those considerations, we can propose one important question: do students receive higher education after colleges and universities are leveling up? Disappointedly enough, it is not. It just shows that the quality of students do not improve by this.
This happens to correspond the proverb: "quantity is not always equal to quality." Though we did make some effort for improving the quality of students, it is still a long way to go.

subject: HW-0801

First of all, since more students tend to have more opportunities to receive higher education, this phenomenon indicates the average education levels and qualities become higher than before. On one hand, this phenomenon can bring our society into another higher level in intelligent ways, such as cultivating more students to stand out in their own fields. On the other hand, this phenomenon can result in less crime, poverty, injustice and so forth. Secondly, in this way we can live in a more diverse and distinct society because we will have more graduates who will engage in their profession and careers in the future. That will improve the average living standards and enhance the diversity and differences in our society. Last but not least, more and more people will get motivated to get higher education. This can to some degrees activate the good circulation of this society.
To sum up, I truly believe that the increase of colleges and universities in Taiwan will have a positive and influential impact on our society and even on our next generation.

subject: HW-0801
content:
The increase of the number of colleges and universities provide more opportunities for students to receive higher education. I think of this phonemenon as positive to our society since college education has come to be necessary nowadays. In modern times, the level of one's educational level gets more and more important. Wherever you go, whatever you do, people often judge you first by where you graduate. For example, I personally is a student of a really prestigeous high school. As soon as people realize that, they consider me well-mannered and intelligent without a doubt. While my brother doesn't have good grades, people look down on him after contrasting him to me. This kind of situation is completely unfair because my brother is actually more organized and optimistic than I am, but he doesn't receive the respect he deserves. In my opinion, raising the number of colleges will help people get chances not only to study, but also to develop what they are good at.
The other reason why I agree establishing more colleges is that youngsters will have more time to become more mature to face today's society. Teenagers graduating from high school doesn't have enough abilities to make a living in the competitive environment today. In Taiwan, the phenomenon is even more obvious since the Taiwanese parents often overprotect their children, which results in the children's lack of independence. Colleges and universities are an ideal environment for young people to learn to deal with their own lives and to improve their skills to socialize.
New colleges and universities are being built up in the last one or two decades. These new schools will help Taiwanese students to develop and discover themselves. I believe that the society can be better with the help of these well-educated young people in the future.

subject: HW-0801
content:

The positive impact is that most of the senior high school students can keep studying and learning. Education can help them find their interests and improve knowledges. My chemistry teacher is a wonderful example. Her grade was not excellent in high school, but she still could enter the college. Because of the chance to study in college, she found her interest in chemistry. It led her to success and bring her a joyful life.
But on the other hand, there are still negative impacts. Students in senior high schools may think that they don't have to study hard anymore because almost every one can enter colleges and universities. They have wrong attitudes toward studying. They think studying hard is just to enter colleges, but they're totally wrong. Studying and learning improve our knowledges and skills. The test scores aren't everything, are they? As more and more students can enter colleges and universities easily, more and more students have attitudes like that. Instead of studying, they spend most of their time playing computer games or hanging out with friends. How can these students compete with foreigners in the future?
It's really a good question that worth thinking because the phenomenon will bring positive and negative impacts.

Though the importance of education cannot be emphasized adequately, it has to be in modest. Taiwan should strike a balance between this situation, so that we can be much more competitive in this world.

content:

subject: HW-0801
content:
Some people think that more colleges means more highly educated students who will bring prosperity to our society. However, I don't agree with it at all. I think too many students receiving higher education doesn't mean more well-educated people in our society. In fact, it's impossible for a society that everyone is suitable for higher education. Some people study harder, while others do not. Some are smarter, while others are not. Therefore, some people are suitable for higher education, while other are suitable for basic jobs. Even if all of them get in college, the fact won't change. In the end, the policy to let more students enter college only wastes education resource. What's worse? The policy leads to many society problems as follows. First, many college students play all the time instead of studying for their future. As they graduate, they can't find a job with a high salary to pay their debt borrowed in their college lives. They become helpless, and banks can't take their money back. Secondly, too
many people having a college degree means the degree is losing its value because jobs don't increase. Finally, highly educated students even without good knowledge don't want to do basic jobs, and its a big problem which is associated with the issue of foreign workers. To conclude, I think our government have to think twice about this policy.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more colleges in Taiwan, which means more students can receive higher education. For example, those students having poor grades can also enter the college. However, is it a decent phenomenon for Taiwan's education? As far as I am concerned, I don't think it better for Taiwan's education because of some reasons.
The phenomenon is pretty bad and the reasons are as follows. First of all, all the poor students can enter the college so that the quality of students at college will become worse and worse. Second, it cannot be denied that Ministry of Education have to offer more money to more universities. Thus, they cannot give adequate money to the high-quality colleges. Last but not least, this impact will require all the teachers at college to manage more students. That is to say, it is difficult for teachers in the university to handle such more students with different standard. Consequently, this phenomenon will cause lots of problems.
Judging from the above, I don't think that will have a positive impact on our education and our socity. Generally, it is really ridiculous for such more students to enter the college. In other nations, they will have the restriction about the number of the students if this phenomenon happens. Accordingly, if the government can limit the quantity of the students to go to university, I think our education will become better and better.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receive higher education. In my point of view, this will have a positive impact on our society because of the following three reasons:
1. The economy becomes better than before.
2. Everyone can become intellectuals.
3. When they graduated, they can go to graduate school or go aboard to receive higher education.
My view on the increasing numbers of colleges and universities is positive. It occurs to me that the economy turns better than before, because ten or twenty years ago, few people can go to colleges or universities due to the fees are high and national colleges or universities are less than now.
People go to colleges or universities to receive higher education, so they can be intellectuals. They will have more sense to contribute themselves to the society. When they graduate from universities, they can go further study or go aboard to receive higher education. Therefore, I think the phenomenon of the increasing numbers of colleges and universities will do us good and have a positive impact on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In my opinion, more colleges, universities, or students, will bring us an opener and more diverse society. This phenomenon will have some positive impacts on our society according to the following reasons:
First, receiving higher education, as a symbol of better life and an opportunity to improve one's status, should be a right for everyone, whether he/she is rich or poor. Thus, when a person can study in university, it means that our society is good enough to supply high level education for many people, and that our government is trying its best to help poor people get a chance for better jobs with better education.
Secondly, more schools will benefit different regions of this island, and help to achieve a balance between the northern and southern areas. Usually, many star schools are in the northern area, especially the Taipei City, and it is not convenient for the students in the southern areas. If more universities, especially star schools, have branches in southern areas, it will not only benefit the education level of southern areas, but also stimulate its economy.
Besides, I believe more schools or students of universities will bring advantages for our society in many other aspects, such as people's welfare, social flexibility, and so on.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In Taiwan, numbers of colleges and universities increase every year. Therefore, many students are able to receive higher education. In my opinion, I think it will have a negative impact on our society. The following are three reasons to support my opinion.
First, we should worry about students' level. Do they really reach the level of being an university or college student? I strongly question about it. For example, when the reporter ask them some questions, most of them don't know the answers. Even the question is from the elementory school textbook, they still have no idea about it!
Second, we should worry about their major in university or college. As you know, there are hundreds of deparments in university. Of these departments, there are popular and not popular departments. If you choose the department which isn't popular, how do you find a good job in the future?
Finally, we should worry about their future. Since there are more than one hundred schools in Taiwan, how can you find a job in the future? For instance, there are lots of English departments in Taiwan. When you want to find a job, you'll find you have many competitors. Thus, if you don't have special talents, it's hard to get a job.
To sum up, the above are the reasons why I think the phenomenon will have a negative impact on our society. I think the government should focus this problem as soon as possible. Thus, our next generation will have a good future.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are more and more colleges and universities in Taiwan. Many people even the authorities concerned might consider this a good phenomenon, because it increases the opportunities for more students to receive higher education. However, in my opinion, it may not have a positive impact on our society.
Since it is now much easier for students in Taiwan to go to universities and colleges than before, the quality of students going to universities becomes worse. Many high school students who don't pay too much effort on their studies can still go to universities and colleges without difficulties. And it may easily cause the waste of educational resources. Those who have no interests in the subject they major in are also increasing. According to a statistics made by the ministry of education, the content of which is about university students' opinions toward the major they choose after graduating from high school, approximately sixty percent of them say that they have made wrong choices and seek to change to other department. And about forty percent of them think that what they have learned in universities have no use on the job they are engaging in.
From the statistics, it is not difficult to understand that more and more universities and colleges don't make much contribution to the higher education in our society. We should choose the right students to receive higher education and increase the quality of both the universities and their students. Those who are not much talented should be assisted to learn something useful to make their own living in this society. By doing so can higher education have a positive impact on our society without wasting educational resources and destroying many students' future.

subject: HW-0801

subject: HW-0801
content:

Unfortunately, as the number of these schools increases, such purpose of screening out students with bad marks is no longer effective, which ultimately results in an explosion of the undergraduates' population.
For more conservative asian countries, grades act as an essential and important first impression for the employers. A higher education usually represents that the student is either smart or hard working, or even both; therefore, if the undergraduates' population increase significantly, competition for jobs will be become even more fierce than before the explosion. As a result, students will have to devote more time into a even higher education, such as a graduate school, in which they are demand to input more of their time, money and energy.
I think an increase in colleges and universities will have a negative impact on our society, for it extinguishes one of the original purposes for having colleges and universities. Moreover, it will greatly raise the level of difficulty in competing for jobs for the students.

content:

content:

If the condition continues, it would curtail the qualities of students graduating from colleges. Besides, too many schools make it so easy to enter one. The easier it is to get into a college, the lazier students become in studies. content:

content:

With this serious situation, some not qualified colleges or universities even cannot cultivate students to meet the industry's demand. Actually, I think goverment should not lay emplasis on the quantity of schools but the quality of them. Those who do not want to study shoud enter the society earlier and cultivate the skills for themselves. And only the qualified universities can really make the country strong!

subject: HW-0801
content:
It's an undoubtable reality that the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases. Education provides us with more knowledge and power; as a result, the rapidly increasing number of universities, in general, has its positive impact on our society.
In this job competitive market, it has been gradually difficult to land a position without a higher level of education. In order to maintain the competitive edge, students try their best to further their studies. With the increasing number of schools, more and more students could have the equal opportunity to receive higher education. At the same time, it also makes our society and country more competitive and powerful. Apart from that, it also adds more positive impression to our nation's image. Another advantage of the increasing number of universities is that with more citizens receiving higher education, a lot of social problems, such as theft, suicide, and arms and drugs dealing could be improved. Owing to higher education, people could have a correct attitude toward their life, work and family. Meanwhile, they are able to make right decisions.
However, this interesting phenomenon could also be considered an alarming trend. With the decreasing number of population in Taiwan, schools get fewer students than they used to. The biggest crisis these universities will have to face is maybe they won't have enough income to sustain themselves.
Considering both sides, I personally think though the phenomenon has both positive and negative influences, the benefits far outweigh its negative aspects.

Therefore, although students in Taiwan get more opportunities to receive higher education, it does not follow that they will learn more from their teachers. In my opinion, increasing the number of colleges or universities may benefit our society because more people are well-educated. However, our government officials should also enact policies to ensure that the quality of education does not deteriorate as more colleges and universities are set up in Taiwan. In that way, we can achieve the goal of education and ensure our students a better future.

Because the competition between colleages and universities will push students to learn more, people get higher education will benefit their knowledge and knowing what attitude is correct. the more people get higher education, the better atomosphere in the society.
The college or university students I met on the street are generally very polite and happy to help other people with the knowledge and skill they learnt from school.
Though a number of college and universities in Taiwan is do good to people to receive higher education easily. However, compared with average number of students in various school, the schools seem a little oversupplied. I found the gap of student's performance in different school sometimes is quite big. Therefore, I would suggest that every university or college whether it is government owned or private owned should do the best and spare no efforts to improve the facult and equipment, in order that student can learn more skill and knowledge to fit to the society during the school day or in the future. That would be really a positive impact to our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Due to the Education Authority allow more colleges and universities to establish in Taiwan, the number of high education organizations is increasing. More students are able to receive higher education. However, I don't think this will have a positive impact on our society. There are at least two following reasons.
First of all, the population of Taiwan is decreasing. More young couples choose to get marry without children. It means that some colleges or universities won't have enough students in the near future, except they allow student enter the school without high academic quality. Secondly, If school can enter colleges and universities easily, they would not study hard in high schools or even in junior high schools. This phenomenon will be bad influence for our education system.
To sum up, I oppose that Taiwan should increase the number of colleges or universities. It won't improve the competition for our students. The more high educational school, the worse academic quality of students.

subject: HW-0801
content:
With the government policy, there are more and more colleges and universities in Taiwan. It might be positive impacts on our society, but negative impacts will overpass positive ones. My opinions are represented as following.
First, higher supply of colleges and universities make the pass rate of college entrance exam over one hundred percent which means that students can go to college without studying hard. After graduating from school, they don't have any advantages to compete with others. It just wastes of time and money to join the college.
Second, I think that not everyone should go to the college or university. People should consider why they should have higher education. Earning more money or finding a better job is not a proper reason because higher education isn't the only way to reach these goals.
Lastly, there are not so many techers to offer high quality education for students.
To sum up, the origin goal of policy makers was good which want to enhance human resource quality, while the policy direction was going wrong. Therefore, I think this phenomenon is bad for our society.

subject: HW-0801
content: No, I don't think this will have a positive impact on our society because of two reasons. The first reason is that this phenomenon increase our educational years. Several years ago, if you graduated from a college, you could find a very good job. But now, there're so many people who graduate from colleges, so graduating from colleges is not unusual. And if you want a good job, you mush have PD or PhD. So there're more and more college students who graduate from school deciding to continuing studying. Therefore, our studying lives become 18 years, maybe more, rather than 16 years. The second one is that the lisence which proves that you have graduated from colleges become meaningless, because anyone can have one. No matter how low you scored on the Colleage Ability Test, you still can enter a college. You might receive many praises when you graduated from a college thirty years ago, but now it seldom happens unless the college you graduate from is the top one or famous one. Therefore, if we want to prove that we're high-educated, it's not enough that we just have graduated from colleges or universities.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As an old saying goes, knowledge is power. In Taiwan more and more people get the opportunities to college. Educational quality is higher than any time in the past. There are several idea on this phenomenon
First, Taiwan doesn't have a lot of natural resource. We need to rely on the novelty and creativity to compete with other countries. More people can get high-educational, so our country will keep the advantage. Second, Education could reduce social problems. Through getting well-educated the poor people could find better jobs. Through getting well-educated, Adolescents could understand the meaning of the life and prevent from commiting crimes.
Finally, high-education could broaden your horizon, and then you can accept other different cultures and custom. By the way, the whole world will become more peaceful and people will have less conflicts
In conclusion, higher education has so many advantages, so families and the government should spent more money and efforts offering children the chance to go to college.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In the recent years, the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan has increased tremendously. I do not think that it is a normal phenomenon. In my opinion, this phenomenon will not have a positive impact on our society.
The increase of the number of colleges and universities does not mean the improvement of the education quality. I find that Some schools' purpose is making money instead of providing better education. Besides, students can get the admission of the colleges and universities quite easily. It seems that the students do not have to study hard for the admission anymore. Meanwhile, some schools can only recruit some students who are not so qualified may not get the jobs once they graducate from the colleges and universities. They will feel frustruated. They probably can not accept the cruel fact that they can not get the job although they have bachelor or master degrees. They will always blame on the economic situation, and ingnore the truth that they are not good enough.
We live in such a competitive world. Therefore, it is very important to improve the quality of education, not to increase the number of the schools. I believe that most parents will want their children to receive better education, instead of getting the schools' admission easily. Thus, I hope that our government can find the best policy for the best education quality.

subject: HW-0801
content:
With a number of colleges and universaties poping up, there are more and more students that are capable of receiving higher education. It is said that if students have money, no matter how bad scores they get, they can still enter the colleges.
This phenomenon seems odd, and as far as I am concerned, it does no good to our society. Since the number of college students increases, there are still few "real" college students. A real college student is someone who should have some specific abilities and always be prepared for devoting himself to the society, not just has a certificate of college. Unfortunately most of college students nowadays are not "real". In my point of view, these "fakes" are only wasting the resorce of education. In other words, they have no positive impact on our society.
On the other hand, if I were a boss, I wouldn't hired one who is not just as capable as their certificates show. So it is useless to enter the college just for certificates. That is to say though more students are able to receive higher education, they still unable to do anything for society.
To sum up, I don't consider the phenomenon good. Students should receive higher education not just because the number of colleges and universities increases. On the contrary They should make themself have real ability to get their college qualification.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In my opinion, I don't agree that the phenomenon has positive effect on our society. Alough education department of goverment's policy is good to make people receive higher education, increase in colleges and universities without controlling in teaching quality and quanity leads to almost every one has college degree. In fact, not all people is suited for higher education in born, every one has his or her career plan without having university education.
First, there are too many people have university degree in Taiwan. Some people may not have the ability and talent as a normal university graduate student, because the school's teaching quality they graduate from are worse than national universities. These students are less competitive than good school ones in labor market. That's why unemployment rises as rockets for graducate students.
Second, higher education is for top students to learn advance matrials. it is responsibe to cultivate our country's higher labor force in the future, such as doctors, teachers, lawyers and engineers. The students stands for our country competiveness in the global village. People without passion in studying is not supposed to go to university, and they can learn new work techniques. Thus, not all people is suited for higher education, the high education resources should not waste on people who don't like studying. As a consequence, I think this idea is not good.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I think it will have a negative impact on our society. Students getting bad grades in high school means they are not interested in studying, but the increasing number of colleges may become some kind of pressure that makes them go to college to get the graduation provements.
First, this makes the quality of college students get lower. Second, the circumstance makes better students getting higher grades like P.H.D. in order to get better jobs. Third, it is a wasting of educational and social resources. Forth, the colleges are too many that the students entry percentege is high than 100%. Fifth, they are wasting their time which they can contribute to the society. Sixth, as long as Taiwan is developing, the birth rate is getting lower, and that indicates too many colleges is a kind of wastes, because they will be tore up one day.
The above reasons are why I thing increasing number of college may have a negative impact on society. Although there exists advantage of it, the disadvantages are still more.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are more and more students are able to get into colleges and universities in Taiwan in recent years. It has been reported that every student can major in a course even he/she gets low grades in exam of joint-venture of universities. In my opinion, it is not good phenomenon to our society although some people say that students receive higher education than the past 10 years of Taiwan.
There are reasons that I think it is not a positive impact on Taiwan's society. First, if every student can get into a colleges or universty to study, some students will not study hard to prepare for the exam of colleges and universities. It leads to the problem of quality vs quantity. Second, the distribution of educational resource always focus on public universities which perform good in adminstration and have good graduates. So students pay more tuition to share the budget of universities if they do not get into public universities. It is a problem for students from poor families. They can not afford the expense from universities. Third, there are more and more students graduated from universities. They need to compete for few job opportunities. Most of company will choose students from public universities. So it is difficult for students from private universities to find a job.
In conclusion, the number of colleges and universities should hold for a better quality.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Quality or Quantity, which one is more important? There are more and more colleges and universities being built in Taiwan. Yeah, the quantity of colleges increased, but how about their quality? Can they provide good educational quality? Can they provide good teachers? Can they provide the equipment of researching and teaching? That's a problem of uncertain. Then, in this situation, can they insure that the students graduated from these colleges are competitive? After all, the increasing of students graduated from colleges doesn't mean the lack of employees in companies increases. That's why there's a popular idiom says:"Graduation means Unemployment." If you can't prove your ablity, prove that you really have a skill that others don't, how could you expect that the supervisor will hire you?
The society is moving and changing faster than ever, and it's also more competitive. If you ask me if the Increasing of colleges and universities will have a positive impact of Taiwan's society, my answer is not. I think there are just that much resource, and good quantity of colleges doesn't mean good quality. The only way to make the students more competitive is increase the quality of education in colleges and universities, not quantity.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Because of the education policy, we have lots of college and universities in Taiwan. Absolutey, students in Taiwan have much more opportuities to enter universities from senior high school. However, Never does every university provides a perfect environment to students. For example, lots of classroom are old and dirty. Besides, government diverges the education resource. Money is shared by a number of universities. No matter every student recieve less advantage from our country.
In this situation, some students can't have good abilities when graduating from colleges. They can't think deeply and find a job. On the other hand, they can't contest with people around the world.
In my opinion, the government should reduce universitis in Taiwan. We have to take experiences from Japan or America. What students need is not just a college. They need a "great" college which can make them excellent and powerful.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receives higher education. In my opinion, there are three positive impact on our society which are increasing of our mankind resource, increasing of our living level and spreading our own culture to the world more easily.
First of all, more colleges provide more education information to students. The students get more advanced skills and master those skills. Our mankind resource would be increase. We get not only the number of people but also get their knowledge. For example, there are more and more people research about the technology of nano meter. And we get the knowledge which other countries don't, we are stronger than those countries.
In addition, knowledge lead technology advance quickly. After technology breakthrough, more useful tools appear which increase our living level. For instance, MRT is a whole new transportation tools in Taiwan, which have had influence on our daily life. No matter the students or businessmen, most of them in Taipei already can't live without MRT. The MRT systems makes us save money and time and reduces the pollution caused by car.
Finally, those educated people help us spread our own unique culture to the world more easily and quickly. For example, some of our college students wants to go abroad to more modern county such as America for learning and researching. And while they being there, they show our culture to others. Moreover, the place which we, the yellow race, built for meeting with others and remind home such as Chinese Noodle Store sometimes attracts many foreigners. Those foreigners would connect with our culture and spread it out.
In summary, more colleges increase our mankind resource. Moreover, increasing of the universities would increase our living level. Finally, higher education makes we have the ability to go abroad and spread our own unique culture to the whole world.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more colleges and universities in Taiwan. In my point of view, it is not appropriate. There are several reasons to support my idea.
First, almost all the high school students have chances to recieve higher education. The graduation certificates of colleges are not as worthy as before. Second, if we want to be more competitive, we have to pay more money on education. In the past, it is hard to be a college student. Now, we have to attain bachelor or master degrees to prove our abilities. Last but not least, some people want to work instead of studying. In the case that the number of colleges and universities increases, they have to waste a large amount of time on studying. It will lessen our national power.
To sum up, we have to control the number of colleges and universities. At the time we highten the quantity, we should care about the quality of schools.
The increasing number of colleges and universities does not really have a positive impact on our society at all.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I don't think this will have a positive impact on our society. On the contrary, I think it will have a negative impact on our society instead.
Here are four reasons based on my opinion. First of all, as the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, the quality of students goes down. Students don't need to study hard to get in to a college or university. Also, colleges and universities won't care about the quality of students as long as they have enough students to support their finance needs. Second, companies can't evaluate a student by his/her diploma. Since students get in colleges and universities easily, their diplomas won't represent their abilities, either. Certifications in computer, finance, or English might be more useful than their diplomas. Next, due to the first two reasons, students will be forced to study master degree in order to be better than other students. In addition, the birth rate in Taiwan is decreasing year by year. There will be too many colleges and universities as the time goes by. It's just wasting our social resources.
To sum up, as the number of colleges and universities increases in Taiwan, it has a negative impact on our society. The government should do something about it as soon as possible.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are more and more universities in Taiwan. It is not easy to define whether it has positive impact or negative impact. I think that universities are high education which wouldn't need everyone to study.
In fact, in Taiwan's society, it is a common conception that studies are the only way to work in higher position. So, more and more students go to cram school in order to go to universities. That produce a bad cycle that students need to study more for finding a good job.
We need to learn from Americans. They have more ways for children to find their interest and ability. Their children are independent and know what they do. They won't always want to go to universities like us. Our government must think about that we have less children before, that is, some universities will closed in the future. I hope that universities can be better but not just build more universities.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the industrial developement in Taiwan, more and more colleges or universities can be seen nowadays. However, does it good for our child in the modern society, or just a way to make money for some person?
Last year, TV news says that only eighteen scores can get the admission to the university For me, a student yet in the university, I feel hesitated why I need to study so hard to enter a college so easily, even though I guess without taking any sight on the test sheet.
Noneless, gradute from the university is common in Taiwan. We lose the competitive power in the society. Unemployment rate get higer and higher for the graduate. It is the phenomenon that in Taiwan. Can't live up by ourselves, can't support our family. We can do nothing. How poor it is.
The large number of universities does not represent the higher educational quality. Simultaneously, it means being a college or univeristy student doesn't represent everything like yesterday. Fortunately, the government step in. We can't let the quality of the university become more poor.
I don't think it is positive impact the many colleges or universities is located in so small island but is it still not negative. We can still improve our quality. That's what the higher education need now.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I don't think it's going to lead to a good result of more and more colleges and universities established in Taiwan these past years. I think it'll be a big trouble choosing the fine employees for the employer in Taiwan, and will make the students studying in college frustrated about the future.
According to a newspaper, a employer in Taiwan stopped his business and went to India. The journalist asked him some questions about why he left in Taiwan and he said "the quality of universary and college students has increased a lot, but the quantity seems to decrease a lot. Like the journalists, always ask rediculous question when there is a destruction. That's the main reason why I leave Taiwan for India.
It's definitely a truth that the system of education in Taiwan should get an obvious change. If we always teach students how to prepare for tests in order to get a good grade on the tests and never explain why, then we'll definitely be fail in the field which we're good at.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowaday in Taiwan, more and more colleges and universities are estabelished. It is believed that the numbers of new-borned babies are decreasing, every parents want their children got A plus in anywhere, the things you eat, you wear, you buy and most important of all, the IQ children got, must be very good. But now more and more people are study in law. In fact, more and more people are studying in profasional subjects in higher education. No questionable, it can help us to have a better life.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In Taiwan's society, it always values one's education degree highly. It's the normal condition for the most students to get higher and higher education. It make the big impact on our society structure. However, I am not willing to see the situation like this.
First, What I considerate is that if the company need so many employee with so highly education degree. In my observation, there are some jobs which may need much more knowledge with high education, but others don't. For example, the phone answer or the cleaner.
Second, I think one can learn more skill and experience in the job. And, we can understand what we are really interesting in. at that time, it's not too late to back to the school, learn more and get higher education. After job, we may more cherrish the chance to learn the new knowledge.
To sum up, I don't think that is a great idea to recive highe education without clear target.

subject: HW-0801
content:
(1) I don't agree on this phenomeno will give a positive way on our society. As the number of colleges and universities increases, the Competitive power of Taiwanese will decrease.
(2) First, coming with the phenomenon, many new univesities just transformed from the career school, they can't catch the way that traditional universities can give to their students. So how to solve this problem and increase our competitive power is one of the most important question on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
While some countries still are composed of illectuall people, Taiwan has high education level, which we can infer from the increasing number of Taiwan's colleges and universities. In my opinion, though this phenomenon seems good, it actually isn't like what it appears. For example, some of the colleges employ foreign teachers to teach English; however, the teachers' real profession may be a truck driver or just an house wife in want of money. Under such education, the graduates of these colleges or universities may have poor abilities and are ace at nothing. What's worse, if some firms employ these graduates, they may give rise to some serious problems, such as misunderstand what foreigners talk or calculate the wrong numbers of import goods and export goods.
Thus, I don't think it's a positive impact on our society. Instead, I think it some what does harm to our society. To sum up, though the number of Taiwan's colleges and universities increases, we need to find out and give the students the real high education not just only the diploma of college or university.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receive higher education. However, this won't have a positive impact on our society.
Higher education is, in my opinion, a kind of elite education. It offers the society high-qualified researchers and human resources. These elites maintain the normal operation of the society such as lawyers, doctors, teacher, engineers etc. These professions need highly trained and educated people. It means that if the number of colleges and universities increases, higher education is not higher education because it can't ensure the quality of these booming colleges and their students. We don't know if the colleges have excellent professors and equipments and we don't know if their students have interest and ability to dedicate themselves to higher education, either. For example, if you are a patient to see a doctor who gets insufficient training and education, would you dare to go again? If you are a mother of a child, would you dare to have your child taught by a teacher without enough training and education? The answers to the two questions are both NO!
Therefore, I oppose to increase the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan in order to ensure the quality of higher education for the benefit of our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are more and more college graduates in our society because the number of colleges and universities is increasing. I don't think this will have positive influence on our society. First of all, the quality of the higher education is decreasing. The requirement of entering colleges is lowering and the performance and the standard of college students are not good enough. Schools can't find so many competant teachers, as a result, students can't grow much in knowledge and ability.
Secondly, college or university diploma is not equal to the ability to work. It is not the only thing you need to be successful. Among all the people who have wonderful contribution to our society, many of them didn't have college or university diplomas.
Thirdly, emphasizing college and university diplomas too much will make young students lose ballance in their life of learning. Nowadays, students spend too much time in cram school. They need more free time to develop more talents and find out what they really interested in. Than they can be successful and contribute to our society more.

subject: HW-0801
content: Apart from the situation in the past, more and more students are able to receive higher education nowadays. Everything has its bright as well as dark side and this phenomenon is not an exception. In my opinion, a society filled up with people who have received high education is defenitely a positive thing. The general moral standard, manners, and a great deal of aspects could be improved if people in Taiwan all received high education. I take the MRT to go to school everyday and I've noticed that almost everyone in the priority seats would stand up immediately and yield their seats to elderly people or young children. This is not one specific incident; people do acknowledge the fact that we are taught to behave like this and it is right to do so. On the contray, since a lot of students could receive higher education, the quality of college graduates seem to be not that high as it used to be. We see this sort of news on the television on a daily basis -- the ability of college students are getting lower each year or a survey shows that even if the amount of college students increases, employers fail to find the appropriate ones for their companies. As a result, I regard the phenomenon as a crucial convert of our society. It is both positive and negative.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There is no denying that more and more colleges and universities are "popping up" in today's society. In essence, the phenomenon can be thought of as the progress of education and the implication that Taiwan is becoming even more democratic because the democracy system is tremendously based on excellent education. Nevertheless, I don't think the phenomenon will have positive impact on our society and in contrast, it may do much harm to Taiwan.
The reasons why I hold such attitude toward it are as follows. To being with, with increasing colleges, students in Taiwan can be admitted to schools easily, which can give rise to such distorted thought that they can get into colleges without any efforts and perseverance. This negative attitude will then result in the decrease in competition. Taiwan will lose the predominant economy stage in the world because of this. If students in Taiwan can acquire college diploma so easily, it will have the above-mentioned negative influence. Also, a large number of collegs will consume a great deal of resource including people such as teachers and school executives, considerable water as well as electricity supply and land to build schools.
In a nutsell, an over-large quantity of schools will have Taiwan lose competition and resource; thus I don't hold positive attitude toward the "crisis".

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, as our economy relys on high-techonology industry, high education is strongly needed when you look for a job. However, we can still discover that many people with high education, such as Ph.D. can't find a job. It's due to the policy of our government that the colleges and universities are everywhere. Although it seems open a way for students to enjoy high education much easier, actually it is not.
As colleges and universities being established one after one, it is difficult for the government to monitor the quality of these colleges. Therefore, students graduate from college without professinol knowledge and skill. There's no company would like to hire an employee like this. Consequently, students from famous colleges and universities, such as Taiwan University, are still the company's best choices and dominate most of the job openings.
For those who can't find a job, their only way to survive in this competitive society is to get a much higher education. That is, go aboard or get a Ph.D. There is no doubt that getting the Ph.D costs a great deal of money and takes a lot of time. Somehow it is a waste of resource in education.
In my opinion, founding colleges and universities is a great idea to make more people share the knoweledge. However, it is no denying that we need an appropriate plan to prevent the bad effects on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
More and more colleges and universities appear in Taiwan recently, making students more easily to receive higher education. College graduates are all around and the employers can have access to good-quality labors. Sounds like great but I don't think so.
In my mother's generation, there were few colleges so students at that time studied very hard in order to enter a college. However, the students now can play the computer games and watch TV all the day, he don't have to study but he can enter the university as other hardworking students. It causes the quality of the students isn't as good as before and the hardworking students have to study in the graduate school in order to make difference to the lazy one. So I don't think it's a good idea to have a lot of colleges in Taiwan. As a student, I hope our government can perceive this phenomenon and do something.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In my opinions, the increasing number of colleages and universities in Taiwan is very harmful to our society.
Since it is much easier to graduate from the university and to get a "beautiful" degree, the number of doctors was also increasing. This mean a degree mean nothing to us, because everyone is at the same leve -- we all have a degree. If I was not in the spot light and a degree counldn't make people believe that I was in the highest position of the education, who would hire me for a professional job? Because it's too easy to graduate from universities, students who do poorly on their intellectual performing can get a degree like students woho are very outstanding. It makes the society feel like the colleage students are worse than the previous generations. The society has no confident that the new generation can handle the heavy responsibility of the future of Taiwan. As you have heard, people called the students who were born in 1980s to 1990s are "strawberry", which means that we are least able to concour difficulities and to handle the relationship with other people. This is all because the average
performents of the colleage students is decreasing. If a "doctor" was really outstanding, he would not have to stay in line waiting for a position of a library security guard.
I think the number of the universities and colleages doesn't need to be very large to show that public are very educated. Only the colleages that raise more perfect and outstanding experts can make a difference to the furture of the society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases quite fast, more students are able to receive higher education. I think that could mean our society has become more developed and mature. However, what is bothering me is that the quality of higher education is not equally improved and there is hardly any way to stop new schools from establishing.
In my opinion, if we want our children who receive higher education will really do something good to our society, we must establish a set of rules for colleges and universities to follow. Those rules should include restrictions on founding a new school, clear standard of evaluation of schools already exist and so on. What I try to express is that the number of schools itself can't guarantee a positive impact on our society, but the quality can. We should set rules for schools to follow to improve the quality of students, teachers and schools as a whole so as to make students who receive higher education can be useful to our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:

The education policy of Main Land China doen not increase universities so that many farmers are too poor to read books. Comparing the Main Land China with Taiwan, people will know what is the reasons we have to increase the number of universities.
Some people may say that these graduated studends will not easy to get a job because of competition; however, this depends on student's learning in school. The English pronounciation of "university" sounds like "you can play four years in a university" in Chinese pronounciation. If students always play in schools, they will hard to get jobs certainlly The ability of students relies on the trainings in school.
In conclusion, I suggest that the government not only have to increase the number of colleages and universities but also encourages the students studying hard during their learning time.

subject: HW-0801
content:
