Nowadays on the streets everywhere are more than ever those undergraduates, masters and PHDs competing for a stable job with good income. Therefore, the job requirement for many jobs have been set higher and higher, which continuously push people to receive higher and higher education. Nevertheless, with more and more people with high education and wide knowledge, the society and the world could improve faster and provide the citizens with better living environment, more convenient and efficient lifestyle.
Moreover, medical improvement is another major advantage for the people. People receive higher education and acquire wider and deeper knowledge to protect not only themselves but also people around them, people in the country and even people around the world from disease, illness and affections.
Overall, with the above mentioned reasons, I personally think more and more people receive higher education would have a positive impact on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Thirty years ago, only thirty percent of the high school students can enter a college or an university, every student study very hard in order to apply an university. But nowadays, due to the number of colleges and universities increases, almost every student can enter a college unless they don't want. I do not think it is a good phenomenon to our society, if every student can enter and graduate from university easily, we can not seprate a good student with a bad student, graduate from university seems useless, so every one keep study graduate school, it makes people marry and gave birth late.
Another disadvantage of the increasing number of colleges and universities is that every one wants to be a college or university student, after graduate from school, they all want to sit in an office cube with air conditioner and do their work, no one wants to stand under the sun that make themselves hot or fix a car and let their hands dirty. It is a bad phenomenon that everyone dreamed about enter a college or university without notice its quarlity and do not want to those hard work because they think they are a college or university student.
This situation will made our society end of a caos.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I don't agree that there sould be so many colleges or universities in Taiwan. In fact, I don't think this phenomenon has a positive impact. There are two reasons supporting my view.
First, since there are too many schools in high-level education, the country has to divide the money and other educational resource into small pieces to cover every school. In that way, all schools can't get much support from the country. And then it affect the educational environment finally.
Second, it doesn't need all students and teenager to put themself in high-level education. In other way, it isn't anyone that wants to study. We don't have to push them into school, but we can encourage them going forward to what they eager.
Under these two reasons, I think it isn't a good idear to increas the amout of the schools blindly.

subject: HW-0801
content:
At the time when there are a large number colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more and more students are able to receive higher education, including me. For me, my dream is to be a biologist someday, so I have to get higher education to be a professor. In my opinion, at this time when there are lots of knowledge to learn about, it's necessary to have higher education.
There're three reasons of receiving higher education, a large number of colleges, more knowledge, and getting a better job. The first reason is there are too many colleges in Taiwan. Because of this reason, everyone can get education. If you want to win other people, it's better for you to have higher education. The second reason is there are more knowledge to learn. Comparing to the past, we have more to learn in colleges which isn't enough, so we have to receive higher grades. Last but not least, it is getting better job. Statistic shows that you will get more money if you receive higher grades. Recieving higher education is important for students nowadays.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As more students are able to receive higher education, it will do good to our society. We have more and more colleges and universities now, which means more and more people are in the pursuit of getting professional education.
First of all, Taiwan's economic is much better than that decades ago, and it is without doubt that we could spend more time studying instead of working in the farm making a living. Second, companies regard your degree as the priority when they hire you. Your degree ensure that you have learned something in that field at least. Third, the public will have a large number of choice to take in what they are interested in, not to worry about where to get the information. To sum up, I think the soaring number of the colleges and universities leaves no harm to our society. It indicates the general cherish the hope of stepping in a higher position, in both education and the work place.

subject: HW-0801
content:
The number of colleges and universities in Taiwan are increasing, more and more students are able to receive higher education. It seems like the quality of student in Taiwan is getting better, but I think the truth is not exactly the same as we see.
First of all, the students actually will become lazier. Because as they know there are more universities appearing, they'll look themselves as the person who has already had a university to enter and won't study harder even lazier. What all the students have to do is studying, if students don't study, it just wastes not only the students' time but also the educational resources.
Second, once the students who don't study enter colleges or universities, it might low down the quality of colleges and universities. Worst of all, if the students take the laziness as a habit, they won't be ambitious, they even won't start to think about what they are going to do or what they want to do when they graduate from school life.
I think the students are the possession of the society, because the society needs students to make it better. In addition to some successful bussiness men, they will donate some money to a college or university to help the school to inspire more and more potential students, expecting the students will dedicate themselves to the society when they graduate. If the students are not ambitious and don't won't to work hard, it is useless to have so many universities and colleges.

subject: HW-0801
content: Yes, I think it will have a positive impact on our society. First when the country who can support the large number of schools, it means this country is mature enough. Second, when the schools are more and more, it means our people who have the chances to touch the higher education that our companies have the more changes to get the people they wanted. The types of job are progressed and the quality of works have to be updated at the same time. Finally, it could help people to know more about their own country, own town, to care about the things which are not so related to themselves. Because if the range that you can care which is bigger and bigger what means the higher education have the positive effort on you.

subject: HW-0801
content:
It is true that there are more and more under graduates in taiwan. In general, this is a good phenomenon, because your raservay will be good. But in the other hand, it might be a warning. Because is more easier than before to enter colleges, students' ability to compete with others will reduce. Most of them have thoughts that it is very easy to enter the college anyway, then why should they work hard to reach the goal. The result is most of our students' ability is not enough to handle their job or even compete with other students around the world. In China, the rate of college freshman is less then five percent every year. On the contrary, the rate of freshman is reaching one hundred percent every year. That means almost every student who takes the exam to qulify college can pass. I am sure this is not good. Thanks to this phenomenon, more and more big companies don't take college education as higher education, instead, they take it as average or worse. All in all, I think it dose not matters how many colleges there are. What matters is students
themselves. If students can work harder incresing their capability, it will be easier to compete with others or even get theirselves on top of the world.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I don't think this situation will have a positive influence on Taiwan's education because of the following reasons.
First of all, what Taiwan has now is more colleges, not more skillful students. We just lower the standard of entering colleges. That doesn't mean that Taiwan's education quality is better than before. As a result, I think what the government should focus on is making Taiwanese students more competitive when they enter the society instead of allowing everyone to get into colleges. Otherwise, colleges wouldn't be as valuable as before.
Secondly, I think the more colleges Taiwan has, the more easier for Taiwanese students to enter universities. Therefore, some students wouldn't study hard because entering a college is not a tough task. However, after graduating from colleges, they will find that there are fierce comptetions in this society and have difficulty having a job because they didn't make enough efforts before.
To sum up, I think this situation is not positive for Taiwanese students. What students have to do is improving their skills to seek for good jobs in the future, not just entering a college. And "working hard" to get into colleges is a remarkable life experience for students.

subject: HW-0801
content:
More colleges and universities are there, and more students get to universities without hard working. According to the news, the student who only got 18 in entrance exmination can go to a university. How weird it is. It is unfair to those who studied hard, isn't it.
I think that if they don't take going to university serious, they won't have the good attitude on studying. Those grades of entrancing exmination may not show the real person who you are, but can show the effort you made on the schoolwork and how the person look as the things. Therefore, the thing of increasing more universities doesn't mean more good education to society but tells that students have more chance not to study hard. Because person who get poorest grade can also go to university. For me, more and more colleges and universities just bring more undiligent people into society. The education of society fails down.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In a highly competitive society, how can we prove that we are better than others? Generally, the answer may be considered a higher educated level. However, I think what is the most important is one's ability, not only studying scores.
As much more colleges and universities increases, have we ever thought seriously about the quality of them? I had seen a news that a student enter a college with his score -- 5. We all know to finish study in colleges or universities is must. But don't ignore what is really we need to develop. To be a college student is easy, but to be a successful person is d.
(2) Our school requests us to learn four languages, therefore, we not only study for exam but truely learn the useful ability.

subject: HW-0801
content:
The increasement of colleges and universities number offer more opportunities for students to receive higher education. Students have more chances to learn the things what they really like.
Since go to university is not as hard as past, students can study not only the common subjects taught in high school, but the other they are interested in. The diversification in college provide students to learn more. For example, they can have a lot of different experiences, learn how to work with others, last but not least, know who himself is. Since college is just like a little society, let more students to have this training experience is nothing but good.
There's a lot of college students, in other words, there's a lot of specialist. All students learn different things in college. Therefore, we have more people to support our country improvement. Also, corporations can find more potentials in Taiwan.
Even though someone think that lots of college students may diminish the quality about students' capicity, but in my opinion, it just means the competition to get a good job is delate to future. Students will meet the competition not in the time whether they can go to college, but after college. Students still need to work hard and enhence their capacity to find a job. As a result, more colleges doesn't means diminish the quality, but give more students to find infinite potential.

subject: HW-0801
content:
This has become a hot news in Taiwan that the number of universities is increasing. It also show a phenomenon that the more students can enter the university, the more students can enter the university, the more graduaters will increase in our society. I am of the opinion that this will have a terrible impact on our society. And the reason will be told in the following paragraphs.
To begin with, some educators are hotly encouraging the more universities will increase the level of our society, the more young students can enter the university and receive the higher education and absorb the better resources in school. But, the educators didn't realize the organism to seperate the better students into a better unversity is getting worse. Some students even had 18 scores and they became university students as well. It should take a balance to deal with the problems.
Next to go would be, owing to the number of university students increase, the students know how to gain their abilites and face the fierce society. They promote their values and keep working hard.
Last but not least, although I don't agree to increase the number of university, I deeply believe the students whether in higher school in Taiwan or not will find their own way and create the road belongs to them.

subject: HW-0801
content: I think that too many colleges and universities in Taiwan can be a big problem. In Taiwan, there are more and more colleges and universities established and are to increase the number of college students in the future, but many experts do not think this will have a positive impact on our society, on the contrary, they are afraid it will become a serious social problem in our society. For one thing, since college education is the better education that can let you learn more about your professional skills, it should be limited in order to remain the high quality of college education. If there are too many colleges there, it would be likely to decrease it's value and may destory the balance of a society. For aonther thing, according to some experts' report, some of the colleges do not established for education but for money only. It means the students are cheated. No contest, too many colleges really has a negative impact on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In recent years, the number of college has been incredibly increasing, since the Department of Education thinks it will enhance the level of Taiwan's students and will increase more and more profesional. However, the experts of the educational community are strongly against the policy. They thought it will imbalance Taiwan's academic quality between profesion and vocation. At last, the goverment still puts the policy into effect despite various opposing advices.
In my opinion, I don't agree with the policy for two reasons. First, even if it adds the rate of entering colleges, the students are not promised to enter the exellent university and their ideal college. Second, the students with high diploma can easily be seen, and they don't take a proper work. In my father's year, people who had a diploma of college were prone to receive a higher position in the company. But now, people having studied in the university do not receive as much respect as before. So I don't think the policy is right and has a good impact on our society, and have made the number of the students studying in college explode, instead.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are more and more schools setting up in Taiwan. Many students consider it is a good thing that they may have more choices and less students in a class or school, while I believe that it might have negative impacts in the future. There are two reasons as my foundation.
First of all, the schools are commercialized in order to compete with each other. They offer amount of scholarship for students who have exceptional test results. The living price has gone up continuously. Students would be less stressful to think about the study and the expenses.
Secondly, the government has to put more budgets on education which might influence our taxes. It is undoubtful if schools need some money from government in order to facilitized the hardwares. The tax-payers will be charged more than it used to be because of the extra expense on it.
As a result, it will cause a big problem if the schools keep increasing. The schools used to be the most secred place to learn and receive knowledge. Besides, the heavy taxes will make us more difficult to live on. Therefore, the number of colleges and universities should be cut down into the appropriate numbers.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, as the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receive higher education, but does the diploma which they're holding in their hands, really proves their abilities, IQs and EQs? I've heard a lot of people saying these, "Graduate from universities equalls to unemployed" and "The number of students graduating in Taiwan each year is far more than the numbers of stray animals we see on streets." Receiving a higher education, like masters and doctors, doesn't mean they have the ability to work in a company. What I am trying to say is that this isn't any positive impact to our society.
A graduate doctor, who has studied abroad and just came back to Taiwan, would think of a salary definitely higher than we would all have expected. They think of themselves as "high level standards" and should receive more than that. In a company, a manager would rather hire someone whose attention isn't just on "money", but who is willing to learn, responsible and is willing to work hard for the company. A manager would also wants all his employees to get along well. Can we see these in those graduated doctors?
Getting a higher education means getting a high salary job is totally wrong. Taiwan may have eighty percent of students graduating from university each year, but is this really "the real high quality"? If it's true then why is "this" been highlighted on news each year and why is everyone complaining about "this"?

subject: HW-0801
content:
In recent years, the number of college students has raised in an umbelievable speed. Thus, more and more people have the chance to get into college and to receive a higher education in school. However, the kink of phenomenon has caused some bad effect in both the students and the society. The following paragraphs are the reasons that I think this kind of phenomenon is harmful for the society.
As far as I am concerned, people want to receive a higher education because they want to get a higher paid job than others. They study hard during the four years and think they could get a good job after graduating. However, they find it hard to even have a job after leaving school. The reason is that now that everybody could get into the university, no matter you are stupid or smart, your college degree is not a "higher education" anymore, which means you are as normal as other people. In this case, you have to receive more higher education such as graduate school or even doctor degree to make you much more special than others. The result will be everyone seems so good, but nobody is special.
The second reason is the quality of college students may become worse year by year with the college students increase. Few months ago, the news reported that people only need eighteen points to get into a college (the total is five hundred). It is a ridiculous thing because colleges supposed to be good enough for those who study hard, not the people who only have money but without proficiency in their subject. If those people really enter the college and graduate, people will find it hard to tell the differences beween "high education" people with others.
The third reason is that this sociey actually does not need so much "high education" people.

subject: HW-0801
content:
A senior high school student attended collage with only eighteen scores last year. This news surprised the society. In addition, it also pointed out a problem that it is easier to receive higher education in Taiwan. Some experts do not think it is a good phenomenon because it might break the high education's system. However, I think it will have a positive impact on our society.
First, it means more and more students can receive higher education as long as they want. In this way, they can get the second chance if they did not know the value of knowledge in the past. Still, they can chase those who are superior during the years in college. Then, some people also criticize that the population would be more than vacancies of jobs. However, in my opinion, it is higher education that teaches students know how to study and how to deal with this society but not teaches knowledge in text books. Therefore, as everyone could get high education, we can expect our society's quality makes great progress in the future.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As more and more colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, some scholars and critics are worried about the standard and quality of universities may get lower. As a result, they consider to cut some colleges that don't live up to standard or boost the standard of entering the college. But I hold the belief that it will have a positive impact on our society. The following reasons are my own opinions.
First, it can boost the most students' education standards. Once the students entering the universities, they will surely gain more knowledge and view the world through wider pespectives. However, not every college is as good as Taiwan University, but I still believe that every student can develop different abilities through a variety of ways.
Second, everyone can aware the importance of education. The citizens in Taiwan can gradually feel the sense of education by means of these colleges. It is no doubt that only the education can boost the economy of a country.
I still hold a positive thought to the education in Taiwan, which will be better in the future. And these colleges will lead a better sociey, where everyone here is eager to learning.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I don't think that more students able to receive higher education will have a positive impact on our society. There are a number of reasons. To begin with, education is necessary for everyone if he or she wants to get a better job. However, it's not proper for everyone to receive higher education since it's not the only way for people to be successful. Second, many talented or gifted people can do whatever they are good at and don't have to waste their time going to school. Moreover, lots of famous people don't receive higher education. Take Bill Gates for example, but he runs a very good company, which makes the world quite different as usual. Thus, whatever jobs you get if you can help other people and do good on the society is a wonderful contribution. Finally, you must think twice whether you'll benefit from higher education. Don't just fool around and goof off all these years. On the other hand, if you can make up your mind and take good advantages of your time, you'll have a rosy future. There is a
proveb that says, "Don't put the cart before the horse." All in all, it's not suitable for everyone to receive higher education.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In my view of points, I do not agree with the statement because of some reasons I would like to express as follows.
First, if there are more and more universities in Taiwan, it means that none of the students can not enroll a university. In this way, those students who lack the abilities and qualities to be an undergraduate can still aquire the diploma after wondering on campus for 4 years. Since this, these graduates can not apply for any job which they hope for at all because the can not match the needs.
Second, it will be wasting of time and money if the high education open the gate to everyone. There are huge gaps among privelige schools and low-teer schools in truth; as a result, most companies would decide to employ those who graduate from good schools rather than those poor ones. Then, why should we have more and more colleges in Taiwan? It would be better for those students to go to work instead of enrolling colleges.
Thus, once there are more unqualified students enroll colleges, there will be lacks of workers in Taiwan society. And this would put more stress on the workers because they have to support their children who should go to work. Then, the purpose of education is upside down because it put people in difficulties instead.
There will be less and less students if the rate of new-born babies still decreases in the following years. Then, there is no need to construct any new colleges or it would be wasting of the social resources from money to faculty. The Ministry of Education should think on this isse and should not give permissions easily for building new colleges. However, the minister have to consider how to improve the quaity and competitiveness of the colleges we had already in Taiwan. After all, the earth is a globalized world, it is significant and inevitable.

subject: HW-0801
content:
The number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, and more students are able to receive higher education. It is absolutely a good news for those who want to get higher education. But, for the whole society, I don't think this will have a positive impact on it.
First, some people aren't really want to go to colleges. However, when more and more colleges are set up and people at their age usually receive higher education, those who don't want higher education find themselves hard to find the job and to compete with others. So they go to colleges without a willing heart of learning, but for the proficiency. In this way, the goals of setting up more universities are misunderstood, and people with higher education aren't always equal to people with more knowledge or more difficult skills.
Second, quantity and quality can't be taken into consideration at the same time. As the number of colleges and universities increases, we often hear about the ridiculous phenomenon, for example, some colleges lower their entrance scores to get students so that they won't have no money for retaining the school. What they don't want to admit is, are these students having enough knowledge to learn subjects which are much more difficult when attending colleges?
Those are my opinions about why I don't think having more colleges can have a postive impact on our society, and I really think that our government should pay more attention on this.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I think that this will have positive impact and also negative impact on our society.
As a college freshman, I think receiving higher education is definetly necessary for us to achieve a better life. In college or university, you can possibily have classmates from everywhere, even overseas. You can broaden your horizental through communicating with them, even though your classmate comes from Taiwan, there are definetly differences between northern or southern Taiwan. Therefore, you will see things differently.
Another advantage is that you can take some classes that you are really interesting in. In my opinion, interest is one of the most important reason that you do something great.
With more people who are able to see things differently and they all have interest in what they are doing, I think our society will automatically become a better one.
But things have two sides. As the number of colleges and universities increases, there are two problems that I am concerned about: one is that are all the increasing colleges and universities good enough to provide things what a college student needs? The other is that are the students, who are always struggling with their high school work, able to receive higher education?
You don't have to be a straight-A students to go to college, but you have to, at least, have some basic skills. For example, if you can hardly name all the English letters, from A to Z, it's redicullous for you to major in English in college.

subject: HW-0801
content:
People say that it is impossible not to enter the college if you are willing to. Taiwan has much more universities than ten year. Although the number of the universities definitely increase, whether the quality is getting better in the same time? According to my knowledge, the quality of several universities is marginal.
In Taiwan, college entrance exam is one of the way to enter the university. Last year, a student only getting 18 score also have a chance to enter the universities. His acadmic ability is equal to a elementary school student. There are too many universities in Taiwan. Does not the authority concerned ensure the educational quality? Some universities in Taiwan seems to become the enterprise. The only thing schools worry about is their surplus. They do not care about whether their student is able to compete with other people. It is the authority concerned that they should pay attention to.
After the universities boom in Taiwan, the victims of bad education graduated from school. According to the statistic, the universities students' get the lower salary than vocation senior high schools'. It means that those students waste their four years in university. A bachelor's degree become no longer valuable. In order to live and compete with other people, no wonder one third of the college students chose to enter the graduate school to enhence their ability.
I think that the minister of education should reflect and take some measure to save those poor student. It is related to the future of our country and affect it for a long time.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As far as I am conserned, I think students can receive higher education in Taiwan will have a positive impact on our society. In other words, it seems having a degree of a college or a university is a foundational equipment for a fresh man of a society in Taiwan.
Why I support that people go to colleges an universities is a good phenomenon in Taiwan? Here are two major reasons to explain it. First of all, you can learn a professional skill you like and which will help you to get a good job in a professional area of a work. What's more, this skill you learn from school will let you make a living on it which bumps into your favorite habit. There is proverb goes "Learn for live." I think it's a best expression for what I am saying.
Second, go to colleges can your skill to deal with other people. Before we go to colleges, we belong to our family. However, when we go to colleges, we need to face to other people from west and east. I think it's a good chance for us to used to how to get along with different people we don't know before. It will help us to used to get along with different kind of people when we greduate from school, too.
For those two reasons above, everyone can go to colleges may not seem to be a bad phenonen at all. it still have some positive works for our sosciety. At least I consider that it's a good phenonenon after all.

subject: HW-0801
content: As my point of view, I agree that more students receive higher education have a positive impact on our society. More and more parents focus attention on the education of children. Parents cultivate and foster children willingly so that the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increase rapidly. Here are three reasons express my view on this phenomenon. Entering colleges and universities is an ideal way to realize what one's habits and interesting career. Besides, colleges and universities can cultivate talents to amilerimate economy and develop industary. Thus, our country would be prosperous and thriving. And people in Taiwan have high literacy and a rich array of cultures. Of course, receiving education is a good way to improve the quality of life. But the most privotal matter is that the authority should have high standards to examine all high educational schools in Taiwan to make sure that every student has good quality, personal trait, competitness and of course professional skills.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more students in Taiwan going to colleges and universities. I think one of the reason resulting in this phenomenon is that the parents of the students don't want or don't need them to work in an early age and also expected them to grab higher social status. Entering the university, the students can have more time understanding themselves and finding what kind of a career is more suitable for them. Also, it provides a great oppotunity to get in touch with lots of people of your age and enables them to develop social skills and relationships. To our society, the universities can teach the students into professionals and thus improve our economy and industry.
However, there are some universities in Taiwan are of low quality. And the students graduating from this kind of schools often had a hard time finding jobs. It is an urgent that those univerites improve their quality or they should be shut down. And students should also think more and be careful when entering an university or they will only find their future a mess four years later.

subject: HW-0801
content:
From ten years ago, educational system in Taiwan began to change. Increasing high schools and universities is just one of these series of policies. I believe the government has its good purpose at first and I'm in favor of the major concept of this policy.
Nowadays, more and more people who don't have good social and financial status in Taiwan are put emphasis on. Our goal is that we hope everyone can have equal chances to recieve education. And if many people can recieve higher education, they will have chances to earn much money and raise to higher social status. Therefore, I think as the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, this will have a positive impact on our society.
Although this will have the disadvantages in Taiwan, such as bad management or teachers which have been seen in some universities, I still support this policy. It's because more universities will have chances to compete each other. They will try to do the greater job and maybe decrease their tuition so that poor families still can afford to send their children to study. This trend will be good to the society, too. Many people will have higher standar of living and then the country will get stronger. It will reach the knowledge economy society more closely. For all reasons above, I do think this will have a positive impact on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, universities and colleges are very often seen in Taiwan while allowing more students to receive higher education may seem a good thing. It may cause some negative impacts on our society.
We often see News on TV about students receiving scores like only eight to ten going to universities. That means you can even get into a school if you only "guess" all the questions on the exam! This is a serious problem, and it may represent the downgoing of our country's education. The cause of this phenomenon is mostly because of the universities we can see almost everywhere. In ealier times, you have to study very hard in order to go into a university, since there were not many schools, and their rate were high. University/College graduated students were proved the best. But now, it turns out to be many schools wanting for students to go. Those schools rates are not as high, so even students with grades so low can go to universities. Because of this phenomenon, many students choose to leave Taiwan and study in foriegn countries.
Although we're not sure what could be done to prevent the downgoing of our education right now, I hope this problem could be improved. After all, a country's education is really importat to our future.

content:
As the time elapses, the numbers of colleges and university in Taiwan increases. It is said that whoever gets a college diploma, he or she should get a highly-paid job. This idea is rooted in many people's hearts and some lowly-paid jobs recruit less people than they need. In order to solve that problem, our governments allows foreign workers to enter our country and to take those jobs. However, not all jobs in Taiwan require people with a college diploma and some lowly-paid jobs are occupied by foreign workers. What can those people with a college diploma do if they can't get a highly-paid job as they expected? What's worse, the worsening economy makes this phenomen much more clear because many companies cut the number of their workers.
Based on the two conving reasons above, the increasing number of colleges and universities is more harms than benefits in Taiwan because the demand is much less than supply.

The increase of colleges and universities means more and more people are receiving higher education. As we know, the world's trend isn't emphasized on labors anymore. The countries with more bachelor's, master's, or doctor's degrees are surely more competitive. Also, the increase of colleges and universities allows people to explore higher level knowledge. In old times, only few people go to colleges or universities. I think that's a pity for many other people who are willing to study.
However, dreams are different from practical phenomenon. The colleges and universities are increasing in Taiwan, but what we see is that colleges and universities try to get students by all means. Even those who did badly in senior high school can go to universities. The quality of students and schools aren't guaranteed. Many observations revealed that college students in Taiwan are often below average quality of the world.
Therefore, the increase of colleges and universities should have a positive impact on the society, but the institutions must not persue lucre instead of quality. This way the graduated students are guaranteed to have enough ability to work in the society, and together make the society improve.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are more and more college students in Taiwan, but the rate of unemployment also keeps rising. Those social freshmen can't find any jobs even they have already receive their high education. To sum up, I don't think the increasing number of new colleges or universities will have a positive influence on our society.
The authorities always try hard to easen the pressure on students. They create lots of ways of exams, but to me, as a third grade senior high student, I don't think them work well. Those experts might say that students nowadays are able to have more choices, but I only feel more confused and unsure. Everyone wants to be higher educated, of course, but what if those new-born schools can't match the standards we want? Be professional or you'll fail, and this is the rule to survive.
Anyway, I think the government should take action to deal with the serious problem. If an educational revolution is just a political rhetoric for them, our ability of competing with other nations will decrease. I don't want to face such a miserable future like that, so the only way to help myself is to study harder and get to a "really good" university. You see, the stress never goes away. Hope the goverment will have a complete plan for all of us.
Improvements will never be enough, but I still have to fight for my brand new future.

content: More and more colleges are set up in Taiwan, that is to say, it is easier and easier to become a college student. However, is it neccessarry to have so many colleges? The more colleges establish, the more quality decreases. At first, the increase of the colleges might represent that there are more colleges available for students to receive the higher education. However, when there are too many colleges, those colleges will compete in order to have more students. If the college is not that famous, it might descend their entrance standard to let students in. Thus, the quality of college students become lower and lower. For example, some of the college students can't even speak English. Their English abilities are so poor that they can't spell easy words like apple. Another example is that, their abilities of Chinese are also terrible. They not only make lots of mistakes in writting very often but also misunderstand the meaning of idioms. content:

subject: HW-0801
content:
As far as I'm concerned, I'm not for the phenomenon.
With the increase of the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan, more and more high-school students would regard getting the diploma a piece of cake, and eventually, more and more students don't concentrate on their schoolwork any more. Consequently, more and more employers would rather recruit the employees who have better professional skills than hire the ones who have nothing but the useless diplomas. This also brings our society a strong impact --- unemployment. The more people couldn't find the jobs, the more problems to our society would arise; the more unstable our society is, the weaker competence our country will be, and then, the vicious circle continues.
All in all, it's better for our government to uplift the quality of our colleges and universities, not the quantity.

subject: HW-0801
content:
With the number of colleges and universities increasing, I am of the opinion of that it is not a good thing. subject: HW-0801
content:
About one or two decades ago, there were not so many colleges in Taiwan. Students had to study very hard, perform very well in order to have the chance to enter universities. To solve this problem, with the government encouragement, the number of universities have been increasing rapidly.

This is a very strange phenomenon to me. I think that you need to have enough basic knowledge before you enter the university. But it seems that students in Taiwan can receive high education no matter the fact that they ability, knowledge are poor or they perform poorly in the test, they all can enter colleges. Universities is a place for advanced knowledge, training students to research indepently; how can a student without basic knowledge can adjust to high education?
So, my view on this phenomenon is that the universities in Taiwan is too many, we have to stop the increasing, even close some universities. The goverments should make new policies to solve this problem. There are some specific reasons support my opinion. First, universities are a place for high education, not all the students, especially those who without basic knowledge, can adjust to its advanced course, so we don't need that much universities. Third, the quality of students will decrease. subject: HW-0801
content: As far as I am concerned, this phenomenon is not suitable for a developed country like Taiwan. You and I know that almost one hundred percentage of senior high school students can enter colleges and universities in Taiwan this year. In accordance with a report, more and more graduated students in colleges can not find a job and they fool around every day. It indicates that a person with a good and useful skill can have more opportunities to get a job than one just with a diploma. Moreover, there are three convincing reasons to support my opinion. First of all, the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan is geting increased. Our goverment should have responsibilities to reduce the number of colleges and strictly take a heed of the qualities of schools. It is of great importance for our students to have a good teaching environment, for they can learn correct things. In the second place, the students in senior high school are not aware of what they like and what they want to be in the future. What's worse, they think that if they have a college diploma, they will have a good work. Therefore, parents and teachers should give them advice about how to make a plan in the future instead of telling them all to enter universities. Third, the graduated students need to be more patient and have few complaints about the salary, work hours, and holidays. A lot of people look these students as "strawberry generations", just because they can't tolerate the pains they have. With these problems, it is vital to decrease the number of colleges. Above all, we should face the music together in order to make Taiwan more and more great. As a proverb says, "Where there is a will, there is a way." So, we should be determined to do it inspite of lots of difficulties.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In this competitive society, companies in Taiwan are like to hire employees who have higher education. Students almost graduate from colleges and Universities, there are more colleges and universities in Taiwan increased to meet the needs of students and society. I think this phenomenon is formed by our society and parents.
Firstly, inflation in Taiwan is improved quickly, the salary of one employee or couples is hard to sustain the life now. If students don't get higher education, it is difficult to get into a sucessful companies or to get a good salary to maintain a family in the future. I think it is a good impact on our society, even though I know that is not a positive way to impact students to want to get more salaries to overcome the inflation of society, but I believe it is a good methods to force students to get higher education and get more intelligent or knowledge from their studies. It good for our society and themselves.
Secondly, I think parents are also the element to push their children to receive higher education. Because some parents do not want their children to have the same life as them. I believe that parents want to give their children better life, they know getting higher education or studying hard is a necessary way to have a good life in the future. Therefore, they send their children to better school even go abroad to get further study. They do not care how much money they have already spent, they just want their children to get higher education and will have a good life in the future.
To sum up, it is real that more colleges and universities are increased can let some students are able to receive higher education to overcome the needs of society. In my opinion, I believe the impact on our society is positive and good. I think higher education and more knowledge are good for our countries and have more qualities to compete with other countries on economic, society and so forth.

subject: HW-0801
content:
More the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more worried I am. The number has a lot to do with the quality of students. As the number increases, parts of the students in Taiwan may think, "Oh, I could enter a college so easily, why do I have to study so hard?" Thus, they wouldn't pay attention on their school works. Then, they live happily during the time in junior high school and senior high school, and, needless to say, they enter a college which is not very good. After they graduate from colleges, they would find out that they couldn't get a job. Finally, in order to make ends meet, they become a thief or someone else. How terrible the situation is!
In my opinion, instead of increasing the number of colleges in Taiwan, hightening the quality of colleges is more necessary. The suroundings of some of the colleges in Taiwan is very dirty. The sanitation looks terrible in some colleges. As a student who is about to enter a college, I am worried about the situation! subject: HW-0801
content: In Taiwan, high educational students become more and more. it seems that it is a good phenomenon for Taiwan, but I think it brings a lot of bad impacts. Sometimes they even have to borrow the money from the country to finish their high education. Of course, education plays a essential role in a country, so tries to develop education is good, but our government should tries to strike a balance between the number of colleges and college students' abilities, that is the only way to benefit the whole people in Taiwan!

subject: HW-0801
content: In the past, it was difficult to enter a college because there were few colleges in Taiwan. However, nowadays, there are colleges everywhere, and enter one becomes a piece of cake. The more you know, the better ways you can come up with to solve the difficulties you face. Second, it can let your have better manners and personalities. Little do they know that if they can take classes which are relative to the job they are going to take, it will help them perform better and make a fortune sooner. subject: HW-0801
content:
In my opinion, I think the increasement of the number of colleges and universities will have a positive impact on our society. As an old saying goes, "Knowledge is power." According to this problem, the government had made an education reform to set a lot of colleges and universities. In this manner, people can make their dream come true by entering universities!

content: In Taiwan, more and more colleges and universities are founded and it means students can obtain more opportunities for higher education. It is good for those who live far away from cities. subject: HW-0801
content:
In recent years, more students are able to receive higher education because the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases. Some people think that it may not be a good phenomena to increase so many colleges and universities. Perhaps it's correct in some aspects. However, I think this will have a positive impact on our society.
First, it can increase the career or social competition. There are only a few openings in each company, but more people want to get the opportunity. Then the competition is much more strict. Second, everyone should promote himself or herself to face the competition. The opportunity doesn't absolutely belong to those who receive higher education or enter better schools. Its owner is anyone that has great ability. So to be a dream realizer, everyone must learn more and have other skills, such as surfing and playing golf. Third, licenses are more important and more useful in our society. How to tell others that I'm the best and unique? Licenses can show the differences because they mean the ability and the profession. In addition to the educational background, most managers also take the personal ability, specific talents and licenses into consideration.
More competition leads to the promotion of a society. And people must change themselves and get more knowledge or skills. Thus, I believe that will have a positive impact on our society and make our society better.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Education is the foundation of a country. It needs time and money to educate a person. However, does it mean that everyone will be "well-educated" after the same way of education? In my opinion, the answer is NOT.
Actually, the phenomenon of Taiwan's education is going to become worse. More students receive higher education in order to gain a better job or make more money. As a result, not getting into a colleage is "harder" than before.
We have no choice but to do it, don't we?
In our childhood, we know that our future is in our hand. But when growing up, we finally know our opportunities are in the diploma we get. We just walk on the road to get a higher education --- step by step --- with no chance to stop and think.
The society makes it like this situation.
Eventually, we obtain nothing.
Not every university can provide good education. Not everyone should get into it, as well. But most colleages in Taiwan now are just able to get benefits from the numerous students and they don't have the purpose of giving knowledge.
Parents cause it also. They hope their children to be college students and think it would be more chance to earn money. Nevertheless, pushing children into a university doesn't mean that kind of good things.
"Quantity is not as essential as quality." We should think more about the phenomenon in Taiwan now.
