subject: HW-0801
content:
Recently, the high education, such as colleges or university education, has become a commonplace in Taiwan society. Almost every student can receive the college education. In my opinion, this phenomenon indeed has several adventages as well as disadventages.
First of all, with the well-educated citizen, our country will be peaceful and do not have any criminal in the near future. The reason why is that everyone knows the law or rules of our government. Futhermore, every worker in each company would have plenty of knowleges or professional skills because of the university education. For example, the salesperson of a bookstore may recite every work wrote by Bei Lee, a famous poet in ancient China, because he has majored it in university. However, in comparison of those benefits above, it could have some shortcomings. One of them is that the value of college students will be lower than before when everyone could finish university education. Their salary would be reduced, too.
Despite the fact that there are some negetive impacts of the comusion of higher education, I believe everyone in Taiwan should try the best to achieve university education or even join the graduation school to chasing more information as well as wisdom for their own good.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In my opinion, I think that more students are able to receive higher education will have a positive impact. In recent years, the world have become internationalized; therefore, we need more professional expert to deal with it. The education can improve the level of knowledge in our country. In addition, the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases. So the people in Taiwan can have much higher and deeper learning.
I will in favor of increasing the number of schools. First of all, the society has changed rapidly since the recent years. We should prepare our ability well to face the competetive circumstances. In the second place, students can learn second language in the schools. When we have the chance to visit foreign countries or invite people living other countries, we can have a chance to show it. Third, the surroundings in the colleges and universities are plentiful. For example, student can take part in a club and learn the social skills between human beings. To sum up, I think more schools are established can give more chance to students who enjoy studying. In addition, students are much easier to go to a college, they can broaden their mind. Therefore, studying college is not a previlige for minority people. Everyone should have the same chance to learn, not just the best one on schoolwork.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In the past decade, there are more and more colleges upgraded to Universities. They opened varities of courses to attract different students. They also awared that the working adults may need a chance to get a higher degree, so they opened night-time courses and weekend classes for them. That's really helpful because people shouldn't stop learning, especially when they became working adults.
Learning new knoweledges is good, but when there are more universities, they needs more students. When they put all their efforts on getting students, they won't be able to controll their teaching qualities. If a student spent three years to learn nothing, even he/she got the diploma eventually, it still means nothing. Diploma shouldn't be the motivation of learning. The real learning happens when you eager to learn.
I don't really agree with the increasing of universities, because people should pay their efforts to get the higher degree. Some people just go to school everyday, three years later they graduate, and ......... What did them learn actually? Do they really qualify as a bachalor? Those are the questions we need to discuss about. The inside knoweledges are the most important and useful for our whole life.

subject: HW-0801
content: As a student of a university, I'm not agree with the increasing of the number of the university. Also I think it will bring a bad impact of our society. The following is my point of view: That is, By increasing of the number of the university, we need more student to enter university to support those new schools. There comes the question that did every student need the higher education? The answer is quite easy to know. There is no need for every student in the society to enter university. For a example. In japan, only the student of the top 20% - 30% are able to enter the "college" education. After those student finish the university they can dicide to imerse themself to the higher level of reaserch or easily get a job in a company. Just look what happen in Taiwan, student of the new universities pay a lot of money to finish their education but they can not even get a job as a university student. After four years, eventually, they may have to get a job which pay them as much as a student without university education. Evidences show that it's a great waste of the socity. To stop this kind of waste we should discrease the number of university. To enter university is not so important, what really important is after four years, if you can be a usefully preson as you wished to be.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Actually, it's true that almost every junior high school student can enter a college, however, the quality of knowledge they learn can't reach the same level. So, there shall be only one colledge in one city and the best teachers shall be picked out and to be paid as professors. Those city-colleges shall be given as much money as they need by government and those best professors shall be paid in high salary.
The reasons are bellow. First, if there is only one college in one city, the city government can support it by all its effort and those students living in that city do not have to study so far from their home. Second, those picked-out professors are must be the best then students taught by them can learn really many things. Only by that, our graduated college students' level can be kept and those hardworking parents won't just pay a lot of money to private colleges but their children learn nothing from universities.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Getting higher education is graduly common to see in developed countries. It has become a trend that spreads all over the world, even in Taiwan.
In my oppion, I believe it will bring our society a positive influence because of the following reasons. First of all, "globalization." Our world has been characterized by globalization today. As one member of the earth village, we must need lots of knoledge and skills to face the situactions. Second, "competitive society". In Taiwan, with less children were born and more efforts and love parents give on their kids, we can predict that it will be more and more competitve for young people to get a job. Those chance will only be taken by well-prepared and knowledgeable people. The last one is for a peaceful and democratic world. The more you understand, the less you fall into traps. Governments and authorities are no longer easily to cheat innocent citizens.
Therefore, I deeply agree that receiving higher education will bring our society a colorful future.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I think this will have a rather negative impact on my society. As a college student, I have to work much harder than ever before in order to "rival" against so many college students growing rapidly, or I would have less chance of getting a good job. Graduating from colleges isn't an achievement that people in Taiwan can pride on. It's only a basic requirement of academic achievement in recent Taiwan.
One of the drawbacks of this phenomenon is the education resources. To support so many colleges and universities, the expenses of the college education from government are more apt to cut off for average use of each college. Thus, not every college could have rich or enough money to improve its academic environment as well as the campus surroundings.
Another one is the motive. It's easier than before to go to college, so some high school students might not work hard to prepare their college entrance examination.

subject: HW-0801
content:
The number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receive higher education. I think it has advantages and disvantages both.
The advantages of the phenmenon is: more people can let their education go on, not only the young men but also olds that never complete their education in their childhood. Our society can have better learning changes for them, so tecnologies can have better improve, all of us can have a better life.
But is also have disvantage. The number of what growing year by year may be a heavy burden to our country. Building schools need a lots of money, space, and people, if the school can't working well, much more problems produced. Becides, the students have poor grades, who can't go to univesities, now, can go. It's not fair with good students honestly.
What should we do with the phenomenon? The government must to consider if the colleges need to be built. And, after building them, to protect, to understand the importances they have in the city. However, if they don't, being useless, redure the amounts of schools immeditily. It has been an serious problems in our society, we should face it, solve it, bravely.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Senior high school students nowadays are almost guaranteed to attend a college or university. Unlike twenty years age, students are not classified by identity of college students. It's my belief that it is not a good phenomenon to Taiwan society.
Firstly, people are born to do something suitable for them owing to various talents. Not all are capable of academic study. Instead of being a student, I personally consider one should find out his or her nature gift as early as possible and develope it well. However, colleges or universities now provide general knowledge but the specific one, which makes one general as others. It could result in the situation that students can't locate themselves in career. In contrast, supposing a student could learn specific skill which he or she is interested in, it must be a strong tool for him or her to compete with others.
As the meanwhile, one country needs not only learned people but also skilled workers who are well-trained in professional industries. For instance, we need the professional, who can operate a system of engineering as well when it comes to reality.
Therefore, I don't think there is a positive impact on Taiwan society that more and more studens are able to receive higher education over these years.

subject: HW-0801
content: If the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan encreases and more students are able to receive higher education, I think that this will have a positive impact on our society, Because if more people get higher education then Taiwan will be able to produce more high-tech products and Taiwan will be able to stand out in technolagy. If Taiwan is able to stand out in technolagy, then Taiwan will be world-knowen for the products and more countries will be more willing to buy our electronic products. This will also have a positive impact on our abillity to trade with other countries, which will encrease the posibility for Taiwan to join the United Nations, and Taiwan will be more able to convince other countries that Taiwan is a country. So I think it will be an very good idea to increase the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan.

subject: HW-0801
content:
When it comes to the number of universities in Taiwan increases, I am of the opinion that it will be a troublesome phenomenon in Taiwan.
In the first place, most of the students in Taiwan want to receive higher education but the number of students who enjoy studying and try their best to improve themselves is not the same. Due to that, there will be more students graduating from universities without enough knowledge. Second, in my opinion, competition makes improvment. The easier to get into university, the less competition between students and the less improvenent on them. Owing to that, students will have less ability to work in the society. Last but not least, in fact, the money for university is not cheap. If students graduate from university without enough skills, they are wasting their money and need to spend more and more money to find another way to improve themselves; otherwise, they will easily fall to find an ideal job. In conclusion, it is obvious that the number of universities in Taiwan increases is not a good thing for students. As the old saying goes, as you sow, so shall you reap. Controling on appropriate number of universites and increasing more useful class for students to choose are more effective than just increasing the number, so I think that increasing the number of universities will have negative impact on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more and more students are able to receive higher education. It seems a good idea, however, I still believe that's not a good phenomenon. And I develop my opinions for education aspect and for society aspect.
To begin with, too easy to enter universities makes students unwilling to learn. They believe they just need to take the entrance exam and then they have universities to take. Therefore, nobody wants to learn new things and study hard.
Followingly, Once they graduate, they have no professional abilities to compete with others. Due to the "Happy University Time", they don't really learn any professional ability. Hence, They may face umemployed after graduation.
In sum, it's a wonderful thing that everyone can receive higher education to improve the standard of life. But we should pay more attention to: firstly, if too easy to enter universities makes students unwilling to learn, and secondly, how to build up professional ability to compete with others. I truely believe through teacher's efforts, universities students can be as excellent as universities students twenty years ago.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In my opinion, I think the increasing number of colleges and universities in Taiwan will cause a lot of negative impact on our society because of the two following reasons.
First, this phenomeon will cause the high rate of unemployment. At our parents' age, graduating from college is like a promise since few people can have such a high education background, If you can graduate from a college, it means that you are sure to have a job.
In addition, the increaing number of colleges make the competition become fierce. When you are looking for a job, your competiors probably not only own the college diploma. They are very likely to graduate from a graduate school or even a higer degree.

subject: HW-0801
content: There are college students everywhere nowadays, but it doesn't mean that the students are getting smarter than before. Many people might think it as a bad phenomenon in Taiwan, I though considerate it as a good thing. High school students tend to study harder in order to enter the top universities in stead of the others. College students will find out that what people so called "Give You Four Years Free Time" as the same pronociation as university would be wrong because of the high unemployeement rate. Therefore, they study harder. Those who had already graduated from colleges will soon figure out they need more diplomas when they go interview. To sum up, in my point of view is that students will keep on competing with each other rather than loosen their nerves as soon as they graduated from high school. In this way, people get to know what they need and they will be well prepared whenever it comes.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I think it's positive for our society to have more and more people recieving higher education. But with the increasing number of colleges and universities, we need to do something special to prevent them from becoming low-quality ones.
When most people of the society have received higher education, it means the society is developing into a higher level. People have learned more knowledge. They learn more, think more, and creat more. Thus will make a better environment for us to live.
But things always have both bright side and dark side. So the policy to prevent higher education from becoming low-quality is needed. I think the school authority should be strict about student's study. By this way, the school authority will get good reputation, and students have bright future.
There're always problems on the way of social developing. We need to think of ways to resolve them.

subject: HW-0801
content:
That more students are able to receive higher education would not have a positive impact on our society. It is because that higher education demands higher thinking and higher abiilities on the part of the students. However, not everyone that enters colleges and universities can meet the requiremant on the course design or school curriculum. Then many of them fail when they study in colleges or universities. The instructors wouldn't demand more on students' learning, lest they fail easily. Hence, the levels of students wouldn't be promopted but lowered down. When those students graduate, they can't easily find a good because they are not trained well and they don't learn well in school.
Second, since students don't have to study hard for Entrance Exam because they don't have to score high in order to enter colleges or universities. This would lower down students' learning motivation and they will not pay their full attention on learning. Then, students gain little from their learning. This will, ultimately, be reflected on their performaces on the job. This phenomenon does nothing good but damages a country's competitiveness in economy.
Not everyone graduate from senior high schools or vocational schools is able to be qualified to meet the demand of higher-level learning in colleges or universities. What colleges and universities need to do is to recruit those who are able to meet the course demand but not those who are able to pay the tuition. Especial those who think studying in colleges, or universities is fooling around in the school for four years should not be recruited for the benefits of the school and the students.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays there are more and more colleages and universities in Taiwan. In my opinion, I think there will have both positive and negative impact on our society. On the positive side, it is getting easier and easier for the students who want to receive higer education. With the increasing number of colleages and universities, there are a lot of choices for student to chose for their ideal one.
Moreover, on the negative side, the level of colleages or universities are getting down and down. About four months ago, I have read the newspaper and it was about a student who just got very low grades on the colleage entrace exam, and unbelievably he was permitted to go to the colleage. I don't think it is a good thing in our society. Everyone has the right to get higher education, but if it is easy to enter the university, how will the students study hard, and after their four years of university life, what will they get or learn?

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, there are many colleges and universities in Taiwan. The chances of receiving the higer education are much more than decades ago. We can say that we are lucky to have these chances to abroaden our sights of views. But this did have a positive impact on our society.
First, the willings of studying will decrease. Students won't push themselves to study hard to get the good grades because they all know it's not too difficult to go to colleges or universities.
Second, the qualities of studying won't be good enough. Many people think that some students graduating from colleges or universities perform not very well though they receive the higher education. What a pity!
Above all, I think our government should consider seriously how to control the the qualities and the quantances of the high education. By doing this, the studying of students can get the guarantee.

subject: HW-0801
content: As the numbers of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, there are over one hundred colleges and universities now, and most of the high-school students can pass the examination for college entry. This phenomenon shows that higher education is no longer belong to small amount of people, more and more students can enter a college or university to get more knowledges. It seems will have positive impact on our society, but there is also negative influence on our society. When we reading newspapers or watching TV news during the graduate season, we will find lots of the colleges or universities' graduaters cannot find their jobs, about twenty years before, most of the college graduaters can find a job, because there are not so many people can recieve higer education, but now competiter increased, students who graduated from colleges or universities need more evidence to proof their abilities, or they have to graduate from the top schools. Although there are hundreds of colleges or universities in Taiwan, the school which can get more education resources are limited, some of the new universities have no enough teachers and buidings for students, and the top colleges have plenty of resources for students, it makes students who entered different schools will get different education, and employers will compare the school when choosing their employees, in fact, the chances for every college students are unfair, and this phenomenon makes some negative impact on our society such as students cannot find a job after graduated, and some of the students cannot recieve education with good quality.

subject: HW-0801
content: In Taiwan, more students are be able to receive higher education. I don't think this phenomenon will have a positive impact on our society. The educational sourses will be average out if there is more colleges and universities. Human world is actually suported by few powerful people and the rest of the other people they just provide a background. By looking though the history this has been prove correct, although this seems unfair but it's right. So if we average out the sourses the possibility the powerful people come out will be less. Acutally this phenomenon is quite common not only in undergraduate level but also in science research. Due to lots of different realm of science research, each realm of research will give the same amount of project founding in order to be fair. But in this way the progress made in each realm will be very slow. Just like this, more students are able to receive higher education, but the quality of students will be less than there are just a few universities there because the sourses can't be used affectively.

subject: HW-0801
content:
There are many colleges and universities in Taiwan. As a result, more students are able to receive higher education. Because of this reason, you can find nearly every one on the street is a college student.
In my point of view, this will have negative impact on our society. Getting a diploma from university becomes easy. Therefore, many college students can't find jobs after they graduated. Due to the umemployment, they go further studying or go abroad for studying. However, after they finish studying, no one can promise that they can have appropriate jobs.
In the modern society, many company depend on your diploma to decide whether they accept you. Hence, diploma is a represent for your ability and performance. If you are just a guy graduating from college, it doesn't have a powerful evidence that you are suitable for the job.
On the other hand, there are many small and unfamous colleges that fail the investigation from education department. Their facilities is not abundant to provide students a excellent learning condition. No matter the quality of teachers or the facilities of school, they are not good enough for any students to be well-eduated.
In conclusion, despite the fact that the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, it doesn't bring a positive impact on our society. Instead, it ends up having some negative effects in Taiwan.

subject: HW-0801
content:
The number of colleges and universities in Taiwan has increased for rescent years. A lot of vocational school before has become a collage nowaday. And we can find out a lot of university we had never seen before.
In my opinion, I don't think it isnot a good phenoment. first, there were much fewer students going into collage to study, so we might think collage students are excellent, but there a lot of collage students' walking in the street. How can we regonize who is a expert, who is a fool person.
Second, studing in the university will cost their parent a lot of money, most parents work hard to let their children study in the university, but their children will be not able to get a job for their living after greduating from courage because everyone can attend university and greduate from university.
Third, a lot of students have to go to cram school to get their skills. They need to be good at something to get a job.
Finally, so many collages cost government so much money.
All in all, I think so many collages and universities will have bad effect on our education and society according to these reasons. I think government should decrease some bad or on used collages.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Since the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, it brings bad impacts for the future of Taiwan for the decreases of students' qualities and the trend of studying abroad.
The qualities of students decreases because of the increases of higher educational schools. As a result of the increases, each student have one more schools to enter on average. Therefore, even the student is poor on basic knowledge, he/she can graduate from school as those diligent student. The diploma doesn't represent for anything anymore.
Students have strong desire to study aborad since the diploma in Taiwan doesn't represent how great they are. They are encouraging to go abroad instead of graduating from domestic famous colleges. If they study abroad, they will be influenced by foreign culture and lose the awareness of being a Taiwanese.
Students' qualities decrease and desires to study aborad are two main reasons I worry about the future of Taiwan.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities increases in Taiwan, more students have chance to get higher education. Frankly speaking, in my point of view, I don't regard it as a good phenomenon. I will give my reasons as following.
First, it doesn't mean that students would aquire more knowledge to deal with their future, but shows they can get a cetificate more easily. And people usually aren't precious of the thing that they pick up easily.
Second, the more people get higher cetificates, the less job opportunities they will get. And that means they still need to study futher.
All in all, if we want to keep the good quality of the colleges and universities in Taiwan, we must set the entrancement standard more higher.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I hold a positive attitude for this phenomenon. As a university student, I think it does a positive impact to the society. It means more and more people are highly-educated and well-educated.
Few decades ago, most Taiwanese families are farmers, they farm and their kids do farm, also. They sell fruit, rice or do sewing, they don't earn a lot and their kids got little chances to get educated.
Situations now are different. More and more university students just like bugs in the woods can get good jobs, old employees are having a crash which young guys are more competitive and more productive. Competitions on or under the table are much more keener now. It makes organizations and society process. We want to fullfill our mind to compete with others, it makes not only society but people process. One more thing is, highly-educated people would think ethicly, which can lower the quantity of crime.
In the past, when government make bad dicision or make mistakes, people choose to ignore or throw eggs to them and ask their mothers. For now, many people learn to send advices to them by e-mail or letters, or they would gather together and call reporters to report their wants. That makes governments notice and force them to make it better. It's very obvious from before to now. That shows people get educated and know how to express their words, showing that they're consern about it because they are high-educated people.
I think the society is keep processing because of educating and I'm glad I'm one of these people.

subject: HW-0801
content:
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receive higher education. In my opinion, I don't think it is not a positive impact on our society. I want to divide my opinion into three parts, present, future and international.
First, for the present, like this essay topic sentence, the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, so many students can get into a college or a university more easily. In that way, a lot of students will not pay much attention on studying. It is not fair for those students who really study hard for receiving a higher education.
Sencond, for the future, a lot of students graduated from a college or a university, and they can't find a good job quickly. For the tradition concept, everyone think that they can graduate from a university, and you will find a job very easily. It is a wrong concept. If you graduated from a university, you still can't find a job, even you graduated from Taiwan University.
Third, for the international, every student can receive higher education, but that doesn't mean you can compete with those people who are from other countries. I think Taiwan is an international country, so there must be a lot of foreigners will come to Taiwan for work. I don't think if those students can get into the university very easily, they will have the ability to compete with the foreigners.
In conclusion, nowadays, you can find many university students on the streets, but you can't find many university students who have a regular job on the job. I don't think it is not a good phenomenon for Taiwan. Those students should change their concepts. They should get the "real" high diploma, not the "fake" one.

subject: HW-0801
content:
Nowadays, there have been colleges as well as universities on the increase in Taiwan. For students, it turns out to be that getting higher education is not as difficult as it used to be. On the other hand, we also perceive transparently that students with higher education seem not all all have positive impacts on our society. There are some factors involved in the phenomenon.
Because increasing universities have sprung up, students can get permissions to colleges easily. From my perspective, it doesn't suggest that college students are equipped with the professional competence. Compared with the past, people can attend universities due to some reasons, such as financial problems or intelligent deficiencies. That is, if students can get higher education, they are consistent with the expertise in their professional. Nonetheless, college students with higher diplomas doesn't have abilities that they should acquire. Additionally, the issue will raise another social problem. Students are not willing to work from the very beginning of the business where they apply for. From my point of view, colleges and universities alike are supposed to boost their standards and strengthen students with better proficiency in their abilities. That the way, our society will have a positive impact with increasingly universities.

subject: HW-0801
content: The increasing of colleges and universities can show that Taiwan knows the importance of knowledge in the world of global competition. In the past, Taiwan is a farming country, and then becomes the industrial. However, the world is changing, and Taiwan also needs changing from the industrial into the knowledgable industrial country. In order to face the coming challenging of global competition, Taiwan can not only depend on the industry of outsourcing, we need to create our know-how economy. So, education is the key point. More people receiving higher education is a good sign in the future trend.

subject: HW-0801
content:
This phenomenon will definitely have a positive impact on our society for some reasons. Higher education brings more competitions is the focused one.
As the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, more students are able to receive education. There are ninety percent of senior high school graduates continuing their study. After that, they put what they have learned into practice with high degree, that's when they take the place of the employees who have 70 higher degree. Since most companies believe that knowledge is power, the higher education the employees receive , the more capable they are.
Higher education brings more competitions. Furthermore, competitions make things better.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I think it a worrying phenomenon that there are more students can receive higher education. Frankly speaking, many low-graded students still can enter some terrible colleges if they have enough money. Good as the situation that everybody can accept high-educated lessons, many of students think it meaningless to have a bad-colleged proof as they want to find great jobs. No sooner had the boss seen the bad-colleaged proof than he decided to throw it away. Not only teachers but also employees who work for school will face a scaring future. How terrible the phenomenon is! I expect whoever can change it and create a strong future for every student.

subject: HW-0801
content:
I think it won't have a positive impact on Taiwan society as the number of colleges and universities increases. Even if you got 18 point can you enter a colleage to study because the colleage and universities are more and more in Taiwan and this is because many big company wants to make money from the tutions.

subject: HW-0801
content:
We all know that after the "amazing" improvement of education, the number of colleges and universities in Taiwan increases, and more students are able to receive higher education. But I don't stand for that kind of improvement. I can't figure out that what's the relationship between "solving the pressure of entering good colleges" and "increasing the number of colleges."
It's not a good way to release the pressure of students who are keen to enter the narrot door of NTU. Those so-called good universities are the same difficult to enter since ever.
To increase the number of universities is not a positive impact on our society. First, the cost of studing gets more and more expensive. Those students who have poor grades are likely be born in a poor family. They can't afford the cost to enter university. Students should apply for government's help, which making them to face the debts after graduation.
Second, those new universities and colleges will face the urgent situation that students are getting fewer and fewer, and they can't make money anymore. And the standard of education will drop down. The news once told that a student doing nothing in the test can also study in one technological college. It's kind of funny, isn't it?
Third, the common education level may go higher. Now many friends of mine plan to study in graduate school. They say that they don't want to be compared with those graduated from some new colleges. But I think that is useless. I don't want to waste my money.
For these reasons I think that will have a negative impact on our society.

subject: HW-0801
content:
In Taiwan, there are more and more colleges and universities. The number of colleges and universities increases. Almost everyone can recieve high education now. In my opinion, there are some advantages and some disadvantages for our society.

Second, nowadays, less and less people prefer staying outdoors to staying at home. Most important of all, the services offered by the Internet are anything but free, while the changes of typing text messages are much cheaper than the cost of talking on the phone.
However, crimes can result from the changes of ways people communicate. More and more people who date online are cheated. As for as I am concerned, there are a lot of problems waiting far the authorities and us to solve.

subject: HW-0861
content:
As is known to everyone, instant messaging plays a vital role in our dialy life. More and more people depend on it as a communication tool. There are some reasons as follows. To begin with, Due to the expensive cell phone bill, people pefer to chat by typing texts rather than talking on the cell phone. Moreover, we can be correspond with our relatives and friends who live far away. We can interact with them by its various way as well. Most importantly, as everybody are using it, you should catch it up, or you will be cut off from the world!
Even though there are many advantages of instant messaging, it still brings some potential problems. Some people spend too much time sitting in front of their computer just in order to chat with friends. It is bad for their health. In addition, more and more people are unwilling to taking to others face to face. It might make the world dull because you cannot enjoy the conversation with voice and emotion. The most terrible thing is that some bad guys use it to committ crimes. It leads to many problems in our society.
It is true that instant messaging make our life convenient and enrish our life. However, if we cannot make good use of it, what a pity!

subject: HW-0861
content:
Nowadays, people can comunicate with each other in many ways due to the advanced technology. Computer is one of a good example. Because computer is very useful and convenient, people tend to type instant messages rather than use phone to talk to others. With the help of the computer, people don't have to memorize others' telephone number and can spend less money. Also, to people who are shy to talk to others, typing instant messages is a good way for them to speak freely. Moreover, as computers become worldwide, people will have more chances to talk to others around the world and thus can enlarge people's eyesight, rather than just talk to friends that people already have on their lists.
However, if people just communicate by typing instant messages, the gap between people may be enlarged, as people may have fewer chances to talk face to face. Therefore, this may lead people to express their feeling just on the internet rather than in public. I think although technology can help people to talk more conveniently, it may also lead to some disadvantages in our lives.

subject: HW0901
content:
Charity organizations have become more and more popular with teenagers. Teenagers devote their time to taking part in some activities organized by nonprofit organizations to help those in poverty or in serious sickness.
The personnel in charity organizations spare no effects to provide some physical and financial supports. For example, people who volunteer to work in hospital offer helps to those patients suffered by serious illness. When the patients are feeling uneasy, volunteers are expected to relieve their pain by conforting them or singing charming songs to make them happy. In addition, the volunteers distributed to some places hit by a disastrous accident will reconstruct the buildings, and schools. Those supports and services provided by charity organizations are indespensable to today's seciety.
Due to the fact that I am a student my main corncern is to act like a sponge absorb a variety of knowledge and do well on the tests. I have no time being involved in any nonprofit organizations. Nevertheless, I'd like to volunteer to help misfortunate patients because I want to become a doctor who doesen't always highly value the money. I consider knowing how much pain patients suffered is the first step of my cause. Even if I will face challenges and setbacks during helping those in need, I will still exert all my efforts to do my best.
When we are engaging this kind of nonprofit activities, we will not only help people but also enrich our lives by traveling to many countries.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations has provided many important services to us. In my opinion, one of the important services is tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan. Without such organizations, there won't be volunteers to help tutoring the children. Another important services is running refugee camps in developing countries. Doing this will help our country, so it's an important service.
The volunteers are really helpful. They do lots of things for the country or for the people in Taiwan. They also provide lots of sevices and most of the services are important. Even though they think they are just helping the nonprofit organizations, I still think they are helping everyone.
I have never done any volunteer work, in my life, but if I could, I would like to be a volunteer in the future. The job I would like to do as a volunteer is tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan. I would like to do it because tutoring children is fun. Having convercations with children is fun. Also, I can test my skill. If I have lots of knowledge, but can't teach the children, that means my teaching skill needs to be improved more. Although I can run refugee camps in other countries, meet foreigners and make new friends, I would rather stay in the country I born in than going out to a unfamiliar country. So, I would like to volunteer tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan.

subject: HW0901
content:
Bill gates always said that this world is always a lots of giving and having. So thoese non-profit company always want to give something back to the world, thats why Mr gates starts a Bill gates organization to help people. He always donats money to homeless or he open places for children who don't have family to take care of them.
Three month ago my school give every student a chance to be a volunteer. I still remenber that my job is taking care of children. With all the hard work I done. They finally had a wonderful day. Eventhough I was exausted, but when I saw thoose smiling faces, I forgot all the pain on my neck or back beause I realize that what I done is a nice work that helps peoples.
Helping for free is a nice thing to do and being a volunteer is the best to help. So I think it will be a pleasure for me to be a volunteer.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations, the groups that work hard but ask nothing in return, recruit volunteers to help with their work. Their work includes from tutoring children in remote areas to protecting marine wildlife, from running refugee camps in developing countries to setting up signs and slogans to tell people to quit smoking. Take Green Peace for example. Its members contribute themselves to the protection of ocean and animals all over the world. Besides, they even put an eye on the radiation effect to creatures as they chose some experts to investigate. The other example is World Vision Foundation. They hold some activities for public to get to know the hazardous situation most African are in. They spread the ideas of donating some clothes, books, and money to the poor by asking some stars to be in their advertisement.
For me, I've joined the boys' scouts and we helped old people in the countryside and hiked into the deep mountains to give the native a hand. Furthermore, I attended a fund. The leader of the fund took us to some hospitals to have a chat with the patients and encouraged them to keep fighting against their diseases by giving them cards and blessing. I, as a volunteer, regard the work I've attended as the most impressive one in my life. In the volunteer work, I not only offer people help and hope, but also find myself more independent and have a brighter thinking when dealing things.

subject: HW0901
content:
After davastating diseases happen, nonprofit organizations always play the vital roles to resue people. They carry on helping others and really make big sacrifices for everyone.
Nonprofit organizations always give the poor money, clothes, food to support others'lives. They send volunteers to some remote regions and teach students how to write. In addition to, they help not only the Taiwaneses but also foreigners. Though I'm just a teenager, their spirit deeply moved me. Whenever I see the volunteers asking for money, I'm pleasured to do a favor to those in need. In spite of we can only help a little, we still have to try our best. I hope someday I can be one of the volunteers of nonprofit organizations.
The proverb goes, "A candle lights others and comsumes itself." Nonprofit organizations volunteer to help people and ask for nothing back. It teaches me that the point of living is to help others. In the future, I want to participate in nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, kinds of non-goverment organizations are hold all over the world. Some spread out around the world, others are just for regions. Their jobs include a big range. Maybe they help people in remote areas, support them with foods, water, medical uses, clothes. And some wants to protect the earth and creatures from the human beings damage. Whatever their main idea is, they all want to let the society and earth more peaceful and fair.
In fact, I haven't join any volunteer work yet. But if I have a chance, I would like to go to the developing countries because I know the big difference and troubles they have than the big city. If you're from the city, I believe that when you see the view there, you'll be shocked. NOt only medical uses but also foods are lacked. They even don't have the most important thing-- clear water to drink. People in these countries sometimes are too hungry that they have to eat the earth or the trees' skin. Also, these countries have high birth rasks but on the other hand their death rasks is high too. Children often die in disease and they don't have doctors. This is unhealthy for the country and the society. So even my power is very tiny, I still have a motivation to change this kind of situation.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more volunteering organizations are developed. They offer teaching and helping in remote areas. Since that there is a great educational gap between urban and remote areas, the organizations are becoming more and more vital. They often drive a big van loaded with books to remote areas and let the children there learn and read from it. Volunteering to teach in rural areas is also a way. In fact, that is what I plan to do in the future.
I believe that teaching knowledge and experience to others, especially to such areas is a very meaningful and interesting job. If I have the chance to teach, I would certainly take it.
The reason that I would choose teaching is because that there are many benefits. Not only the children, but also I acquire experience too.
Through teaching and helping, I can also realize how fortunate I am. Experience a life under poverty, therefore, seeing a new prespective of life. I believe that if this trend goes on and on, more and more people will join the path of volunteering. From this, the society of Taiwan will only get better and better.

subject: HW0901
content:
"Giving is better than receiving." Nowadays, many kinds of organizations are rising around the world. They all keep this faith in helping those in need.
I still remember that when I was a child, Taiwan suffered from an devastating earthquake. This disaster left many people homeless. "Red cross" a worldwide nonprofit organization offered many social workers to run refugee camps, bring food and show their compassion to the victims of this disaster. By the same token, there are many kinds of nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. A local nonprofit organization which always offers many volunteers to clean the road, recycle the garbage and show their passion to this society. And it doesn't end there, they usually go to the remote villages to help the poor or the handicapped to rebuild their houses, give their living materials and help their kids to have normal education. Given that they do these services, this society can get far closer like a warm family. The more service they offer, the closer relationship they can have.
Wow, I am a junior. I have participated in this kind of club. We went to the elementary school which is near my college and helped those children who are needy for people's care. Evertime, I teached their homework. They always smiled. They enjoyed to be loved. And children might cast us as knight in shining armor to bring love to them. It make me so warm to see their beautiful smiles. I wish that everyone can jump on the bandwagoh to service this society and make this world full of love.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, many people spend their free time on helping nonprofit organization. The job of the nonprofit organization is not hard instead it is an easy job like tutoring children, taking care of children or picking up the garbage on the road. The meaning of these work is helping the people who need or make the society much better.
Some nonprofit organization will invist a lot of different catagory doctors to Africa or some countries where is poor and low medical. The doctors will stay there for one months or longer to help the inhabitors and teach them the medical knowledge. By this way, the people will change their lifestyle and stay away from the sick.
There are a lot of different style of volunteer jobs. Being a doctor may be the better but I would rather to be a teacher to tutoring children. In may opinions, education is a best way to help people. Some said education can change one's mind. By education, people will have ability to thinking. With thinking, people has his/her belief and value which other can't destory it.
"Giving is better than receiving." if you have free time just join nonprofit organization to help some who need. To offer your strenge, profession or time add to a pure heart. You can help much people who in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan provide a diversified sevice. Most among them needs volunteers to help with their works. For example, some colleage students from their school club will spend summer vacation to tutor children in remote areas. Some people will help to sevice the lunch for the elder people living alone. One of the most touching service is that some organization will help the dying people in their rest time of life.
When I see many children that can not have good education, I would like to tour them in my free time. If I have the opportunity, I want to open a middle-way home to teach children without good cares or good education. I also want to spend some time staying with the helpless elder people. I'm very happy to do these works.
Giving is better than receiving. These sevices will bring the whole society closer and provide numerous and bright future to those needed people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadys, there are more and more nonprofit organizations poping up one after another. They devoted to helping those who are in need and expressing what unfair situations they have experienced. They provide the homeless, the poor, the ill, and the elderly some shelters or cares. They also fight for their rights. They can somehow influence the policy.
I have once volunteered to help the church donate money by performing in a concert. The church was going to use the money to help the orphans. Numerous people came to the concert to enjoy the feast. It was a big success. I have learned that helping others is the happiest thing.
In the future, I would like to join the projects of protecting rare animals. Due to the environmental pollution caused by humans, we must do something to make up for it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations are better-organized and can provide more services and gather more resources thanks to the growing volunteers.
Most nonprofit organizations are fucosing on helping and protecting human rights such as survival, freedom and education. Their volunteers raise fonds or collect donations to provide medical supplies for people in developing countries and in desaster areas. They also tutor children, build schools and buy books and desks, even pencils and papers. There is a very meaningful activity of adopting children whose parents are not with them or can't support them. By donating a certain amount of money monthly, everyone can really help children far away. In developing countries, these organizations also save children in the streets and teach them skills so that they can make a living in a proper way.
I have never done any volunteer work. I only donate money because I think my money is more useful than my labor. But if I have a chance to do volunteer work, I would like to teach children. I believe that education can open a door for them to a better life.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this money-driven society, some people begin to think about the disadvantages of this world filled with material and idea of making money. How could we lock ourselves on this cold and cruel iron cage? So they begin to set up nonprofit organizations to help those people in need in an nonprofit way, hoping to turn over the wave of money. According to some newspapers, their kindness is praised by people. For example, some organizations provide medical care to several poor countrysides. Some donated daily necessities such as food and clothes when the 921 earthquake striked Taiwan. They also participated in resecuing mission no matter how dangerous it was.
I must admit that not all people has this kind of thought. They take their services for granted. For me I admire their contribution which is in an no selfish way. My friends also encourage me to join in this kind of group. Finally, I join a club in my university. In this club, we would held some activities in a semester. We would bring children having some diseases to visit the places they may be interested in such as Taipei zoo and museum. In these activites, children absolutely lough loudely and run everywhere happily. For us, it is truly a difficult task to make children obey what we say. However, when you find the key to unlock their mind and learn how to get along with them. They will see you as their brothers or sisters. Each activity is a new challenge. We alway gain new treasure and memory. The smile of children always accompany me and help me beat each challenge. I won't give up helping these pretty and innocient children in the future. They are angles and nutrition for me.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations in Taiwan and worldwide to help people. They will recruit volunteers to help people who need some help. For instance, there was a big earthquake in SouthAsia many years ago. The scared earthquake collasped people's houses and made a lot of people injuryed. Some organization provided some food and medical goods to that place as soon as possible. They also helped people to go through these pains and rebuilded their houses. Wherever happens earthquake, these organizations do their best to save people and provide goods.
If I have chance to help some people, I would like to tutor children in developing countries. In developing countries, the education resources are deficient. Knowledge is power. I want to give these children more extensive knowledge. Children who grow up in developing counties have more knowledge; therefore, they have power to make their countries and lives better. Furthermore, tutoring children in developing counties could make me to realize the different cultural and learn some special custom. I also can introduce our cultural to these children and interact between two different culturals. Helping people will make you happier than receiving help.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are a number of nonprofit organizations in Taiwan, and there also are some volunteers to help with their work, such as university students, housewives or retired people. These volunteers use their free time to help those who are in need, and because of their participation, our society will become better and better.
Many people would wonder what these nonprofit organizations do to profit our people? For example, some organizations would take care of people who are ill or disable to move in the hospitals or even at their home. Besides, these organizations also donate their money to some orphanages and nursing home to improve their living quality. Third, in order to have a better environment and to save our Earth, some organizations not only encourage people to recycle, but they also do so to make an example. All of these that I mention above are so great that I would like to thank to these nonprofit organizations; however, only say "thank you" is enough, I also want to give my hand to help people.
I have donated some money to the organization that helps to take care of children who need help and to the one that takes care of stray animals before, now I would like to continue denoting money and I would also like to tutor children who live in remote areas. Since these areas lack of teaching teachers, and I think I can do a little help on these children's studying. Anyway, let's keep doing something good to improve the quality of our own society.

subject: HW0901
content:
Following the topic of humanism, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to many countries where are now suffering wars, natural disasters, or poverty. Volunteers many dedicate themselves to a lots of work such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan or overseas, going to refugee in developing countries and guiding people who need help through the difficulties. They, in particular, don't have any profit.
The volunteer work I have done before was to company with sick men in the hospital. The experience gave me some inspirations. I make a dream that one day I can participate in more voluntary activities. To bring knowledge, joy, and love to orphans, for example, is now my hope. Though the work won't make me become rich, I'm sure that I will get more merits such as good mood and different notion of live while doing so.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations sacrificing time to help those in need. By the press and the commercial, we know they offer some important services so as to make the society, even the whole world a better place. Despite the aim of nonprofit, these organizations are quite necessary. Here are some examples.
Some important services can be offered in the natural disasters. The volunteers deep into the disaster areas to provide the refugees with the food and shelters for living. Those volunteers cooperate with the rescue from the government to help those refugees get through the hard time. Second, due to the climbing rate of joblessness, these organizations cooperate with our government to offer some lessons for free. People who are temporarily jobless can attain the class to get themselves more competitive in the job hunting. By doing so, the rate of joblessness may incline. Moreover, children in remote areas in Taiwan desperately need tutoring. Many certificated teachers, who have not sought the school to teach yet, may consider this way which can fulfill their dream of teaching and assist the children possessing less information than those in urban areas. As for me, I have never done these work before, but I'd like to spend some of my weekends to help the elderly people in the charity. I had been taking care of my grandfather before he died of the lung cancer two years ago. Therefore, I'd like to convey the concept of health to the eldly people. Helping the elderly with chatting or spending the leisure time with them, I can train my patience and get little fulfillment from it. I'd like to cook some healthy food and bring them the importance of healthy meals and regular exercise. By keeping company with them, I can realize every individual in the world needs to be cared. Even though these people who are not capable are getting more, we still need to contribute to make the world better.
