subject: HW0901
content:
Since the technology has been improved, there have been more and more developed countries all over the world while there are still some remote areas needing help. The nonprofit organizations have made hundreds of acheivements to help those disadvantaged groups. They not only provide the living groceries to the poors but also teach them how to start making livings on their owns.
In order to save those poors in developing countries, they have held a lot of charity activities to recruit some money and donations. Moreover, they fly to those poor countries with the living donations and money, they also teach them how to grow their own agricultural plants. Indeed, the nonprofit organizations are amazing system in the world.
I would like to take part into the nonprofit organizations one day to help the poors in the developing countries, too. I am good at English, I will be a patient English teacher to teach them how to communicate with the people from all over the world and how to read the newly information from English books.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, it common to see that the nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work and the nonprofit organizations provide some important services. For example, I remembered that the last semester, the teacher take two hours to show us a video which is about the group of doctors to help the people who live in remote areas of world.
In fact, the video really affected me a lot. It made me to think what I can do to help the one who in need. Fortunately, my friend want me to join the group that they will go to the remote areas to help the children every winter vacation. Most of children studied the elementary school. Therefore, we would like to teach them how to use computer and something about their study. Moreover, we not only taugh them but also played with them, such as playing fire balls and some interesting activities.
As far as I am concern, it is a precious experience for me. And it made me know that I still can do something to help others as well, even it just paly with them. To sum up, it's very important to help others. By this way, it can make our world to have much more happiness and to know how to thank other who help us.

subject: HW0901
content:
Although we live in an inadequent city, there still many people in other country, city, even town we know are to poor to have a meal. Luckily, they are not alone. Because more and more people take part in some nonprofit organization for dedicating their heart and life. The most important is to help and give those people who are in remote areas or who are in need.
Except for raising money, the nonprofit organizations also keep to recruit volunteers to help with their work which is to provide assistances for those who are in remote areas from physically to mentally. For example, providing food and stuff instantly after big earthquake or even building simple houses for those victims to have a place to study safely. What's more, the organizations also want to give them better education, so they always try to have more volunteers to teach some knowledge in every remote downtowns. It sounds too hard to achieve this goal, but they still keep it go on.
Last summer, I've participated in a tutoring program. In this program, we need to go to a junior high school in remote area. During the program, we not only taught the subjects but also shared some experiences with those "kids". They were really like kids, although they were about forteen to fifteen years old. Because of their living situation and environment, it made them so pure and truely, just like kids.
In the program, I really realize that there are still so many people having a life which is totally different with us. If I have ability, even just a little, I will keep helping them and find more people to join me to make our country more friendly and more peaceful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, I have been a volunteer for an international organization in Taiwan. Its purpose was to help cure the mentally-challenging elders or take care of them. The activity was held in Banchiao city, Taipei County.
I remembered my five senior high school classmates and I going there as volunteers to help with their work by the name of English club. It was a sunny and cloudy day. Eight o'lock in the morning, we met in front of the Starbucks coffee shop and went to the plaza to sing up. The informers gave us each person a cap, water and a wooden billboard. Our work was to go to the neighborhood to advertise this activity and let people know what was this activity for.
After a day work we finished, we all felt happy and thankful that we could participate in this activity. It's very meaningful and educational and I thought it was really a precious experience for me.
If I have any chances, I will have join in this kinds of activities in the future, taking care of kids or elders in particular. Because I consider kids are very cute, rock-solid and innocent. They often inspire me and I can really learn a lot of things from them. Hoping that one day I can go abroad to take care of those kids who are in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
As quick developing of our world, there are many problems are showing up in developing countries. To solve these problems, some developed countries and charities are trying to establish nonprofit organizations.
These organizations provide many important and helpful services. To help the children get better education, who can barely recognize a word, they recruit some college students as vonlenteers to make them kown this world as much as possible. And these organizations also teach the people in developing countries the skills about argiculture. With better and professional ways, the people there have no need to worry about their life and food.
If there's an chance that I can devote myself to these kind of organizations, I will choose to improve the children's education. After all, how will a country go depends on the children, who will finally grow up and can make important decision for their own country.

subject: HW0901
content: In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations working for society without any rewards. They provide some important services to help people in misfortune. The most impressing service to me is that they take care of poor kids who may be an orphan or misused by their cruel parents. Such service is touching to me because it saved my Mom in her childhood. My mother was born in a poor family and she lost her futher when she was seven. She starved all her childhood, but fortunately, these organization gave help in time. They provided scholarship to help her complete school work and periodicly gave her some food. What they have done deserves my sincere compliment. In addition to taking care of children, they offers many other types of service, such as curing service in areas where just encouter a giant disaster like tsunami or eathquake. In the future, I'd like to join them and volunteer to help children who needs help. Some of my friends have taken part in these kind of activity, one of them even went to the third world to help refugees. Maybe I can start my voluteer work with them. I think everyone must at least participate these activities for once, because you never know when you will need helps from these activities.

subject: HW0901
content: Nonprofit organizations always do some important services, and there are many volumteers like to help nonprofit organization. Nonprofit organization do many kinds of thing, such as build school, clean the street, take care of old people who live alone.... I have been to visit poor children who live in the mountain, we volunteers give children some presents which we bring from schools, and those presents was from the students in the school, they don't need those stuff such as dolls or old books. We take those stuff from students, and give it to those poor children. This kind of organization do many services, and no need repay. I like it very much, and I will still be the volunteer even after a long time.

subject: HW0901
content:
Some nonprofit organizations provided many important services for Taiwanese people. For instance, a couple of volunteers, retired celebrities, alway show up on an advertisment warning people to quit smoking as well as helping the people with lung disease which is due to smoking. Besides, there are many nonprofit organizations help the children with unusual disease. They encourage the family to go through the suffering.
I haven't done any kind of volunteer work because I still have some responsibilities of my family. There are many things need to be done so I never get around to it.
However, I suppose the most volunteer work I would like to do is to be a story-teller in a hospital for unhealthy children. I can't imagine how miserable a child can't live in a normal way. I want to make them laugh and forget anything unpleasant even only for a short time.
Sometimes, people need help like we do.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are more and more important in morden society. They usually provide the services that governments forget. For example, Doctors with Boarder, they provide medicial aid to the areas that lack well medicial care. With their work, many people in developing and undeveloped countries don't suffer from diseases as usual. Some organizations provide humaniaran aid. For instance, they help refugee to rebuild their homes after earthquake or typhoon.
I would like to be a volunteer to turoring children in disadvantage family. "all men are created equal," so every children should receive fundamental education. In this competitive society, knowledge is important, so I want to teach children that once lost their opportunities to learn. They may not have many chances to receive imformation like normal children. I hope that with my assistance they can keep up with other children. They can gain more abilities to compete with others even they come from disadvantage family.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there are many voluntary teams or organizations that offer service to those help-needed places. They may be a working team comprised of college student, medical group made up of doctors, or religious organization which anyone can join in. Although the qualities are differ from so many organization, their directions are the same: help people with no payment.
For college students, with passion to serve, they can regularly tutor children in remote areas which have insufficent educational source like tribes of aborigine on the mountain. Furthermore, the students can also help the tribes's development by promoting the sale of crops the residants cultivate. In the places which is suffering wars or plague drastically need medical help. In Taiwan the professinally medial team never stand behind others in the world. The well-trained doctors cure many patient in the refugee camps and win the repution worldwide.
As a college student, I think I can teach children that grow in the poor family and their parents can't afford them to go to cram school. I will teach them well so that they will have good chance to find a stable and nice job, and they can support their family.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations to help those who are in need. For example, they hold lots of teaching lessons in remote areas, giving good chances to the children to learn. Or, they run refugee camps in developing countries, helping those children that can't have good quality of life, not to mention going school to study!
Although we, ourselves, do lead happy lives every day, every moments there're still many people who aren't as lucky as we are. Therefore, we need to do something to help them. Actually, in the past few months, I volunteered to hold a summer camp in the elementary school, which is located on the hill. My friends and I brought lots of clothes and story books for them. We had a very great time there. Though they can't have priceless things as many as the city's children do, they pleasure all stuffs they have and share with us happily. All we wanted to tell them was "When there is a way, there is a hope." If you keep going and never give up, your dream will come true! I believe.

subject: HW0901
content:
These days, numbers of nonprofit organizations offer and finance various volunteer work to help the people in need both in a society and in the world. For example, some organizations provide personal teaching instruction to the children in remote areas. This tutoring job does offer a great deal of help to the children living in distant regions lack of good sources of teaching. Some charities promote to raise money and recruit volunteers to give an aid to the poor, the homeless and the elderly. They will establish a refugee or a caring center where the needy can be taken a good care. Some may concern about the orphans and battered children. They give these poor children a better and temporary place to live in until these children's problems are solved. Others pass their great love to the people in developing countries in the world. They may run refugee camps where food, clothing and health care are required.
As far as I am concerned, I have been participating in financing the orphanage with NT1000 a month to the World Vision for more than five years. What I have done is just a small part of the world, and I really hope that the people whom I had helped can actually live a better life than ever. In the future, I think I will use my spare time to do volunteer work in person and practically experience what volunteer work is like to enrich my life as well as enjoy the bless of giving than receiving.

subject: HW0901
content: There are more and more nonprofit organizations because people start to focus on human dignity, the gap between wealth people and poor people, someone who is disabled, and those people who are in need. In order to tackle with those phenomenon, these nonprofit organizations would recruit people and collect fund to build the nursing home for elderly and disabled. They also help the people who are unemployed to find the job through training them picking up new skills. They would also go to the hospital to provide some free of charge services, such as counter counseling, help the patients with wheelchair, and give you a warm smile. Actually, they go to the places where suffered from natural disaster such as tornadoes, earthquake, and tsunami. Take myself for example, I have gone to the hospital to do volunteer work. I was assigned to go to the Intensive care unit to deliver a description to the nurse. When I enter the ICU, I saw the patient with fatigue appearance and weak breathing, but the only thing I could do is nothing. But I realized that I still could make my life to fullest by doing such volunteer work, no matter it is easy or not. And I will keep doing this, indeed.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people love to join nonprofit organizations to help those people in need. Such as the people, who have to run away from they homeland due to a civil war, or some children, who were born in developing countries and are too poor to attain schools.
These nonprofit organizations were founded to help these people. They mainly provide schatters for those, who lost their home, and food for those, who are suffering hunger. Moreover, some volunteers provide their knowledge to teach the Children and the skill to help them build houses and medical services.
What these nonprofit organizations have done touch lots of people, I have no exception. In the future, I'd love to join some of these nonprofit organizations to help those people, who are lack of education.
In my opinion, education is the most important value of one person. If I learned some thing, that will be always in my mind, no one can take it away. Education could be a way for these people in need leave their poverty and they can do some thing helpful for their country.
Some one said "Knowledge is Power". I am totally agree with that. In the University, my major is History, I'd love to help the Children to see this world, and to know their own land. They can broaden their mind and make their own country better.
Last but not least, there are lots of people in this world still need our help, if everyone of us can do something for them, this world could be better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provides many pleasant services, such as children tutoring, old men's care, pressure animals protection....... and so on. What they do, we can see them on TV, chemercials on MRT statation. Furthermore, they hold a activitiy to tell people what they do, and how they work.
I was shamed on doing nothing about volunteer work. Someday, I will try to help people who need in my capitities. First, I'll visit a nonprofit organization, asking them is there something I can help? Feagure out what I can do. Tutoring is my best, I can do this one from now on, if they have list. Frankly, I would donate money if I have money to help people.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is true that we need more people to help the ones in need. Nonprofit organizations work hard on this. They even invite famous signers to promote their work, such as Lee-hom Wang. He just finished his trip in Lion Montain. His work was to bring more supplies, like food,clean water and clothes to the people there. Besides supplies transportation, nonprofit organizations also provide services of tutoring children, bringing food to the elder persons who live along and also helping sick people. Those people need social supplies and everyone's help. Some of them might lose their parents under car accident. Some of them might lose their jobs because of econimical recession. Some of them might move to Taiwan because of the war and didn't have marriage in Taiwan.Of course they won't have family to take care of them.
We can see there are so many people in our society need our help. We should really thank those nonprofit organizations' effort. We also must devote ourselves to help the people who need us. It's shame that I never help those people in action till now. However, I would like to teach the children in English. I used to be an English teacher and teaching Children's English. I can teach them in my familiar profession and help the chidren to enjoy learning English.
I also hope everyone takes action to help those people. Show our care and concern toward our people and also people in other countries. We are all big family on the earth. Let's do it!

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations. Their goals vary, including raising funds for poor families, turtoring children in remote areas, adopting orphans in different conturies, and so on. Although this organizations aim at different goals, they all make the world a better place.
As a student, I don't have much time to participate in nonprofit organizations. But still, I've done some volunteer works before. For instance, I adopted a child from Africa when I was sixteen. I donated some money regularly, sending it to the child. Even though I couldn't see the child in person, I know that he really appreciated my help. He sent thankful cards to me twice a month, telling me that his life had been better. With my help, he could buy enough food to eat, and wouldn't suffer from hunger anymore.
If I have time, I would like to do more volunteer works in the future. Everytime when I help people, I feel very great. I give out help or extra money generously, and I will recieve many smile and thankfulness. Those feedbacks always make me happy all day, and they are such accomplishments for me. Most important of all, I want to make this world a better place to live in.

subject: HW0901
content: As I know there are many different services provided by nonprofit organizations. One kind is to help children who are too poor to pay for their tuition or their lunch fee. The other kind is to help people who are challenged in someways, such as disabilities in walking, face damaged, lowed IQ or having rare diseases, some organizations are helping people oversea in developed contries. They help them to get clean water, teach them how to grow food, and provide education for the kids. Some organizations are very flexible. They appear at the disaster places immediately to offer help for people there. For instance, they build houses for people whose house damaged in an earthquake.I have done one volunteer work. It was to as a companior to old people. I have learned something about taking care of elderly, so it was a very good experience for me to do as what I learned, and also help people. In the future, I'd like to help children with their homework especially English homework. If I have the chance to do the tutoring job, I'd like to go to the remote countries in Taiwan, because I think the educational resource there is not as good as here, Taipei. Since I don't have the chance right now, all I can do is donate some of my allowance to those nonprofit organizations. Although, it is not a big thing but I know I am making the world be better.

subject: HW0901
content: Well goes the proverb "To give is to receive." Nowadays, contributing ourselves into a volunteer work is becoming a trend to show our passion forgiving and the deep meanings of life. One of the most famous activity is the "Hunger for 30 hours" held by the Red-Cross Organization. This activity involves people staying together and go without food. This may remind people of their good luck to be in a region that isn't associated with the lack of foods. At the same time, they may deliver some food to the places that is suffering the problems such as the developing countries in Africa. I'm looking forward to the volunteer job I am going to do in July. We are going to tutor the kids in Thailand. This work has nothing to do with any skills or ability but a heart to distribute. While paying time and money to those kids in Thai, I believe it is a trip that I'm going to harvest.

subject: HW0901
content:
None profit organizations play vital roles in Taiwan. They utilize and collect the sources from people's donation and help. When in emergency time, noneprofit organizations always take place of government, providing in-time service for those in need.
We can found their service such as donating a whole computer classroom to those remote elementary schools and coming rescue to people suffering difficulties after big disaster. Sometimes government doesn't have free time to discover the weakness part of the society, but noneprofit organizations are special in insighting the dark side of the society and seriously handling with it. Although there still the poor and the weak haven't been taken care of, but I think it is good idea government should cooperate with noneprofit organizations then Taiwan may become better.
I've been a volunteer since I was young, I usually help noneprofit organizations collect people's receipts or pursue people purchasing the product noneprofit organizations made. It's an unforgetable experience and that's the reason I still want to be a volunteer in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Last year, a destructive earthquake hit Sichuan and so many resecue teams went there to help after the catastrophe happened. This is the most important function of nonprofit organizations. They raised funds to construct schools and houses which were destroyed in the earthquake. Also, they donate daily necessities to those victims.
I have not done any volunteer work so far. But in the future, I want to be a volunteer in hospitals. Taking care of others is what I always want to do.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteer to help with their works, such as helping disable elders' daily life, picking up trash on the streets, help planting grains and fruit in developing countries, or taking care of children who don't have parents. Those service are important to our society, it reduces government's problems.
Since I wanted to major in physical therapy when I was in senior high school, I went to the department of rehabilitation in hospital to do volunteer jobs. I helped some handicapped ppeople to do the therapies, like straching their arms or legs and moving their fingers. Their therapies take a long time, it helped me learn to be a patient person. After I did the volunteer jobs in the hospital, I know how can physical therapy help people. Also, I know how hard the job is, so I appreciate those therapists much more.
In the future, I want to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan. My hometown is Chiayi, there are some children can't have good education since their families are poor. In my opinion, education is most important thing to a country, everything comes from education. I want to help those kids learn to read and write, it's wonderful that you have the ability. Their rights can't be sacrificed since they don't have money. Education is a way to help them get rid of poverty. Although I am only a college student, I will do my best to help the society. It not only help the society but also help myself.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this high-developed island, our cutting-edge technologies have flourished our economy, nevertheless, there are still some pathetic people need the public's helps. That's the reason why those nonprofit organizations like Red cross set up rapidly.
When it comes to their generous conduct, it can't be told in brief. They are fond of giving hands to the old in the rural areas, accompanying and also supplying them some equipments that the old are lack of. Some organizations have tendency to raise money from tycoons or citizens, with an eye to establishing hospitals and schools in the foreign countries. They also hold some campaigns to let people know the ordeals that those poor people suffer. Furthermore, they help those homeless victims cope with the accommodations while the refugees confronting their lovely homes destroyed by some natural catastrophes.
I have been the volunteer since I was in the elementary school. Because my parents are also the volunteers, I'm familiar with those merciful activities. I have donated several books for ten years. My parents also brought me to the hospitals to take care of the disabled and patients. Now, I can only do those trivial matters to help the need, but I have made up my mind to pursuade more people to join us. I think the world will be more wonderful owing to our endeavors and those nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are lots of nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. Like Zugi which is one of the most famous organizations around the world. Those volunteers do many things to help the community. They build schools for children, build hospitals in remote areas, provide medical supplies in places overwhelmed with disease, provide food and water in poor contries and go to those places suffering horrible disasters. Other organizations provide in needy help for poor families, wounded children hurt by their parents, people who want to quit smoke and so on. More and more nonprofit organizations have pop up to help the weak.
I have joined a nonprofit organization recently. The organization is aim to help children in weakness families. They want to build a comfortable place for children to have well education. My job this semester is teaching a third grade boy. I told him English and math once a week on Saturday morning. In basic, I have to check his homework to make sure he is following the school. But what I like to do most is to train his English speaking. He progress a lot weeks after weeks and I enjoy spending time teaching him. We have happy time together and I think that is the most important thing in volunteering.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are some prominous nonprofit organizations in Taiwan helping people in difficult problems. These organizations function in rebuilding cities in disaster: planting by themselves, providing teaching resources to remote areas and running refugee camps.
First of all, planting could be a base for helping others. Since you understand how hard planting is, you know how important the hot food for refugees. Take the Darha-Drum Mountain for example. Not only do they plant for the daily need, but also build the park by themselves. The plantings have some functions; for instance, Tsu-Chi in Hualien plants herbal medicine to provide for refugees in developing areas.
In addition, Tsu-Chi in Hualien runs refugee camps in developing areas. Once they survive in disasters, they transport food to them first and then build temporary houses for them. What impresses me much of Tsu-Chi is they insist building temporary schools for children no matter how it is difficult to get enough education resources. If I have the opportunity serving in Tsu-Chi, I hope I can be a teaching assistant in the schools.
Finally, some clubs in universities form a team to teach children in remote areas in Taiwan. Take National Don Hua University for instance. There is a camp per year named "You are the college students? Students in NDHU plan the whol department classes for them. I have served as a conductor and led club classes. All participants in this camp must come from remote areas in Hualien; nontheless, I was so touched by them that I kept in touch with several children from then on.
Thanks to these nonprofit organizations, we can learn how to help people by ourselves and give them the best help. What I desire now is to attend a club in my school and tutor childrens in countryside of Hualien.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations do lots of things to help those who are in need, and the number of volunteers are increasing. There are many kind of nonprofit organizations in the society, they help a variety kinds of people. Some taking care of the elders who are abandoned by his/her children and not able to take care of themselves. Some of the volunteens go to the countryside where is so poor that many of the children are out of school, the volunteers teach the children to read, then their parents could go to work and be able to increase their standard of living.
I really respect the one who volunteers to help others who are in need. Last summer, I have volunteered in a nursing house. I've done nothing only talking with the elders and reading the newspapers out loud to them. Though what I've done was just a piece of cake for me. The elder grandmas and grandpas looked so happy with my company. During that summer, I've thought a lot, everyone will turn old, and become the one "in need", so why not helping others who need helps while you are able to offer now?
Being a volunteer and devote myself to the society is really an unforgettable experience to me. I will do a lot volunteering in the future, to help people and to make my life more colorful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Walking through the halls in school, you can easily find advertisements on the wall that write "Volunteers wanted!" on them. I often being attracted and take a look to see what kind of volunteers they want to help their work. Those nonprofit organizations really do a good job in helping people who indeed need help. They provide free clothes and foods to the old man who live along, and pick them to the hospital if they're sick. Some organizations provide free books and toys to the children who live in promote areas in Taiwan.
I would like to be a volunteer who walk into remote areas and teach the children there. What I want to teach them is not only the knowledges but also the aptitudes of living. I will tell them, they must keep their mind open and never think themselves as nothing. I can tell some stories to encourage them, too.
Being a volunteer is a worthful experience. Everyone should try so that we can know what wonderful lives we had led.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the highly competitive society, people become more selfish and indifferent. Given these situations, nonprofit organizations try to recruit voluntters to help people in need. In this way, not only volunteers can cultive an altruistic attitude but also people who are in less fortunate situations can receive help. There are various types of services provided by NPOs: Taking something for example, they may tutor children in remote areas either in Taiwan or abroad, provide free phychological councelling with phone calls, and recruit some undergraduates to launch camps in remote areas in Taiwan, etc.
As a major of the department of Social Work, I have took some kinds of volunteer works. The most impressive experience is tutoring pupils whose parents can't afford the surging fees of cram schools. I taught them math every Wednesday night during last semester. I could not help but to remember the optimistic and positive attitude they owned, although some students may live in poverty. From my experience, I think what I got from the students are more than I give. And everyone should participate in volunteer works because our society need more love rather than hostility.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They provide a lot of various and important services to our society and developing countries.
In our society, because of high rate of divoce and and financial problems, more and more children are forced to live with their grandparents. Few grandparents know how to teach their grandchildren homework. Thus, some nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help these children to finish their homework and acompany them to deal with some conflicts from family or society and give them correct values and positive attitude to face their lives.
In addition, some nonprofit organizations recruit some foreign teachers and send them to go to Hualien to teach students English. It's wonderful to see many students have had lots of benefits from nonprofit organizations.
I'm touched by these volunteers; therefore, I am a volunteer in the church which cooperates with one profit organization. My volunteer work is to teach children English and assist them to finish their homework. I think I'm a lucky person because I can help others and most important thing is that I learn lots of experiences and different views from this volunteer work.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations around the world and in our society which help people in need. Some people lost their homes because of the serious natural disasters and some children didn't get the chance to be educated while some elderly people are worried about their next meal.
So the nonprofit organizations are doing their best to make the world better by helping these people. They provide some really important services. They build the roads and villages, and offer food for those whose houses are destroyed, which giving a great comfort to them. In addition, they find books for children in remote areas around the world. And from time to time, those nonprofit organizations visit senior people who live alone providing food, clothes and some money for them.
I have done free tutoring for elementary children in one summer which was my best summer ever. Although they didn't do well in school, they are really sweet and willing to learn. It came to me that they were just like some normal kids except that they needed more care and patient. After the summer, I found that I could do more for people in need. My next plan is to visit elderly in remote areas in Taiwan.

subject: HW0901
content:
"Tsue-Chi" is a well-known nonprofit organization. The group just like the Chinese mean of their name--kind and give.
They usually do recycle to loss waste, take care old people, and help poor child. Although maybe we didn't notice that, they still very happy to do their work. It is a possitive power to our soceity. The Tsue-Chi hospital is also bliud by the organization. They will cure any patient even thought for free. So that the people in remote areas can taken morden medician.
I think volunteer work is not suitful for me. My family, my friends, and my lover: I must care people around me. If we alway do good thing to every one we see, the world may be more joy. The goal is the same.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organization devotes themselves to making a better world. They need no return from money, but they still try their best to improve lives of you and me.
They have done many things but, however, we don't realize sometimes. Due to poor health resulting from smoking, some nonprofit organization tutor the younth to keep away from smoking. Some nonprofit organization also concern about global warming and the emission of green house gas. They provide the cautions and ideas to all the people in the world. They dedicate themselves to save the earth.
In the future, I would like to donate my knowledge and skills to help the developing countries by providing medical treatment. My clinic will be pay-free for those who have economical difficulties. By doing so, the people in edge countries will have less sickness and painful. The smiles toward me will be the best support to this goal. Helping others without money is not an easy thing. It is great for the nonprofit organization to do it. Next time when you see them working hard under the sun, say "Thank you" loudly to appreciate their endless services. It will be the best support toward the volunteers.

subject: HW0901
content:
The best solution to disaster is love. Nowadays, lots of nonprofit organizations convey this concept through many unselfish and responsible activities practiced all over the world.
Never could I imagine the world without these organizations. The children who live in distant area would not recieve the same quality of education with the advanced countries without their help. Many refugees may die for lack of enough food and water without their donation and transportation of those.
However, devoting yourself for others is not only belonged to them, but also what can we do if we really want to contribute to our society. Taking me for example, since I majored in law in the college, I participated in a team which host a annual camp for teaching children the basic knowledge of law. I am still convinced that only with the safe and sound law practice, our country operates well.
In short term, everyone can be the hero to others if you just devote yourself totally, despite you are normal person just like you and me. The love is the only solution, but the answer need to be executed.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide many different services such as provide free supplies and medication for refugees, dig wells for people in remote area, collect donations from people all around the world and give them to those people in need. All the services they provide are about helping people.I have no experiences of volenteer work, but I'm willing to. In the future, I want to be a volenteer teacher who tutor poor children who cannot go to school. By teaching them reading, I can show them how beautiful and hopeful this world is. Once the children can read books themselves, I will try to convince all my friends to donate books to the children, then the children can enjoy reading like the children who do not have finacial problems. Still, if I become a doctor in the future, I would like to provide free medications in Africa. Cure the people who suffer from diseases and prvent them from been contracted again will be my happiness.
There are still many people need help from others, so we should support nonprofit organizations and make this world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work in Taiwan. In my opinion, These nonprofit organizations help the people who are poor and lack resources of taking care of themselves. They usually make volunteers help children's homework in remote area or hold summer camps to play and learn things. For example, when I was a college student, I joined a social club. We set up a small library to invite children to come here for studing. When they were out of class, they could come here. In addition, we went to remote schools in the mountain and helped students to review their homework and we had a very good time. From this experience, we not only helped their needs but also learned a lot from them. Thefore, many college students like to be as volunteers for helping people and broadening their horizens.
To sum up, nonprofit organization recruit volunteers to help with their work because they know a lot of people needed for help and many kind-hearted person like to help them and solve their problems. These volunteers prefer to live a meaningful life.

subject: HW0901
content:
What can nonprofit organizations gain? Or accomplish anything, for that matter? How? By recruiting volunteers, who can give either financial or manual support. With their help, the nonprofit organization can do things. Helpful things, powerful things, good things.
Nonprofit organizations are usually the first to arrive at a scene of disaster, manmade or otherwise. They are also the most willing to help old, sick, orphaned and otherwise crippled beings, caring for the old and sick, schooling for orphaned or abused children. They also help conserve the enviroment, doing thing like recycling, which our Earth desperately needs.
I have done a rather odd kind of volunteering work before, which is helping in a nonprofit organization's bookstore, to raise its funds. That includes shelfing the goods in the store, counting the (not necessarily in this order) goods, and general cleaning. I have also manned the stall during an exhibition.
A nonprofit organization is no joke. It does things that the government--perhaps--cannot. Anyone can help, even you.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people live richer lives as resources are being provided. However, there are still quite a few people who really need help. Luckily, those organization which are non-profit are willing to donate everything they have to give the needed a hand.
As far as I know, the non-profit organizations provide a lot in many fields, such as food, education, recycle, environmental protection, and recruit money. The volunteers gather some bread which is left from bakeries, then they send the bread to those who are poor but are not affordable. In addition, as the education may not available in remote areas, they would like to teach kids there to help them learn knowledge. With their favor, kids can have the opportunity to learn techniques or information from textbooks which are valuable.
Besides, some volunteers also turn trash into "gold"--they do the recycling. As modern people have much more than before, we don't really treasure what we have and throw a way things easily. Volunteers gather trash and devide into several items. That way, they can not only make trash into "gold", but also save the energy and resource.
Personally I have never had the experience as a volunteer before. But I do really want to do something to feedback to society. If I had a chance, I would join the non-profit organization and went to the remote areas for the teaching work. As I'm currently working as an English teacher, I understand and love kids. Nothing will be better than make them educated. I could teach them like alphebats, KK symbol phonics and basic grammar. I believe they'll learn a lot.
In sum, human beings are the animals who live with each other. If we help others, someday we may get help from others, too. We should be kind and generous to devote ourselves, so being a volunteer would be quite helpful.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the improvements of our sociality and technology, people nowaday become more dedicate and more loving. MSF (doctors without border) is one of the best know nonprofit organization in the world. I was really moved hearing the kindness they've done. I'm only 17 now and I'm too young to be dedicated. Although I have little money, nor free time, I'm still willing to do something. In the future, I'll certenly volunteer to be a volunteer to some of the nonprofit organizations I agree with, and dedicate the world! It is altogether fitting and proper that I should do it!

subject: HW0901
content:
There are several nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. However, perhaps the most outstanding two are Red Cross and Tsi-Zhi. Their purpose is to help people who is basically in need. It is their duty to take care of those who are evacuated from an earthquake or a storm and even who suffer from epidemic diseases. With the view to commiting such substantial tasks, the organizations inevitably require some volunteers. People who join them are really kind-hearted. Therefore, I decided to do so.
While the tasks the above two organizations have done seem to be remarkable, what I've done is really humble. I used to participate in a mountain-cleaning club. On weekends, our members always went to various mountains to pick up garbages dumped by mountain climbers. For me, it was such an unforgettable experience because I had really done something beneficial to the earth and all humanity.
Now you see, with little sparks of goodwill to help others or the environment, we are sure to get presents in return. So just come and help others, you will undoubtedly get no regret but feel a sense of achievement in the long run.

subject: HW0901
content:

Next semester, I want to join this kinds of clubs. Furthermore, I hope that I can be an international volunteer in the future. I want to give a hand to children in the underdeveloping contries. I think I will realize that giving is more happier than just accepting in near future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work nowadays. Their work includes tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. I haven't done anything to help yet, but I plan to join and help their cause in the future when I'm able.
The services provided by these organizations are really important to the people that recieve them. For rexample, tutoring children in remote areas of Taiwan. The people that live in these areas are basically seperated from the outside world, so the children don't have things like schools to go to. This results to lack of education, which ends in lack of jobs and bad profit. When volunteers go there with their teaching, it changes for them. And these kids are usually more hard-working than anyone. It gives them a chance to change their own lives. But it all begins with these nonprofit organizations.
For me, I think that I still have a few years until I can actually join them. But I'm already planning. I plan to start off with some smaller services in Taiwan first. And after I feel like I have gathered enough experience, I'll move on and volunteer for some bigger things in foreign countries. Maybe I'll be able to start one of these organizations one day. Who knows?

subject: HW0901

Those boys and girls were laughing and screaming all the time while I was trying to teach them something about English. I was very depressed after the incident and I never do any social work again.

subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901

Nonprofit organizations always want to help people in need have a better life and get out of the poverty. subject: HW0901
content:

Some people may think that helping for the poor people without getting salaries is a waste of time, but most people think it's worth it. Helping poor people, in my opinion, is much, much better and much more interesting than sitting in your office, doing nothing but waiting for the day the company pays you money. subject: HW0901
content:
The more developing the country is, the better life the people can enjoy. With their help, sick people with no family arround or no money can still keep their dignity in the last stage of their life.
A few organizations collect the used items, such as clothes, computers, televisions, etc from the public, reorgnize it and pass to the ones need. It helps the community to severage the resources-from "over-loaded" to "shorted", and also help save the planet from the garbages.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations (NPOs) recruit volunteers to provide some important services in remote areas in Taiwan and developing countries. They also take care of the disadvantaged, such as the poor, the aged, and the disabled, to improve their quality of life. subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are helping people all around the world. They provide foods, clothes, medical services to those who are starving and sick in poor area. subject: HW0901
content:
In most of the countries around the world, organizations are established just to earn money or gain profit. However, there are several non-profit organizations in the world which help people or others with care and love. Most non-profit organizations are charities. They help people who needs living equipments or others who don't have enough food. They help people with almost everything. In addition, they sent living requirements to countries that are poor. They sent money that people have donated to Africa. All they do is to take care of people. Other non-profit organizations, such as the green party, are trying to help and save the Earth. They appeal to people for the fact that our enviornment is in danger and give us warnings.
Now, I often recall that the days I have been volunteering. Remember that time, my mom took me to the "Tzi-Ji" working mom to help her finish the work. Her work was to fold the dark-red blankets and put them in boxes. First, I did not what that was for, though I really enjoyed doing it. Then my mom told me that they were going to be sent to Africa. I was astonished then, but after that, I started to fold more and more of them. I felt very proud of myself. Since then, I went to the working room once a week, just willing to help others. In spite of there was no salary, I still like it very much. There are superabundant of organizations around the world. In my opinion, non-profit ones are the greatest of all. They give services for no rewards. In conclusion, helping people or others is much more important than anything else though earning profit is integral.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations are quiet important to our society. They provide plenty of services. Take the world-known organization, TsiZi, as example, they recycle and sort the garbages every sunday to reduce the amount of trash and make the community clean. They go to the houses of the elderly who live alone to take care of them regularly and to accompany with them so that they won't feel lonely. And the most important thing is they head toward those disaster areas, assisting the victims with neccesities such as water, food and camps. Afterward, they raise money for them to rebuild their houses. All of these above are their contribution to us. Eventually, I found that I'd collected more than 200 a day! So delighted was I that I gave the box to the worker and thinking about those orphans' happy faces. After this wonderful experience. I think once I have time I'll go to be a volunteer and help more people in need.

subject: HW0901
