I and my friends had a band, and we played musics on the street to raise money for the organization at that time. With the experience above, we deeply understand the challenges that noneprofit organizations are facing. What they need is the power and attentions of the public. So besides giving money, what you can help them are just some single steps, like telling your friends you know such telling your friends you know such organization or just cheer them up while you see they are working. And that's what I'm going to try my best to do in the future, too.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many kinds of non-profit organization, and each of them has different but useful functions. About careing of people, we learn that their are food service for street people, careing service for single old people, and the shelter for people suffering from violence or tortures. If we face the unfair treatment on shopping, we may ask non-profit organization about caring pets, encouraging people stop smoking, or taking care of disabled.
Frankly speaking, I've ever done any volunteer work officially. I once tried to adopt a cat from animal-caring non-profit organization. But I think that is not enough. I would like caring the homeless animals in the future. I'm going to keep accompany with the animal, and make sure they'll find a new master. I provide a temporary shelter for them, feed them, playing with them, and the most important of all, finding a new home for them to live permenantly and happily. This is the volunteer work that I pursue to reward our society and world.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, more and more nonprofit organizations were established to help the people in need in remote areas or some developing countries. Although most of people become rich due to the progress of technology, there is still a numbers of poor people need help. In my opinion, the appearance of those kinds of organizations is a great support to the society.
The services offered by such organizations are in a large numbers. For example, they often take care of children who live on the mountain and have few resources to use. Also, some might spread their love to other places, like Africa, and teach them how to grow some economic plants to support their life.
I haven't done such works before. However, after reading the news about these organizations. I really want to do my favor to join their activities. In the future, maybe I will help companing with the children who are poor. To sum up, the more people try to help others, the better the world would be.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are a lot of nonprofit organizations all over the world. People in these kinds of organizations are always voluntary. They have an enthusiastic heart to help others. They provide daily appliances or food to those who have low income. They also offer free and delicious lunch for elementary schools' children. They do something that the government do not see, they help someone in need that we always forget. They give the poors a hand to help them support their lives. These kinds of organizations are sometimes composed of religious people. They may hold a speech in church and tell people who is God and how God helps people. Because their unselfish giving, more and more people would like to join them to help others.
When I was in senior high, students were asked to do volunteer work in public places for eight hours. I have done the work in the library, to tell people where the books they are looking for. After doing the volunteer work, I realized that "Giving is better than receiving." In the future, I would like to be a counselor guidance to guide people who have broken marriages, working problems and so on. I will not only give them advices but share my experiences to them. Everyone has the rights to live in betteralife.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowdays, more and more people devote themselves into nonprofit organizations in order to help people in low-develop countries. Take "MSF", which means doctors without borders for example. MSF is a nongovernmental organization founded in 1971. It mainly provides medical aid for the people not only in the locations where are in the spotlight but also in the places where forgotten wars continue to cause suffering. Moreover, aside from the medical care, MSF also helps people in the disaster area to rebuild their shelters, give them food and cothing.
There are many nonprofit organizations in the world in order to make the world better regardless of religions, culture and nationality. If I have an opportunity to be in one of their membership, I would like to be a sanitary engineer. I want to improve the quality of environment for people who are suffering from bad diseases due to the lack of cleaning water, well-equipped hospitals or even an access to healthy food. All people have their right to having a better life. That's the reason I want to volunteer in this kind of job.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations like Tseji, Redcross provide victims and people immediate help in big disaster. Earthquake like 921 in Taiwan and in Mainland China recently, thanks for these organizations, they went to the place in the first time give people physical supplies and mental support. In these events, we see the true nature of human, we help people beyond the national boundary, because we live in a global society.
I am a lifeguard of the Redcross. I service along the riverside every summer season. In this activity, we provide our expertise to help people play and swim safely. Except that, I donate some money to several organizations, like Tseji, Good Sheperd Foundation. People say "Giving is more blessing than receiving. I will continue to participate in nonprofit group, no matter physically or mentally, that will be good for all the mankind.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are lots of nonprofit organizations in Taiwan recruiting volunteers to do many good deeds and help those in need. Not only in Taiwan but also in some developing countries we can see some volunteers doing their work.
There are two main kinds of those nonprofit organizations. One part of them do their work here in Taiwan. They fight for the benefits of poor people farmers, the disables or workers, and try to have their voice be sound by the government. Hoping they can remove bad laws and push the legislators to set good laws. They may go on street and speak their needs out. And some nonprofit organizations are not that violent, they just do their work silently. They go into the mountains and contact with the aboriginal people, listen to their need or tutor their children. Some of them go into the nursing home and chat with those old, sick patients, and give them mental supports. Still some of them go on the street, not fight for something unfair but try to help those homeless people, give them some food clothes and comfort them.
The other part of nonprofit organizations do their work all over the world. Where there is a famine, war or flood, there is these organizations. They help rebuilding homes for the victims, give them food, teach them how to grow rice.
No matter where these organizations doing their good deeds, I think they worth our respects due to their willing to sacrifice themselves. I myself have done some volunteer work in a nursing home and I talk to some lonely old people and do some activities to have them exercise and make them laugh. I think it's a meaningful work, and I will continue to do other volunteer works in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are important and can help many people. Such organizations give services such as tutoring children, medical help and food supply. In Taiwan, nonprofit organizations go to remote areas to help children and schools collect money, because there are many children who haven't enough money to afford the school's lunch. Some schools can't even have enough teachers to teach children. So, these organizations give them a hand. They help teach these poor children. Bigger organizations can go to other countries, especially developing countries. They give them medical help, in case to save more people from disease. They also send farming teams to help them plant, because in such countries, people are so poor they can't actually buy rice or other things to eat. Thanks to these unknown people in nonprofit organizations, they saved the poor.
Although I've got no experience in volunteering such work, but I truly want to help other people when I am older. In fact, I'm trying to apply for helping children in remote areas now, like giving out food or taking care for little kids. Helping people is my career when I grow up. It's a desire for me to be a doctor. I know it's difficult, but if I really made it, I can help, or even save people's lives with my proffesional knowledge. I've seen a movie before that have a sentence I'll never forget. "With great powers, comes with great responsibility." I will join a nonprofit organization when I grow up. It's my destiny.
Joining a nonprofit organization is not only for certain people. Everyone should do their best to give out a helping hand. Helping is the main idea of happiness. Trust me, you can do it!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations do help a lot with the one who is in need. We have all heard of the "Red Cross Organization," since that we all bought some of their stamps. They gather a large count of money from selling their nonprofit stamps to help the poor and the ill. Though those stamps have no real utilities, we are still glad that we could do good deed with a little money. Organizations like the "Red Cross" is everywhere, "Tsi Zi" is one of them. They send supplies to Africa or countries that just gone through a disaster. They also donate money to build hospitals and schools, which helps the ill with no money and the illiterature. They do all most they can do to help the world to be a better place.
I have not volunteered to any sort of nonprofit organization so far in my life. I should be ashamed, but I am really look forward to do what I can do the help others. I think I will volunteer to be the tutor of the kids in remote areas in Taiwan via the Internet work in my university. And maybe also sign up for the international volunteer during summer vacation next year. It is all about self achievement and the fulfillment of helping others. After all, giving is always better than receiving, doesn't it?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations, or nongovernment organizations (NGOs) have been the most powerful groups in society which deal almost every problem these years. Comparing with political party or company, nonprofit organizations gather citizens who has special protession to solve the public problem without any pay. Volunteers are the major component of these organizations. Although they work without pay back, usually make great effort on the world.
There are two kinds of organizations; one with special studying in certain area such as some groups that concern the science especially ecology issue. These group often uses their protession to protect the natural enviroment and wild life. The other kind of nonprofit organizations participate in variety of work in society, finding and solving the difficulties is their goal. For instance, volunteers of those groups would visit old men with severe disease, making them felt comfort and warm.
I have joined one of the group last summer. It's called "Public Health Serving" founding by our school institue. What's the goal of the serving group is to find the public health problem in the countries. I researched with the proffessor by using medical method to recover one of the disease in mountain area last summer. It was a unique experience of joining such work with the serving group.

subject: HW0901
content:
We are all in the same earth. There are many nonprofit organizations (NGO) help people beyond the distriction of nation. Some NGO are well oragized. They send not only materials to the people who are lack of food and medicine, but also orgnize volunteers to help people to rebuild the house, or tutore their children and so on.
We know that the terrible earthquake causes great damage in mainland china last year, many NGO donate large money and send volunteers to help wounded people, to remain their homeland. One of my sister even attended a NGO to Germany to tutore the children in an orphan institute. The other one serviced in the elementary school in summer time. They are all volunteers to do some services.
I plan when I am retired, I like to read the books to the blind, or record the story with music to the children. Do something to the one who needs my help.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations have helped people all around the world. They have helped a lot of people by providing food, clean water and medical aid. In places that have suffered from war, sickness and proverty and other kinds of bad things. For example. In Africa these organizations help provide food and water to the people. I have never done any volunteer work at all. But I would love to some volunteer work when I graduate from high school. I would love to take care of children who need to be taken cared of. Because I think it is very important for a child to be taken cared of. Not just because it is dangerous for a child to be at home by himself, but also because a child needs to play with somebody. In order to learn how to do things and com-municate with others, so that he can become a person who can talk to people about what his is really thinking about. Another kind of volunteer work I would love to do is to help people in countries that need help. The reason that I would love to do this, is because I believe that a person with the power to do something should help those who do not have the power to help themselves. Those are the things that I would like to do in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are numerous humanitarian projects held by nonprofit organizations to help people all over the world. The objectives of these projects are to improve the lives of the disadvantaged and to make the globe a better place. Everyone is encouraged to become an volunteer and engage in the humanitarian projects. I myself was an environmental volunteer of Tsuzi Bhuddist Organization and I would like to share my experience here.
The services provided by these nonprofit organizations can be classified into two categories. One category is on the material level. That is to say, the volunteers will provide necessities or medical services for the disadvantaged people. The organizations will also set up funds to help them financially. Another category is on the spiritual level. The volunteers will hold activities to delight the disadvantaged. Besides, schools are established in remote areas or underdeveloped countries to instruct and enlighten people.
I was an environmental volunteer of the Tsuzi Bhuddist Organization when I was a graduate student. I worked at the recycling station to sort out the materials that could be recycled. After the recycling job is finished, we volunteers will pack these useful materials and sell them. Then the financial profits go to the funds of our organization, which will serve to establish hospitals or help the disadvantaged children to pay tuition fees.
The nonprofit organization is one of the most admirable and beneficial institutions of human society. Therefore, we should keep on improving its functions and encouraging more people to become volunteers. I think my experience as an enviromental volunteer of the Tsuzi Bhuddist Organization is meaningful and helpful. I hope I can continue to join any nonprofit organization in the future and dedicate myself to this meaningful and respectable objective.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. These organizations give the society many hopes and helps, and also make good effects to some peole. Following are a few examples of their services.
First, nonprofit organizations give hands to those who are poor or have no abilities to help themselves. The organization of single parents family provides society workers to understand what can they help for the family. And the organization of some religious, their volunteers donate foods, clothes and money to the victims of disaster.
Second, those organizations not only provide using things but also provied phycological helps. They talk to some victims almost everyday, trying to help the victims to overcome the harms and terrible experiences. Nonprofit organizations' volunteers bring lights to victims' dark life.
If I can join in an nonprofit organization, I want to go to teach students in remote areas in Taiwan. Because I think that children are our hopes of Taiwan in the future, and they have rights to learn even though they are poor or living so far from city. I also can learn things by tutoring them at the same time. In my opinion, giving is better than reciving. If we had the ability to help people, join in nonprofit organization would be a good choice.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations now play an important role in our sociaty. Ten years ago, 921 earthquake hit Taiwan. Lots of people became homeless and lots of children became orphan. The nonprofit organization like the "Red Cross" help those people in need. They provided the victims places to live, food to eat and clothes to wear. They even helped victims rebult their houses.
Last year, the horrible earthquake took place in Mainland China. The condition was serious than 921 earthquake because there were more people lived in China. Thanks to those nonprofit organization, lots of lives had been save.
I haven't done any volunteer work before. I'm willing to do something meaningful and help other people. As the poverb said "Giving is better than receiving." If I have a chance to do some volunteer work, maybe I'll devote myself to teach children those who lived at the countryside. Lots of students from the countryside were lack of education because their family can't afford them to go to school. I'm willing to be an unpaid teacher and teach them whatever I known. If I can help them get enough knowledge, they can get a job in the fulture and support their family. Maybe the education condition will be better and better one day.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, doing the volunteers is more like a trend. My friend whose major is social working tells me that how the government treats the low-class people in the society can lead the country to a strong nation or to a mess. Thus, with the promoting of the government, there are more nonprofit organizations start to join volunteer works. The following are some types of volunteers I have heard:
One, these kind of organizations were popular in the universities. Every summer or winter vacation, we can see lots of students going to the distant villages or towns to tutor children. Since those children didn't have many resources for learning, the college students always prepares for the whole semester to give children special classes.
Second, some organization would not only focus on our own people, but also pay their attention to other countries. They might give some devices or tools, like the computers or some technical skills for planting.
Moreover, I would like to share my plan for my summer vacations, I join the volunteers for the Olympic in September. I am looking forward to give help to others and learn the experiences at the same time. Giving is better than receiving, isn't it? If there are more people doing the volunteers, it maybe could reduce the unfair in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations also called NGO, is the organization in order to help the people in the world. There are variety of nonprofit organization, each of them have different types of sevice. For example, the Red Cross is a typical type of nonprofit organization, they encourage people to donate the goods for those people inneed. Every month, the Red Cross also promote people to have blood donation. The other famous NGO, they collect the recepit from us and if they get the reward from the government, they use the money to help the homeless people and the vegetables.
I myself have been join some volunteer works in the school. The organization is called "People to People International". The main purpose of the organization is to help the foreign students in Taiwan. We introduce the Taiwan famous food, culture and scenery to them. The organization also help the foreign students if they have any difficults in language, accommodation or traffic in Taiwan. From the voluneer work, I don't get any money but I learned a lot such as I improve my English listening and speaking ability and I have a chance to make some foreign friends in Taiwan.
In summary, once you have the chance to do service work, don't be hesitate! Find the work you are interested in and I believe you will have a high achievement during volunteer work and feel fun of it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations play an important role in our society around the world. they provide many important services to the countries which are not developed well and help people who are really in need.
In my opinion, nonprofit organizations provide services in addition to tutoring children or running refugee camps. they can also provide meadical service or environment protection activities or some easily-learned skills. These kinds of activities will also help the countries to develop well and people to learn skills to make a living by themselves. They will cherish the outcomes and change their lives to become better. I used to join a nonprofit organizations when I was a student at the university. I visited the old people caring centers once a week. I usually took them outside and exercised such as walking or stretching bodies in the early morning. Everytime I finished it, I felt very blissed that I was still healthy to do anything I wanted. The old people there were also nice, they always shared me a lot of experiences and interesting stories that I have never known before. I think I also received a lot from them.
Besides helping people in the old caring centers, I have tutored aboriginal children in the east of Taiwan. I have joined a summer camp to go to aboriginal villages in summer vacation. I taught the aboriginal children English and math. My parents and I prepared it whole semester to arrange the classes and activities. The aboriginal children's kindness and optimism really impressed me and they also helped me to look the bright side of things. I appreciated that I have joined this activity to experience the happiness of different life styles.
I think if I could find time in the future, I would like to join nonprofit organizations to be a volunteer again. It is really worthy and meaningful.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more people are willing to be the volunteers to help others now. They help people in need, not expecting for return. These years, they have helped a lot of people.
Some of them go to poor families, which parents need to work, have no time to look after and teach their children, and also have no money to send their children to a cram school. The volunteers teach these children, so that they can get well educated even they're not rich enough.
Some volunteers go to remote areas in the mountain, setting up the Internet for people there. They also teach them how to use the Internet and get the lates imformations. People living in remote area used to be lack of imformations and knowledge, but because the help of the volunteers, they now can know as much as people living in city. Volunteers also care for the old. Some elderly people don't have families. They often get sick without anyone can take care of them. With the care from the volunteers, elderly people can enjoy some warm, happy time at their late ages.
Though there are already many people volunteer to help other, there are still many people in need and can't recieve any help. Volunteers never can be too many. I've never be a volunteer before since I'm just a student of senior high. I would like to be a volunteer after I get into college when I can have more time. It's never too late to help people.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are so many people in our society need our help. But we have our own jobs, not having a lot time to help those in need. Thus the nonprofit organizations appeared, they do charity as their job. We can donate money to them, let them help more and more people. We also can choose different organizations offer different services. For instance, some help the disabled get jobs, some offter the stray animals a home, others help the poor students can study. Take my family for example, we make a donation on a regular basis to the organization which help the poor families have better lives.
I have done volunteer work on the last summer vacation. I went to the hospital to do volunteer work with my friends. We were given the diffirent tasks. My task was to deal with the paper work. After working all day long, I felt very joyful and the volunteer work was the best experience on last summer vacation. My parents also took pride in what I had done.
I think If we have the better social statuses, we have responsibilities to help those in need. Because nobody wants to suffer from misery, they receive our help out of reluctance. I think one day these people have improved their lives, they are willing to help people, too.

subject: HW0901
content: I have always been impressed by the spirits that the volunteers in the nonprofit organizations have. For example, in a book that professor Lee wrote, Mothe Teresa helps many poor people in Africa, she provides the shelter for them, serves water and foods, and also give them medical help. Just like Mother Teresa, the nonprofit organizations also provide such services. In some special organizations, for example the women organizations they help the women who are badly treated by the men. To sum up, the ambitions of the nonprofit organizations are to balance the resources between rich regions and poor regions and to help the people who are not treated well. Though I am not a volunteer of nonprofit organizations, but I had join a school club that go to Pong-Ho to tutor the children there. We will tutor them for ten days in the summer vacation. In Pong-Ho we will also arrange our time to visit the old people, to talk to them and care about them. By the way, we will do the recycle in Pong-Ho, and teach the children there the concept of recycling. Though we are just a club not a nonprofit organization.

subject: HW0901
content:
Due to the depressing economy and stressful life style, there are more and more people start thinking about the meaning of life. There is a saying "Giving is better than reciving" so it seems a tendency for people begin to get involved in volunteering or Non profit activities to look for the true self-value.
According to this tendency those NPO organizations are willing to provide some useful trainings for young people aims to make undersanding of NPO system and realize there are still millions of people in need. Assisit young people to enhance their skills of organizing and caring heart; learn to make themselves as a usfull tool to make fair contribution for their societies or help the NPO organizations to run some meaning events. Then there will be more people be benefited.
Speaking of my own experience in volunteering, I have been volunteering in hospitals for more than three years. I learned to churish what I have right now and every monment I spend with my beloved people. In addition, I have realized how lucky I am to be able to provide myself to ill patients since I am a healty girl and am capable to do it.
Baced on my past experence of volunteering, I would like to go to some developing countries to do some medical service because I am a nurse and I think it is my duty to promote health knowledge for people's well-being globally then I shall fufill my life and find my core value of my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are a great number of nonprofit organizations and charities existing in the whole world. They do not ask for any wages but help people in need. Thanks to their love, people in difficulties can overcome the obstacles and recover from the sorrow.
While such organizations receive money from different place, they help rebuild the broken destructions caused by wars or natural disease like earthquakes, hurricanes, turnadoes. They send food and clean water to the refugee camps suffering from the poverty. They pay attention to the children who don't have good educations.
Every time when I watch the news on TV, I see lots of sad things occur in our society, but the volunteers from the nonprofit organizations are adapted to give hope to the world. I am so touched by what they have done.
I had been one of the members in a little charity which help the children, who are deaf and deaf, develop their ability. I found they were really adorable and dauntless. They weren't beaten by the natural obstacles but try their best to overcome all the trials. They learned to play the piano, learned to draw, etc. The special and unforgettable experience made me feel that I want to help more people.

subject: HW0901
content:
(1)There are many dark corners in this society and in this world. However, there are many people devote themselves to help those people in need. Many non-profit organizations and asso-ciations are combining the good-wells and strenghth together to spread love for poor people though money-collecting, volunteers recruiting .... etc. Not only tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, also medical services and nursering caves are running there. For example the Association of Hwa-lien Doctors is one of the non-profit organizations. The members of the organizations are providing effective and necessary service without reservation. The only reward for the members are the smiles and "Thanks" from the poor. On the other hand, the NGO help people overseas. The Worldview Association gives a hand to the poor in foreign countries. That also can get respect and diplomatic links with the foreign countries and Taiwan (ROC).
(2)I am a member of Animal Protection Association of Hsin-ju city. Although the target of this organization is homeless dogs and cats, but in my mind they are all lives. Pets are people's best friends. We are trying to match nice masters for those poor animals. Those people who have pets will enhence responsibility and love cares. In the future I'd like to devote myself in educational business for free. Not only the family education and both self-education. I'd like to see this society can become a cultivated and polite one. The quality and quantity of people are both with high level. To organize some people who have the same idea with me is the first step. Wait and See!

subject: HW0901
content:
Two of the most famous nonprofit organizations conducting charity services in Taiwan are the Buddist Tsu-Chi Foundation and the International Red Cross Society. Both organizations are well known by their deep involvement in helping people experiencing big natural disasters. For example, the Tsu-Chi Foundation sent thousands of people to Mainland China just two days after the giant earthquakes happening in Sichuan, China, in 2008. Tsu-Chi Foundation's teams consist of people from various professional backgrounds such as medical doctors, nurses, fire extinguishers, construction workers and sometimes even cooks. Those volunteers helped the survivors of the giant earthquakes to identify their lost family members, to build emergency shelters and to establish medical services, just to name a few.
While I haven't had time to participate any of the volunteering work by myself, I will certainly dedicate my self to such types of charity activities as soon as I can be on leave of my work. After all, giving is better than receiving.

subject: HW0901
content:
"Giving is better than receiving." This sentence is always in my mind. When I was a child, mom kept teaching me, "don't be hesitated to help the people who are in need." That's the reason why I kept join some charities no matter where I moved.
Last summer I took part in an international volunteers cultivating camp. It was a wonderful experience. From the courses and activities of the camp, I learned that there are so many ways to help people in the world. The camp provided us several classes such as "How to inspire students' interest in learning Chinese?", "How to contribute to the undeveloped countries in practical way?", "How to lead a group when there was an unpredictable disster happened?", etc. Some of the classes were really challengeable to me, because I didn't know a lot about the situations in poor countries at first, so I couldn't understand immediately while the teachers were teaching the methods in helping people there. I was a little bit upset at that time.
However, the last three days, all the members in the camps were sent to different remote areas to try teaching children there. After I contacted the junior high school student there, I realized all the concepts in classes and the reason why they want to help people in these ways. That's because by these helping methods, we could help people in most enfficency way.
What I learned from this camp was not only those useful and practical knowledges on helps people, but also the attitude. After all, it is our responsibility to do a favor for people who are in need to thank this sociaty that had also helped ourselves.

subject: HW0901
content:
These nonprofit organizations provide physical and mental services in the world. In part of physical services, they collect foods, water, clothings and a variety of things from society. And the other part mental services, is significent to those receive the help. Because a sweet sentence can warm the broken heart. People who accepts the help would emerge their smile again.
As far as I concerned, I haven't had an experience to be a volunteer work. But I hope I could be a volunteer to take care children or teenagers who has a complecated back ground or no parents. I think a person in his or her life the most important proccess is the adolense. If they had bad memories when they are babies, they do need more love and patience as they grow up. If not, they have more probably to be on wrong way. Therefore, I wish that I have this ability and time to be such this volunteer, not only help children but also solve some problems caused by tutoring children in the society.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, working for nonprofit organizations is a trend in global village. The primary principle of these organizations is to help people in need. Children in remote area, lacking access to knowledge, and refugees of natural disasters or wars in developing countries are the main targets.
To enhance living standard of those people and ensure their human rights of education, nonprofits organizations send a large sum of volunteers to these areas. For example, volunteers like college students or inexperienced teachers may be sent to deserted mountains in Taiwan to teach the children in poverty. Others with adventurous personality may go abroad to help the poor in developing countries, like building the water system.
To me, it's a little shameful that I have no experience of doing any volunteer work. On the contrary, I am always taken good care by my parents. Therefore, I resolve to change. I think I have the ability to help the children, especially teaching them some basic Chinese characters or English words. In my opinion, it's time to give rather than to receive from the society all the time.

subject: HW0901
content:
Thanks to some nonprofit organizations in Taiwan, many people in need can have better lives than before. Owing to the rapid development of our society, people tend to emphasize more on material life rather than pay attention or care about others. People become selfish and indifferent, thus we can always see violence and many tragedies on everyday news. In order to save or society, we should support those nonprofit organizations.
As a proverb goes, "Giving is better than receiving." I quite agree with it, because that means you have the ability to take care of others instead of being taken care of. As a teacher, I used to teach in summer vacation for some students. Unlike other students, they can't afford to take extra classes in cram schools. Thus, I volunteered to teach them for free after class. I feel truly happy whenever I do so. There are also some important services should be provided, and I think the most important are the elder who live alone and the education of kids whose parents are in interculture marriage. The following suggestion may help to solve these problems. First, the nonprofit organization can send more volunteers to accompany those elderly. To sum up, nonprofit organizations need everybody's support. And I think only when everyone learn to care about others can our society become better. Taiwan is a great place, and we have to cherish all we have and always spare no efforts to a better future.

content:

subject: HW0901
content:

These kids are from broken family or raising by single parents, therefore, they can not get well care after school. I think it is very important for nonprofit organizations to recruit volunteers to help with their work. The society is belong to everyone, some live well and some live poor. It is benefit for everyone, if everyone help each other and make a harmony society. I would like to suggest everyone if you have free time go to do the voluntees.

content:

content:

However, there are still a plenty of under-developed countries suffer from terrible droughts and floods, serious food shortages and fatal infections diseases that pose a great threat on people's life. From their conduct, I can see the virtue of kindness and devotion. After I finish my studies in medical school, I would be a volunteer doctor to provide medical services, protecting them from being infected by fatal diseases and upgrading their living standard.

subject: HW0901
content:

I am a volunteer in a nonprofit organization. I simply stay in the recycle station to help "organize garbages" on Sundays. There's a mountain of the so-called trash waiting for us to put them into different sections such as paper, metal and plastic. The reason why I call it the so-called trash is because you'll definitely find something still in function or useful. People sometimes throw them away just because they're out of time. I find it really great to reuse these no matter electronic appliances or bottles. It's a way to precious everything that our mother nature gives us. Since people now adapt to the more luxurious and extravagant lives than before, we should be aware of the environment and protect the world by a simple stepusing everything to the fullest and recycle to make our world a better place.

Also, some organizations put donating box in the stores, letting people donate little change into it. They sometime use the money to help the sick while sometime to help the poor. Educating, health caring, or just simply money supplying for the poor are the main things these nonprofit organizations do. Besides all these above, these organizations not only help the poor in our own country, but also in foreign countries. When a disaster happens, the nonprofit organizations send supplies like food or water to the place. Also, they send some volunteers to help recover the place. All these things mentioned above are what the nonprofit organizations do and without any rewards or paid.
If I have the chance to do so in the future, I would like to go to the remote areas to help the poor, especially the kids. There has so many people need us to give them a hand neverless in our own country or ouside of our country. Open your hands you will get more. This is what I'm believing in.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work because they want to change the world and the society through the power of the volunteers.
For example, the World Vision often holds the Famine Thirty activity in order to not only help the refugees with no food, but also educate the citizens that we mustn't waste the food.
Another example is that Iden Foundation keep the uniform tickets to help the "plant" people, the people who cannot move. The volunteers gather all the tickets, change the prize, match the winning number, and send the money to some family who has the "plant" people.
For me, I have attend the Iden organization as a one-day volunteer. I help the volunteers to clean the windows and the platforms catagorize the tickets, and do an one-hour assistant. This experience educated me that not only they got the benefits, but also me.
In sum, these nonprofit organization recruit volunteers not only change the society through their power, but also collect their love and to every person who needs their help.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide services such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, running refugee camps in developing countries, helping old people who lived alone or strayed animals. They recruit volunteers who are full of kind, patient, sympathy and eager to help others to make the worlds better. They don't have salaries, because it's a nonprofit organization, but helping others make us happy, I think it's the best pay.
I've never done these kind of volunteer works before, but if I could, I would like to take care of those old people who lived alone. Some of these old people they don't have kids to look after them or they have some dicease but don't have enough money to see doctors, I really want to do something for them, I could take them to park to walk and do some simple exercise or go to hospital with them, moreover, I could chat with them and help them with the housework.
I hope that I could do this kind of job in the future, although it's nonprofit, it doesn't matter, I think people should help each other, if everyone could achieve this goal, that would be an ideal society.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in the world. From rdios, from newspapers, from magazines; we can see some reports or advertisement about them from time to time. Many of them contribute a lot to Taiwan and even to the world, their feats are admirable and make people want to know something and learn something from them.
As far as I know, in the past few years in Taiwan, the number of nonprofit organizations increases rapidly. Taiwan is a rich island, but there are still a lot of problems to solve: Some students can't afford lunch at school, some children can't learn well since they can't follows the lectures of teachers at school, some women and children are mistreated by other family members, some old people are abandoned by their sons or daughters, and the list goes on. See! There are so many problems in Taiwan. Although our government try to do its best to solve them but, in fact, most of the time the government have to depend on those nonprofit organizers to achieve their goals. Nonprofit organizers usually recruit volunteers through newspapers or the Internet. The work of those nonprofit organizers includes funding money all around, taking care of the old and the yougn, tutoring children who can't learn well, and helping refugees after the earthquake or any other cotastrophe.
I have taken part in some activities which was held by some nonprofit organizers, and what impressed me most is Hugry 30. Despite the fact that my mom told me not to participate in that since she was worried about my health, I still insist. I hoped I could experience what those refugees in Africa experience, and saved more food for them.
This summer vacation, I would go to South Africa with my club to help those suffered from AIDS. I hoped that their lives would be better due to my work and the contribution of many nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more nonprofit organizations in Taiwan, and they provide many services to help those in need. For example, they often gather money donated by a lot of kind people, and spend it buying some things, like food or clothes, to those people who are too poor to get them. In addition, they may go to deep in mountains and help children to study. Such is education that though in remote areas, they should have the same standar as children in city.
I am sorry for not having taken part in any volunteer works. But if there are any opportunities for me in the future, I will do it without brooding. And what I would like to do most is to take care of old people who are living without their relatives. Because I think it is poor for people to live alone. I can be accompanied with them and talk with them. All I have to do is make them feel not lonely.
Not everyone lives as comfortably as us, so as long as we have time or money, we can help them to live more comfortably.

subject: HW0901
content: There are alot of nonprofit organizations in our society. Their scale are not same from each other at all. From a normal university to the international organizations can provide different kinds of services. For example, there is a really famous organization called red cross association. It is known by whole world because it provides the first-hand rescue and medical resources for the countries who are damaged by natural disasters or war and those who in need in the poor, low development countries. Moreover, due to the green house effect, there are aloso alot of organizations who work hand in order to protect our environment. They make their efforts to protect the spices which probably will disappear from the world, encountering with government about the problem of pollution that factories and industries bring us .... etc. As a university student, I also had made some efforts to this society. I went to a remote elementary school with some of my friends this winter vacation. We went there to tutor and held some interesting activities for those cute little boys and girls. Due to the few resources they own, I realized the huge gap between cities and counties. During the winter vacation, we sometimes cooked, and read books the childrens. This experience really improved me a lot. I think in the future I will spend more time to participate this kind of volunteer work, because I have really learned alot form it.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are a lot of nonprofit organizations in the world, such as Red Crossed, Green Peace and so on. We recognize these organization through TV, news papers, and web sites everyday, and get more details about their purposes and their helps to the world. Some organizations might recruit volunteers to tutor young children in the remote areas or running refugee camps in developing or poor countries while others might focous on saving earth, saving energy or other kinds of environmental protections.
If I get a chance to work as a volunteer, the organization which I want to join the most is Green Peace Organization. The reason why I want to join Green Peace is simple: "The earth is our mother, and all of us have responsibility to help and improve the surroundings, so I shall pay effort and pay participant in the action."
To be a volunteer of Green Peace Organization, I will try my best to persuade my friends and my family not to turn on the air-conditioner too often or take MRT or buses rather than driving cars. Through these small tips everyday, we can save the plant by ourselves and let our children live in a better condition in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, human rights' problem has risen. More and more organizations concern about this kind of problems. For instance, The International Red-Cross organization helps people that have financial problems in remote areas. Some other nonprofit organizations give medical service in undeveloped countries.
I'm a high school student. I joined in a rotary club when I was a freshman. I learned a lot from this club. I participated every activities in the rotary club, such as picking garbages in the mountain, visiting the orphanage and standing beside the road to collect money which was donated by the pedistrian. These kind of experiences made me realize that we should cherish the things we own now. We shouldn't take things for granted. Above all, we need to be contented.
In the future, I would like to participate in some nonprofit organizations, volunteers to help people all over the world. If I got enough money I will donated to the orphange. I hope I can really achieve my goal in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Such was the nonprofit organizations' efforts that make the world a warm place!
In nowadays, the world is making exploded improvements in high-technology. No matter how, we have to acknoledge that "The technology lies in humanity." We still aquire the warmth from people and the human beings' connection as well. It is the nonprofit organizations that reach out to the society when it's indeed. The world was aided by them spectecular when facing unavoidable natural disasters, for example, the mental and materials aids for China earthquakes from Tzu-chi charity, the food aids to South asia tzunami from Red Cross organization and World vision's aids for Africa. These are just simple examples of their great contribution to the world.
Last year, I attended a thanks-giving project that was held by Jin-dian organization. I did recycle for my community, clean the surroundings and grow some plants for a month to feedback to my community. The contentment fullfilled me, and encouraged me to help the community more often. I learned a lot in the process!
United we stand, divided we fall. Only when "Think global, and work local." can we make the life better and make the world better!

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, more and more people in Taiwan devote themselves in nonprofit organizations. Nonprofit organizations are organizations that provide help for people in need or the government without getting any profit. The important services they provide include providing places for teenagers or divorced people to stay in, sending volunteers to accompany with the lonely elders, or even taking care of stray dogs and cats.
I myself have been a volunteer for two years since I entered college. My schoolmates and I go to a orphanage near our school, NTNU, every Thursday. Our duty is to accompany with the children in the orphange, and teach them with different activities according to their ages. We read books for them; we tell them how to draw a picture, and we also teach them how to dance and sing. If they have any problem with their homework, we try to give some advices and figure it out with them. I have a great time getting along with those children, and from their facial expression, I could tell that they are happy to have our accompany. From the experience of being a voluteer, I gradually become a person who is more mature and more able to pass forward my love and care to others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are some nonprofit organizations are trying to do their best to do something good to our society. For example, there is an organization for blind people, and I am a volunteer in this organization. They need volunteer to help them do some recording and reading for those blind people can know what the books are talking about.
There is another organization is also for blind people. It is the guide dog training center. This organization also need volunteers to help them to do some administrative work. If you have guide dog training lisence, you may be welcomed to help them trining guide dogs.
There are so many people waiting for our help in the world. We can help them through some nonprofit organization. If we have time, we can be volunteers to help them. I keep on being volunteer in the blind organization, I also donate some money for guid dog training center and homeless children center. I am willing to go to the mountains in order to help those far-district region. Those regions in the mountains was destroyed by some disaster, like typhoon or earthquake. Many people are homeless and no food or drink. I would like to be volunteer to deliver some goods to them.

subject: HW0901
content:
It may be unbelieveable for many people in Taiwan to know that there are still lots of people suffering from poverty, hunger and illness. Therefore, many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help them with their work, such as donating blood, tutoring children in remote areas, providing food to the poor, teaching people how to grow rice and vegetables in Africa, building schools and hospitals in some poor areas, or running refugee camps in developing countries.
Both of my parents are sincere buddists and they are also members of Tzu-Chi. They always find time being volunteers like recycling the garbage for our community, visiting those people who are old and live alone in the countries regularly. Sometimes they invite me to join them when I go back home to visit them. My parents always teach me to treasure the blessings in my life and not to take everything for granted. Although I just started working for a year that I don't make a lot of money every month, but I donate NT$1,000 every month to charity organizations. I also tutor some kids from poor families English on the weekend. In fact, I feel happier even though I've become busier and busier. I'm proud of myself that I try my best to help people in the society and that also makes me become a happier person.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, nonprofit organizations have recruited a lot of volunteers to help with their work. They have planned many programs to help those who in need. One of the most famous nonprofit organizations is Chi-Ji.
Over these decades, Chi-Ji has done great things to our society. For instance, whenever there are natural disasters, Chi-Ji is always the first one to arrive at the area. They provided local residents with daily supplies, food, and clothes. Moreover, they will set up an account for people to donate their money and then give these money to those who were suffering. Take the last year earthquack in China for example, Chi-Ji had recruited volunteers in a shortest time and had arrived Si-Jan quickly. They always help people in a silent way and never expect money in return. Every time when I see their news on TV, I feel that I am useless and have no contri-bution to this society. I just watch how others help people but do nothing at home. So, I have made up my mind and I plan to join Chi-Ji this summer vacation. I hope that I can help remote area's children to study English.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations gradually gain their popularity in Taiwan. They not only involve in the disaster rescue in foreign countries, but also do their best in providing children from remote areas in Taiwan with better chances of education. Organizations such as Tsu Zhi, help those lonely elderlies as well as the poor. The Red Cross Foundation raises the international rescue compaign to help other countries suffering from wars or disasters. There are many of them helping those disadvantaged with job opportunities as well as social security. In conclusion, due to these organizations' effort, our society have become a better one.
I have joined in the voluntary work that help kindergarten teachers with those children. It has been a happy memory because of the children's naive and innocent smiles. I also joined in the holiday cleaning group to help clean our neighborhood. However, I prefer the former because it not only provides me with a chance to interact with those young kids but also a chance to tutor them. As a result, I would like to join in the club that help those children in remote areas in learning help and afterclass care. In addition, I want to join in the anti-smoking campain, which involves outdoor activites. Above all, helping people with a selfless heart can bring the world more happiness and joy, so why not join the groups now?

subject: HW0901
content:
We get a lot of imformations about nonprofit organizations helping the property and the people suffering from hardships. The best known nonprofit organization is Tsu-ji, a budist organization in Taiwan, helping anyone who needed help and care all over the world. There is also a big amount of nonprofit organizations dedicated to different social problems, such as female rights, gay rights, children rights and so on. They protect their rights by supporting politic leaders hoping to make laws and protect their rights.
On other aspects they reach out their hands to people who are on the edge of the society. Some organizations established food banks provided to refugees and also peoples who are unemployed in recent days. There are also volunteers who visit the elderly living alone, giving them intensive love and care.
The volunteer work that impressed me happened in my junior high. My classmates and I went to an orphans home to accompany the lonely children. Happy to find people visiting, they played and chatted joyfully with us. I was totally engaged by their smiles when they welcomed us. I made my mind to be a volunteer for children rights in the future. Every one of them are the future stars that shines when they turn up to become an adult. I can be a teacher and tutor the lovely kids.
The aims of nonprofit organization has promoted social rights' improvement while the government is too busy to reach out their hands. I believe that nonprofit organizations keeps the harmony of society. In the future when I can become a volunteer, hopefully, I can reach out my hands to those in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the economic in the higher classes gets better, the worse it gets in the lower classes. Therefore, more family with children unable to attend school in appropriate age increases rapidly these few years not only in Taiwan. Furthermore, some elders left alone by their children is also often seen today. We begin to wonder what is happening to their conscience in the society today.
With more social problems gaining, nonprofit organizations recruiting volunteers to help out the people is becoming even more well-known. As far as I know, services such as tutoring children, founding money for ills and countries that had just came through nature disasters and ... etc.
In many universities, such organizations become a part of the students' extra-curricular programs. They participate in the services aforementioned. One of the volunteer works I'd like to try out is teaching children art or daily chores in the remote areas of eastern Taiwan. If I have a chance to do so in the comming summer break, I believe it would be a very meaningful thing.

subject: HW0901
content:
As far as I am conserned, saving people's life is the best thing in the world. Every time when I saw accident happened in the world, I felt sorry for people living there as they were not born to suffer these accidents. Fortunately, there were always somebody stand up to rescure. When these people get together, they found some nonprofit organizations which aim is to help the world to work in the better way. Because we are human, none of us should suffer. As a result, they offer every kind of help to those who are in need. They provide food for those in hunger and teach them how to grow crops, fight against some companys which only goal is to make money, and rescure those who suffer from accident, providing them tents, food and water. How great these nonprofit organizations are!
As for me, a freshman in this September, I have some time to join in these group to donate my ability. Perhaps, I can teach children in remote areas in Taiwan. This can help them study easier, or they may be more interested in books. This can make them smarter in the future. This is exactly what I want. Afterall, it's better to give than to receive.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more volunteers help at nonprofit organizations. They work there for helping those underprevileged people. They might hold summer camps to teach children some knowledge, such as English songs, chants, dancing, making masks, cooking, etc. They also tell stories to kids in elementary schools once a week. Students can learn more by listening stories. Moreover, they provide scholarships for those children who perform well at school. These are the most important services provided by nonprofit organizations.
Take me for example, I've been tutoring children after school for five years. Most of them are raising by their grandparents; on the other hand, they seldom do their homework or study at home. Therefore they need me to tutor after school. Although I can't teach them well, at least they all finish their homework on time. My satisfaction comes from these kids. Watching them growing up day by day is the energy for me to continue tutoring them. Thanks for these nonprofit organizations, so that I have the chance to tutor children after school.

subject: HW0901
content:
Economic improvement, wide spreading of educations, and globalization have lead many people or organizations not only focusing on earning more money but also tring to use their money to help those in need. The most famous international one is the Red-cross, which provide medical survices around the world. Decades ago, without a complete medical networks in Taiwan, many Taiwanese benefited from their aids. Nowadays, there are also several nonprofit organizations popping up in Taiwan. , for example, have recruited those with same religious faith to go to less-developed areas to provide food and living goods for the poor. Recently, more volunteers join them not due to same religions but to the same thought to help others, providing educational supports, technical supports to improve other Taiwanese and people around the world.
I have join an organization aiming to protect marine animals. Since pollution problems are getting serious, it's also important to save our environments and the diverse animals and plant in the world. In the future, I will still keep the pace to involve in environmental protections.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations, and they are needed.
As everyone knows, some of the nonprofit organizations provide medical services in countries which far away from big cities, and sometimes they establish hospitals, too. Not only in the medical services, some of organizations provide educational services. They send teachers to remote areas where the children are lack of educational institutions or schools. In addition, there are some rescue teams trains by those nonprofit organizations. When there are earthqueck or typhoon, the rescue teams are ready and they will go to the hitted places beyond the distance.
After talking so many services that nonprofits organizations have done, I should do somethings as a member of the society. I took part in tutoring children in remote areas during my freshman summer vacation, which I really want to join once again. I think that is what I can do as a student.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations in Taiwan are taking more and more care for the poor and physically challenged people. What they've done are not only in Taiwan, but their love are also spread all over the world.
A famous organization in Taiwan called Zi-Gi, is one of the best examples. The volunteers in Zi-Gi take professional training before they go for help. After, they go to the remote areas to provide food and medical services for the poor and illness old men to make them have better life. What's more, they give a hand to all the people around the world. There was a terrible earthquake in China and it made thousands and thousands of people homeless. When Zi-Gi organization got this news, it immediately sent volunteers and food there. All they want to do, was to decrease the damage into the lowest point.
I am now only a student, it is impossible for me to do magnificant actions. Next month, some of my classmates and I are going to the remote areas in Mount A-Li to teach the elemantary students there. I wish I can give them more knowledge for them to use. And I wish when I grow up, I can help more and more people who really need my help. That's what we are born to be, isn't it?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organization! Why and how could they exsist during a century when money is everything?
All over the world, more and more nonprofit organization have been found, and their main goal is to help those in need. Disposing garbages, looking after elders, raising the poor ... every job that we hated the most are done by these nonprofit organization, and more over, they ask nothing in return but a warm and kind smile saying, "Thank you! "
Inspite of the fact that there are no salaries, I am considering volunteer the school camp to foreign country where we study in the morning and devote ourself helping the poor after school. It may be tiring, but I'm sure this trip would brings me inspiration and gratefulness toward life.
In general, the volunteers that ran the organization may not have the same age, gendor, profession, hobbies nor fortune. But one thing is sure, and that is they all have love in their heart.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the technology rapidly progressed, many people are getting wealthier than before. Simultaneously, it is a true fact that there are always some undeveloped countries or places which can only live hand to mouth everyday. Some don't even have places to live, foods to eat, not to mention having good education.
Accordingly, these sort of nonprofit volunteer groups come to their help. As the name suggests, this group doesn't get paid or treated. They provide those children with books, teachers and refugees with places to live. They can also bring up the orphans with their cherity funds. As for me, though I am of the conception that volunteer work is worth time and effort, I haven't done any till now. What I probrably want to try is tutoring the kids in remote areas and giving them books to read. Not only can I feel proud of myself, it can probrably change the children's entire life as well.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations, such as red-cross organization, attracting more and more focuses because the global villiage has already build, by the efficient travel and convenient communicate to the world.
Lacking of food in a African small village is not just their own problem and talent anymore but we suffer together. This are the main idea of this kind nonprofit organizations, get rid of the panic even from the minest corner in the world, making every humankind live humanity and dignity.
What I would probably do in the future will be healing people's disease in the world by join the non-bounding doctor's league, that's a nonprofits organization too, with the top medical and healing team in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:

Because most disabled might be rejected by employer for their body status.
Those organizations are nonprofit so they have to fund money by people and big corporations. Another way to save budget is recruit volunteers to help their work. In fact, I've never join this kind volunteer work. But, in this summer, I'd like to try to totor children in remote area. I think learning new knowledge is one of happist thing in the world. However, there are some kids can't study well for lack of enough text books and teachers . Then they might can't enter good high school or university and become another social problem, unemployment, in the future. I want to solve this problem in root. Therefore, totoring children in remote area is my next plan of volunteer work.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the recent years, the form of our society has become a "M" shape. Which means people who are rich become wealthier and people who can't make a living become even poorer. In order to solve this problem, some charity are trying to give a hand to those people who needs help. First of all, lots of nonprofit organizations raise money to the poor and build classrooms for the children who live there. They also help them solve the problem of lunch because lots of families can't aford it. In my opinion, there is one more thing important. We should respect them rather than look down on them. If a child thought that he has been discriminated, he will be lack of self-esteem. Even when he grows up, he will have no courage to do things well. As a result, we should respect them while giving them help.
Secondly, I have been volunteer to collect receives from people who are waiting for the traffic light. Although it is not easy to stand there for a long time and talk to strangers, I think it is worthwhile because those receives mean a lot to people who need help. I also volunteer to clean the mountain with my mates. It was a time consuming job and you will find out that some people are selfish. They throw the garbage without thinking that it may harm the environment. I enjoy doing those things above, and I learned a lot from them.
In summary, lots of children in remote areas and developing countries need help. In addition, we can help them by joining charities and nonprofit organizations to be a volunteer to give them a hand. As a result, we will have a world with no poverty.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries.
There are several important services they have done, such as building schools and hospitals for refugees, providing daily resources, namely water, food, cloth for them and take care of children who were in the orphanages or in the poor educated areas. These nonprofit organizations do help many people in disaster.
If I can, I would like to tutor those kids. Since I am a student who study the education, I've learned some educational issues about those poor informationed children.
Therefore, I want to teach them to catch up with those urban children, to make them have more competitive edges. Education should be immese, whatever your economic situations or your living places, everyone have same rights to be educated.
I'm glad that we have those nonprofit organizations in our country. If everyone in our earth can do charities like them, the whole world will be more peaceful and beautiful than ever before.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are thriving in our society recently, and more and more unfortunate people are relieving due to the founding of these organizations. Although I'm not familiar with these organizations, I still feel grateful for them. They've saved so many people by providing them food and education while they don't get any benefits by doing these. They've rescued plants and animals that are almost living on the brink, but they don't get awards or fame by doing so. Some of them even go to remoted countries to provide techniques of growing crops. These tasks takes a lot of stamina, yet their unflagging spirits won't stop them from giving.
I am astonished by them, and they also stimulate me to volunteer doing charity. In the future, I would like to take action for saving rainforests. Nowadays, man are cutting down trees, leaving animals with no shelter. Soon, we used up the vital elements of earth, which are trees, and animals start to perish. I won't let such tragedy happen, so I'd like to do this in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Thinking of a nonprofit organization, it will always be some charity works they've done. This kind of organization, such as Fu-Lun, there is always news of how they helped the poor family, how much money they donated to the school, etc. Sometimes they held a flea market. Although I have no experience of providing this kind of survices to people, I think helping others will never be too late. If I have the chance in the future, I'll definetly join the crew and help people around the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many nonprofit organizations are trying to help those who live in remote areas or countries. They tutor children so that knowledge will spread to the areas. These children can have good education in the future if they have knowledge and do the entrance exams well. They also provide computers with the Internet so that even if people live in remote areas, they can still keep contact to the outer world by means of surfing the Internet.

There are many people who need our help in Taiwan. If we have time and strength to help them, we should do our best!

content:
Nowadays, more and more people volunteer to do the charity. For example, some organizations help the poor children to go to school and offer lunch to the children. I think this is what I have to do in the future and also the most important thing

subject: HW0901
content: There is a great group of people who sacrifice their time and efferts to give their hands to those who need help; that is, nonprofit organizations. " If all of us can provide a few efforts, I believe our world would become better and better. So, what does the nonprofit organizations offer?
