Those volunteers in nonprofit organizations help from children to adults. For children, they enter emote villages and areas to tutor children. On the other hand, they set up running refugee camps to let those who lose their homes unfortunatly. How does a student like me be able to give the hands? In fact, I have already join this kind of work. Last summer, my university especially English Department let me have an chance to teach child English in the summer camp. All the lessons are free. Providing my professional knowledge to help children who are from poor families is valuable a lot to me. That experience also gave me a stage to learn how to teach and behave like a teacher. Most importantly, I had an unforgotten summer.

subject: HW0901
content:
What is nonprofit organization? It is a organization that help people without profits. In our life, there are lots of nonprofit organizations. These organizations always help people when they are in need.
When there are tornadoes, earthquakes or typhoons. These kinds of natural disasters always bring lots of damages. People become homeless, get hurt or lose their family. Some nonprofit organizations will establish refuges, help finding lost people or provide medical therapy. They help people to start their new life.
When some people are physically-challenged or some infants don't have their parents. They don't have any abilities to live. Some organizations will teach them some skills, help them to learn books and establish some buildings that they can live in.
When I was a junior high school student, I went to an orphanage to help them. I sweeped the floor, vacuumed the floor and washed windows. It is the first time I do the volunteer work. Now I am a senior high school student. Once, my school held a program of donating blood, I participated this program and I think It is not so scaring that I used to think. I feel very great when I help people. In the future, I don't think I have a lot of time to be a volunteer. But I will do what I can do. For example, I'll donate money to beggars or nonprofit organizations and donate blood in hospitals. When I do a little, it may become a big help to other peoples.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are plenty of nonprofit organizations in the world. They recruit volunteers helping others. Take Red Cross for example, they service everything they can do, such as donation, helping others by themselves. They went to remote areas to save lifes by rescuing the victims of disease. No matter how far the way is, no matter how dangerous the areas are, as soon as they are informed, they just take off. Their kindness inspire lots of people who volunte to participate in nonprofit organizations.
Inspired by such things, I determined to devote myself whole day to help people who need. I chose an orphange to be a volunteer. I played with them, taught them how to make stuff, and even helped them take a bath. The smiles of children are so sweet that I almost forgot the tireness. Since then, I have learned that the world is not as wonderful as I think, there are a large amout of people needing help. The more kindness we give, the more wonderful the world will be.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations are becoming more and more all over the world. They recruit volunteers to help them with a lot of work. With the help of volunteers, these nonprofit organizations will have enough money to provide foods and neccessities to those who need them. And such organizations usually send a group of volunteers to remote areas in Taiwan or other countries to give them some basic educations. One of the clubs in my school is doing the similar things as nonprofit organizations. Some of my classmates joined it, and not before long, they had a visit to a villiage in remote mountains. The people in that village are poor, so their children don't have the chance to get good educations. The most important thing they wanted to do is to teach them some basic knowledge. They also bought some small presents such as color pencils to give them. In their two days trip, they had a great time with those children and their club are planing to go to India in summer vacation. I have never had this kind of experiences before, but the things they did is really touching to me.
Since many people volunteered to join the nonprofit organizations, many undeveloped countries had received the help from them. There's little we can do to improve the lives of all the people around the world, but to them, I think it's really different. If there's a chance that I could join such activities, I think I will do my best and spread the love.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, making money doesn't seem to be difficult, but how to fulfill a sense of achievement becomes harder and harder. When we work overtime or stay up late for a project, seldom do we feel happy. Instead, we think it is holy and wasting our time. As a result, more and more people get involve in voluntary works to find the peace in their mind. For example, I join the organization named Green Peace. What I do every month is donating a part of my salary to support the group. The organization stands for protecting the eco-system. Sometimes, the news reports that Green Peace drives a ship to the Pacific Sea to stop Japan or other countries from killing whales. Green Peace also reports stories behind luxuries to inform us how they do harm to the environment during the production.
Besides Green Peace, I join the activity of donating blood as well. It not only helps people but lets me stay healthy, and it won't take me too much time. In the future, I would like to get some training in the National Palace Museum to become a voluntary tour guide. The knowledge of jade, calligraphy and pictures is what I am lack of. However, I could be better through these professional classes and help more people. This is the core of the voluntary work. We can enhance our ability and be helpful at the same time.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, there are more and more nonprofit organizations appear on TV programs, magazines. The members would give a seech in schools, in order to make everyone understand that although the society is rich, there are still some people looking for help in other areas. They recruit volunteers to join them, working for those who need help, they do the work such as visiting old people who live with no one, cleaning their house, cooking for them and chatting with them. Besides, they will go to distant villages so as to provide resources for the people living there. Also, some of the nonprofit organization would be willing to build houses and schools after typhoons come, earthquakes occure, causing building collapsed. Nonprofit organizations do what people need, usually faster than government, I think they just want to make the world we live become better.
In the future, after I enter college, I think I would join some organization, for example, , go on streets to ask people donate their buying receipts. Otherwise, I would go to hospital during winter or summer vacation, taking care of the patients, do something for them, such as telling interesting stories for them, to decrease their bored time. The things above are just some easier things I can do for them, When I have more capability in the future, I would do more things for them.

subject: HW0901
content: There are many people in development country facing many serious problems such poverty and healthy issues get help from from the nonprofit organizations around the world. Thanks for those organizations and the volunteers, it is possible for the local government to get some seriouse problem mentioned above under control. However, food and money donation just solve the problem in the short time. For helping those people in poverty, enducation is the appropriate way. Enducation could help them to earn what they need by their self. What I would like to do in the future is to be a acricultural volunteer. Because my major in college is acricultural and I took some medical-related courses as well, I would like to be a acricultural voluteer in the developing country during my military service. So, I have applied for the government and I wish I will succeed because it is a meaning work for me.

subject: HW0901
content: Most countries in the world have their own nonprofit organizations and Taiwan has no exception. These organizations are consist of volunteers. The volunteers might range from students to the elders. However, they all keep their passions in helping people. The chief goal of nonprofit organizations is to improve people's lives. Thus, they alway lead people to being educated and surviving. For example, some villages are away from moden cities so that children can't have good educations. Then the organizations will send some volunteers to tutor these children. Beside, the volunteers will also pay attention to the tubes if their foods, clothes and resourses are shorting or not. However, no matter what kind of job we take, there are always coutless volunteers works are waiting for us.

subject: HW0901
content: There are so many disadvantage people in the world that need us to care about. Nonprofit organizations do many good deeds to make the world better. Each volunteer do his best to reduce, reuse and recyle to make the world be better place to live. After my retiring, I think I will join Tzu chi nonprofit organization to help the poor people. subject: HW0901
content: In recent years, many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to provide people in need with supplies of necessity and voluntary tutors for children. Volunteers can not only help people in need but also benefit from an experience of a voluntary work. Some nonprofit organizations send supplies of necessity, such as food and clothes, to people living in developing countries. Also, in Taiwan some organizations recruit college students to ask them serve as voluntary tutors who can teach children in remote areas English. Take me for example, last winter vacation I joined an organization to voluntarily teach English for student in an elementary school in Hualian. I taught students basic vocabulary they could really put into use in daily life and taught them several English songs. The students who are tutored can receive some information they can use for the rest of their life. However, for tutors, they can obtain the joy of helping people who are really in need, which cannot be traded with money.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, such nonprofit organizations have aroused much attention of the public. This is because they have much to do with helping other people. And helping other people seems to play an important role in our daily life because we are all members in the global village.
There are some important services provided by such organization such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan and other foreigne countries, or help people living in the original areas with agriculture. With the donation by such organization, people in such remote areas may live a better life. Without the services organizations offer, these people may still live in a horrible life like a hell.
Take myself for example, I used to tutor children in a remote area. Not only did the children have a free tutor, but also benefited from me. Besides, I also learned how to be patient with people and the importance of perseverance. In view of the above statements, we all should pay attention to it. However, there are still some people make little of it. What a pity it is.

subject: HW0901
content:
A friend indeed is a friend in need. In general, we will help our friends to solve lots of problems. Some people help others not because of he/she is a friend of them, but, due to their love, they volunteer to help those who really needs their hands. These kind of people will join a nonprofit organization.

We sing songs to them and tell them that lives sould be full of hopes. I am gald to do these things, I think a person should not hide his/her abilities to help others. People have different talents, and we sould use these talents correctly. Also, a person needs to share his/her loves to one who really needs your hands.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations help people who are not have enough ability to help themselves. subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901

If everyone can volunteer to do something good to others, our life will become better and brighter. Or we can devote ourselves to charities, we can feel happy every day.

subject: HW0901
content:
With economic development in Taiwan, more and more children can get good cares because of their parents highly salary. They can go to cram school to improve their studies' grades or to learn all kinds of skills just to be better than others. However, there are some children in remote areas can not get such cares.
People in remote areas are usually poor and can't get well education. They have to rely on nonprofit organization's help. subject: HW0901
content:
Most of us are lucky enough to have sufficent foods and water for each day. If my first goal is attained, I would like to raise funds to buy tents that keep mosquitoes away for those who suffer from malaria. I've heard that some high school students in America are doing such things and they are quite successful. Maybe I can help others through the same way.
In sum, we should all do something to help the sufferers if we're of the ability. I wish I could achieve my goals of tutoring children in remote mountains and raising funds to fight malaria someday.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations founded in the society. The main reason why they would be built is to rescue the poor or handicapped people living in the poverty. subject: HW0901
content:
As the time flys, Taiwan has changed in to a wealthy country. But there are still some countries waiting to be helped. Nonprofit organizations reach out their hands to these countries. They send people to teach them how to cultivate and build water systems. These things they had done not only made those countries more better but also made them happier than before.
I have been raising money with my classmates for the children who are not allowed to go to school because of their families' finacial problems. Helping people without repay makes me happy. I wish I can do more things which can help more people when I grow up. I won't give up any chance to help other people, because helping people can make the world better, and it is also a good way to improve myself.

subject: HW0901
content: In recent ten years, nonprofit organizations have developed very fast. They make up the shortages of some government works, such as educating children in remote places, helping to rescue people in tsunami of southern Asia or some human rights issues. And I think some of the most import services provided by them are educating children in remote Taiwan and distributing food for poors or old men. The former one help those kids in remote Taiwan a lot. They can let those kids learn more and have more chances when finding jobs in their future lifes. And the second one I think it also help many families, too. It helps many poor or weak families have more energy and lets them feel warm in both body and mind. Therefore, I think if I do volunteer works, I would like to choose both of them described above. Because I think these are also what Taiwan's society most need now. I would like to do them in my future.

subject: HW0901
content: There are a various of important services provided by nonprofit organizations. I discovered that there were difficulties to communicate with them. I really tried my best and received a great deal of achievement. Last but not the least, I am looking for the next opportunity to volunteer the work which needs me!

In the graying society, it is undoubt that there will be more and more elders seeking to the help. As a part of the society citizen, it is the most important job that we should take care of them. To be a volunteer is the best way!

content:

subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations act as a crucial role in our society. Some of the important services they provide are as follows. Also, there are some alliances help protect the nature. They not only help clean the surroundings, but persuade to erect environmental-protecting laws. In addition, some hold free speeches and lectures for the poor. These services help to make the society a better one.

content:
Living in a rich and convenient society, we sometimes neglect what's going on in some other small places in the world. However, as we turn on TV or flip through newspapers, we can find that there are many poor and sick in such areas as Africa or South America. At the same time, we might also be touched by numerous volunteers devoted their lives to helping people.
As far as I know, there are more and more nonprofit organizations springing up in recent days. For example, the Doctors Without Broaders provides medical services and care in remote countries to reduce diseases and pain. Doctors in the organization also do lots of research annually to inform people latest medical knowledge. Another nonprofit organization called Red Cross, which is composed of various people around the world, provides food and great amounts of daily uses for refugees in developing countries. Also, when there is disaster happening suddenly, those volunters arrive at that place at first time to offer savings in emergent conditions.
In Taiwan, there are also some local nonprofit organizations to help the old and the sick. Because in somplaces like Taitung or Youn-Ling, many children are undereducated. It is my blessing to join the Green-Cross Health Orginization supported by my school this summer vacation. We are going to provide medical care for the old in Youn-Ling because we are all medical students. At the same time, we will educate some science knowledge to the children there. In fact, I've prepared for the camp for a long time since it's my dream to help people and give people warmth. Most important of all, I hope I can take volunteering work as my mission throughout my life!

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many groups or individuals devoting their money or man power to help others within a poor or difficult situation worldwide, For instance, the Red Cross, it is an international rescue organization or some charity organizations from different religions. Nonprofit organizations can find people's proverty and sickness more quickly because they live with people. They cure people who are sick, feeding people who are hungry. They use their power to tell the world, the rich world that they can't disguise that they can't see people crying in the dark.

We spent a week there and tried many different ways to make the students love learning English again. In the beginhing, only a part of the students would do the activites we wanted them to try. content:
In recent ages, due to the developement of democracy, people started noticing the rights of human. Despite the fact that we live in a convenient life, there are still millions of people suffuring pain out there somewhere.
When it comes to refugee, most people directly link to Africa. Indeed, residents in Africa often get tough lives. No one wants to be a refugee in Africa. Everyone should be born equally. Though in reality, it cannot always be true, but lots and lots of constitutions had established to make this dream come true. These constitutions help them to live a better life. They support them food, medical treatment or even some places to stay. More and more people have devoted in this career to care about those who have problems to live on including me. Every month I donor some of my money to constitutions to save human lives. Maybe in the future, I will have the ability to directly go to some place which has people who need help. Many people start caring those who has tough life. Are you one of them?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide many important services, and the importance of it cannot be overemphasized. First, they help the teaching of children in remote areas of Taiwan. Due to lack of communication with modern society, those children often need resources such as used books, clothes, computer equipments, and so on. They are often provided by nonprofit organizations. Second, when the emergency comes, like typhoons, earthquakes or even landslides, the nonprofit organizations become more important, they will provide necessary food, water, and refugee camps temporary shelters. Last but not least, they create the opportunities of communication between big cities and remote areas. By this way, the residents of both sides will know each others better.
The last view point mentioned above is the volunteer work I have done. In my school, I am one of the menbers of the Faith-Hope-Love Club. And we have a lot of chances to service in tribes or bring those children from remote areas to visit Taipei. In the process of those interactions, I feel very happy. As the saying goes, "All men are created equal. " I think I will join the nonprofit organizations and devote myself to this kind activities in the future. That would make people in the world live more happier.

subject: HW0901
content: Even though most of people in Taiwan live adequately and care-freely. However, there are still some people live in a dark land, especially those living in developing coutries. Nowadays, in solving these problems and bring welfare to those developing countries, there are many nonprofit organizations which pay attention to publical affairs for a very long time. In fact, these organization in Taiwan, such as Pa-Ai or IDAN, really have done something greatful. For example, they often recruit volunteers, especially college students, to help them with tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan or running refugee camps in needed countries. These volunteers will do and learn lots of things that they have never known or experienced before. In fact, I'm going to philipine to be a volunteer this summer vacation. And as far as I know, my job there was tutoring children, building schools, painting refugees. .. etc. I wish this trip would be fun and meaningful.

subject: HW0901
content:
War, starvation, tutored children, homeless people, etc. .. are still common in 20 century. In desperation and darkness, there's still a shed of light that help people get through the pain. That's the nonprofit organizations.
These kind of organizations help people who suffer from many kinds of disasters. They send doctors and nurse to the places which are in war, they give food and drinks to country which has lots of starve people. They protect children tutored by adults, they give the refugee and homeless people a safe place to stay. They really help a lot in many countries and city.
Although they won't get paid, they still work so hard to help people. I praise them for their behavior and give them a high respect. However, I think I have to join this kind of organization. I'm now a senior high student. I wish I could be a doctor and go to Africa to treat the sick there. I would love to dedicate myself to help others, because that's the way to make the world better. I'm gratitue to those organizations and one day I'll be in those organization to help people just like other volunteers.

subject: HW0901
content: There are more and more nonprofit organizations recruit young volunteers to help people living in bad conditions nowadays. The NGOs provide many kinds of service. The volunteers make our world much better and sometimes promote the image of our country positively. Some NGOs recruit the young doctors to go to the developing countries like the areas of southeastern asia or the african countries to help people do check-ups and get better medical treatments. Some NGOs assign the graduate students to help the oversea Chinese children improve their learning ability for the poor kids have few chances to go to school. Other volunteers with professional backgrouds go to the poor societies to build the roads or improve the native people's agricultural skills. In doing such things, they promote Taiwan's image and gain the true friendships from other countries. Since I am a college student with some part-time works, I have no experience of going abroad. However, I admire the international volunteers very much, I definitely will take part in the NGOs' programs to help people in poor situation in the future. I will sharpen my computer skills in order to teach the kids of the developing or underdeveloped countries when I graduate from college.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations have provided many important services to help the ones who are in need. For example, they donate money on the street in order to build schools and libraries for children who live in remote areas. They recruit volunteers to take care of the elderly who live alone. They collect clothes from every family in the city, and send them to the country. They offer teaching and learning devices for students' education. They even run some refugee camps in developing countries to help them live a better life.
Nonprofit organizations, such as the Rotary and the Red Cross, certainly make the world a better place. For me, as a student, I always do my best to help others who are in need. I joined our school's Rotary Club and went to remote areas to help clean their living environments. I collect my pocket money every day, and give it to a nonprofit organization that raise money for the refugees in Vietnam. This summer, I plan on being an volunteer in the hospital near my school in the hope of helping more people around me and gain more experience. Little things we do can make big differences. I now find it very enjoyable to give my hands to others. I will keep on doing volunteer works and eventually joining more nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content: Nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers play an vital role in today's chaotic world. They not only provide some homeless people with food and care, but also spare no effort helping tutor aboriginal children in remote areas. Some of them even run refugee camps in developing countries and so on. As far as I'm concernd, their noble acts and minds are just like the embodiment of angels. Although I don't have any experience about volunteer work, I'll volunteer to do something for stray animals. Oweing to majoring in veterinary medicine, I think speechless animals are also need our hands and care. I have two beagles in my home which are abandoned by their master. How can they treat such adorable dogs like dirt? They are genuine companions to people nomatter what happens. Out of sympathy, I think there are still many stray aminals need us. Above all, As an old saying goes, "Act local, think global." Before being a volunteer, there are many people and animals around us which are easily ignored, need our help and care.

subject: HW0901
content:
Today, nonprofit organizations play an important role in helping people under the poverty line and in delivering necessary services in damaged areas across the world.
In Taiwan, there are so many famous nonprofit organizations as well and different nonprofit organizations offered different services while all of them aimed to supply hamanitarian services as their main idea.
When it comes to the important services provided by nonprofit organization, I belive these must be education, health care, food supply and disaster rescues.
With economic recession came in, several organizations donated food and clothes to people who really need it in the remote country in Taiwan. While other nonprofit organizations emphasized on health care, especially the elders and the disables. They usually recruit doctors in citys to go to the countryside to assist the patients who are unable to go to the hospital fighting their disease. In addition, it is also common to see these kind of organizations appeared in the damaged areas around the world searching survivers and rescued people.
In my view, I would like to join these nonprofit organizations as a volunteer teaching children in the remote areas, especially in undeveloped countries. Education is the best way to help them get rid of poverty and also works as a function in widening their vision. Only through education can they learn the skills or knowledge that can keep their life having quality. In addition, they can have the ability to help themselves after receiving the education. Based on these reasons, I firmly regard education as the best way to help people and I would like to give it a try.

subject: HW0901
content:
In morden world, it seems like every body is working on their own business and profits, having no time to care about others. Nevertheless, there are still some nonprofit organizations concern "helping others" as their duties, taking actions with compassion and love.
"Red cross" is a very well-know organization that help people all over the world. For example, when the 921 earthquake happened, and caused big damages, the Red cross rushed to Taiwan immediately. It ran refugee camps, provided food supplies, and gave hands to rescue teams, acclerating the rescue process.
In addition, "Doctors without boarders" is also a popular and respectable organization. It hires well-trained doctors from different fields, and gives medical services to developing regions, such as Africa. It helps local people getting rid of sick and pain and lets people get to know more about their bodies.
Another nonprofit organization I want to join in the future is "Green Peace". It gathers compassionate and passionate people who care environment and animals. It uses creative and young methods to make people care more about our mother Earth. It has been my dreams to join in Green Peace since I was a little girl, and I hope I will have the chance to fulfill my dream and do something for the big Nature.

subject: HW0901
content:
The volunteers of the nonprofit organizations always make great efforts to help people in need in the country and sometimes even those suffering all over the world. For example, one famous nonprofit organization-the Red Cross usually offers help to the people in the war-damaged countries. And when the nature disasters, such as earthquake, strike the country and lead to lots of injures, death, and countless homeless people, many of these organizations will appear and help those poor people go through the nightmare.
Also, there are some organizations focusing on the kids who live in bad environments and have financial difficulties to go to school. The volunteers from this kind of organizations often raise the money to help them, and some of them go visit the children, talk with them and even teach them some simple words.
I admire those great volunteers very much. Though I've never done any volunteer work before, I have planned to do some in the future. I want to take care of the old people who live alone and have no one to talk to. I want to help them live a more pleasant and comfortable life and feel less lonely. I hope my help can change their lives and warm their heart. I want to be someone as great as those admiring volunteers.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, people of many charities and nonprofit organizations devote themselves to helping those in need. However, what did they do? For instance, they donate money to the distant aboriginal villiages in Taiwan every year. They give money to the poor who cannot afford their kids' lunch in school. They collect second-hand clothes and used computers, and send to the areas where resources aren't as accessible as cities. What's more, they lend a helping hand to those who suffer from natural disasters like earthquakes and tsunamis. They love others and themselves as well.
They truly established a good example to all of us. Although I'm still young, I can also dedicate myself to some of these events. I take part in a Christian fellowship in school now. I have been to several far aboriginal tribes and elders' nursing houses with them. I saw the precious kindness of human nature during my participation. There, we played with the kids and teenagers who received less love and care from their family. We wanted to show our love for them. We also took a visit to nursing houses and hospitals during the Christmas. We visited the lonely elders and patients with serious diseases such as cancer or certain disorders.
There are still many people needing help and love in Taiwan or even all over the world. Your own power might be little. Gathering everybody's can strengthen it a lot and be very strong, isn't it?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations can be seen everywhere in our society. Most of these nonprofit organizations are aimed at providing help to the public.
There are some important services provided by these nonprofit organizations. For example, they recruit volunteers to help chidren who are suffering hunger and dieases from developing countries, or they lend a hand to the disabled people in our society to help them find a job. If I had a chance, I would like to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan. Because children in remote areas can't get so many informations like the children in the urban areas. By tutoring them, I think it can close up the gap between rural and urban areas. In this way, children in remote areas can have a chance to be well-educated.
To sum up, nonprofit organizations are organizations that provides help to the society. By entering these organizations, we can lead the society to a better future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, we live in a global village. We are capable of getting the latest news within seconds, and we are able to travel around the world without difficulties. While we are enjoying the advantages brought by advanced techniques, some parts of the world are suffering from poverty, epidemics or civil wars. Because these refugees don't have the money or techniques to build their industry, they were usually governed by other powerful countries and mistreated.
Fortunately, some charity organizations gain hope for them. These kind of organizations recruit volunteers from all walks of life and send them in groups to distinctive countries with a view to help the refugees. The volunteers' missions vary from the situations. For example, they teach residents in AIDS-spreading countrys how to use condoms, and they build hundreds of schools ranging from primary school to secondary one. Also, they raise funds the world over and cash in on the donations so as to set up various helpful plans to change refugees' lives. Being a volunteer can bring a lot of fun and the following are three reasons for I'm saying so. First, you are able to learn how to love the people you don't know. Secondly, you can broaden your horizons at any time. Last but not least, you will understand how wonderful a life you are living and come to cherish everything you have. In the future, I would like to set up my own nonprofit organization with an eye to making the world a better place. I want to raise self-awareness of women living in poverty and provide more access to education to poor children. With all my efforts, I'm sure that the world will be a wonderful place to live in.

subject: HW0901
content:
Volunteer works have become a trend in many developed countries. Volunteers help the nonprofit organizations to give a helping hand to those in need, taking care of orphans, the handicaped and running refugee camps in countries that are not so prosperous and well developed. The things that the volunteers have done for those in need always spill warmth, harmony and happiness on the darkest corners all over the world. One of the important services provided by such organizations is aiding poor children. Many generous and kind people donate money, food, books and clothes to the nonprofit organizations such as the Red Cross. The organizations then give these souces to the orphanages. shabby schools and the children living in starvation to ease their hunger pang. The second thing they do is aiding people when threatening natural disasters taken place. For instance, yeas ago when the tsunami attacked all at a sudden, many people lost their home, their family, their friends and their hopes for life. Many nonprofit organizations soon came to their aid, the volunteers devoted themselves to helping people, trying their best to cure their sorrow and to help them find the missing people. Such organizations also provide services like helping the disabled. They built schools for the disabled ones, let them be educated or learn useful skills like baking. In this way, the handicaped will lead a better life. Trained and educated ones can apply for nice jobs and have abilities that are not worse than normal people.
I have taken part in an activity held by a famous non profit organization. I went to the orphanage to read stories for the adorable children. I was touched by their pure and innocent smile, their contentment listening to stories were such an warm expression I ever seen. To sum up, I am convinced that doing volunteer works is very meaningful, and I admire the volunteers working in such nonprofit organizations. When I have the opportunity again to be a volunteer, I would be joyful to do so.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people not only in Taiwan but also in the whole world needing our help. Fortunately, there are also many nonprofit organizations and volunteers willing to help those who need help. This kind of organizations provided a lot of services, such as education, medical technology, food and etc. Food is the most urgent thing to those developing poor countries because people there may die of hungry. Medical technology may be the second important thing to them. Many of them just die from normal disease. Finally, education is also important. It is quite a good way to help people get away from poor situation. It's necessary for both children in remote areas in Taiwan and people in developing countries.
I haven't done any volunteer work yet. It's quiet a pity. If I have chance, I will like to go to developing coutries to help people there. I think I can learn a lot from it. This experience may unique and useful for me.

subject: HW0901
content:
Take WHO for example, it would provide lots of information about diease or virus to many coutries. And it has some strong reaserch teams to find the way to fight diease. WHO is like the health guard of world. If there is any new and dangerous virus been found, WHO will tell every contries and try its best to kill the virus. Nowadays, every contries on earth is like a big family. And the world healthy organization is like the family doctor to take good care of every family member.
Nothing in the world can delight me so much as being a volunteer to take care of primary school's students in the countryside. It was a very special experience. Those kids were filled with energy and very nauty. I can feel that they love me. But, they "climb on me" to let me know their love. It made me feel that the children are not only angles but devils. When you know more about those kids, you will find that they just want love. As I hugged one of children. He stopped his activity and enjoyed the warm feeling. I suddenly though my parents, How luck I am! My parents love me so much. Thank you kids. You made me grow up.
Being a volunteer is not just donation, I always learning lots of things. That is why I like to help other people.

subject: HW0901
content: With the rapid developement of economy, our lives are getting better and better. Nevertheless, there are still some poor people in remote areas suffer from a lot of problems. That's why nonprofit organizations were founded. The goal of these organizations is to try to improve those poor people's lives. For example, some volunteers of the organization will go to remote areas and they will take care of the elderly and children, offer some food to them and turtor chidren and so on. Without their helps, those poor may be disable to live or even die at last. I have been a volunteer when I was a junior high school student. I went to help some poor people living in the mountain. As soon as I arrived at their village, I was shocked. The village was totally different from the city we lived. They lived in the house with only simple and broken furnitures. We went to take care of them for five days. We brought some food and some useful materials to them. After I chatted with them, I found that they were really nice even though they were poor. There are still a lot of people in the world that need helps. We are so lucky to live without any problems. Why don't we spend some time helping those people and making their lives better?

subject: HW0901
content: There are many nonprofit organizations around the world. Some of them are famous for their help to people all over the world. For example, when an earthquake strikes one place, the volunteers from such group will help taking care of the residents who have no home to live. Moreover, some of the organizations have the ability to rescue people before the local rescue teams come. An organization which is founded by a Taiwanese is usually the first volunteer team to help poor people. Also, such group provide children in remote area with essential things of education. If people have the ability for charity, they will send money to such organization, then their money will make the children in poverty have better lives. I have never taken part in such volunteer work. But I desire to help children having enough education. The way I will take is not only sponsoring poor children but also teaching students who are in the remote mountain area in Taiwan. Seeing that I can improve their ability or living environment will be a sufficient accomplishment. After my college entrance exam, I am goint to be a volunteer of my elementary school to teach students simple Math and English. To sum up, I should start my wish of helping people from my nearby area.

subject: HW0901
content: These ten years, the people in Taiwan finally realize that education is really important for children, they begin to send their children to cram schools or summer school. Some parents even payed for tutors, they come to their houses and teach their children. I don't understand why Chinese parents have to make their children so busy, when I was in Italy three years ago, I didn't have any stress, the children there are happy every day. They don't have cram schools, but after school they go horse-back riding, swimming. .. .. .. In the future, I would like to find a way, to change those thoughts that only gives children pressure, Taiwan should change their way on education. Maybe this will take time, ten years, twenty years. .. .. .. But I think this is the best way to improve, Taiwan doesn't have to be exactly like Italy, but we can copy their good parts, this will make children have much less pressure than before.

subject: HW0901
content:
The nonprofit organizations volunteers are mostly college students or some social workes. Not only service for the children but also gaining their social experiences at the same time.
As I know every school has volunteers to help when you have problems at school. They always seem happily to help you in many ways. The volunteers has the right attitude on solving problems. They are dealing the same problems which it helps them to know how to solve them in a short period of time.
The volunteers seems satisfied when the children had known the answers from them which may levels the society to better class in Taiwan. I have done an English tutore volunteer for many years for students who are in grade one to six. I teach them basic English after they finish the school. I am teaching them with a good attitude, too. I think everyone should be able to speak more than two languages which you can get to see the bigger world.
I would like to go to the forigen countries to see more what the culture is about. I want to go there to improve my English ability, so I can tutore more students in Taiwan.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. Still the others are very work after some big disaster. For example, they gathered the food and clothes in 24 hours after the 921 earthquake. And they also offered medical service to the people who lived in those area striken by earthquake. In fact, the thing above are not their main job. To help the underpriviledged in usual time, actually, is their main job. Therefore, such as take care of the older who was out of care or donate money to the poor family are including in their service. I used to joined the Chizui Younger Club in my first year into colleague. That was reall enrich my life in the period of time. Some times we go the special school to play with orphanage and some times we go garbage recycle spot to classify the garbage into different kind. I think it is really meaning to our life.

subject: HW0901
content: (1) With the fast pace of modern life, sometimes we find that people become indifferent and selfish; however, there are groups of people volunteering to help those in need and improve our environment. The volunteers collect old toys, old books and old clothes from people who don't need them anymore. The toys and books will be sent to the orphans or children in remote areas. The clothes will be given to the poor so that they may be taken care of. What is more, the groups of people volunteer to clean the beach and roads. By doing this kind of activities, they hope to remind people of the importance of cherishing our earth. (2) I would like to join this meaningful volunteer work in the future. I would like to tutor children in remote areas, because being a teacher has been my dream and I hope that all children can have fair chance of taking good education. Certain remote areas in Taiwan have less learning and teaching material and support, which is unfair to children in remote areas. If I have a chance to be a volunteer tutor in remote areas, I will try my best to teach the children and be friend with them. It is my sincere hope that my little contribution can be part of the positive power to make our world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Thanks to nonprofit organizations' help, our world becomes more warmful. These organizations always give a big hand to those areas in wars, epidemics. They offen supply for food, clothing and medical instruments. They make a fundation to raise money for using the money to rebuild the home which has been frustrated.
I always see these kind of news on television. If I have the chance to help those in need to get away from infernos, the volunteer work that I want to do is to teach children suffered from wars. The children look so helpless. One thing that I could do is to teach them some essential knowledge and skills. Telling them to learn from the mistakes that humans have done is a basic idea. All we can do is to stop the wrong step during the human's evolution. If we can leave this acception held in the world from generation to generation, our world would be better. Although this goal is hard to achieve, we human beings should strive to have this concept done well. Eventually, there is no nonprofit organization, and we make our world more brilliant and colorful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Non-profit organization (NPO) seems to be a world-wide trend nowadays.
The services provided by various NPOs fall into two categories according to my observation: spiritual and material. Roughly speaking, spiritual services include metally supports such as counseling, comforting, or inspiring while material services provide materials like foods, water, or money to the poor and the elderly. Nevertheless, some services cannot be divided that clearly. For example, if a NPO help a human-right activist out of prison, on the one hand, that NPO free his body; on the other hand, it free his mind. I think the reason why NPOs can gather so much volunteers may be due to those high values such as freedom, charity, social justic, and etc. As far as I am concerned, I had been to a remote villiage in Hualian, "playing" with primary school student, though I think that we "aliens" disturbed them to some degree.
As for what I would like to do in the future, I would like to tutoring children no matter where they are from. As long as their grades are poor, I am willing to help them, unpaied. In fact, this is what I will do next whole year.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have become stronger and stronger, and have played an important role in the society recently. They've kept working and purified this world by devoting themselves to helping whoever needs their help in almost everywhere around the world. This kind of organization includes World vision, Red-cross organization, and some religious groups. The main purpose of these organizations is to help people to live a better life. Take World Vision as an example. There are some important services in this nonprofit organization. Every year, it holds an activity about experiencing a life without food to eat for 30 hours. It can make the participants to cherrish what they're possessed and some necessities in their lives. Furthermore, World Vision has a plan and it's been under taken for a very long time. People who join this plan could "adopt" children living in some poor countries. By donating money or daily necessities to them to help them have a better life, those doners can also receive a sense of honer and acheivement at the same time. What's more, World-Vision will send some volunteers to care about people who live in a war-torn area or slow-developed countries and teach them how to make a living by themselves.
If I had chances to be a member of this kind of organization in the future, I would like to be a tutor to teach children from remote areas, not only in Taiwan but also in other countries. As a student of National Taiwan Normal University, I think I sould use what I've learned to have some feedbacks to the society. Because of the professional training, I believe I could enhance their abilities and help them lead a wonderful life. Further more, I would like to do volunteer work in some refugee camps to not only help them, but at the same time feel what they feel. Maybe I would become more mature and have different perspectives toward my life. I think everyone should have this kind of spirit that those nonprofit organizations have shown to the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people that needs to be helped in the world. Money, education, mind ... anything you can think of. Because of this, some kind people created some organizations to help them. Most of the people only knows about giving money to them. But actually they also give many other sevices to the poors, and some of them we can do it together. There are many organizations that provides different services. Some of them help the poors mainly, some of them educates the children which has no money to go to school, some of them take care of orphans. The meaning of creating this kind of organization besides helping the people, also has the meaning of telling everyone there are people that needs to be helped. What can we do to help them? The popular know answer is to send money to the organization to let them help the people for us. There is also a way is that being a volunteer to help them ourselves. This is an intresting way you can try.
I've always wanted to join the volunteer work of educating the kids that can't go to school. One of the reason is I like children very much. And another one is, I think childrens' education is very important, every child in the world have the right to learn. I wish to help the world the best I can. And I will, someday in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is a well-known nonprofit organization in Hua-lien, called Chi-Zei. They built hospitals and schools at Hua-lien in the beginning and then spreads all over in remote areas in Taiwan. They educate and cure people's body and mind, but most important, they rescue people that is forgotten by the crowds. During the 911 event and the horible earthquake in india, Chi-Zei had organated rescue teams immediately to where needs help and love, decreasing the damage and lost.
I would like to be a volunteer to help refugee in East Africa, has the most many countries, also the place that happen wars most frequently. Due to those selfish goverments, different kind of people, little war invades to them, the poor East Africa residents, everyday. Countless people are homeless, sickness and without education. Being a doctor or teacher, cure them, educate them, offering them a chance to get rid off the harmful place.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations can be categorized as an essential element for the World to become a better place for all mankind. They not only provide the incapable or poor people the necessities, such as food, shelter, water and clothes in order for them to survive but also giving them hope and motivation to continue with their own lifes.
Nonprofit organizations are mainly distruting limited resources to the places or persons which have difficulties to obtain them. Partly, this is due to environmental conditions or geological disadvantage. However, with the services that the nonprofit organizations provide, the scarce and valuable resources can be justifiable distributed to those who needed them. The benevelent acts of nonprofit organizations can also spread out a positive image that the world is full of warm-hearted people. While the globe is pervaded in an environment full of fierce competitions for instance the cut-throat bussiness or territory conflicts. By demonstrating the global citizens that the world is actually full of love, people have better outlooks to their neighbors, colleagues, elderly and even strangers. Other than reallocating resources and posing righteous and cardinal images to onlookers, nonprofit organizations provide the best job offer in the world. I firmly believe that by involving myself in this sort of organizations, I can grasp the essence or perhaps the real meaning of life, that is, to contribute our strength as much as possible to make the world a better place for all humans. Therefore, I definitely will be participate in one of the jobs of non-profit organizations in the future such as rebuild the houses in the villages of Africa, etc.

subject: HW0901
content:
Apparently, a majority of nonprofit organizations have embarked on constructive plans and beneficial offers for some people in need. There have been some services provided by them. For example, they encourage people to save money and raise funds to assist poor people. Besides, they also take actions to come to rescue for those suvivors in tremendous disasters. Furthermore, consistent educations are attributable to their arduous hardworks, so some children can attain abundant knowledge from them. Most importantly, they recruit volunteers to cosolidate groups or organizations with an eye to cultive a great virtue of helping people around us.
As far as I'm concerned, I make up my mind to be a kind-hearted lawyer in the near future. I don't mean to let people to pay homage to me, or spimply be a lucrative lawyer. I'd rather to fight for justice and solve their problems happened in their lives instead of sitting in the office and counting the amount of money. Despite the strenuous job, I can get much pleasure from helping people because I can see people teeming with smiles due to my assistance.
After all, all my efforts will pay off. It is my dream that can illuminate my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, most people live in a modern society and enjoy the high quality life. In addition, they regard helping other people in need as their own mission. Therefore, people who have kind hearts gathered together and established a large number of nonprofit organizations to show their willingness to help needy people or even the natural environment.
There are all kinds of nonprofit organizations which have their own purposes and aims to achieve. For example, the Red Cross Organization provides medical care for the soilders who get injuried due to the international wars. It has engaged in a variety of wars and has raise the percentage of soilders' survival. Besides, there are other nonprofit organizations which devoted themselves to education, environment-protection, animal protection, and so on. These organizations remind people of some vital issues that are often be neglected in our daily lives. Moreover, they can improve some awful circumstances and make our society become more harmonious.
The nonprofit organizations must recruit volunteers to help with their work to attein their goals. Therefore, I have participated in such kind of works. I went to the hospital and took care of the elderly patients there. I talked with them and made them feel happier under the serious atmosphere of the hospital. It was really an interesting and meaningful work. What's better, I felt a sense of satisfication after helping needy people. Next time, maybe I will try to have a volunteer work which tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan. I can educate our country's hope and improve my teaching and expressing abilities. Volunteering not only can help others, but only do benefits on us. So why not join in the volunteer work of the nonprofit organizations?

subject: HW0901
content: Nonprofit organizations provided many services in the world. I think they have some services such as teaching some poor students and have some activities to make our environment cleaner are important. I think the best service is that they make our environment pollution less and less. Nowadays, most of the people are not care about the environment but care about how to make money. These organizations let us realize that money isn't the important. Our enviroment is the most value. I would like to have a volunteer work such as make our enviroment better in the future. Now I am a student. I need to spend most of my time studying. I just can only use my free time to recycle and put garbages together. I can't help the social and nature about the enviroment. When I don't have study plessure, I would like to go to recycle company to help them recycle things. I have done volunteer work is that our school once brought us to the recycle company to recycle things. I learn that throwing able recycle things out to recycle is hard. This is the reason why I want to volunteer to work in the recycle company.

subject: HW0901
content:
How can students have a meaningful summer without spending too much money? Joining a volunteer team recruited by nonprofit organizations is the way! Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations pop up. These organizations help with those in needs, and they recruit volunteers to help with their work. I have never taken part in this kind of groups before, but I would like to join one someday.
The volunteer groups recruited by nonprofit organizations do lots of significant things to help people. In Taiwan, they tutor children in remote areas, they teach the natives Chinese, and they also accompany the elderly or the handicapped. These groups are also sent to developing contries to run refugee camps, help in disaster areas, teach children reading and writing, and etc. The most volunteer work I would like to do is teaching and playing with the native children. I think it is fun to be with children, and it is meaningful to help them. I believe I can learn to be patient and more loving by doing this work and I can also learn some native languages! Volunteer groups recruited by nonprofit organizations are of great value, and I would very much like to join one in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: There are some nonprofit organizations devote themselves to people who are in need such as Red Cross. And some services provided by them are important for the refugees and people living in remote areas. For example, the services of food and wate supply from Red cross is essential for the refugee camps, which helps starved people survive in a tough condition. Additionally, the day-care for elders which is provided by many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan is also necessary. According to the rising ratio of elders in Taiwan, there are more and more old people living alone needed to be looked after. Although I have never volunteered in any nonprofit organization, I sincerely want to serve as a doctor and work for Red Cross in Africa to help those people suffering from political turmoils in the future. While serving in Red Cross, I will be more aware of world events and learn how to help others. In addition, I will try to live in the way of refugee camp in order to realize how it feels when you are living in such an awful condition. In my opinion, those people who live in good conditions with all kinds of luxurious substances should devote their extra energy and resources to those in need. If all human beings could do in this way, this world would be more colorful and wonderful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, Taiwan has tranformed to a wealth country, some people would have more time and money to help the poor. Consenquently more and more organizations inform to help other.
Chairty an kind of organization let collect money from rich people. People can not only help the poor bay money but in action. Now that the tecnology has increasingly improve, people can easily get to the place they want. Thus, people can get on the high-speed train, quickly arrive at the place to help the poor.
However, people now in this generation have a lazy body. They do not want to move unless it is necessary. But I am not. Since I was born in a wealth family I can not stand seeing homeless people laying on the street with newspapers on it. In my future I would want to enter the organization which educate the children have no money to school. To sum up, no matter what kind of volunteer works. People should always try giving others a hand. As a old saying goes, "Giving is better than reciving. " God will be watching us every moment up above the sky. If you want to enroll going to a heaven, do the best you can.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in our society. These kind of jobs is use for helping those who needed. Those organizations provide many services and different types of them have different kinds of help, too. Take the refugee camps for example, it often work in developing countries. What these countries face is not only the problem of living but also the difficulty of education. So some of the organizations provide food, health care or even build schools and houses for them.
As far as I am concerned, I think to help others is a greatful thing. I'm a senior high school student now and I used to be the volunteer in Taipei Animals' Care Center. I went there on weekends and what I can do is to type the imformation for new animals. I like this job even though it doesn't have salary but I think it's meaningful and I learned a lot.
To sum up, these nonprofit organizations give a hand to others around the world, they spend much time or money. Nevertheless, what we learned is not only the way to help each other but also the value of life. If everyone can join these kind of meaningful jobs, I believe our society will be much more wonderful.

subject: HW0901
content: Well goes the saying, "Giving is better than receiving. " This is exactly the central belief of nonprofit organizations. As the name suggested, members in such organizations do not work for their own profit. They voluntarily give their hands to those who are in need and especially pay attention to disadvantaged groups. For example, some nonprofit organizations provide voluntary medical care for people in remote areas, others prevent abused children from violence, and still others help refugees recontruct their hometown. Nonprofit organizations are willing to provide many kinds of services. As a result, they desirably need everyone's help. I hope that I'll have a chance to be volunteers. Though I'm not a professional medical member. I'm interested in voluntary medical care for a long time. I would like to go with organizations to remote areas and do whatever I can do. Although I cannot provide medical care, I am able to offer other kind of care. I can play with children who wait for healing or work in kitchens to prepare meals for them. If we want to do, there is nothing impossible.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help those people who are in need. In some developing countries, nonprofit organizations would get food supplies or clean water in remote areas in Africa or offer medical supply for refugee camps. Greenspeace is also a nonprofit organization with people who are ordinary citizens or scienties from around the world to support and find solutions to protect the whales. They often positioned themselves between the hunting boats and the whales for keeping away the whales from killing. Nonprofit organizations like Greenspeace are not only protect the ancient forests and save the spieces of plants and animals, they also save those avalueable natural resorces we have left for the future generation.
Two years ago, I attend a volunteer work in one of the school clubs that it has to go to the remote areas in Taiwan tutoring the children and helping them to learn different things such like cooking, make toys and learn different cultural backgrounds of other foreign countries. We designed courses for those children and played games to teach them how is the importance of team work. In the next coming month, I'll be a volunteer of the Deaf Olympic. I'll learn how to communicate with othse althetes, with hand signs and help them as a traveling agent for how to use the public transportation and offer some local tour guides.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations and more and more people willing to do volunteer works. As a teenager, I am already an experienced volunteer and I would like to discuss some important nonprofit services and the ones I have done in this essay. Nonprofit services can be divided into to several types: educational, social and medical. Educational services, such as tutoring children in remote areas, are very important to citizens in a bad economic condition. Besides, many senior citizens rely on social services for food and warmth. And the last type is the medical services, which provide areas destroyed by wars and poverty with medical help, tents and food. Among these three types mentioned above, my favorite is the educational one. That's because I have always dreamed to be a teacher who helps students neglected by others. By taking part in nonprofit organizations, I can fulfill my dream and work with people with noble goals. To recruit more volunteers to help, I suggest that nonprofit organizations hold more interesting activities and offer useful courses for students. Then we will have more young and energetic helpers to do such a meaningful job in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, we have nonprofit organizations all over the world. They exist in almost every country, doing their best to help people who are in need. Such organizations may build hospitals or schools so as to provide a more suitable and comfortable environment for human beings who are sick or immature. Still other services are provided by these nonprofit organizations, like offering food to those who suffer from starvation and taking care of people, such as soldiers or hostages, who are wounded during the war.
Speaking of this kind of volunteer work, I recall that I have been a volunteer whose jod is to collect a sort of receipt when I was in senior high with some of my classmates. We walked from our school to the trainstation, collecting the receipts all along the way. It was really a tiring day. At first, we get little reaction, which once made us disappointed, but we did not give up. Afterward, we chose to stand at the door of a store and bow to everyone whoever passed by us. Eventually, we got a full box of receipts. Though feeling extremely exhausted, all of us supposed that it is definitely worth doing volunteer works like this, for we learned a lot sincerely. As for the next volunteer work I would like to do, I feel like trying to take care of stray animals, especially dogs. They become homeless all because of selfishness of human beings. Therefore, I want to help them to find those who love animals by heart.

subject: HW0901
content:
Despite the highly developed material life, helping others is deemed as human nature. We hope that people who are in need can greatly improve their livies through our contributions. Especially when you got helps from their unselfish sacrifices, you will, in turn, spare no effort to give the needy a helping hand. There is no denying that people in the society will live in peace and harmony.
Being the member of Toastmasters International Club which was founded in 1920s in USA and is an international nonprofit organization, I feel satisfied with what I've done. I vividly remember that a senior member comforted my sorrow as I delivered my English speech in public. Later on, I felt a lot of confidence through their encouragement and my constant practices. I can imagine that I would be a loser in public speaking without their contributions. Now I return to the club as well.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They give assistances to the victims under natural disasters and the families in poverty. The most important part of their services is rescuring people from natural disasters or armed conflicts. Take Red Cross as an example, they were the first NGO which arrived at India to saves the victims' lives. And they've been providing food, water and medical care in Gaze Strip for almost a decade. Without them, those situation would have become worse than now.
If I get a chance to do works as a voluntary worker, I would like to go to Afganistan and help refugees there rebuild there shelters. Afganistan was shattered by Taliban for a long time. Although the conflicts has been almost subsided by the U. S. army, the living environments of people didn't improve after the peace. I want to go their assisting them to rebuild their home. Because I think it's hard to imagine their misery unless you visit there and help them by yourself. I know it will be dangerous, even lethal, but I won't regret to make this decision on the time when I have the opportunity to go there.

subject: HW0901
content:
When a country keeps progress in economic, politic, or education etc. There's one thing we can't denile that the social works. Because chasing a better life for everyone who live in this world still the most basic topic. As we can see, there're more and more nonprofit organizations been organized not only here in Taiwan but also all over the world. They provide some services, such as encouraging people to donate their money for helping those children who have no their own family in Taiwan, or for helping some handicapped people can learn more skills through the organizations. Besides service domestic social situations, we expend our love to overseas. Teaching those people in developing countries how to plante rice or vegetables, how to use the computers to getting more informations, even help them cleaning up the environment to avoide some virus.
Talk about this recalls my memory about the volunteer work I have done before. When I was a third-grade student in college school, I often spended my weekend in an organization called "E-Dian". Everyweek, I prepared a funny story for those handicapped children below six years old in that organization, making them happy and helping them learning more words. It was a wonderful experience in my life. I learned how to understand what those children need and how to express my love to them. In the future, I'll still love to join these kind of nonprofit organizations as well as I can. As part of this beautiful island, I think I have the responsibility to make it better.

subject: HW0901
content:
In modern society, though people are busy, some of them are still devoted themselves to helping others with poor environment. They may take part in some nonprofit organizations. In those organizations, people may donate some money for them to build educational center in rural area or mountain area. That is, they can provide some professional courses to children who can't afford the tuision to study. In addition, some organizations may build hospitals and recruit some voluntary doctors to cure the poor for free. On the other hand, some organizations not only care the local, but also concern other people in developing countries. The volunteers in such organizations will go to those countries such as undeveloped area or war-striken place. They may bring some food and clean water along with old clothing donated from their national people to the land. As people care more about the poor, they may obtain more happiness from other people.
As a senior high school student, what I can do for now is to go to the library to help clean the floor and classify the books. I always go to library to clean the floor in summer. To make books easily be found is my work, and I'm always glad to see people smile after they find the books they want. Additionally, I do not think it is a tired work; however, I think it is valuable to do it. Seeing every thing is clean and people are happy; then, I am very satisfied. To be honest, I will still cleave to the goal in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: One of the most important function of nonprofit organizations is to provide education to those who couldn't recieve it, either because the inability of the government or because they don't have a government at all. With the proper knowledge, these people will at least have a fraction of hope in changing their condition. The other important service of these groups will certainlly be provide food to homeless or poor people. I once went to a village in the east part of Taiwan, in the mountains, with a group of students from my university. We brought food, toys and books, among other things. Our main goal is in providing education, though I spent most of my time there in performing magic tricks and telling stories of fantasy for the children in elementary school. Kids got to have dreams. In the future, I would like to perform such task in those countries that really need all the help they can get, like a lot of countries in midde east. I am not making it the work of my life, but the world becomes darker and darker everyday, I have to do what I could, and so should everyone else, if we want a better place to live.

subject: HW0901
content:
Not only in Taiwan, but everywhere now has more and more nonprofit organizations. They will do their best to help those who need help. For example, not long ago, an earthquake happened in china, and there were so many nonprofit organizations arriving there immediately and started to help the locals.
These organizations can be divides in different categories. But almost every nonprofit organization has some same sevices. First, they must need money to help, so they will promote their love and let everybody denote some money. Second, they will have many volunteers. When someone need help, love is definitely in need. Volunteers will help them with love and give them confidence. Last but not the least, these organizations will provide some basic things, such as food or drinks. But these only will provide to someone who really need help.
In my college, there are some clubs like this kind of orgenizations. I like to help others, especially that I have some abilities now. In this semester, I joint a club that helped children to solve math problems. Because I major in math and I am very pleasure to teach others, I help junior high students. Every Thursday night, I went their school and solve the problem they were confused. After many classes, I was very happy and thankful for this opportunity. In the future, I hope I can help more children, or maybe the olders. I enjoy the feeling of helping others, and see their happy faces.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They are made up by groups of volunteers. Those volunteers spend time or money doing something helpful and essential. They take care of the poor, the old, the sick. They transport daily use and food to the refugee camps. They protect the natural environment and natural resources like rare animals and plents. Due to these important services, the helpless people can live much better lives than they used to and the natural resources can be protected from dying out or running out.
I have been a volunteer last semester. My work was to clean the garbage along the seashore. The purpose was to prevent the sea from polluting and to make the sea as clear and pure as the original sea. After doing such work, I thought I really should reduce the use of plastic products because the plastic products could not be broken down naturally and the large sum of garbage would remain on the sea or in the sea. The area of sea is decreasing, so it is so important to conserve. I would like to keep doing the same work I done before. As I clean the sea along the seashore, I can spend a little time to have a close view of the big nature. Also, I can do something beneficial for our society, for myself by this golden chance and experience. Therefore, it is worthy to have a try as a volunteer.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many people take like for granted and do not really appreciate their current situation. Mese people do not have the chance to come to know that they are fortunate enough already, but instead their complaints never stop. This is one of the many problems that is happening among the youth of today. That is why I suggest that teenagers should volunteer themselves in the work that the nonprofit organizations provide.
These organizations provide a wide range of services such as caring for the old, raising funds or helping the poor. By spending some time and effort taking care of the old can not only let them feel less neglected, but also we learn to be more respectful. Raising funds and helping the poor on the other hand teaches us a lesson on the value and importance of money. We could visit these people who are in need of a better environment and realize how lucky we are actually.
I hope to visit people who are needy and live in a poor environment to help them. I believe that when we all take part in many different kinds of voluntary works, we would learn to appreciate life as it is and start grumbling lesser each day. Then we would be thankful of what we've got at the moment.

subject: HW0901
content:
Indeed, nonprofit organizations in Taiwan has done remarkable contribution not only in local society but also international community. For example, there is a religious organization called Tsu-Chi. The members all come from all walks of life in Taiwan. They volunteer to take care of those old people who don't have children to look after.
