And they deliver rice, food, needed items to those poor family. When someone passes away, we can also find them attend the funeral to say good wish to the dead person and also comfort the family. Another example is World-Vision. World Vision annually hold an event to encourage people to be hungry for 36 hours and donate money to children in poor countries in Africa. In my personal experience, I've joined Tsu-Chi volunteer service in the first year of universaty. We went to hospital to spend some time with people who suffered from cancer and may die before long. As a matter of fact, we can't give them medical service. Instead, we tried to entertain them through singing and saying jokes. I feel this is really meaningful experience.
I was very lucky to learn some EMT skills during my 1 year and half military service. In the future, I want to become a volunteer fire fighter because I can use EMT skill I've learned before to help and save more people in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many important services provided by nonprofit organizations, which influence the world in a very positive way. First of all, some organizations hold activities to help people who just suffer from natural disease, such as typhoon, earthquake, and tsunami. The volunteers deliver food to them, provide medical cares, and help them to rebuild their hometown. Furthermore, there are organizations that focus on helping the poor, too. Volunteers teach poor students, lacking money to go to cram school, the subjects they want to enforce. Some poor families get resources from these volunteers too. Moreover, organizations helping the disabled are important as well. For example, they can put pressure on lawmakers to pass some laws making the disabled have better lives. It is clear to see that there are various kinds of volunteer work can be done by these nonprofit organizations.
Three years ago, I served in a elementary school in Hualien to tutor children in summer vacation. I taught the students not good at math, a real challenge to me. I had to be very patient to those children. However, when I saw them understand how to deal with math more and more, I was really happy and proud of myself. After all, it was me who helped them to overcome their difficulties. In the future, I am sure I will do more volunteer works!

subject: HW0901
content:
In this global econimic crisis, it is not much more important saving ourselves than saving ourselves by saving everyone. To earn the profit and offer the needs is the way most nonprofit organizations do. First, they recruit volunteers from young adult. Second , they hold up some learning activities for student during their summer vacation and winter break.
I have take part in King-Car as a global volunteer. Education to the humble student is the main purpose. Every summer and winterbreak, we work as TA. To help American teacher be available teaching Taiwanese, student. It is also promote the good relationship through contries.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, general people involve more in no matter money or volunteer works to the world. For example, red cross or some charities. Some donate bounches of money to the developing countries for buying books, teaching kids how to use computers, giving stationaries and gifts or providing them medical cares. Some give helps when emergencies or natural disasters happen.
I've been to an elementary school in a deep mountain in Taiwan. I taught them singing and computers for two weeks. Helping them catch up with new tech is cool. Their eyes were glittering and they screamed. I would like to try some volunteer works abroad in the future. Historical building maintaining sounds attractive to me.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, there are more and more non-profit organizations recruiting volunteers from different walks of people for various purposes. The people in the nonprofit organizations help people who are in need with great love and sincerity. They could take good care of children in orphanges and elderly ill patients in hospitals. When you walk in the hospital, you might see volunteers who wear a bright jacket and direct the right way you can find your doctor. Besides, volunteers can be seen when certain diasters occurs like earthquakes and typhoons. Soon, they will be those victims' side and give them timely comfort, hugging them spiritually. Two weeks ago, I participated one volunteer work. I took some children to a trip to museums. Most of the children were dumped by their parents or their parents are busy in work. We sang songs, chatted a lot and admired the views in the bus. I helped them explain the exhibitions displayed in the museum and directed them to fill out the worksheet we designed. At the end of the trip, we even took pictures together and exchanged e-mails and phone numbers. I treated those children like my own students or daughters and sons. This volunteer work was such a meaningful and wonderful experience to me. I realized some people who are often ignored by their important families and really needed for caring and instruction. Now, I am considering that joining in international volunteer work which aimed at offering schooling administrative work or teaching children about their school subjects in developing remote countries.

subject: HW0901
content:
The nonprofit organizations, with the kind and hard working volunteers, help the people in lower social locations and the people with physical illness a lot undoubtedly.
The volunteers, for example, send food and cloths to the refugee camps and the remote areas, and they also take care of the injuries. In addition, they give the children from poor families or small towns books to read. They also try hard to educate the children which are given up by their teachers. On top of that, they help the old and physical illed in their daily lifes. You can also see the volunteers when disasters happen. I really appreciate the volunteers in the organizations. I have planed to join a club with my friends to spend time with the children who suffer cancer. We will visit them once a week, playing with them, teaching them on their homework, making friends with them, and cheering them up.
I hope I will do my best and successfully hlep the children and be the volunteers that I've dreamed to be, just like the volunteers in the nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are millions of people that live a very miserable life nowadays. Those people don't have enough food and have no house or shelter to live in; as a consequence, something must be done to take care of those people, and it is the nonprofit organizations that shoulder the responsibility.
Such organizations provide all sorts of services to those in need. In my opinion, foods and temporary shelters such as tents are the two most important services. Without food, people could not survive long; without shelter, people have no way to escape from bad weather. Furthermore, medical services are also very important since people without food and shelter get sick easily.
Since I am a doctor, I would like to go to areas or countries that need medical service. As we all know, the gap between the rich and the poor is widening. As far as the poor is concerned, these people are unable to afford the basic medication, which the general public tend to take for granted. Numerous people died in the past few years just because they did not have enough money to pay for medical service. This is inhumane. As a doctor, it is my duty to save people. Therefore, if possible, I would like to offer my expertise to those that need it but can't afford it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations are developing in more various fields. To begin with, some of the charity organizations delicate on the education. They will have well-educated volunteers to tutor poor children. In addition to the education, some volunteers from nonprofit associations devote their time on the rehabilitation of remote areas destructed by natural disasters.
Regarding to the personal experience, I have been an one-month environmental volunteer last summer. I participated a camp held by the Chinese Youth Corps which is aimed for youngers' activities. In the volunteering month, I learned how to protect the earth from "human beings"; I learned how to do the garbage recycling well; I also learned how happy I was when I sacrificed my lovely summer time on picking up trash on the streets, cleaning up the beach, and planting a large amount of green plants.
To sum up, more and more people nowadays are willing to pitch in the volunteering career. Due to the increasing choices of various fields such as education, economy, and environment protection, it becomes more flexible for people to get into the world of volunteering.

subject: HW0901
content:
There was just a horror memory in the 921 earthquake. When it happened, I was a sleeping boy who was only a student in primary school. Terrible shakes made me wake and scared beyond writing. All my family escaped and we were safe in the end, but when we went back to home and turn on the TV, we knew that we were lucky. Lots of people died in the earthquake, I saw so many people cried to their family and needed help from others. In few days, a lot of volunteers arrived the scien to help those who survied. Not only Xi Chi, the bigges nonprofit organization in Taiwan, but some international organizations came, like the Red Cross.
What did they do for Taiwanese people? They helped Taiwan police to search for surviver in rocks and sands. They built some sample house let those whose hoase were fell to have a place to live, they also took care of their life even cook meals for them. They did everything could help them.
I was a student now, I couldn't jut leare my school to help those who need help. But I will donate something I have to help those people who is inneed. In the future, I think I would join an organization like Xi Chi to follow my passion to help people. I am good at deal with children, maybe I can take care of those children who lost their family, or teach them some skills of magic to get out of the sadness, that will push them back to the right road.

subject: HW0901
content: There are more and more nonprofit organizations in the world. They help the poor in developing countries and teach them how to live in better lives. Through an assortment of information transmitted by televisions, broadcasts and Internet, a growing number of people are aware of there are still a lot of places where the impoverished people are in need. With the help of nonprofit organizations, poor people in remote areas in Taiwan or in developing countries can receive many kinds of resources and we can also put a few efforts in these humanitarian aids. Nonprofit organizations provided various kinds of service. From emergency medical relief to food supply and sanitary improvement, they spare no efforts in helping people. They recruit some volunteers to take care of the infants without completed families or to teach them about something to do with better ways of cultivation or sanitation. Providing there is a calamity happens, these organizations will send tons of food, drinking water or clothes to help them get through the difficulties. They do these things out of humanity and want to give everyone a better life. I have volunteered to send some clothes to some developing countries, but I think it was not enough. I would like to devote some money and join bigger events to help the poverty-stricken when I can live independently and have enough money. I would also like to share the great life with those people in need, making the world better because of me.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people devote themselves to participating in the nonprofit organizations. Joining in these organizations not only helps the need but enriches our spirits as well. Also, there are different kinds of nonprofit organizations which you can choose to do the service by your own interest.
For example, there is an organization called Saint Roser, which aims to help mentally-disordered old people. They company with them and provide them what they need. Plus, volunteers will also feed those who can not eat by their own. It is really a warm and nice place.
In addition, a nonprofit organization called Huan-Ye Environmental Protection Association is also a great organization which you can volunteer to do the service if you love the environment. The main goal of this organization is to protect the environment, especially the ocean. They have a special and meaningful activity which recruits volunteers to clean the beach. You can protect the ocean from being polluted.
As far as I'm concerned, if I have the chance, I would like to clean the beach. For one thing, I can touch and embrace the environment in flesh. For the other thing, I love the ocean very much, and I don't want to see the precious ocean is damaged by people.
Overall, it's a great thing that people have the will to do the service for those who need the help. I think volunteering to do the service is not just wasting time and energy. Instead, you can learn something from serving others. In my opinion, it is totally worthy to join the nonprofit organizations to do the service.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are two kinds of organizations play vital roles in modern society, one of which is international firms and the other one is nonprofit organizations. When international firms are trying hard to figure out some ways to make a large amount of money, nonprofit organizations is busy recruiting volunteers to help them with their work, without making any profit. Due to nonprofit organizations, the weak minorities in the world are concerned by people around the world and receive much help.
What nonprofit organizations do is a variety. They help local policemen or military rescue people in disaster areas. In addition to it, they also provide children in poor areas with textbooks, pencials, blackboards, or even a school, several classrooms, and a good teacher so that they can be educated in an excellent learning surroundings. What's more, they do send some doctors with some medicine to those remote and poor areas, and the doctors will take local residents' pulse, temperature, and do some blood test to make sure the conditions of local's bodies. Most important of all, all of this services is free. However, people who are willing to join in nonprofit organizations are fewer and fewer. It is impossible for those organizations to help others without enough people to help the organizations themselves. Therefore, after entering college, I'll devote myself to nonprofit organizations. I want to teach children who live in poor cities because I love children, and actually, my dream career is teacher. If I have opportunities to tutor those children, I'll surely try my utmost to make them feel happy in class but still can learn something from it. It is always feel blissful when you do something you love and are able to help others at the same time, isn't it?

subject: HW0901
content: For a peaceful and wonderful world, there are more and more nonprofit organizations nowadays. Every one of them has its ultimate goal to attain. Take "Tze chi" fundation for example. Volunteers from all walks of people make most of their abilities to engage in helping the needy. Doctors and nurses demostrate the importance of public health in the underdevolped countries. Teachers and college students serve as tutors, educating aboriginal children in remote areas in Taiwan. However, a lot of ordinary people are enthusiastic about relief operations when overwhelming earthquakes happen or typhoons approach. There are still numerous anonymous people who donate money to build the hospitals. As far as I am concerned, I have once went to remote tribe with doctors and volunteers to educate people the ways to keep fit. I was moved in those voluteers' kind action. I would like to become a doctor in the future and devote my life helping patients in remote countries.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help their work, but how many of them do you know? Most of the people know the volunteers in the hospital who helps the patients or the volunteers who blows the whistle on streets to help the traffic. Are there any others? Yes! Plenty of them! Such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. .. etc. All of these volunteers recruit from the organization are all willing to help their country, even the world, just for one word "Love. "
I have been a volunteer. I still am now. I tutor elementary and junior high school students from the Internet. These students live on the countryside and doesn't have much resources. Our group tutor these children by net with a webcamera and a microphone. At first, it wasn't easy, actually it was tougher than I thought, however, I wasn't willing to give up. I tried different methods to acttract the students attention and after a few times we became closer, everything started to be on track! It is an honor to teach children who are needed, even though they are naughty sometimes, nevertheless, it is worth it.

subject: HW0901
content: Volunteering to help those who in need is a good virture that worths praising, especially being a volunteer with a nonprofit organization. Reported by newspaper and magazines, Ching-Tze nonprofit organization is now one of the most well know volunteering groups in Taiwan. In 2007, a severe and devastating earthquake struck heavily many cities of Southeastern China. No sooner had the news spread by media did Ching-Tze people took a plane and reached the damaged province with various suppliment from medicine, food to clean water. As to the world, the "Red Cross Organization" and "Doctors without bounders" are distinguished as well. The former dedicates to improving the education of underprivileged children in undeveloped or developing countries; the latter is famous for its eagerness and kindness of operation and medical treatment for poor people for free. All the volunteering insititutions aim to help others with their heart, which makes the world better and better. I would like to be the volunteer of Ching-Tze organization after my graduation from college to make the world full of warm. With my belief in Buddism, I can devote myself in the volunteering happily and because I like to travel and like architecture, I am concerned that I will be a good volunteer and help people rebuild their houses after serious earthquake, or help them design their new beautiful houses.

subject: HW0901
content:
NPOs are very important in a country. In a country, no matter it's developed or not, there are always people who need to be help. NPOs recruit volunteers to help with their work in helping people in need. There are so many services they provide. For the homeless, they provide meals and a place to take a rest and to clean themselves, thus they can live on with the mininum dignity. For the poor who cannot afford their children's tuition, they offer schdarships. For families of disabled children, they provide emotional support to let them know they are not alone.
So many things have done by NPOs that a lot of people have been helped when they need a hand. I am a volunteer of some of these organizations. I go to the prison to visit the HIV infected people every month. These people are suffering biologically and psychologically. They are stigmitized and labeled. When people talk about AIDS, they say "They deserve it. It's a disease of gays and drug users. " They're not accepted by the society. We need to help them through the bad situation and educate the society that "Yes, they may have done something wrong. They were not careful enough. But they themselves are victims of the disease and the discrimination."
Participating in the volunteer work is meaningful for me. I learn to be empathic and to admire what I have and who I am. It's a wonderful thing to do.

subject: HW0901
content:
I think helping others is a really good thing. Because my own ability is limited, I can't help those remote areas in Taiwan and other developing countries. Thankfully, nowadays some nonprofit organizations gather many volunteers to give hands in time to those in need. In Taiwan, there are several nonprofit organizations. Some of them tutor children in school every weekends. And some of them particularly take care of the patients who have rare diseases. Moreover, they connect the nonprofit organizations oversea, and running some international camps for hungers and poors, too.
For me, I've been a volunteer in Tapei County Hospital in Banchiao for two years. I am happy and feel honor to help the elders and patients. I had heard that "What you gain is more than what you had given. " After being as a voluteer, I can't agree no more. This summer vacation, I will run a camp with a school team. We will tutor the children lived in Greenisland. I hope that one day I can join an international charity and help those people in other counties.

subject: HW0901
content:
People were all born in different environments, so we have our own destinies that we should live with. However, some people may be less fortunate to live in a worse environment. There are more and more nonprofit organizations that raise money and recruit volunteers to help those people. I think those nonprofit organizations have really done many important services for our society. For example, when some natural disasters occurr, they would immediately send some daily necessaries and food to the victims. Volunteers would also help to take care of children and the elders. I think their donations are great and I really loop up to them. When I entered the college, there were various kinds of clubs in my school. After my consideration, I chose to join a service club, which mainly help to tutor some children from poor families. I love children and I really enjoyed the time when I got along with those innocent kids. I tutored two kids every Wednesday night. I helped them review their homework and sometimes told them stories. They were very active and polite. They would share some interesting things in their school with me. Everytime when I saw their happy smiles, I felt that all I did for them was really worth it.
During the whole semester, I not only enjoyed the time to be with them, but also learned the real meaning of helping people. Helping people is not only a work, it's also a process of learning how to love people. I think that sharing happiness with people is really a wonderful thing.

subject: HW0901
content: In my mind, the most important services provided by nonprofit organizations are their dedication and the spirits of sacrifice. Since only 30% of the people are living in well-developed countries, there are, in other words, 70% of people living in developing countries and poor countries which are almost in Africa, South America and Asia. People living in poor countries are doomed to face deadly diseases, hunger and poor living standard; what worse, governments in poor countries are often in bankruptcy and therefore, they have no resources to help people. When people in poor countries are praying to God to give them a hand, nonprofit organizations come. To join in Greenpeace and other nonprofit organizations protecting environment from collapsing is something I have decided in my childhood. Although I have not yet participated in such organizations, I have volunteered to take part in some activities such as cleaning mountains and beaches. I have a dream that one day I can buy all of the forests. By doing so, I can make sure no one can destroy our nature anymore. Love and devotion will make our world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Not long ago, when I was watching TV, there was a piece of news about college students tutored poor students in villages with their math and English. On the screen, I saw that there were full of happiness on the children's and the colledge student's face. The children were so thankful to the students that they drew cards to thank them. Touched by their cards, the students promised to come back next year.
I think the services of these students were great. Because the schools in remote areas won't have many outstanding resources to educate students. There are also few cram schools. As a result, students in these areas won't have many opportunities to receive better education. But the volunteers tutoring them may bright up their lives. The volunteers tell them that there are even more to explore in the world of math and English. The volunteers will also tell them the importance of English. For students having studying problems, they will teach them with patience and let they perform themselves much better than normal students. In one speech, the speecher told the participants that he had founded a organization that help students in poor countries like Nepal or remote place. He showed us lots of pictures about the students there. He said, "These childs are as cute as childs in the city, but they don't have equally access to be educated. " So he encouraged us to volunteer to help these students out. I was very impressed. I thought, "Yes, he is right. I am very fortunate to born in a modern city. I should be thankful that I can receive a wonderful education. " So I made up my mind: when I become a colledge student, I will volunteer to tutor these poor students. I will teach them with patience and love and put my effort on them. I hope that there will be more and more people volunteer to help these students. In this way, those students will have a better future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are know for helping people in need without profit consideration, and they are different from businesses we commonly see in our daily lives. They very often reach their hands into remote and undeveloped areas where resources are rare and insufficient. Many important services are provided by them, one of which is medicare. Hygiene in those remote and developing areas is often bad, so there are many outbreakings of diseases. Worse still, medical resoures are poor in these areas, causing people living there prone to catch a curable disease but die. Thus, nonprofit organizations will train their volunteers and equip them with abundant medical knowledge and skills to help those people.
Another important service is education. People living in remote areas often lack the ability to read and write. Nonprofit organizations will send people there to educate them, helping them increase their level of literacy, and sometimes they even teach them the stories of the Bible. As for me, I once joined the volunteer work of going to an orphanage to tutor those children who were discarded by their parents when they were young. I taught them English and read interesting stories to them. Though they were orphans, they were as cute and navie as other kids. The smile they gave to me was the best achievement I ever had. The experience let me understand the concept "Giving is better than receiving", and the happiness from helping other people made me willing to take part in the volunteer work again.
Hopefully, in the future, more and more people can spare some time joining any kinds of voluteer work which are so meaningful and inspiring.

subject: HW0901
content: Some nonprofit organizations provide important services, such as recycling garbage, collecting old clothes for poor people, promoting anti-smoking, which help our society immensely. With respect to recycling garbage, it delays the speed of global warming, saving energy, and contributing to our environment. In regard to collecting old clothes for the poor, it prevents some poor people from dying in cold weather, helping children in poor familes grow up more happily. As to promoting anti-smoking, it is beneficial to our health and conducive to the environment protection. I have not done any volunteer work; nevertheless, if I have a chance, I would like to be volunteer to help with recycling garbage, because I think global warming is really pernicious and I should do something to prevent it. We all can do something profitable to our society, I hope everyone can be volunteers if they have time, including myself.

subject: HW0901
content: Nonprofit organization call for volunteers to help with their work including helping elders who were abandoned by their children, offering free medical examination for those who can't afford it, taking care of children who are handicapped, etc. Speaking of my experience, once I had a chance to teach children whose IQ are below average when I was in college. I still remembered that I brought them a big size story book called "The very hungry caterpillar" and read it to them. I was deeply touched by how kids reacted. Although they might not be as clever as normal children, they were innocent and always showed their true feelings inside them. Whenever those memories came across my mind, I would still see their eyes dancing with delight. Honestly speaking, sometimes you do feel sorry for them and might even start to wonder why it is so unfair for them to be different from others. However, they're just like angles from heaven leading us to truly respect and appreciate the differences of every individual.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many people are tired of the news about politics and bloodly social events, thinking this is a cruel and hopeless society, but thanks to some organizations which are keeping doing something good to benefit this country or even other under/in developing countries. These kind hearted people working for he organizations make us see the good nature of mankind. Because I donate some money regularly to the non-profit organizations which are found for helping plantmen, the elderly people, the disabled, poor families, ill people and etc. I know there are some volunteers, from many business of the society, including students, office lady, professor or even who is the man needing help, devoting their time to do some services without asking rewards or salaries. For example, They change diapers for the ill baby or old people, teaching children homework, going to the ruined site from earthquake to comfort the helpless refugees overseas. The best is those volunteers will contribute some knowledge what they have learned from school or workplace to teach the refugees how to rebuid the houses and make their lives better after such a misery.
I used to donate money only because I am quite busy and tied up with work and family. However, I wish I can also be a volunteers in near future having chance to go to Hua Liean to help those abriginal children to improve their homework. With a better education, their lives will be diffent. Of course, this need co-work by many people. And I hope everyone can contribute every effort he could to this society, then we will have a better tomorrow for sure.

subject: HW0901
content:
Despite the economic crisis, still many people devote their money, love, care and even their whole life to helping others. Even a large amount of nonprofit organizations provide various services to the needy. For example, the most well-known organization, The Red Cross, contributes a great amount of money to poor children whose family don't have enough money to sustain their lives. Owing to the proverty, it's impossible for the parents to pay any money for their children's education. With the help of The Red Cross, more and more children have the opportunity to go to schools. Another example is that an organization of women. It provides women who has been mistreated by their husbands with shelter and classes for them to rebuild healthy minds.
I have seen the advertisement of helping women living in violent families and read their programs of contributing money to the nonprofit organization on a monthly basis. At that time, I had the desire to give out my pocket money. However, I didn't do that, but still put the advertisement into my bag. After thinking about this for a very long time, I have made up my mind to join in the group of helping the women living in the danger of being hit by their husbands after finishing my final exam next week.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more noprofit organization in the society in Taiwan Some are origniated from other countries, other are affilirated to some company.
Why they are vital in the society now? I think it's because as the coutries developing, more and more company-owners want to find the workers who can work efficiently, so those who can't are left behind and can't find a job. When the organization finds them they provide them with worm clothes, sufficient food and other things they need. In addition, they might give them a temp work so that they can sustain their family. And that makes me think of the day when I was young. At my young ages, my mother volunteered at such a organization that help those who are physically disabled, she helped them take a bath, gave them food, that really touched my heart.
Now I am a senior-high school student, though I don't have money to do such things, but I often donate to the organization. I hope that one day I will have enough money to be a philanthropist and help those who need help.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations do a lot of good things, for instance, free medical service, charity and education.
They provide free medical service to people who can't afford medical service. They provide money to poor family so their children can go to school, the also provide free class to teach these children to improve their ability, like english class and computer class.
If I have chance, I will attend the medical service work. Because my major in college is nursing, I can use my skill to help people.

subject: HW0901
content:
I think some services provided by such organizations, should be some of these.
First, they help children learning things in remote places, such as Africa or India. Second, they may provide food, water, medical help, clothes. .. to countries either being struck by natural destraction like, flood earthquake. .. etc, or having a war with other countries. If I had the chance to be a volunteer, I think I will work on the children education in developing countries, because I believe the saying, "Teaching them how to fish, instead of giving them a fish", so that is why I want to volunteer in education work. But on the other hand, I hope I can also help them on how to do their things in their daily life, not just only studying.
I wish we could all support to be a volunteer, in that way, you may help the poor and also have a chance to really believe ourselves quite lucky to live in a wealthy life!

subject: HW0901
content: There are a lot of nonprofit organization in Taiwan. Most of them are organized by religion group such as the most famous one called Tsi G belonged to a buddist group. Most of their works are helping people who are in difficult condition, or improving the living condition in remote area. When some disaster events happen, they also start their humanity work to relieve the refugees. We usually read their stories in the tsunami in Southern Asia and 921 earthquake in Taiwan. The stories deeply impressed to everyone's heart. I haven't attend any humanity work yet. I hope one day I retire from my job, I could service in the kind of work such as improving living condition and tutoring children in the remote area.

subject: HW0901
content:
When I was a children, Taiwan got a lot of food support from U.S., such as milk, powder. My mother told me I got benefit from that. I don't know why we can be the free rider. After grew up, I realize the world are not equal, the capable people ought to help the helpless people.
Considering my interest and capability, I would like to be a teacher volunteer. The futures of children are unlimited, as long as you educate them properly. The teach have to open children's talent, and give them self confidiences. You will get what you paid. The result is huge and unbelievable.
I hope I can bring the chance to children as many as I can. I will enjoy it forever.

subject: HW0901
content:
It goes without saying that Being a valunteer is the most honorable thing in the world. Volunteers don't get any pay but happiness. a lot of organizations provide service to public. Those services are including taking care of orphans, such as orphanages; helping homeless people, like shelter; Aiding elderly people, such as social service workers. Besides that, some organizations assist others who suffer from natural disaster such as earthquake, flooding etc.
As far as I am concerned, I have volunteered to an elementary school for two years. Read story to kids every week. Because they are our future. If I can tell them some meaningful story, they will put it in their mind. Maybe one day they will contribute to society. In the future, I will keep continuously doing this voluntary job and spend more and more time to help children in need. In summary, I believe that volunteer plays an indispensable role in society. With their inexhaustible efforts, our world is full of energic and hope.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this world, there are some people with a huge amount of wealth. On the other side, there are also some people in need. In order to help these people, many nonprofit organization were established. Some of the organizations aim to improve the environment and protect the earth, so they recycle the garbage.
Some of the organizations work hard in help the minor ones. They tutor children lack of education, help the handicapped to find jobs, take care of the aged, help people that are addicted to tabacco or drugs and so on. These organizations do devote a lot to the society.
When I was in junior high school, there was a lesson called service learning. We had to look after some children and take care of them. The children were born unabled. They couldn't see, couldn't here or short in intellect. At first, we were reluctant. But after several weeks, we changed. We learned that there were lots of people needing our help in this world and that we were very lucky. From this experience, I was surprised and touched. I wish that I can help more people in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations established in Taiwan. People in the organizations help the need all around the world. They are all patient and kind to others.
For example, there is a charity, called Zhi-Jii, people there would like to help those who are sick in remote areas. Not only the money they donate but also the love they give inspires lots of people. They tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan, take care of the elderly people, who usually live on their owns and save the victims suffering from the earquakes. What they have done really inspires me. As a teenager, I find it important to be willing to help others. Perhaps I don't have enough time to teach those children living far from the city now, but I will certainly be a volunteer to work for them in the future. Offering assistance to the need is my honor and it will be my pleasure if I can help them.
From my point of view, I think that helping people is the most important thing that we should have done. Instead of studying and going to cram schools, we have to do such a meaningful work so as to make the world become better and happier.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is a well-being thing that I can take part in this test here. Nowadays in the world, many children can not go to school to learn knowledge, and some people even can't have money to eat food, wear warm sweathers in the winter and live in a comfortable house. How tragical it is!
Fortunately, there are many nonprofit organization, which devote themselves to help other people who are in troubles, established in the world. They will afford various kinds of assistances to those who are really in need, such as money, food, and doctors. They not only teach children knowledge in remote areas, but also offer some opportunities for jobs in Taiwan. Besides, they sometimes offer the free clinics for the poor, who don't have money to go to hospitals, to see doctors. They spare no efforts to help others, encouraging people to look things on the bright side. Such charitable deed really save many people's lives and give them the spirit to keep on breathing.
As a result, if I have the chance to service other people, I will volunteer to take care of the elder. Why? Because I think that now people in the society are lack of sympathy on the old people. The elder seems like be forgot when they become old. Cosequently, I hope that I can do my best to bring pleasures to them. Making them happy is a meaningful thing to me. As a proverb says: "to give is more than to recieve." The more we treat other people well, the more we can get someday.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan, and these kinds of groups are mushrooming indeed. Volunteers in these groups have usually been sent to the remote areas to teach students their homeworks, or to accompany with them, navie children, to have some fun. Since I am a freshman now, I had already been participated in some volunteer works. One work that I took part in was in my first winter vacation of my collage life. For I am a student of the National Taipei University of Education, I have some chances to practice teaching and go to the remote areas to help the students study. In that volunteer group, I was a teacher who teaches science. I had have to take an about one hour course for the students, and I felt so scared before my teaching. However, when I started my teaching, there just comes one thought: "You are indeed a good teacher, and you can do that. Just believe yourself." There is no need to say that I felt so proud of myself after giving a lesson to the students.
As a volunteer, we have to do our best to help others and must be full of energy and passions. Help others can make us satisfy by ourself and happier. Therefore, it's undoubtedly worthy to be a volunteer or join a volunteer group.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations are popular in Taiwan because people become to rethink the value of life, intending to be devoted themselves to promoting their belief or to improve the society they're living in. Among all the nonprofit organizations, there're one kind of organizations striving to improve the life of people in remote areas. Such kind of organizations often recruit volunteers to tutor children, to take care of the old and the sick and to make some projects to attract public attention to their welfare and their lives. Besides, such organizations would regularly visit the remote areas in Taiwan to research on the citizen's demand and try to meet their demands.
I join a Mountain Service Club. It's similar to such NPOs. We would visit the same aboriginal villages every winter and summer vacation. Every vacation we would design different activities and courses for kids and for teenagers. Besides, we visit every family in the villiges to concern their lives. Our club has built the good relationship with them for 20 years. We always have good time there. We not only offer service but also find the meaning of our existence there. We want to recruit more people to work with us, helping our friends improve their lives.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are numerous nonprofit organizations in Taiwan nowadays. One of the most renowned program is called "Helping tutor children in remote areas" carried out by the "1919 Foundation." In the program, attendees not only provided help on children's schoolworks but also took care of them nearly the whole day. In the program, they played games with the children and played sports with them to make the children became healthier. It was a half-month program that required the volunteers to be very passionate in helping others, and they had to be very outgoing and knew how to interact with kids as well. However, I wasn't qualified of attending that program because I was too young. I wish I can have a chance in the future. I have also worked as a volunteer for several times. I had helped collect receipts in the "Chuan Shi Foundation" for the whole day with teens my age to help the paralyzed people. Another experience I had was to go to a nursery home and spent a whole day with the elderly a month ago. I chatted, telling stories, and also performed a drama to amuse them. I remembered an elderly telling me his own story when he was at war, he still remember its details and he felt delighted to have someone listened to him. We both had a great time and watching him smile could be the most precious experience I gained.
Though I may not have enough time be a volunteer in the future since a big test is coming soon. But I'll still try to squeeze out some time to help people in a different way. Such as: collecting clothes, raising money for nonprofit organizations. I love helping people and I'm sure this passion will last forever.

subject: HW0901
content: There is a huge progress in our society; nevertheless, our society still isn't perfect. One of the reasons is family violence. Obviously, family violence happens in the families and its objects mostly are women and children. Hence, there are several nonprofit organizations fight for them. And I am one of these fighters. I've been a volunteer in Taiwan Fund for family and children for couples of years. Sometimes, we hold fairs to make money for those poor families or single-parent families; sometimes, we have activities to encourage those who are lack of confidence due to their families; sometimes, we have to be a teacher to tutor those children who couldn't do well in their school or who their families have no ability to teach. The process is hard even if we provide "help" to those people. However, I will still keep devoting myself to help because I believe it will work. The more people pay attention to this problem, the more people will join us. The more people join us, the more help we could give. The more help we could give, the less family violence there will be. The less family violence there will be, the more fabulous the society will be.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the development of society, there are more and more nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. These organizations usually provide services to people who are in need, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan or running refugee camps in developing countries. The contributions made by these nonprofit organization are meaningful to our society and thus, moved some people to help with their work voluntarily and I was one of them.
I was recruited by a nonprofit organization to teach students knowledge about sports in a remote area in Taiwan. By teaching them sports, I also let them understand that characters can also be trained by participating in sports. If he or she knows how to play for a team, not for himself or herself, he can learn the spirit of teamwork, and thus formed a cooperative character. Helping these children are unforgetable in my memories and is a good experience to me.

subject: HW0901
content: In recent years, volunteer works in Taiwan are blooming. Many people are willing to join in volunteer groups and help others. There are a vast variety of volunteer groups, some provides financial assistance to the poor, some take care of the orphans, and some even devote themselves to helping those who suffer from serious disease. When I was in junior high school, I once volunteered to take care of the elder people in the hospital. I sang songs to them and even wrote cards to encourage them. An old lady was so touched that she said "Thank you for coming, I feel so uplifted!" with tears filled in her eyes. My heart was filled with joy and accomplishment when I saw their smiling faces, and suddenly I realized that helping others can bring happiness. Perhaps the true meaning of life is to help those who are in need. As a saying goes "Life is to give", I think I'll continue to spread love and care to the needy in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: Volunteer works have received more and more attention nowadays. The numbers of people who are willing to devote themselves in helping others are increased significantly. Some people may volunteer to cook meals for the homeless. Others may go to an orphanage to teach the children. Still others may fly to Africa as a goodwill ambassador to help the residents there. Many may consider this kind of volunteer works only be done by celebrities, such as Angelina Jolie and Matt Damon. But the truth is, even if you're not so famous as those celebrities, you can still do your bit for the world. Nowadays, many nonprofit organizations are doing such work. After raising enough money and finding volunteers, they will go to some remote areas or developing countries to help them build hosipitals for the sick and the old, help them build houses to create a better living environment, and provide them with clean water and food. And the volunteers will tutor the children some simple English or math! In the future, I would like to go to the remote villages in Tainan to teach the children how to write Chinese characters. I may not have the considerable amount of money to provide food or shelter for them, but I can provide them knowledge, which is the most valuable thing in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays inonprefit organizations provide some important services to help people in need. There is a very famous nonprofit organization called TzChi () in Taiwan. They necruit volunteers to help poor people to improve their lives not only within Taiwan also all over the world. Besides, they promote the necycling activities. The volunteers collect papers, and plasfic bottles to be necycled. They believe by doing that we can make the earth a better place to live.
In the future, I would like to join Tz chui to devote my time and money to help people in need. I believe that with people helping each other, we will be better off and there would be less dispair in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Being a global villager, I would like to say we should love each other. Nowadays, there are the huge difference between the poor and the rich which always need us to give a hand to alleviate such difference. Although our colors are different and our languages are not the same, yet we live on the same planet. We all are global villagers.
In order to stretch your love to the people needing help, there are many nonprofit organizations in the world now. These organizations actively play the role to connect your love with those really needing people. You can donate money, to the organization, or you can be a volunteer.
As long as you are willing to devote youself to them, you can light up the hope for the poor. Don't disdain your strength. Taking me for an example, I am a volunteer at the local primary school to tutor the poor students who fall behind their class. I accompany them in the early morning before classes. I help them to review their lessons and check their homework. I know my help is limited. Therefore, I often advocate the happiness of being a volunteer and invite my friends and neighbors to join me.
In the future, I will extend my love to the remote country. I know there are some people in the dark corner waiting for me. In the past, I thought I helped the people. But now, I find it is they that make me experience the true love and understand the meaning of life. I appreciate the needing people who make me enjoy the fullness and significance of life. The nonprofit organizations can also help you perform your life much more delightfully. Let's go for it!

subject: HW0901
content:
Two sores of services occur to me that should be provided to developing countries. The first one is knowledge. As the old saying goes "Knowledge is power. " There is no need for me to over emphasize the importance of knowledge here. My opinion is for the nonprofit organizations to create methods to teach those children of developing countries, which will eventually enhance the vision as well as knowledge of children. I'd like to address that "people" who tutor children is essential and influential to such as program.
The second one is environmental protection. Many businesses build their facilities in developing countries due to the cheap man-power expenses mainly. However, this investment not only damages the enviroment seriously, but brings unpredictable losses of wild lives, and natural sources. In the long run, human gains nothing good but have to pick up the pieces of what we had done before to japardise the only globe we live on.
I'd like to tutor children to learn English if one day I have such an opportunity. Not only will, I play the English teacher role well, I will also show those kids how to be caring for people. Above all, I'll not forget to remind kids of the little contribution they can devote to love the only earth we have for now befor scientists discove another planet suitable for human being to live!

subject: HW0901
content: I have heard there are lots of public benefit activities such as: medical services, eldest careness, traffic assistant, etc. If I will do, I will assist the weakness and eldest on their rest of life. It is because more and more young people give up their family and those eldest were abandant in their home and nobody take care of them. This is a serious social problem in last few years. I will volunteer to join this kind of organization to take care of them. This is my wish and I will do this when I retired.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people contribute themselves to volunteer work, and more and more charity organizations are founded. These volunteers and organizations do many things to help the poors or the disables. For example, some organizations found charity hospital, and provide free medical services and equipments for those who have no money to go to common hospital. There are also many volunteers in charity hospitals to take care of the disables who have no money to get medical care. Another example is that some organizations provide food and living goods to developing countries that destroyed by warfire, and there are also volunteers go there to take care of wounded people and the children who lost their parents.
In my college life, I joined the volunteer club called fundemental cultural service club. The purpose of this club was to teach elementary school students who lived in remote area, and hold some vacation camps for them, who didn't have much entertainment in their lives. Although going to remote area was tired and unconveniet, but when seeing the smile and joyness on those poor kids' faces, I thought all the hardness and tireness was payful and worthy. I think helping others who need my hand is very meaningful, and I enjoy the satisfaction of helping people, so I will continue to do volunteer work in my life. Moreover, I consider that if there are more and more people do the volunteer work to help others, and everyone has a kind heart, our society will be more peaceful and wonderful.

subject: HW0901
content: Recently, we humans have advanced much in different parts. On one hand is the technology advances. We can live a much more better life than our ancestors did. On the other hand, or the most important part, is the emotion advances. As the contacts with other areas become more and more convenient, we realize that there are still lots of people live without enough shelters, foods, and even love, and thus, some nonprofit organizations such as the Red Cross spring up. These institutions not only give supplies to the needy places where they just be stricken by some natural diasters as we see on TV, but also teach some poor students after school without being paid, send love to those who suffer from home-violence, and donate much money to support other nonprofit organizations, and the people serve there are all volunteers. I haven't done this kind of volunteer work before, but I believe I can help teach some young children and make them access to much more knowledge in the future because I can gain more self-fulfilling by helping others rather than depriving of them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations usually volunteer to help others but they don't ask for any payment. The organization provides foods and shelters for those who lost their homes or relatives in disasters such as earthquakes, tornadoes, or hurricanes. It comforts refugees and gives them courage to live. Another service it provide is helping the disabled and the elder. Volunteers will take care of the elder who live alone without occupations. Besides, they will also help the handicapped by giving them positive thinking and happiness. For instance, some ministers will go to them and give them comforts and courage in a spiritual way. Last, nonprofit organizations will look for the poor and try to help them by providing money and foods or daily products.
I've once been to Nepal where the Mt. everest is located. Instead of the majestic scenes, there are abundance of the poor and dirty roads which are just sand and dirts. I went there with many old clothes and toys which were abandon by the rich. We, travel partners and I, gave the old things to the poor in a local elementary school. I felt sorry for the poor but I got happy because of the work I've done. I am pretty sure that I'll do the same thing as before in the future and not just one time only.

subject: HW0901
content:
The work from these nonprofit organizations have such a great diversity from each other. Some of them help clean the streets, the bay, and the moutain. They keep away the garbages everywhere. And sometimes they even do the recycling work just for protecting the environment. Others dedicate their time and spirit to stand for animal welfare. They hate those guys who once owned a pet and gave up raising it, so that would build a new home for those stray dogs and cats and take good care of them.
Still some of them give the first-time aid to injured ones while disaster happens. For instance, many years ago the 921 earthquake had stunned millions of people, and some organization come to them before the ambulance to give them mental peace and the strength to survive.
As for me, I have lots of experiences doing volunteer work in the hospital. It's a little different from those above since we have to be trained for 3-month courses. After this train we would know much better how those patients suffer not only from their pain they got hurt but also the struggle in his/her mind. For a patient living a long time in the hospital, he must be quite sad and hopeless. That's what we guess before entering his room to have a talk with him. But he was so optimistic that we don't have to ask him any questions. He said he was bored and was very glad to talk to us. Sometimes we help patients and sometimes patients help us, too. It's a meaningful job!

subject: HW0901
content:
I think tutoring children in remote areas is a good way to help those who need help. In this way, the kid we turtore won't starving at all, and we can help them to go to school to study. If they study hard, they may get a good job, have a salary, and live in a normal life. Maybe the next time when we need some help, they will lend a hand if they can.
Though there are many ways to help with nonprofit organizations' work, I still don't have any experience of doing volunteer work. All I can do now is just send them some clothes I can't wear. If I have a chance and ability to do one, I would like to go to the place that need help to teach them and help them. In this way, I can help them by myself, and I can know their feeling in living with them. That will help me to appreciate my wonderful life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations have been founded. The purpose of these nonprofit organizations, as the name tells us, are not making money for their own benefits, instead, they do some charities, or do something which make our society better and more harmonious.
The tasks which people in nonprofit organizations do, usually, are helping others. For example, they tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan, and take care of poor kids who got cancer unfortunately or who survived from a car accident but their parents did not. Those people are volunteers, which means they don't get any money by doing these. All they want is to spread love to every corner in the world. The worthiest feedback is the smile of those people who have ever received their help. Besides, some nonprofit organizations protect the endangered animals from extinction. Animals is an important cycle of our earth. If we keep killing or catching animals without self-control, the nature will be damaged at a fast speed. To prevent this circumstance, These non-profit organizations prevail campaigns to protect animals.
I have ever participated in this kind of volunteer work once. My job is to clean the garbage on the road. Tiny work though it looks like, it helps very much. We gave the people live in there a comfortable dwelling environment; meanwhile, what we did was protecting the earth. The spirit of nonprofit organizations is worthy to learn. As a human living in the earth, we should do something to make our society, our world, our earth more progressive.

subject: HW0901
content: There are lots of people around the world living in a miserable life. Some are suffering from hunger. Some are living in a dark cold hole filled with horrible wars. Some are even struggling with their lives because of sickness. Fortunately, there are nonprofit organizations nowadays reaching out their loving hands to pull them out of the situation they have long been tortured by. This kind of organizations often offer some helps like building a hospital or school there in order to help them recover from illness or give them better educations. Some volunteers even spend their whole life dedicating themselves into helping those in need. I once volunteered in an orphanage with my friends. We played games with the kids there and also taught them some little magic tricks. That is totally a remarkable experience, which makes me feel the true happiness of helping people for the first time. It is true that "Giving is more than receiving", but to me, giving is receiving. Throughout helping people, I feel like receiving lots of love and inspirations from those I helped, too.

subject: HW0901
content: Due to the fast development of information technology, people nowdays can get almost everything they need much faster then ever. However, the remote areas and the developing countries are not able to provide people with this kind of convenience. Some of the developing countries suffered from famine, floods and wars, as a matter of fact, the people in the developed countries fund many nonprofit organizations to help those who are in urgent need. There's a lot of different nonprofit organization around the world, they do things mainly for charity. For example, the World Peace Organization helps people to stop the war in their countries, the World Food Organization helps people to have things to eat and the Red Cross Organization helps people who needs medical treatment. Last summer, I joined the Red Cross as a highschool student paramedic. I traveled to a small country in the south-east Asia with them. They asked me to test all the resident's blood pressure and recorded it. Although it was not a difficult task, it still took me quite a while to get it done. I learned a lot from the trip, it makes me feel extremely well to help the people in need. I believe that I will do more volunteer work to help more people in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Most of the nonprofit organizations provide some services to help people who is needed. Some of these services is really important. For example, the nonprofit organization may provide some medical helping, some food, and even tutoring children in remote area.
If I have a chance, I would like to tutor children in remote area, most of the children in remote area don't have money, but it doesn't mean that they are worse than others. I would like to tutor them, so they could have a opportunity to be a person they want to, not limited by the environment they born. Anyway, providing is better than receiving.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are a lot of nonprofit organizations these days that recruit volunteers to help with their work. Tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan or running refugee camps in developing countries are very common services that organizations provide. There are other important services such as sending students to a foreign country on an exchange program where they are to experience a different culture and also promote their own country. There are also some organizations that provide immediate rescue services when there is a natural disaster.
In the past years I have done various kinds of volunteer work. I am a volunteer of a nonprofit organization which gives me the chance to take part in all sorts of volunteer works. I have been to homes for the disabled and mentally challenged to help with food distributions and feeding them food. I also had a chance where I went into the rural areas in Africa to care for AIDS sufferers and orphans. The most common volunteer work I do is educate youngsters about global warming and how we should always recycle to save the world.
In the future I would like to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan. Apart from teaching them English, I want to share my life experiences with them. It could be a little getaway from the busy city life and a chance for one to experience what life is like for those children. I believe it will not only be me that is teaching them something, in return, I am sure that they will teach me a lot too. A teacher's best teacher is their own students.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations helps people without getting paid. They do the works that normal people don't want to do.
When disasters like earthquakes or tsunamis happens, nonprofit organizations sent their people to those who are suffering.
Some nonprofit organizations also tells people to be aware of disease. They hold activies and invite celebrities to let everyone know the importance of health.
Nonprofit organizations also makes advertisements to let people know that smoking and taking drugs will harm your body, and that there are many in needs who don't have a house to live in, or food to eat as a meal.
I have done some volunteering works before, like helping the library replace all the returned books, gathering reciepts from passersby on the streets so the nonprofit organizations can exchange them to money and help more people, and I always save my allowence so I can donate them to those nonprofit organizations.
I hope that one day when I am old enough to donate blood, I will donate my blood to save lives. I also want to be an member of the nonprofit organizations in the future so that I can help those who are suffering.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people in need, so that's why some nonprofit organizations giving them a hand. Some organizations, such as Red Cross, or religious groups, etc, do good to the people. The following are some services these organizations give. "Help suffering victim in war. " While encountering such serious wars, Red Cross will offer some foods and drinks to the soldiers or the people. It let them feel comfortable. "Care the sick." Some will go to hospital to company with the lonely elderly or the sick taking DNR in the future, etc. They are just willing to spend their time on them. "Give medical care in remote areas. " Many doctors belonging to a group to stay in countries instead of urban areas to make the people accept good medication.
To me, I think these work is very new to me, and I hope one day I can do well on these tasks. In my summer vacation, I decide to volunteer in Deaflympics. In the volunteering period, I can learn about the hand languages and I can truly know how to understand them by body languages and facial languages, not by talking.
However, in my lives, I hope I can do a lot of meaningful things. One of them is "Doing my best to help people. " Although now, I don't have real abilities, such as money or skills, I will still wait and learn continually. It stands not just for me but for the people surrounding me. Finally, I want to say "thank you" to these organizations. With your help, Taiwan becomes more active with full of happiness and hope. Doing the volunteer work is our best choice! Let's do it!

subject: HW0901
content: Volunteers of nonprofit organizations help children in remote areas with their schoolwork or running refugee camps in developing countries. In Taiwan, volunteers not only teach but also play with kids in places far away. They go into the mountains and teach those kids easy subjects. Some of the organizations provide children with new computers so that they can communicate with people in another city or foreign countries. Some other volunteering works are to help those people who are suffering in foreign countries. They go to different countries and help people cure their disease, rebuilt the broken hometown or teach them how to plant. They are not afraid of being infected and are willing to help. I have never done any volunteering works. However, I would like to go to remote areas in Taiwan and tutor children. That is because I like children. They are as pure and cute as angels. I also like teaching. Although I might not know a lot about school subjects, I can teach them singing and photography. I think that they might enjoy learning them. I will go to those places and help children someday in the future for sure.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are getting more and more non-profit organziations in this ever-changing society, dedicating in helping those who are in need. They provide some service, such as consuling, summer camps, raising funds, volunteering tutor and so on.
At the begin of 2009, I participated an activity which was going to run a winter camp in this winter vacation. The camp was set for children in remote area in Nantou. Three days of the camp including many interesting games and lessons of some basic health concepts were all prepared by ourselves, and of course, was free. I had learned a lot from the special experience. Volunteer work isn't that easy. You will pay your time and energy in it, but in the end, there won't be any "actual" pay back. You might face with some frustrations in the preparation of the work, but when the children's faces are filled with smiles, everthing you've done will be worthwhile. In the future, I hope I can join the volunteers in the hospital, which I have not experienced before. To help people in need can really make oneself happy and satisfied.

subject: HW0901
content:
Working for no return is a highly admirable job for me. In my points of view, I think it is an honor to work as a volunteering nonprofit worker. When I was studying in an English teaching program in New Zealand, I was told by my trainer that there's a group of people traveling around the world with the job of volunteering language teachers. They travel through countries all over the world and teach English for some nonprofit organizations. Most of them tutor children for free in some poorer area of Asian countries. What they are offered are simple meals and accamadation, but they enjoy what they are doing. Most of the language teachers think through this job, they can not only help the children who cannot afford the costs on education, but also, they enrich and various their life experiences through living country by country. Their ways of helping others impress me a lot and make me admire them deepling.
When I was still a student of English Literature Department, I used to take part in an English camp during a summer vacation. We planned an interesting program with lots of interesting activities for a group of children who are from some low-income families. It was really a pleasant job that all of the member enjoyed working through out the whole time, and no one cared about the money or anything in return. For me, the smiles we saw on the children was the best prize. Because of such a fullfilling experience, I think I will take a chance to work as a volunteering language teacher in the future. People who work for no return are truly respectful, and I hope one day I can be one of them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Though we live in a prosperous society in Taiwan, there are still many social problems we seldom notice. Nonprofit organizations have popped up in recent years to help better these problems. An organization called "Sunlight Fundation" assists children who have difficulties developing intelligence. Volunteers teach them bake bread and snacks to give them confidence and endow them with a living-skill. Another organization named "Li-Shin Fundation" provides service for those who become pregant before marrying or are raped. Instead of discriminating against the victims. Volunteers are always cheerful to them to drag them out of the shadow of great pains.
With so many voluntary services prevalent around, I usually go to remote areas with friends in church to help children. We play with them, tutor them, and lead them to pray. Those children are venerable because they don't have a whole family or even have been abused. There, I have to use my patience and love to cure their mind. Through the process of helping, I gain happiness of giving. I think it is the unselfish love that makes the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more nonprofit organizations are being founded in modern society, silently giving hands to those who are in need without asking for rewards. Helping out the poors and saving lives after disasters are two major deeds that impress me most. As myself, I sincerely hope that I can join them someday. As we can see, the reality is uneven and cruel. Many families in remote areas are suffering from hunger while we are being picky on extra foods. Showing pity on the poors, the organizations provide these people with warm foods warmheartedly for free, taking care of their lives without complaints. What's more, whenever typhoons hit or mudslides occur, no matter how dangerous these places are, the volunteers are on spot at the first place and always ready to rescue lives. Their selfless spirits are respectable and honorable. Don't you think their secret deeds should be highly praise by the public?
The volunteers' brave actions have a great impression on me, encouraging me to follow their steps. In the future, I wish to change thw world with my talent and passion. I would like to tutor poor students living in countryside how to speak English. I know I won't be able to change the circumstances all by myself but at least I'll still give it a try.

subject: HW0901
content:
In developing countries, remote vallies, and poor villages, you can see a lot of nonprofit oranganization recruit volunteers. They are devoted to their volunteering, and contributes a lot for the whole society. The main services they do is to offer medical helps. Those places are always short of medical equipments, so the volunteers carry them there. The oranization may even send some doctors with a lot of experience there and help improve the sanitary facilities. Furthermore, another important service is education. The education resources there are not as abundant as the city. On TV, we can see many enthusiastic university students come to poor village to help the kids with their school works.
I've been to nursing homes with my mother several times. Due to her job, I always go help the elderly people with her. We talk, sing, and play games with them. And I've heard some crazy childhood stories from them, too. When I pull their wheelchairs to the park, I feel like that they are just like my grandmothers and grandfathers! They are not lonely anymore because of my mother and I. I sure that the rest of their lifes will fill with joy and laughters as well.
I'm always touched when I see those vonlunteers. Though they don't obtain any profits, they want to help more people. Don't just applaud for them, you can make volunteering a reality from now on! May the power of love illuminates the whole society, and even the whole world!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. This kind of organizations provide people chances to try different things and gain life experiences. Some organizations allow us to help other people. Students who have difficulties with their schoolwork can ask for special tutoring. Some run summer camps and let children learn to be independent and cooperative. In libraries, there are also volunteers who help arranging books or hold interesting activities. Volunteers enjoy themselves while working and others are impressed by their professional and friendly services.
I was a volunteer in the library last summer. My mother made me go there and at first I was furious. I could complete other more exciting things than working in an old, boring library! However, as soon as I arrived there, I was amazed. The place was full of books and wooden tables. People were devouring one book after another. Younger kids were reading picture books and grinning in delight. A friendly librarian told me that my work was to entertain those children with fairy tales or other stories. I was afraid nobody would listen to me but it turned out that everyone loved my stories. Little kids surrounded me as if I were a super model. I soon grew confident and started to use various of tunes to read. I even stood up to act! It was so much fun being a volunteer in the library. I learned to get along with children and started to believe in myself. It was certainly a wonderful summer.
I'm thinking about being a tutor in summer camps and help teenagers. I'm sure it'll be another memorable experience.

subject: HW0901
content:
I am a valunter to hospital stray dogs. In Taiwan, there are a lot of people abandent their pet. If no one help those pet, they will die in two weeks. Those animal don't know how to find food, and many car accident happended on them. When I saw stray dog, I will take them home and find someone to adopt them. Most of them will have a new family and happily ever after.
Stray dog will produce environmental problem. There also a lot of valunteer doing TNR. They neuter stray dogs. Neutered dogs will not produce new stray dogs. We want to solve the problem of stray dogs. Maybe one day, there will be no stray dogs in Taiwan. All of the dogs have their family. No more mercy kill. All the resident in Taiwan will not be attacked by stray dogs.

subject: HW0901
content:
These days, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their world. They aren't like other company just want to make "alots" of money. Their goal is to help others to make life better. There are some organizations in Taiwan.
There are "World Vision", "orphan organisation" and other "church missionary service" in Taiwan. For "World Vision" this organization was mainly help kids in the second world or poor kids in Taiwan. People who are volunteers can adapted one or more child to provide their living cost. Some orphan organization provide orphan a place to live and care.
