For other "church missionary service" provide a place calm down our spirit, make us feel peace and relax.
In many years, I have done serveral volunteer work such as help kids study Chinese in church, help library to organise books and went to see orphan in the Christmas time. I feel fullfilment when I help others. That was not just making money, it was helping others happiness. For all that, nonprofit organization are more popular these days. We can see in many magazine, news, and their own website. They provide alot of information about people who need help, and how we can help them. In the future I would like to try other volunteer work to do. Everyone should try something like this in their life. Although we can't get money but you can get some experience money can not buy from it!

subject: HW0901
content:
When it comes to important services provided by nonprofit organizations, the recent news regarding the inhumane massacre in Dafur, Sudan occurs to me. Living in the comfortable and peaceful Taiwan, few know things and states about the cruel events taking place in north Africa. During the dreadful domestic war in Sudan, there are many who are in urgent need of help from other countries as people there are forced to leave their homes and they are under brutal attack of the rebels. They, most civilians, are faced with the ordeal with almost none willing to help them, including their government. In the juncture, many nonprofit organizations around the world send their medical groups there, offering many advanced medical services for free. To save and deliver those in need, they devote their precious time and money to the victim. The services includes medical support, supplement of food and, if necessary, they also help them set up some tentative houses, so that the victim may be able to stay at where they are secure.
As to what volunteer work I might choose to do in the future, I think I will dedicate myself to the slum where people are destitute and devoid of money and education. I'll go to India or Africa to endeaver to remove the poverty there. I will sacrifice all I have to be engaged in the work of education. After all, with great power comes great responsibility.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have been helping people in need. As we all know, providing food, clothing and money is a way to help people who don't have enough resources, but it is not the only and best one. Actully, educating them is a better and more important thing for the nonprofit organizations to do. Providing the resources that people in remote area need is a way that has immediate effct on changing their life style. But the result cannot last long, because the donation is unstable. And what money can do have its limit. On the other hand, educating people in remote area can have profound change in their lives. As education can give people knowledge, it can also teach people how to use the knowledge to help themselves. "It's better to do than to wait." So this is the better service that provided by nonprofit organizations.
As a student in educational collage, I have known the importance of education. Now I'm devoting myself on mastering the subjects well, so that I can use the knowledge I have to help more people.

subject: HW0901
content:
We often overlook the needs of people who have lesser than we do, and so does the govnerment. Thus, this is where nonprofit organizations come in, helping people in remote areas or in developing countries. The volunteers help with the childrens' education, the peoples' medical problems, their meals, the quality of their drinking water and just about everything in their daily lives.
My parents are also part of one such group. These volunteers work with the local police to tackle the needs of the people in remote areas. I have also gone on many such expeditions with this group of volunteers, and have seen first hand the miserable conditions these people live in--no food, no medical services, no warm clothing, and no one to keep them company. My heart bled at seeing the way they drag on with their lives. So the first step of helping them was always to give them some food or things to cook with, and to check up on their health conditions. The most heart-wrenching scene was when they smiled and laughed in delight when we gave them little gifts that meant nothing to us but obviously meant everything to them.
Anyone who has ever done some work in a nonprofit organization would know the despair you feel when you see so many people in need. Those organizations really are selfless. Whatever services they do for people in those remote places, whether it be education, medical services or just plain chatting, these volunteers are doing something we don't willingly do in this world anymore-giving out love freely, and without repayment.

subject: HW0901
content:
From my point of view, I think it is very important for people like us to join nonprofit organizations because most of these institutions are lack of volunteers to help those needed ones, including children and elderly. There a number of institutions we can join in and different volunteer work that suitable for us to choose from. Such as helping disadvantaged children do their homework, volunteering in a hospital, helping people who have problems with drugs, sending the elderly who live alone their meals, and so on.
These are meaningful volunteering jobs that we can do and they are precious experiences that we won't forget in our lifetime. Actually, I have done a number of these kind of jobs before. The first job I've done was helping people, especially the elderly, who came to hospital and directing them to the right exam rooms to do their physical examination. In my senior high school years, my classmates and I also went to some homes for veterans and we cleaned the rooms and swept the floors for those elderly. All of these experiences made me feel good. The good deeds like I did for those people is urgent for more people to join the volunteering because giving is always better than receiving. Someday we will need someone's help, too!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the society become more and more indifferent. People live close to each other; however, they seldom care about those people who live near them. The nonprofit organizations hlep not only the people who are in a desperate or tragic situation but also can help people who are become indifferent since the development of capitalism. They share their love to poor children, single mother to stray dogs and even accross the country to help those who are inneed. Their spirits definitely worth our respects.
I have not had an opportunity to be a volunteer; however, I am willing to participate in it to help people. If I have the oppotunity to become a volunteer, I will choose to go overseas. Since I have learned English, I can use my ability to get to know what they really need. One of my friends had been to Thailand and taught the children Chinese. After he came back, he shared his experience to us and said that he became mature and he cherishes his life more now. He also said that if there will be another chance, he will go there again. Since we are living in Taiwan, most of our econimic situations are not so bad. Sometimes people will take what they had for granted. It will be great to see the world outside and to realize that how lucky we are and cherish our lives. I would like to work as a Chinese teacher in Philiphines or the countries in Africa. There are so many children who can not have enough food to eat and not to mention education, therefore, since I have the ability to help them, I should contribute my knowledge to them.
Education, I think, is the basic need for human being. Once people have education, they can use it to change their situations. I think that is what they need most. I hope that one day I can really participate in the nonprofit organization and try to do my best to improve this world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Thanks to the callouts from social and political leaders, more and more organizations are offering a variety of important services to help the drawning ones.
Some of the services may include helping sexually abused children to find a responsible hostfamily, giving the children a chance to enjoy the life they deserve. Another service can be assisting elders in the community to obtain education that was not accessable to them decades ago.
Activities I mentioned early on are exactly the things I have taken part in. I participated in a church group to visit the victims and give them some encuragement. Furthermore, I helped out in my community by giving elders English lessons. The payback from these experiences are far more than I could ask for. It helps me to build up a mature and responsible personality. A saying began to echo in my head, "Offering is more enjoyable than receiving."
In the near future I plan to take more oppotunities in joining such organizations, I would like to travel to different countries with problems. By doing so can I expand my enthusiasm to the whole world and thus become a proud member of the world village.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are vast of tutoring children, refugee camps, and other nonprofit organizations stunning up around the world. Therefore, a large amount of people take advantages from them and become happy again. Following are some services that these organizations provide and what volunteer work I would like to do in the future.
To begin with, the refugees will provide food. Some poor children may have three days or more that haven't eatten foods or water. Thus, when the refugee gives them food, they will definitely be greatful and have stronger health than before. Second of all, it provides them good medical care. The organization will sent some doctors and nurses to help people who live in poverty to do the whole body examinations. It not only solves their problems, but makes them feel concerened and be loved as well. This is also what kind of volunteer work I would like to do in the coming future. Helping people always makes me feel joy and cheer. Last but not least, it help those children who have problems with their school assignment. Some parents are lack of money to afford their child to go to the cram school. These kids can ask the tutoring group for help. It can teaches them after class and helps them to improve their weaknesses on various subject.
To sum up, the nonprofit organizations will provide food, good medical care, and teaching lessons after class. These are indeed very crucial.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the technology advance, many countries become richer and stronger. However, there are quite a few people suck in poverty. They have no food to eat, no bed to sleep in and other inconvenience in their routine.
For the sake of helping those who are in need, nonprofit organizations are set up. They usually consist of doctors, nurses and volunteers. The group of people will visit remote villages to concern the poor. Sometimes, they will bring some books and toys to kids. Also, doctors and nurses check their health condiction and prescribe some medician for them. Most importantly, they will call on every residents to see if they need something and chat with them to make them feel warm.
I think that apart from studying as a student, I should spare some time to do society good. I may take part in such organizations and do my best to help the community. I am good at sharing my experiences and inspiring those who are in a blue mood. I consider I am capable of chatting to kids and adults alike. I can tell them what I have learned from school. I am able to bake cakes and cookies; therefore, I can send them the my handmade gifts to them to express the love to them. Last but not least, I can mail letters to them frequently to keep in touch with them because I think love is the most important thing they require in such places.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, with this fast-paced society, the interaction between people become less frequent, and most people care only about themselves. However, through the nonprofit organizations, some people choose to help others, and change the attitude toward life.
First, some organizations raise money to help improving the life and the environment of the poor. For example, they provide the poor with food or clothes, and also doctors to avoid some diseases. Besides, the volunteers in the organizations can tutor children in remote areas. That is to say, the educational gap between remote areas and downtowns becomes smaller. In addition, running refugee camps is also one of the things they help people. For instance, after the 921 earthquake hit Taiwan, volunteers all over the country and world came to the center of Taiwan to give the people a hand.
To me, as a 15-year-old student, I never had the experience of being a volunteer. However, if I have had an opportunity, I would love to be a volunteer to teach children in remote areas or to run refugee camps. As a saying goes, "action speaks louder than words, " I think I can first join clubs in school which help people.

subject: HW0901
content: When an emergency or natural disaster occurs, except the governmental departments related, the nonprofit organization are the ones that appear at the scene. They provide not only medical care and first aid, but also supply daily goods and after repairing to the victims. Nonprofit organizations also devote their time tutoring children in remote areas or run fefugee camps in developing countries. They give care to the elders and hadicaps who don't have the ability to live on their own. With so many services they provide for the society, what would happen without them? If I had a chance, I would like to teach the children in remote areas who don't get as much education resources as the city children. According to the old saying "rather teach him how to fish then just giving him the fish. " I believe that teaching them a skill that could help them find a job and support themselves would be way better then suppling daily goods. It helps develop the area's economy and enhances the education level. I have spent time and took care of the elders as an volunteer before. I realize that the reason why they were left alone by their kids is because their kids don't have the ability, which is usually financial problems, to take care of their parents. Therefore, to change this phenomenon, I think "teaching the kids how to fish" is the most direct way. That's why I would like to teach if I had a chance to be a volunteer in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Three years ago, I have joined nonprofit organization program which is going to Nepol for a month. My friend noticed this information in goverment website and invited me to go with him. At first, I don't want to go at all but after I check out the website, I find out these activities is worth to go.
During that month, I have had a good time there. I work with my hoststay in library which is plenning activities for children in summer vacation. By activities, I know this country's culture quickly.
I enjoy nothing so much as being volunteer. If I have time, I would love to do it again.

subject: HW0901
content:
The nonprofit services always deserve my attention, the fresh one in my memory is tutoring children in police offices. Children used to be home alone after school, since their parents still work. Some of them stalked in the streets, some stayed at home and yet into troubles without immediate helps. A police office in south Taiwan provides a day care service to take care these children. They not only keep children from dangerous places, but also tutor them how to do the homework. In addition to the polices, their relatives and neighborhoods also involve the service.
The volunteer work I have ever done was helping collecting old staffs, including books and clothes, and sending them to low-income people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Love is without borders. As we can see from those war-torn countries, like Congo and Iraq, numerous personnel from the UN or the Red Cross devote their lives to help those displaced refugees. Because of these volunteers, the welfare of local residents get improved.
To be more specific, the services provided by such nonprofit organizations are very diverse, ranging from medical care to facilities construction. Soon after the devastating earthquake struck Si-chuan () of China, the Tsi-chi() immediately dispatched volunteers to the site to help those in need. Their relief mission covered food delivery, fund-rasing, school building, etc. The aim of the operation is to help the refugee zone back to normal as quickly as possible.
As for me, I once went to a remote aborignal village with my friends while I was in college. Since most of the students were from economically disadvantaged family, our job was to guide them to learning in a more effient way. I felt my life became much more meaningful from such work. So, I would like to lend my helping hand to the sick by being a doctor in the future!

subject: HW0901
content:
For economic inequality in today's world, the gap between the rich and the poor has become larger and larger. As people in a developed country with high education, we have to provide our capability and knowledge to help those in developing countries who need support.
The easiest way for a college student is to tutor children at poor families or in remote areas to deliver knowledge for them. Some agriculture groups provide their technique and professional experience to help those developing countries' people plant rice and produce food. Additionally, doctors' group form a team to Africa to provide medicinal care for free.
I ever did a volunteer work in Nantou county. That day was after the big earthquake 921. Other volunteers and I took responsibility for building a group of assembly house at the location where residents' original houses collapsed.
I felt exteme honor from my heart since I never contributed myself so much before. It's an unforgettable day in my life.

subject: HW0901
content:

Whenever there are wars and natural disasters, such as earthquake, we can see the rescue teams which are raised by the nonprofit organizations rush to the areas and help refugee to rebuild their howntown. In my opinion, everyone can do charity and help others. Doing charity depends on our minds, no matter we are rich or poor. As a colleage student now, I take part in the service club. In addition to the funny activities that we prepare for them, we also provide schoolwork reforcement. Every weekend, we go to the remote elementary school to teach them Chinese, math and English.
Helping others enriches my life. The feedback is more than I expect. In the next summer, I plan to take part in the program of AISEC and go to the middle East countries to help people in need.

subject: HW0901
content:

They will provide refugers with food, drinkable water, and even treatments and help them get rid of their helplessnes and pain. subject: HW0901
content:

content: I think that some services provide by nonprofit organizations are very important, like tutoring children in remote areas, medical service to other developing countries, and running refugee camps. subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more people devote themselves to nonprofit organizations. These fellowships consist of people from all stages help people get through their hard times, for example, curing poor people who suffered from disease, tutoring children in remote areas, running refugee camps in developing countries and so on. subject: HW0901
content:
In the world, there are people from riches to rages. Some millionaire or billionaire are selfish, and they don't care of people who lives insolated, primitive places. But, some of them do. subject: HW0901
content: With the gradually growing gap between the rich and the poor, more and more poor families need the help from the rich people. In order to give a hand to the poor people, people who have abilities start to help them by donating money, building house for them or providing medical services for them. Some of these kind-hearted people doing charities don't want reward, so they form the nonprofit organizations. The nonprofit organizations are fund by people who have ability to help others but ask for no payback. These organizations provide some medical services such as doing health examine for free in big hospitals. For example, if you were homeless and you don't have the health insurance guaranteed by government, when you are seriously ill, it would be very expensive to see a doctor without the health insurance. At this moment, the nonprofit organizations are the best helper, and they also provide other kinds of services. Nowadays there are many broken families in the society. Some old people live alone without caring. Some children have only single parent and the can't get proper care. Even some of the children are undergoing homely violence and don't know whom to turn to. Volunteer from the nonprofit organizations would come to these families and help them out of their difficulties. The volunteers would care about the lonely elders as their kids, and take care of the frightened children as gentle adults. With doing so, the people in need can get consoled. In order to improve the harmony in the society, to join a nonprofit organization would be a good choice. Since we don't have much money and we are not strong enough to change the society overnight, we can offer our little strength to gradually make a better world. If I am going to be a volunteer, I would like to take care of those kids who lack of love from the family. Children are our future, and we can feel some satisfaction from being volunteers without receiving reward.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing. In final, they do not do it for money. Such organizations like Red Cross, AIEF or many more. They help people with many difficulties. For example, sending some necessities to some place in need is their top priority. With their help, some may benefit from them. What's more, these organizations can arrange some teachers to some remote areas to teach children. In order not to have the distance from the city to urban. Last but not least, they may hold a activity and gather some volunteers to work together to have better workout in the future.
With such nonprofit organization, not only can people in need feel their love for them but can we realize how hard their life would be. In my opinion, I would like to go the South Africa and help the children there. Although I do not have a lot of money, I am healthy enough to do things for them. Just a little help may be their biggest wishes! Clothes-we donate, can not only warm their body but also their heart. Not until we lose something do we realize that we should cherish what we have. Consequently, volunteer work means a lot to me. Because I can help people who are truly in need and fulfill my life as well not just feel sorry for them with some words.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more positive changes are happening in Taiwan, and they are also turning Taiwan into a better country. 'Nonprofit organizations' recruiting is one great example. Not only famous people but civilians are getting more willing to devote themselves to helping others. Some college students sacrifice their vacation to reach out to the mountains in orde to teach the aboriginal students English while others spend their time hanging around in KTVs or the internet cafe. In my opinion, tutoring is a necessary service which isn't an easy job. Another important service, I think, is about environmental protection. Because of global warming, the public gradually pay attention on recycling. Therefore, some organizations provide money and rewards to encourage people to sort the trash and collect paper and plastic bottles. In addition, some poor families are able to be supported financially by trading the resources for extra income.
With the progress of Taiwan's economy, the society are becoming more aware of the importance of charity. I'm part of Taiwan, and I would like to put some efforts for others and give them my hand. In fact, I have been doing this job for a long while. Since I was a high school student, I have been a volunteer of the church near my home. Every afternoon, I teach the homeless kids English and math. They can always deliver me a sense of achievement because of their laughter. Even though I have lost a lot of my free time, but what I have got is much more valuable than everything. Being a volunteer has brough me many lessons, and the lessons is leading me a more fulfilling life. In the future, I trust more people will dedicate themselves to being volunteers and helping people who need help. Also, I will still try my best to help more people.

subject: HW0901
content:
The most famous and biggest nonprofit organization in Taiwan is Chi-Gee(). It was founded by a weak and thin lady, but it becomes the most powerful foundation now. Also, they have a TV channel in which they spread the good deeds such as loving other people and helping the poor. In doing so, more and more people are influenced to do things good for the society. Meanwhile, they also have hospitals in remote areas to cure those patients who have no money. They train doctors and nurses in their own medical school, so they learn to treat patients as their own family. Many volunteers also collect used papers or bottles, and then they recycle the material. They sell them and use the money to help more people.
I admire those volunteers and appreciate what they have done. I would like to be a part of them. Therefore, I am going to join them. I will donate some of my salary regularly to the charity, and help out the elderly, the poor, and the needy as well. I believe that the whole country will become better because of our unselfish love.

They've tried hard to demand for environmental protecting policies from UN (United Nation) fifteen years ago, which forced the UN started the COP, an annual meeting which was settled for the environmental issues, discussing the way or policies to make the environment we live better.
Frankly, I have never been a volunteer of the nonprofit organizations I have mentioned above. However, I am really care about these imformations, and I try my best to follow the environmental policy which were mad by the government or those nonprofit organizations, like don't use the plastic bottle, hoping I can do something for the earth in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
It goes without saying that there are some famous nonprofit and non-official organizations in Taiwan such as church, tempo, or other private charity. These kinds of nonprofit organizations have been helping people who are in need all over Taiwan countinuously and not require any repayment.
In my opinion, most of the nonprofit orgnizations were established by the wealth who have made a lot fortune and want to donate something such as money, materials even more their rat of lifes to the social works. On one hand, they would show up at the first time while earthquake is happened to shatter the buildings causes thousands of people homeless. On the other hand, these organizations would take care of the old people who are solutary live on their own or teach children in romote mountain areas. Regraless of appreciation and repayment, they just spend the life to lighten other's life. All they want is one kind feeling of success.
Although I have not joined this kind of organization yet, I still try to help others as possible as I can. In my opinion, people who make money from the socialty should repay something to it. There are still many people have troubles of sustaining their lives. On the top of that, this would be a precious experience which could be replaced by nothing.

subject: HW0901
content:
After the 20th century, with the human right enhanced in the whole world, a great deal of nonprofit organizations were founded one by one. They blamed on the indiffrence toward the people living in poverty and the disabled. Therefore, they raise money and volunteer to help them with all their heart worldwide.
There's a well-known non-profit organization called Red-Cross, which was founded by a nurse who intended to help the wounded soilders in a conflict betwent England, France and Russia in the 19 century. Red-Cross also helped a lot in the World war I and II. Nowadays, it still help people living in Africa or other impoverished places and hold a lot of volunteer activities worldwide. And I have participated a one of them with my classmates which I donated them by selling things and I felt delight that I had the capability to help others. Moreover, I would like to donate more money and accompany the elder in the future. In my opinion, I think people should get involved to some volunteer activities. After it, they will feel more content about their life and cherish what they have now.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, many people need others' help due to some problems in life. As a result, more and more nonprofit organizations are established. There are some important services provided by them. For example, when there is an disaster that people have run out of their supplies, some nonprofit organizations will provide them with food, water or something they need. When some children are tortured, they will have a service that will protect them from torturing again. When there are a lot of refugees in developing countries, they may run refugee camps to help those they really need help. I have been to a hospital during a summer vacation because my friend asked me if I wanted to go with tehm. I agreed without hesitation because I had wanted to help with others, but I didn't know how could I do. I really enjoyed a lot and had different thoughts there. There, I saw many children who were supposed to running around and playing around like us, but they were not allowed to do these because of their disease. I learned that we should appreciate our parents that they give us heathy bodies, and make good use of the time to do anything we really want to do. Therefore, we won't regret what we did someday in the future!
I think I'll go there to be a volunteer again this summer vacation!

subject: HW0901
content:
In this high-technology society, there are more and more people who only care about their own benefits and they are unwilling to spend time or money to share or to help others. However, some nonprofit organizations appear and try to do their best to help those poor people. In Taiwan, those organizations are more and more popular nowadays.
These organizations not only donate food, money, or objects in need but also volunteer to help others with love and care. For example, doctors provide medical examinations, medical lessons and courses to teach people how to protect themselves from being hurt or suffering from diseases. Some educators provide professional knowledge to help students who cannot afford the payment of cram schools or reference books.
I have this kind of experience when I was 18 and 19 years old. I joined a school club and one of the objectives is to help children in remote areas in Taiwan. We ran medical camps at the elementary schools in Changhua every year. We designed a lot of activities and let children learn some skills and medical knowledge through playing. We also invited some dentists to exam their teeth and teach them how to clean teeth.
The love and care of people are not limited. I have a friend who donated pens and pencils to a small country in Thailand. Children there cannot afford educational payment, even a pen, or a pencil. We mailed many pens and English books there for those poor children who really want to study but can not afford those costs.
In the future, I would like to keep helping those poor people, and I have one dream-tutoring children in remote areas. I would like to enrich myself and become a professional teacher, then help those children and make the world better. It's better to give than to receive, I enjoy the process of helping people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the economy develops so great that the gap between the poor and the rich has become bigger and bigger. And the nonprofit organizations are the bridges to connect this gap. Every year, these organizations will shoot a large amounts of short vedioes to remind people that there are still a lot of people still faced famine. They even assemble some people or doctors to Africa to help the refugees. The members of these organizations devoted their lives to the world, and they don't care about feedbacks such as money. They are really great and they're also my idols!
I have been a volunteer two years ago. My job is to teach a junior high school's student from a single family homework. At first, he didn't even listen to me and I was frustrated. However, whenever I think of the no name's heroes around world, I know I have to do something, too. With my perseverance and his consideration, we finally became good friends. Both he and I had learned a lot from each other!

subject: HW0901
content: As a matter of fact, I heard a lot about nonprofit organizations, and I respected what they done for underpriviledge people. The volunteers from nonprofit organizations always spend their free time such as holidays and weekends taking care of the poor and helpless people. For example, they teach some of children who are from poor family. Those children's parents can not support them to go to the cram school. Therefore, in order to help them keep up with their classmates, the volunteers teach them after children are out of class for free. Another example is that the volunteers go to developed countries and help the people who suffer from starvation, illness and even disastral events. For me, I have taught children as a volunteer. Those children are lack of high quality environment to study. Because I take educational courses in my university, I am trained for teaching students. Therefore, I am glad that I can use my major and abilities to teach those children. Like other volunteers, we use our passion and patience to help people. I am sure that I will continue to do this meaningful job in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the current society, some people harboring a merciful heart actively dedicate themselves to the philanthropy. They work together to constitute some nonprofit organizations and recruit volunteers to assist them in their work. For these organizations, their intention is to provide some assistance for the people who need help and to save these people from any disasters. They offer a wide spectrum of services, such as tutoring children in remote areas, assigning their staff to help some victims and survivors escaping from serious calamities, and so on. In order to tutor the children in remote areas, these organizations designate some people to those areas to impart these children with knowledge either about academics or about daily lives. Furthermore, they utilize the technological devices, such as the Internet to carry out an instruction. In addition to tutoring children, the organizations help some victims of disasters. They may donate a sum of money to assist these people in reconstructing their houses or offer some sanctuaries for these people to take refugee.
For these kinds of nonprofit organizations, I am really zealous to devote myself. Despite no experiences in these kinds of work, I am thinking about tutoring children who are in remote areas and who have learning difficulties. Maybe I can teach them English, which is my major subject and inform them of some skills and strategies to learn English effectively and efficiently. With much passion and effort, I am willing to spend my leisure time on the meaningful works. After all, to do the charity is not merely helping others but also benefiting myself a lot.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organization is a kind of organization that morden people considered more thesedays since people have more times to relax from the exhausting week and they urned more money than before although the economic problems just damaged the whole world.
This kind of organization offers services such as tutoring children in remote area in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. I think the most important thing that the services provided by the nonprofit organization is that helping the ones they need help. No matter where they from or what kinds of help do they need, the organizations will do their best to decrease the numbers of the helpless person.
I haven't done any types of volunteer work before and I also didn't know much about the organizations although I do know that it is getting more and more popular these days and it is a organization that they do plenty of things for the people who are in need. If I have the chance to do the volunteer work, I would like to tutor the kids. Although I am not smart enough but I think if I do my best the kids will be delighted then they were before.

subject: HW0901
content:
Thanks to these nonprofit organizations, the quality of a little village. I live become better than before. I was born in the countryside and the education, transportation here were very bad. Since I have memory, there were several volunteers helping us in my town. They provided many food and donated money to build a big bridge which made villages here obtained convenient transportation. One of the volunteers, Mike, usually tutored me after school, he also played some funny games with me if I felt boring on the homework. Certainly, Mike is my idol and I want to be a man like him in the future.
I have done some voluntary works such as surving in the hospital nearby, helping clean the environment in the community and assisting elderly in the nursing home. To my suprised, the pleasure from children, patients and elderly is the most unforgettable experience. The first time I surved in the nursing home. I chatting with the elderly, sharing some funny jokes to make them feel happy. In the end, we hugged together and they said "Today is the happist day after my son abandoned me. Thank you" with tears in his eyes and either did I. To believe it or not, surving as a volunteer to help other is the happiness thing in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Not every children in this world have a good condition for living or studying like we do. Some of the children have to look for food in the garbage to survive, while others live happily in a big, convenient city. Nowadays, nonprofit organizations from all over the world started to look into this problem. They brought food and fresh water to the civilians of poor countries, built school in the place which is far away from civilization, and took care of children who had problem fitting in the society. Thousands of families were able to have a normal life as a result of these organizations' help.
Needless to say, it would be a great honor for me if I can join those organizations. Although I won't be able to help everyone in the world, I will still do my best to assist making this world a better place.

subject: HW0901
content: There are many nonprofit organizations all around the world, some of them are famous, the others are not, but all of them doing the same thing that helping people in need. The nonprofit organizations provides many important services, such as giving the homeless food and help them to find a shelter, keeping the refugee from being injuried, help the people in developing countries to make their environment and lives better. A nonprofit organization held an activity that people could not eat any things in thirty hours. This activity made people exprience the feel of hungry and realize the difficult of people from developing countries. I want to join a camp which goes to teach kids in the mountain area in the future. I think that it is important to give them a chance to learn more things. Because most of there don't have as more teachers as

subject: HW0901
content:
The organization helps a lot of people all over the world. They provides food, drinks, and some suppliments to remote areas or developing countries. They really devoted to helping others as many as they could. What they did is good to the society.
I was a train lover. I used to wander in the station taking pictures. One day, I found the station was recruiting volunteers. I was happy and I rushed to the office to tell the staff that I wanted to be a volunteer. Thus, I began to work in the station. I told the passengers which platform they should go to, helped the staff close the train doors, checked tickets, etc. Most special of all, I met a foreigner who wanted to go to Hualien, but he didn't know how to get there. At first, the staff was confused because they couldn't speak English. As last, they found me. To their relief, I translated to them where the foreigner wanted to go. Finally, the foreigner got on the train. Although doing volunteer work is not easy sometimes, I still like it very much.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there're more and more students volunteer to join a kind of group or activity that the main purpose of these organizations are to help people who are in need. Not only helping in their own country, but also other countries as we know for example, in Africa, there're so many refugees, who haven't eaten anything since they were born. However, I think the Red-Cross is one of the famous organization which is doing this kind of activities.
The Red-Cross travels all around the world, where people are in need and there they will be. Now, there're more students in Taiwan volunteer to go to remote areas to help the kids their. The students think that after they see the people who live their and help them, they cherish their lives and family much more than before. They've learned that not everyone has a wonderful or fortunate fate. We should treasure what we have now, and what we get from our parents.
However, I have never been to such activities or join the organizations before. If I have a chance to go to the remote areas, I may feel the same way as those students. Therefore, I strongly suggests that people should participate to such kind of activities, people should know that you are not the saddest person in this rapidly developed world, you should cherish your live not wasting.

subject: HW0901
content:
Today, there are a lot of nonprofit organizations in the world. They recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as protecting environment or taking care of lonely elders.
There are a various of nonprofit organizations, too. Some might help those who used to commit crimes do good things; some may call for the public not to pollute the envionment, and some could made efforts to protect their own cultures. Take me for instance, I live in a city where used to be dirty, inconvenient, and notorous. Nevertheless. A person made a nonprofit organization which the goal is to make the city clean and famous. Of course, I joined them. First, we taught all the citizens to pick up the trash on the streets and not to throw the garbage in the park. Second, we publicized the unique things in our city on TV. Consquently, our city become clean and famous.
To sum up, nonprofit organizations' goals are usually to make the world better, and I hope that I can make a nonprofit organization in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Animal shelters are starvations for those street dogs and cats. The movies which have dog-oriented expression in them often trigger a trend of raising dogs. However, after the trend passed by, these pets became homeless dogs. Animal shelters are exclusive to accomodate these pathetic animals. They not only provide lodges for animals, but also clean their fur or bodies. They taking care of them just as if these animals were their own children.
The volunteer work I have done was at Taichung Animal Shelter. At the shelter, I saw many injured dogs living in dirty place due to the city didn't provide sufficient budget for the shelter. Most people in our society do not willing to pay much attention to poor animals because they do not concern about the issue. However, I think the animal welfare does not conflicts with human welfare and that's why I would like to devote myself to helping these animals. Animals can feel pain as us, so we are oughted to treat them with humanity. Therefore, I hope that by means of the efforts making by each citizen, our society can become a more friendly place for animals.

subject: HW0901
content: These nonprofit organizations provide important services, like giving help to the stray dogs thrown out from their owner's, taking them to a safe and comfortable "heavan" they can live for a while, waiting for new owners to adopt them. Some organizations tutor the children or give the people things they need in the remote areas of Taiwan. Some tells the others the poor live and encourage them to give a hand and help those who live a hard life, while others run refugee camps in developing countries. These organizations are lending their hands to others without wanting anything back in thanks; they are the ones we should learn in nowdays. I haven't done a volunteer work like the organizations above did before, but I would like to join some of them in the future. I might be as rich as the ones that made the organizations, but I still want me to be a useful person with a true heart. I don't think that helping or lending a hand to someone whose level is lower than me is something imbarrassing; in fact, I think that we should help these smaller sounds from below, pull them up to a level and life like us, after all, they have the power to become one of us.

subject: HW0901
content: Nonprofit organizations often send clothes, money and food to developing countries. To help improve their education, they recruit volunteers to tutor children and adults in remote areas. Besides, when there is a big earthquake, this kind of organization will provide people with instant noodles and tents so that people who suffer this catastrophe will feel warm and hopeful. Also, nonprofit organizations sometimes holds sports events, such as riding bikes, to help people remain healthy. I have been a volunteer in a hospital. I was just a senior high school student and I didn't have enough professional knowledge to diagnose ill people. But I thought I learned a lot from my experiences of being a volunteer. The first day, I was in the emergancy room. In there, I helped nurses to write some papers and also saw many poor people who had car accidents. I felt pity for them and told myself to cherish what I have. During the time of volunteer, I had also helped an old lady get medicines and X-ray pictures. This was a big mission for me because the hospital was big and I needed to go to many different places in it. Finally, I finished and I felt very happy when I helped her. On the way, the old lady told me her story and kept saying "Thank you" to me. It was that moment that I understood what "Giving is better than receiving." really meant.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations, and they really do lots of work to help these people who is the weaker side in today's society. I can say it proudly, "I am one of those who work for these nonprofit organizations."
I am a freshman in the college. I chose a speacial club as my extracurricular acctivities. This club provides students to the service provided by such organizations. The service is to sent students to a junior high school in remote area far away from the city. My work is to teach these teenagers schoolworks and tell them right from wrong. After teaching these guys for almost a semester, what I want to say is that they are good-talented, all they need is the more teaching and more caring. And I am really glad that I can do them a favor.
The organization who provides the service also establishes other services, such as being a nurse in a hospital or running refugee camps in damaged area. Next time, I would try to be a nurse in a hospital. After all, as it goes "Giving is better than receiving. "

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are plenty of volunteers who devote themselves to helping those in need. The services provided by different organizations are different. Some of the services are helping the people whose house have been damaged by earthquake to settle down, the other may be teaching the starving inhabitants to grow food in the areas that lack of food. I plan to study in a medical school and be a doctor in the future. After I retire, I would like to provide free medical services in remote areas, which are usually in need of health care.
There are still a lot of people waiting for help even in such a modern time. Once we are capible of lenting them a hand, just don't hestitate.

subject: HW0901
content:
Since the industrial revolution in the 18th century, technology has been developed quickly and the capitalism has prevailed rapidly in our society. Many advantages as the process brings, it causes many negative influences. Modern people seldom concern about issues that are not lucrative to them. As a result, men and women become aloof and have no sympathy for those who need help at all.
Fortunately, there are some nonprofit organizations in our society, providing the poor or the physical challenged with necessary and proper aids. Orphan houses, senior citizens' hospitals are both important services provided by such organizations. The former adopt orphans and offer them with good care, and the latter have professional doctors and nurses who exactly know how to take care of senior citizens, not only making them feel confortable but also protecting their personal privacy and self-esteem.
I have once gone to a senior citizens' hospital to be a vulenteer when I was a high school student. During the several months, I went there every weekend. As a student, All that I have to do is push the patients' wheelchair around, listen carefully to their ideas and accompany them for the whole day. Serving in the hospital, I acquired much from communication between those old man and I. Besides, I learn the right attitude of doing tasks from the experience. Last but not least, I found the task enjoyable. I was very proud of the fulfillment, and I believe if everyone is willing to provide a few of their excessive time and money, the society can be very warm, even no worse than the heaven.

subject: HW0901
content:
According to the investigation, there are more and more poors and refugees on every dark corner of the work. Without aids, they have nothing can do but wait for hte god of dead coming to take their life gone. However, some organization founded. These give a beam of hope that support the poor face to their desting.
Tsu Gi is an organization which helps people who suffers from starving and illness all over the world. This organization was made up by nuns and everyone who is volunteer to help poors. With the donatition from every famous company, Tsu Gi used these money to construct the building from remote areas where medical is underdeveloping and the education is only for the few people. Another important service is that Tsu Gi also founded a TV station and displayed the program which could remind people "giving is more important than receiving."
To my espect, I hope one day, I can help the refugees who are sick. I must study hard now to get more knowledge of medical in order to develop the new medicine to cure the rare disease that kill the people cruelly and fatally.

subject: HW0901
content: I think the works of those nonprofit organizations are very helpful to the world, and in my point of view, every one should join this kind of works, which will make your life have more joy and meaning. In my memory, those organizations do so many different kinds of services in the whole society. First, we all can see, when a disaster suddenly occurs, like a earthquake or a flood, the organizations will soon send the people, medicine, food to those areas which the disaster happens, and they also help the residents there to rebuild their homes or encourge them go out the shadow of being wounded. And the other one I want to talk about now is the work I have the passion to do afterwards. And that is: give the children in poor condition helps-no matter they are the children have a miserable background in Taiwan or children in refugee camps of Africa. I want to use the power to help all of them. I would like to do the volunteers such as teaching math or English to the children in countries can't get a better education. And I will donate the money to the organizations which focus on the children have a poor family-such as the parents divorced or abused them-, once I know my money can help them to get a better situation, I will be very happy, because I think the children are angels of the world, and the hope of future. If they don't grow up happily but struggle in misery, it will be a gaint pity to me. I want to use the ability to support and take care of those children who truly need helps.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They do a lot of things to help people, and there are some my viewpoints being described as follows: First of all, these organizations might help people who are in need, such as homeless people, isolated old people, or people who are not availible. They often ship food to them once upon a time to make sure they are not out of food. Besides, the volunteers who join those organizations would help old people to take a bath, feed them food, and make their bed. Those seems kind of hard works to do, but they won't get any salary by doing so.
I haven't done any of volunteer work yet, but I am willing to take it if I have extra time. Volunteering to help people, I might choose to work in the library, helping people to find books, or fix the problem they are concerned about the books. Some people reffer to volunteering as a work, which is wasting time, but as a matter of fact, I consider this kind of thought is far from the truth. Helping people doesn't get no credit back, because I will get happiness from it, and it will last for a long time, compared to those job which can get paid but people spend the money right away.

subject: HW0901
content:
There're a lot of nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They usually do kinds of different activities to help the society be better. For example, the Customer's foundation always helps us notice all the goods we can buy, offering the informations that which product is reliable, and the Red Cross helps patients and wounded people in the battlefield, the area which is destoryed by disaster, and the countries which are suffered from epidemic, etc.
I've stayed in hospital several times. At that time, I saw a lot of patients lived in a misery because they couldn't do anything but call for help! What a pity it is! So many people were forgotten in a little space, and they couldn't live on their own. Although I recovered, I couldn't forget that there were so many people needed our help. From then on, I always volunteer to help those who have to "live" in hospital, and encourage them to look on the bright side so that they can live happier.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations is a group that will give a warm hand at the time you need help. They do these works not for the money, and they hope everything which they have done could help people in need; furthermore, they also want them to help others when they have opportunities and power.
When the earthquake came, their were countless of people which were homeless. They suffered from the cold weather and hunger. The organization will definetely support them with food, water, and some warm clothes. In my opinion, I think the actions they do can not change the disaester, but they do all they can do to make it better. I think just a little better is enough to feel "Their is always someone their supporting us."
I have served as the volunteer in the hospital. I'm not doing things that change the world, just to talk to the old people, chatting with them, share the happiness. It's good enough to let me think that "I'm doing something to help people."
"Giving is better than receiving. " I believe nonprofit organization can lead the country, the world, even all human beings to a world that full with apathy and love.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations to help the needs in this world. Though the volunteer can't get paid, they are willing to provide their own fortune or even talents to help others. For example, many people donate their money to help the refugees in Africa to let them can have food to eat. Furthermore, the talentive people such as doctors, teachers or dentists are willing to fly to those devoloping countries to exam the people's health or teach them to recognize the words. In these days, the devolpoed contries' people have enough wealth and have good condition of materials. However, we started to consider how to gain our things of inside not outside anymore. If we have wealth, talents and power to let the needs have better life, we should be willing to help them because all we have are the gifts given by this world. That's why all of us have responsibilities to make this world promote and have happiness. I also have this kinds of responsibility, so if this world needs me or I have chances to help this world someday, I won't say "no" at all.

subject: HW0901
content:
In a highly developed society, there are still groups of minorities waiting someone to reach out to them. In Taiwan, the best-qulified nonprofit organization is without a doubt the Tsu-Chi, most of its members are volunteered to do the charities without any payment. Their main work includes street cleaning, elderly nursing and offering financial help to desitute familes. The volunteers are often seen in the scene of a disaster, when everyone are all immersed in deep desperation, they will always beside those people in need to raise them up.
Last year, a vital earthquake hit shi-chaun Province, China, without any forecast, Tsu-Chi organization sent a big group of volunteers to Mainland China to the rebuilding work, and my family was involved to. Each member of my family is qualified Tsu-Chi volunteer. Standing at the condemned buildings, I just could believe that it was once a school. The deaths were dragged out from the blocks one after another, although we're volunteers, all we could do was accompany their relatives to see them through the most difficult moment of bereavements. We stayed in Shi-Chaun for only two weeks, but its impact from the heart-breaking scene will last a lifetime. If I have the capability to reaching out to others, I will build an organization which is similar to Tsu-Chi to help more people, even all the creatures in the world, as my return to this generation.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations, which are founded to do some charities, has become more and more popular in Taiwan. In Taiwan, the economic gap between the rich and the poor is very huge, which causes some social problems. It is said that the more ability one has, the more responsibility one takes; therefore, more and more people devoted themselves to nonprofit organizations to help those who are in need. In nonprofit organizations, there are two ways to help the poor. One way is to help those who are in need by donating money to them. The purpose of donation is to provide the poor with material need, and the poor can use the money to buy some necesities, or to see a doctor. The other way is to do some volunteer jobs for the poor. For example, some organizations will provide medical service for the poor once a month, for some poor are too poor to see a doctor, which may worse their health conditions. In addition, some teachers volunteer to teach the poor children after school, for these children do not have the money to attend cram schools to learn. For me, I have been volunteering to tutor children in an orphange for a year. My job is to teach students in the elementary school once a week. I am really happy that I have the chance to do the volunteer job, which enriches my life a lot. Whenever I do the job, I am satisfied with myself because I can help those who are in need, which makes my life meaningful.
In conclusion, if people have the ability to help other people, they should do their best to help the poor. They can devote themselves to nonprofit organizations to improve the poor's life. If people are willing to help those who are in need, the society will improve a lot.

subject: HW0901
content: Until modern times, more and more people are concern about the under priviliged. We can see some nonprofit organizations recuit volunteer help those who are in need, for example, red-cross organization, a world-famous group, hold many camps and let their volunteers play with children in remote areas, exposing these kids to different cultural stimulations. Sometimes, they have tutors help teenagers who stop their academy because they have to work to earn money. In developing countries, they want doctors as their volunteers so that they can teach residants how to keep theselves from viruses and make them understand the importance of sanitary. I have been a volunteer in hospital last summer vacation, and what I needed to do was help the physically disable to wheel in and tell them the right direction. Although it wasn't a great job, I felt happy when they showed gratitudes to me. So, if I have chances to be a volunteer in the future, I will combine what I'll learn in the university with my passion about helping others and go to different remote areas in Taiwan or developing countries. By means of that, I can know what they really need and feel empathize with those in need and solve their problems.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more non-profit organizations all over the world. They recruit volunteers to help with their work. Their main purpose is to rescue those who need immediate help.
In Taiwan, "Red Cross" is a very famous non-profit organization. It supplys many helps, such as tutoring children in remote areas, or running refugee camps in developing countries. They offer various of help to make people in the world live a better quality of life. Besides, there are still other non-profit organizations. When do they come to Taiwan to help us? Take 921 earthquake for example, countless people were killed after the big earthquake. Many rescue teams came to Taiwan trying to safe people who were graved by the collapsed buildings. The non-profit organizations asked their members do their best to rescue us. Moreover, they called on the public to donate money or materials to the area that were out of connection.
As to me, if I have the chance to volunteer the work, I would like to tutor children who never get a good education. I have the experiences of teaching students because I have a part-time job in the cram schools. So I think it's easier for me to teach them. In my opinion, giving is better than receiving, I will make any effort to help those who want to learn. Being educated is also their rights, too.
It is really open-minded for those who volunteer to help others. I hope there are more and more people have the thoughts of helping others without receiving anything back and try to help people in need, so do I.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, nonprofit organizations are often seen in places where are in need. They give their generous hands to assist helpless elder, tutor kids in remote areas, and take care of refugee affected by natural or man-made catastrophes. These organizations serve toil and hard to make the world more wonderful.
Among the services the organizations work, I'd like to tutor kids in remote areas in the coming years. Hearing plenty of stories of tutoring kids in Nantou by my sister, I am deeply motivated by the organizations' behavior and inspirt. I wish I could contribute my knowledge, specialities, kindness and passion to educate kids who receive less educational resouces than urban children. I will spend my weekends and vocations improving their overall achievement as well as cultivating appropriate character. In addition to tutoring, I will pass my enthuisiasm to people around me and invite them to participate the organizations. In this way, more and more volunteers would contribute themselves to help others and our hands will closely hand in those in need. Sooner or later, this world will be more wonderful and adorable.

subject: HW0901
content:
Giving or receiving, which one should you choose? Nonprofit organizations play the role to help making the society better. Lots of volunteers supply food for refugees in Africa and South America, also others help to prevent the drug abusing among teenagers. And there are still some doctors sailing around, and cures the peoples no matter where they anchors.
I had taken care of the elders in last summer vacation for about three weeks, and the works was listening to their words. Because almost none of them had children, so they were very lonely, and needed someone to interact with. And this summer vacation, I will go to nursing home, having some different experience.
As a medical student, the thing I want to do in the future is to innovate a new kind of staple that can live in any kind of weather zone, like Norway or India. And it is so cheap that the poor can afford it with no burden. Also, it contains lots of nutrition, so no one will be hungry or malnutrition in developing or undeveloping countries. This is the biggest hope in my life.

subject: HW0901
content: World Game will be held in Kaohsiung from July 16 to 26. Because it is a huge event, many volunteers are needed. Every kinds of volunteers has different duties. I am the volunteer who stay in the stadium and serve for the VIPs. For example, I need to make sure that only the people who have the ID of the VIP can enter the VIP room. Moreover, when those very important people have any questions, I have to help them. If I am unable to solve that problem, I have to find someone who can help as soon as possible. Besides the jobs VIP volunteers should do, there is a work that all the volunteers should do. We have to show the people from other countries how wonderful Kaohsiung is. It enable those vistors know more about Taiwan and they would like to come this place again in the future. These works seem easy, but I feel nevrous from now on. Although I am afraid that I cannot do my job well, I will try my best. I know it is a good opportunity for me to practice my ability and I believe that I will learn more that I think.

subject: HW0901
content:
Look to this day, there are many golden-hearted people in the whole world. To the best of my knowledge, one of the best known organizations now I want to disscus with you is the Tsu-Zi, which is founded by a dean, Zhong-Yan.
The volunteers in Tsu-Zi do many things as follows. First of all, they do the sweeping on the untidy roads. Second, they donates money to some orphanges so as to make orphans there eat enough food. What's more, they helps the lonely elders with their daily routines. Furthermore, not only do they gives hands to the domestic peoples, but also helps people oversea. The volunteers go abroad to teach peoples who are always in famine how to grow the agricultural plants for food. Judging from this, their deeds are so sacred that I want to be like them.
In the near future, I will develop myself to act as the international volunteers. I want to contribute something useful to the world, such acts like donating money, helping the paralyzed peoples with their daily routine, and helping the people in need, etc.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more people take attention to lower power community recently. As a result, there are increasingly nonprofit organizations founded in these years. Undoubtedly, Taiwan is no exception.
People volunteer to help lower power community such as children, disabled people and ever women. Helping others in protecting children from violence, donating money to improve the facilities about the disabled and demonstraing to gain women's right makes them feel much happier than anything.
To become one of them, I will donate some money as possible as I can afford. Although the money may be very less, I can donate every month and many years later, it will be a huge amount of money and help those who in need. Besides, I can do some job in these organizations such as the Red Cross, and so on in my free time. People said, "giving is better than receiving". Being nice to others, and it will be paid off somedays. So, what are you waiting for? Just do these great things and feel the sense of accomplishment in it.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many organizations that have provided several services. Firstly, some organizations will say that if we would like to pay the money to help students in remote areas to have lunch to eat. Secondly, they sometimes have the posters to the schools, wanting that teachers and students can help to buy their hand-made cakes during the festivals such as Father's Day and Mother's Day. Thirdly, they might gather the volunteers who want to go tutoring children in further places in Taiwan. I have done the similar experience of the tutoring. It was my high school teacher that asked us to go with him. I am glad that I was one of them. We went to the mountain to teach english to the childs there. I was surprised that they did not have any english lesson before, so we teached them from the begining of the english. For instance, some simple vocabularies such as "cat", bag".
In brief, nonprofit organizations have these important services. And we should attend more voluteer works to help people.

subject: HW0901
content: When watching TV, surfing the Net or just listening to other people, we can easily find that nonprofit organizations are everywhere. They play an important role when it comes to offering help. Their helps range from tutoring children in remote areas to taking good care of elder people. They also run refugee camps for the destitute. They appear in places that the government do not notice or refuse to give help. I once joined them in a summer vacation. In the organization, I was sent to hospital to help nurse take good care of many patients. During the two month, I saw a lot of patients of all age. I told story to some children aged four to ten, lead elderly to their destination, help nurses deal with a lot many records. I was happy there because I not only found my own worth but provided help. We everyone may receive help from others, so I think we should take every chance to help others, too. This is what I did during the rememberable summer. I won't miss another chance next summer!

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan devoted themselves to running refugee camps in Africa. They often help the poor build their own house and provide medical care to those who are really sick and have no money to see a doctor. Meanwhile, some volunteers teach residents how to grow vegetable or rice so that they can have enough food instead of starving all the time.
I have done a volunteer work in a hospital last summer vacation. Though I didn't give people service in an emergency room, I still saw many people who was terribly ill, and my heart once broken then. All I could do was guide them to the way which they wanted to go to. Sometimes, I also helped the officers send documents to doctors, sweep floors, assist the elder to use some equipments. I have learned a lot in this volunteer work, and I would like to do it in the future. After all, giving is better than receiving.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations, or NPO, play a vital part in those in need by supporting money and menpower. They help people in several ways. They always help old people or childs lacking love and care. Moreover, sometimes they support the underprivilege and offer medical help to remote areas in Taiwan and developing countries. Also they will emerge while destructive disasters strike such as 921 earthquake.
In my opinion, I would like to provide medical help as a volunteer since I'm determined to become a doctor. Even though I can't become a doctor in the future, I'll spare no effort to offer a medical help. Should I became a doctor, I'll be too glad to help others by using my professional knowlege and skills. By the way, I have done this in a hospital and not until then did I know that giving will make you happier than receiving. With my determination, I must improve the lifestye of those in need just like other NPO.

subject: HW0901
content:
By virtue of the developing of nonprofit organizations, more and more people are able to give those people in need a hand. Some nonprofit organizations encourage people to donate the items they seldom or never use to the countries in need, while another is holding an activity called "no food for thirty hours" to experience the starving feelings that is torturing the Africans. Some organizations even lead people to countries that is lack of food, clothes and medical surplies and countries that is involving in wars.
I have joined an activity held by one of the nonprofit organizations before. We helped the disabled clean their houses and stores. I feels glad that I have the ability to help others. I would like to join the "no food for thirty hours" in the future because giving can satisfy me easily. Helping others usually makes me feel more pleasant than receiving from others. According to a old saying, "giving is better than receiving. " Don't you agree?

subject: HW0901
content: When it comes to nonprofit organizations, Amnesty is the first group that flashes into my mind. There are many volunteers from various countries and what they want is to create a peaceful world. I read a special report about the Amnesty, and it is about that a German Woman quit a high-salary job and contribute to help people. Her name is Nina and she went to South Africa for three years. What she did is help refugee or poor people to have a better life. Amnesty is a famous humanitarian group. For example, it advocates that all governments should abolish the death penalty because no one has the right to threaten and kill someone else. In my opinion, I would like to be a volunteer in these organizations. If I have a chance to be a volunteer, I am willing to help the people who need. It's a meaningful job for me. Actually, I turtored children in remote areas in Taiwan when I was twenty. By teaching them, I felt happy and obligated to help them in the future. As the saying goes, giving is better than receiving. And the sentence is the motto that I am determined to live on in my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Through TV, newspaper and broadcast, it can be easily noticed that there are many services offered by nonprofit organizations around the world. In my opinion, two important services are humanitarian aid and to instruct people in the developing countries.
First, humanitarian aid support the poor's lives. Everyone knows that in a number of countries in Africa, their people are starving and suffering diseases; therefore, the organizations give the slump food and medicine. Besides, the children in the developing countries are usually not educated and even civilized. They are taught to acquire more skills to make their future lives better. Although I have heard of these marvelous deeds done by the organization, I have not had a chance to a piece of volunteer work. However, I believe I will do this in the future. Since I know I am not that great to teach children in developing countries, I believe I will teach Taiwanese children in marginal areas. Plenty of children do not recieve good education in their places so I want to raise their compotence by turtoring them. I believe there is nothing more important than it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, with the thoughts of peace and love continuously spread around the world. The voice of the needed are gradualy being heard. And that's how nonprofit organizations such as the Red Cross and the World's View became known.
Nonprofit organizations work on various service for the needed. Take teaching children in remote area for an example, due to the unconvenient transportation, the children living in the remote area could only share limited resource of education. With the help of the organizations, they can now receive equal resource as children living in the city.
For another example, endless wars in developing countries not only led to enourmous amount of refugees, but destruction of unexceptable facilities of the local people as well. With the help of the organizations, the running of the refugee camp and the rebuild work of the facilities has become much easier. Although I don't have any experience of being a volunteer, I've always wanted to be one. As to the most desirable work, I would like to convey the sources transported to the refugee camps in order to ensure the safety of the sources. Though it's going to be very dangerous, while thinking of the needed, it will be nothing.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. As far as I know, AIESFC is one of this kind of organization, and its members are around the world. What they do is teach some children English, runing English camps. Although what they do may not be very big for the whole human kind, but as a student organization, they use their tiny power to build a better world. I don't think it is a bad idea for a good beginning.
In my opinion, to be a volunteer who works for a plan to profit all human kind is too bold for me to achieve. However, I'm willing to do what might not help so many people but just the people we know. Our life could not be peace until all the countries in this world stops war. Saving all war-wrecked people is a burden responsibility to non-profit organization. They should try another way to persuade government to stop the war or something. I'd like to become this kind of volunteer. However, it couldn't be if the volunteers haven't been trained. Therefore, it's neccesary to build an non-profit organization to train them.

subject: HW0901
content: There are more and more people taking part in volunteer work nowadays. As we know that volunteer work in quite meaningful. These people join in some nonprofit organizations, and these organizations offer lots of services to those in need. Such services as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, taking care of some old people who don't have any person to depend on, and so forth. Tutoring children in remote areas is important, because it can improve the education degrees of children in remote areas. On the other hand, it diminishs the education distance between cities and outskirts. Taking care of the old is important as well. Besides letting the old live conveniently, we can accompany with them so that they won't feel lonely. I have done volunteer work once. The experience impressed me a lot. To learn how to help people, I did some volunteer work in the hospital in a summer vacation five years ago. After the work finished, I learned "Giving is much meaningful than receiving".
