In my life, this experience is a important class. Never would I got it from school life.

subject: HW0901
content:
People often say that "giving is more than receiving. " More and more people believe in it and devote themselves into nonprofit organizations. They practice the belief by participating voluteers to help those in need.
There are aboundant nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. Some of them are from varieties of religions, Buddhists or Christian for instance. Some of them are founded for the aim of protecting enviroments or wild animals, such as Green Party. No matter what their resource is, these groups are trying to lead human beings into a better life by heart. Just take the most well-organized nonprofit organizations-Zhi-Chi for example. It is based on Buddhism. It owns a great amount of volunteers who spread around the world. These volunteers always appear immediately in severe accidents, such as a horrible earquakes or a heart-broken plane crash. These volunteers are called "blue angles" because they wear blue shirts when they stand out.
On 21st September, 1999, there was a terrible earthquake hit in the central of Taiwan. Countless houses collaped right after that deadly accident. Over two thousand souls were summoned by death. Volunteers of Zhi-Chi gave their hands to those who lost their beloves. These blue angles cooked and settled people down for those who lost their houses. As for those who lost their beloved ones, these blue angles gave them big hugs and mental supports.
I am eager to participate this nonprofit group--Zhi-Chi. I am willing to contribute my power to make the world better. Although I am not really good at cooking, honestly speaking. With a kind and warm heart, I am convinced that I will be an angle in the future for sure.

subject: HW0901
content:
A proverb says, "Helping others is the source of happiness. " I'm very glad to notice that there are a lot of people in Taiwan will help children in remote areas or running refugee camps in developing countries.
It goes without saying that Taiwan's people received the help from other countries before. Till now, Taiwan is richer than before, so I am happy to see our people can help other people. Some people help teach the children in remot areas because the resources of these areas are not enough comparing to urban areas. Some medical personnel volunteer to developing countries to help them running refugee camps. These people take the risks of infection, so in my opinion, they are very great people.
It is a pity that I didn't take part in any kind of these organizations before because of my work. I was a military person before so I don't have much time to help others. But now I have retired several year ago, I can help others in the future.
In a word, I'm happy to know there are so many people would like to help others. And I would like to teach children in remote areas in Taiwan and I will donate some money to these organizations. Actually, I have donated some money in recent years, and I think I will do it all my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the whole world is considered as a global villiage. That is to say, we can travel easily around the world, and provide services to those people or countries in need. Luckily, there are still many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with this work. Take the news channel, TVBS, for a good example. They always recruit volunteers, such as college students, to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan, especially for those aboriginal students. Due to their kindness, those kids who lack of proper educational sources can enjoy their studies much more.
As far as I am concerned, I have been an volunteer to an orphange once. I joined a non-profit clubs at school, and we visit those children in the orphange once in a month. Every time we visit there, we will perform lots of entertaining shows for them. Whenever we saw their big smiles wearing on their faces, it will be the greatest happiness in the world.
It's thankful that there are still many other people contribute themselves to help those people in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is true that there are many rich people in the world nowadays. However, there are still a majority of people suffering from hunger and cold in each corner of the world.
There are some nonprofit organizations established to help solve this problem. Like sunshine and water are to a tree, so are these organizations to the poor. Without them, the poor may not have enough food to eat. Besides, the children of the poor won't have a chance to attend school, even won't have access to keep inform of the world. If educated, they will become someone great. Thus, we should not ignore or abandon them.
I have been to a hospital to help deal with little things. When comforting the patients, the would return you a warm smile. With the smile, I felt full of energy again and eagered to help more people. A saying goes "Helping others is the source of happiness. " It really makes sense!
This experience has engraved on the bottom of my mind, and I would like to help as many people as I can in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They play an important role in our society. They also reach out their hands to some developing countries, such as countries in Southeast Asia and Africa. For me, I had done volunteer work several times in Taiwan.
The nonprofit organizations in Taiwan provide some important services in Taiwan and some foreign countries. They help those who live in the tribes in the mountain. They send teachers to tutor those children and give them books and DVDs such as some English novels. Also, they help them on their daily life. In some developing countries, they provide them some help on their education and health problems. They send teachers and doctors to those countries.
I had done volunteer work several times. When I was a freshman in senior high school, I went to some remote ares, such as those tribes in mountain to help those poor children on their studies. I tought them math, English and played with them. Additionally, I went to Taichung Hospital to be a volunteer when I was 17 years old. I helped old people write their basic information and say their symptoms to the doctors. In my opinion, I think nonprofit organizations are very important and people can't live without them. Consequently, I am willing to be the volunteers to support these organizations.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowdays, Taiwan is facing a hard time, the whole society is becoming "M society", which means the rich becomes richer, and the poor gets poorer. That why we often hear the news which states that there are many students in remote area can not afford their lunch fee. It might be unbelievable for you and I, but it does really happen in Taiwan. Unfortunately, there are much more unfortunete stories in Taiwan. Fortunately, there are many non-profit organizations to help people who are in need. For example, the aborigines, who live in remote area, are lack of education resources, so the non-profit organizations would go to the mountains to teach them Chinese, math and even computer. Besides, aborigines are also lack of medical resources, so the doctors in the non-profit organization would go there to cure them for free, and make them to have good habits of hygine. Taiwan is becoming a development country, the percent of elders is growing up, the elders would definitely become a problem. They may live alone, no one cares about them. So in the future, I would like to devote myself to take care of those elders who are alone, or who need one to talk to. If there's any elders who feels happy or lead a live because of me, I would feel relived and it would encourage me to help more elders.

subject: HW0901
content:
Today, more and more charities are founded and launch on their expective projects to aid those who are in need. Mostly nonprofit and supported by their own volunteers, these organization, though play an gigatic role in today's world.
These organizations provide financial assistance to students coming from poor family, reach out to people suffered from special diseases, or devote to protecting stray dogs, etc. Some of them even have their helping hand across the sea to save the poor in developing countries. When there are disaters occuring in the world, they also help a lot.
To me, though I don't have this kind of experience. I'm still willing to do so one day. I would like to dedicate myself to tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or even in the world. I hope I'm brave.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this profit-oriented society, nonprofit organizations are getting more and more indispensable. Because all governments in the world are busy with making more money, and neglect those who are in urgent need. Hence, these nonprofit organizations embark on helping children who are too poor to have normal schooling, and people who are homeless on account of natural disasters. What they do most is assigning teachers for children and sending foods and clothes to the poor.
Although I am now a senior high student, I have done some volunteer work before. I have gone to street to encourage people to donate some money in their pockets to help people who are in need. In addition, I have been to an orphanage to take care of the children. To my surprise, those children were so innocent and optimistic and they worked so hard on their job. Young as I am, I hope one day I can participate in nonprofit organizations. Because I think we, who have a good life, should share this happiness to those who don't. After all, when we give, we also get something.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the world news are always about economic problems. Everyone is worried about that we have to cut down on the expenses on movies, clothes or jewelry, right? But, look carefully into the people living in the third world. It is everyone's responsibility to help them for god created us equally, and they should share the same benefits, too. The Red Cross Organization and the Charity have done a great job. They work nonprofitly and the most important, happily. They use their leisure time to volunteer to help those people in the third world. The refugees, same as us, are people alive standing in front of us, except that we are healthy and they are ill; we are perfect, they might loose a part of body in wars. We are all human beings, so they should be treated equally and we should do our best to help them.
I have attended in many speeches, and most of them are about giving love and sympathy to those refugees. I've alway been touched by the sene. How terrified! How unbelievable! Therefore, in the future, after I retired, devoting myself into charity is a promise with myself. At that time, I have the time, money and ability to give them a hand. I want to travel around the world and publish a book about it, that way, everyone can realize that even a little bit of their help can cause a butterfly effect.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the global village, the world has changed a lot. However, the problems which result from the previledge and the poverty still exist. Nowadays, we have nonprofit organizations to solve the issue. The importance of the services provided by such organizations are as following.
To begin with, it makes us have a closer connection with others. Because we can help the needy by joining this kind of organizations. Then, we will know each others easily. Moreover, it is convenient for the public to help others. Because we can just offer the money or time to the organizations and it is convenient for us to help the needy. Last but not least, it builds a peaceful world by providing such services. By joining the activities, we will learn how to share with others and how to deal with people. Therefore, we will have less chances to argue with people. As to me, I have done a lot volunteer works. I often keep the elder company in the nursing houses. In my opinion, it is another way of learning. We will again a lot from it. To sum up, it is important for us to create more opportunities to join the activities, and we will make our lives more colorful.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are various kinds of nonprofit organizations in the world, and the ways that they help needy people are different, too. Though the nonprofit organizations may use different forms to do their works, their main idea is the same. All of them is trying to help the people who are in need and make the world become better. Some of the most familiar events which the nonprofit organizations do are that they take care of old people, especially those who live by themselves, help poor people, and tutor children who live in rural or remote areas.
In my own experience, I had ever done some volunteer works before. When I was still in my senior high school days, I had ever been to a fundation which keeps and takes care of plant patiences. I helped them to clean the environment, including the patiences rooms. I also went on the street with my friends to ask for the pay checks from the passers-by for the fundation. In the future, I think I will still go back to the fundation to be a volunteer when I have the opportunity to do that. I will also try to do some other different kinds of volunteer works like tutoring children in remote areas, for I can help other people and make my life become more meaningful at the same time.

subject: HW0901
content:
Those nonprofit organizations play an indispensable role in stablizing the society. When food shortage or flood strikes some courtries, those organizations will reach out to the residents there. They can sent food into the area stuck in such guanday. Those nonprofit organizations serve as a platform for the affect to donate their money. The organizations will definitely make the most of the money.
I have done different volunteer work before, but what impressed me the most was the experience of taking care of victims suffered from severe brain damage. Not able to speak or move, the patients need a large amount of intensive care. After knowing the stories behind the victims, I was very upset. Some of them were successful businessman, and some of them were even teenagers. And the brain damage really ruined their future. They just can do, merely, breathing on their own. I do more volunteer work after the experience, because I know that many helpless people still wait for my assistance.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the 21th century, humanity is not a noun, but also a positive spirit in the society. More and more people devote themselves to those who needs help.
These activities can be many types. As far as I know, some medical organizations gather volunteered doctors and nurse to remote areas and help the residents to fight against disease. Some nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers and go to nondeveloped country the teach the people how to farm in barren plant. Also, some people try to save and help the whole world, they go to the beach to collect trash and advocated people not to litter.
As talking about these people with kind heart. It make me remind the experience of being a volunteer in the hospital. Last summer I worked as a volunteer in a hospital, my job was to give directions to patients, delivered documents and measured the patients' blood pressure. During the days, I always kept good mood because it is my pleasure to help others. "Humanity" can't be overemphasize during 21th century, more and more people should join these activities, and I believe they may all have a good experience after help others.

subject: HW0901
content:
As that more nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers every year, many people is enthusiastic about devote themselves to help others through many ways. One of the important step is that they can join this kind of organzation because it could provide many services and informations. For example, they could develope their abilities in doing volunteer work. In spite that the work is done without any payment, sometimes it still needed unique skills. Also, if people want to obtain the work they long for, they should pay more attention to the work information unless they lose any opportunity. These organizations, actually, not only do the charity for others, but build a road between voluteers and the poor people.
Most people are following the volunteer work, and I am not excluded. Take my experience for example, tracing back to my memory, I remember clearly that I refused strongly as my friend invited me to teach the children after school. At first, I was not willing to be the volunteer at all. It happened only because of accident. However, what's beyond my imagination was that I learned so much from that experience, such as being patient. From then on, I enjoy to be volunteer in many respects. And I have a desire for volunteer abroad in summer vacation someday. Being a volunteer is not only for doing charity; however, it also makes our lives colorful. By knowing that someone live harder than we do, we may be more content with our life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. So that nonprofit organizations are becoming more and more important. In Taiwan, there is a nonprofit organization that always claims the bad effect by smoking. They help people to stop smoking and the quality of the air is getting more and more clean. The person who sucessfully stop smoking is also getting more and more healthy. All the benefits being make are by the nonprofit organization. There is also another organization that send volunteers to take care of the elder who live alone. They make foods for the elder and give the elder medical supports. A society with many kinds of nonprofit organizations will better than ever.
In my college life, I have been being volunteer that help the elder recycle old books in order to earn some money by selling the old books. Because of the hand disable, the elder can't take heavy things even lower than one kilo. To prevent them from hurt, my school choose some strong young man to help these elders. We help elders to collect old books and tie the books tight. After that, we put the books on the cart and pull the cart to recycling center. On the way to center, elders say thank to us and accomplish our behavior. I still remember the smile on the elders faces. I wish I can help more people in the future, however, more power I have, more responsibilities I need to face.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the volunteers in nonprofit organizations tutor the children and take good care of the elderly in remote areas in Taiwan. Besides, they run some charities and send some supplies to developing countries. For example, they will send foods, clothes and useful tools to Africa.
Firstly, the organizations will reach out to poor people and the disables. They give some classes to further their education and teach them skills. For instence, they will teach them how to bake cookies and make a cake so that they can depend on themselves after finishing the courses.
Secondly, not only do they help these misforture people but they give a helping hand to improve our environment. Sometimes, they will hold activities to clean up the environment, such as cleaning the beach and collecting the garbages in the moutains.
I often volunteer to support the elderly to cross the road and push the wheelchairs for them in the hospital on weekends. By so doing, everyone can make the world better just as I do.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide some important services, and I think that tutoring children in remote area in Taiwan is the most meaningful service. In Taiwan, there are no balances between rich and poor, especially between cities and countries. In addition, the government can't really take care of everyone. Therefore, children in remote area don't have enough sources to support their daily lives and education. As I know, nonprofit organizations provide the service for a long time, but they still don't have enough volunteers. Some people are not willing to be volunteers because of no pay. They think they have to spend time to tutor children in remote area, but they don't get anything from that. They think it is not worth.
However, I have the other thought, and I love to be a volunteer. I had been a library volunteer. As a library volunteer, I had much work to do, such as answering people's question, and putting the books to the right places. Sometimes I had to stand for four hours, and I still felt happy. I think being a volunteer should keep passions. If I lost my passions at that time, I will have been bored to be a volunteer. I have looked for the information about being a volunteer. I think when I am a volunteer and I can solve others' problems. I think it is my pressure. Therefore, I am willing to provide what I learn to others for free. Moreover, I will encourage my friends to be volunteers. Being volunteers is a happy thing and good for the society.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have helped lots of people who are in need in our world. For instance, volunteers in the organization will help take care of children who don't get enough care from their parents; the volunteers also ask for donation to those who are poor in Taiwan or in developing countries. If there were earthquake or typhoon, volunteers in nonprofit organization must go to the place where was damaged by the disaster to save people who were hurt, and help clean the environment, rebuilding the houses for them.
As to me, I have been an one-day volunteer of a nonprofit organization to ask for donation for people whose brains were hurt so they can't move and even don't have the caution. I like this voluteer work very much, and I hope that if there is a chance next time, I can get the same volunteer work and give hands to those who are waiting for help.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan and the number of them booms recently. I think it is the consequence of the well-developed economy, so people start to chase for spiritual happiness instead of material joy. Such organization do a lot of things. They may go to the mountains to teach aborigines and improve the hygiene knowledge of people. Besides, some may visit the lonely elders or donate money to orphanage and charity organizations. Some nonprofit organization with medical background may dispatch their doctors to see the poors for free. I even saw a organization which help some poor area to build bridge and roads even houses. Moreover, some nonprofit organization may help contury stricken by catostrophes such as earthquakes or typhoon. I remeber many nonprofit organizations came to Taiwan in 921 earthquake. Such behaviors impressed me a lot.
I don't have many volunteer experience in senior high. I only did some volunteer work in hospital. However, when I got admitted to college, I have done a lot such work. Recently we held a activity in winter vacation for elementary students in a remote area. We have prepare a lot for it and we were trained very hard. We spent lot of time in designing the games which they may like. Although the preparation was painstaking, it pays when you see their joyful face. In the summer vacation, I prepare to take part in a activity which will go to some poor contury to take care of some elders and accompany them. I think I can elevate my heart and gain lots of joy that money can't buy. I think I will participate in more volunteer activity in my college life, because I think they are very meaningful. Besides, as a student of medicine college now, I want to go to the far-reached country to see patients for free when I become a doctor. I even want to go to some poor country in Africal or South America to do this kind of work. I hope I can still have passion for it in my whole life. I am deeply convinced that the joy of materials is limited, but the happiness from spiritual activities such as volunteer work is infinite.

subject: HW0901
content: There are many nonprofit organizations in the world. Here to remind us that there are someone to go to when we need help. For example, millions of poor families or children under violence are saved each year by such organizations. I would like to join the community services before I try volunteering for an advol organization later in life. This way, I could gain experience and know my neighbors well before I know the world. If I joined the community service, I could learn how to treat co-works, thus gain experience as to how to command or be commanded. For example, the sweeping of floors on every floor I could also give advices to neighbors. I would also know them as I devote myself to such works and learn to appreciate things. For instance, knowing how tiring was it for someone to clean the floors. I would take care to keep it clean for them. To sum up, I believe entering services to serve others would definitely help me a lot in future. I would use the same experience as a volunteer in future.

subject: HW0901
content: The world is unfair, some children have no problem to choose what to eat every day and they can go to the first class school to study, but some have to share a bowl of rice with family in days and do part time job instead of going to school everyday to support the whole family. Due to it, some people come together and make an organization to help these poor family. They send them foods and daily necessities, help their parents find the jobs, and have tutors to help the children with their study. I was so impressed when I heard what they did, and I decided to follow their steps at that moment. Now, I teach elementary school students after school time for extra practice and paid for nothing. I love my job, and I'll carry on in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more people, joining the nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. So, want are these organizations doing? They do services like teaching the poor children to learn how to read and write. Helping the poor countries to develop their medical systems and giving their people free medical diaganozes.
International organizations like the red cross organization sends a lot of volunteers to the countries who need help. The volunteers bring foods and teach the children how to read & write their language and even teach them how to speak English.
Helping the poor countries to develop their medical system is very importent, the countries should having the ability to save their people by themselves. Or if wars happened, there will be many victoms.
I would like to attend an international volunteer work to north of Tailand. My school hold this activity every year and lots of students attend this activity-sending loves to north of Tailand. These volunteers teach the students there Chinese, English, math and history of the students' country. This is a great chance to meet new friends and experient how to teach foreign children!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more problems are around the world. Though there are governments to solve some of them, they still couldn't take care of every part of the world. So, nonprofit organizations play an very important role in our life.
Those organizations recruit volunteers to help them deal with issues. For example, after a serious disaster, they help dilivering food to the area that has been damaged, while others are raising money for them.
There are nonprofit organizations not only in Taiwan, but also in other countries. Some of them even provide survices to every part of the earth. Because of the huge amount of people who are in need for help, volunteers are needed to decrease the difficulties.
The volunteer work that I have done was helping in libraries. It may not be a big deal, but things like volunteering should be started from small places. I took this work as a training, so that this experience will help me someday when I'm participate in a larger organization.
In the future, I would like to volunteer in an international nonprofit organization, it may widen my knowledge and gives me opportunities to see what does this world look like. I'm looking foward to it!

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations play an important role in our life--maybe not in ours, but in those people in developing countries. Providing supplies such as food and clothes, for example, is one of the service that these organizations provided. They may also hold some charity activities, like charity concert, to pursuade and encourage people live in develope donating their money--of course the surplus money--to help those people in need. So important are those volunteers who work in the organization to help the people who can't live in a good life, I consider it's a important mission in our life to take part in a volunteer work. Consider that I'm still a student and don't have enough time to work on a program such as running refugee camps in developing countries, I chose to join other kind of volunteer work--I've join a program called "Clean Up the World". With the action of picking up the garbage, we can not only make our surrounding cleaner but also protect our enviorment. And to the future, I hope that I can join the organization, such as Red Cross to help those people in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. In this essay, I'll state what these organizations contribute to this society.
In my opinion, the major goal of such organizations is to help the needy. In my country, there's a typical one which I named it "Mercy". Every time there is a disaster happened like flood, earthquake, serious landslide and so on, the volunteers of Mercy are always there. They help people to take refuge at safe places and rebuild the poors' home. The most important is, everything they do is free. Weren't they angels? Due to I'm still a junior high school student, I only have limited power. Therefore, I take apart to help the disabilities at my school. My routine is to help them go up and down stairs. I believe if I try my best to help others all the time I am able to gain experiences to do something good for others.

subject: HW0901
content:
So far as I'm concerned, some people possess some special skill can find organizations to offer free survices to people in needed for free, such as teachers teach students left behind or doctors, dentists or even other medicine worker make up a small medical team to help ill ones in poverty.
Besides, other people may just provide their time to organizations concerning for elderly citzens who live poor and almost without any concern of others. They may help the work to deliver meals from center kitchens to where the old people live, or spare time to phone with old ladies and find if they have difficulties to conduct ther daliy work and give help. For a healthy and young people, the activites mentioned above won't take too much time, and effert from them, but can give the elders a great feel of warm by concerning actions and words.
I used to be one of the member of an organization that concern the lonely elders. During that time, I helped part of preparing meals for elders and did some conversation with several upset old people and even participate one old lady to see a doctor to find a chance to live better. I can get a great feeling when I learned I made people's life better.
It is for sure that I will be a dentist in the coming future. Therefore, I plan to attened one of the organizations to provid my time and skill and knowledge. Such as teaching childern how to clean their teeth in right way and teaching in public to maintain healthy oral condition. Morover, I'd love to combin people with differen learning in medicine and make up a "small mobile clinic" to provide our survice in remote area for fee at times in the future.
To see the sorrow appearance turn to a smile is worth working as a volunteer.

subject: HW0901
content: As I know, such as Red Cross Organization, they will help poor children find their finanial supporters, or even some organizations like this will improve the sanitary of the W.C. Wow! So cool! I know, I am not a person who alway like to speak, so I always go to hospital to help the patients. I have helped a sentimental youth surffering from AIDS get through his bitter life. he got this disease once he was born. Although I am not a person who is talktive. But, when I saw patients suffering from agony, I couldn't help to encourage them. What I have to do is keeping encouraging them, let them feel that they are all playing important roles in the world, and every day they live must be colorful. Undoubtly, there is no "give up" in my dictionary, so I don't allow some patients "try to" give up their lives. As result, I prepare some delicacy for the person who was going to die, let them know I share my good things with them; let them know I look them as my best friend, let them feel how wonderful this wonderland they have been to.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the past decade years, there are more and more nonprofit organizations built for variety of issues. Some of them concern the environment protecting issues, while the others pay attention on helping people. The later would recuit volunteers to provide all kinds of services to help people from suffer getting better life. I will discuss some important services in the following paragraphes.
The most important and famous service should be helping people sufferd disasters in the world. Take the major earthquake happened in Manland China last year as an example, several nonprofit organizations sent their volunteers with support materials (food, refugee camps, medicine etc.)to the area, helped refugees keep living and mental support.
There is another service to help children who cannot get education.

subject: HW0901
content: As the technology becomes more and more convenient, transportation, education, and economic have really come a long way. Nevertheless, some remote area or slow-developing countries are not able to catch on the improvement. Nowadays, nonprofit organizations provide help to those in need, such as building school or learning centers in remote areas, found-raising to help the needy, or even provide help to families, as well the elderly. This reminds me of my experience of working at a winter camp. The camp was set up for children, whose parents are unable to take care of them while their work during winter vacations. I felt really great after I saw the excitement on their faces, like they had never got to do so many interesting activities like these (because they were often being alone at home without anyone looks after them). I really learned a lot after I volunteered for the camp.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many people put themselves in helping those in need, and they even form nonprofit organizations to improve their works for aids. The nonprofit organizations have various works such as donating clothes to developing countries, serving medical aids towards developing countries or the disorders in their own countries, and helping developing countries' children to have a profit education to raise themselves or even their families, etc.
I have done the volunteer works once when I was in the junior high. All of our classmates went to the charity so as for celebrating the Christmas with orphans; upon the time, we gave those children gifts made by ourselves as well as prepared a lot of performances to please them in order to make them somewhat much more optimistic in the great holiday. After the celebration, I felt a sense of relief and satisfication. It is great to know that even if I am a student, I can certainly help those need a helping hand. In consequent of the thought, I regularly donate parts of my pocket money to nonprofit organizations. While there is a chance, I will participate in the work without second thoughts. It is not that difficult for us to land a helping hand to the poor. That is, we can donate maybe a little money to nonprofit organizations, or we may take a short time talk with the longly old and orphans. There are various works can reach only one purpose, helping those in need, as what I said, I will keep doing the volunteer works as much as I can in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
The most important things that nonprofit organizations have always done is to help people with grassroots backgrounds. They have done numerous helpful action, for example at the top of the list, they might tutor children from elementary school to junior high at night to improve their school grades. Parents with this kind of children often need to work all day long. Helps by the organizations make them much more easier to solve the problem of taking care of their kids.
Also, playing drama shows for children living in remote areas in Taiwan is another things they have done. Children can enjoy recreational activity without going to Taipei or paying a lot of fee. This definetly let them explore an entirely new world.
In addition, the volunteer work I have done is being a Chinese teacher in Thailand last year. I serviced at the North part of Thailand. As a volunteer, I taught them how to use Chinese in a right way. Having the ability to speak Chinese, it could be easier for them to find a better job in the future.
Finally, I would like to be an international volunteer again, maybe visiting Africa. People there live in a poor environment condition, that's why I want to be there to do somethings for them.

subject: HW0901
content:
At present, there are a great number of nonprofit cooperation groups who welcome volunteers to provide assistance for their work, such as toturing children in distant areas in Taiwan or running refugee camps in developing countries.
To begin with, there is a well-knowed and domestic organization, which was built up by the majority of buddists in Taiwan. At the first stage, it was only set up one place in the eastern part of Taiwan. They offer a wide range of nonprofit behaviours to whomever needs help. In Taiwan, people can find a lot of their good performances such as providing instant kindness and goods for people who may suffer from a severe tragic after a unpredictably natural damage like earthquake, or typhoon, or providing great love and care to people who are under low economic status, and have no income to raise their young kids. Moreover, they also do as many as their efforts to those whom are not Taiwaness. For example, there was a tough earthquake which happened in China around one year ago. As soon as they received this bad news, lots of people volunteer to sacrifice themselves to offer their help and be willing to fly to the tragical place to give immediate help despite they may be off their work for a long time. Owing to their good behaviors, more and more people are eager to participating in this organization. There are lots of their branches set in almost everywhere in Taiwan.
I used to be a volunteer in hospital. During the activity, I learned how to treasure my life and my family. I found that lots of patients who were eager to live longer in this beautiful world, but they suffered from a serious illness, therefore they could do whatever they wanted to achieve during their life. In the future, if time allowed, I would like to join some activities held by Crossred who provide their help in developing countries. That may help me broaden my horrizon, and learn how to give, how to live with a more positive attitude. Having a sense of content is very important.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations founded in Taiwan nowadays. The main purpose of these organizations is to help people in need, such as the poor children in remote areas, the homeless and seniors who can't take care of themselves.
In order to help, these nonprofit organizations provide all kinds of services. Take tutoring children for example, volunors go in to mountains or forests to teach the children who are far from school or have no money to go to school. Children in remote areas often have difficulties in learning, not because of they don't have the desire to learn, but because of the financial problems. Even schools in these areas have trouble having good teacher and equiptments. That's why we need the volunteers who have patience and are passionate to teach, and provide kids computers and all the latest knowledge.
This is the most important service in my point of view, and is also the work I want to do in the future. Because once these children have learned all the knowledge, they sure will long to know more. After they grow up, they can come back and help not only the kids but also the whole village. Maybe it is just a dream, but how do you know the result if you never try?

subject: HW0901
content: In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations offering services to disadvantaged people. For example, the church might donate the money to refugees or orphans. In Taichung, I know there is a church called Banner Church offering tutors for children whose family has difficulties paying for this. The teachers are volunteering themselves to teach the children. This activity is called "Breeze" which means the children can feel that they are beloved by God and feel the safy and warm like they are in the breeze. The volunteer teachers not only teach school subjects but also build the characters. Many children have difficulties sharing their feelings at the beginning because they don't believe there are people actually cares about them. The children even try to protect themselves by bollying other children. However, the teachers never gives them up, and keep telling the children they are beloved by God. I myself am not a Christian, but one friend of mine asked me to teach the children English. Therefore, every Sunday last summer vacation, I carry lots of flash cards, sticky balls, and some other teaching materials to the church to teach. At the beginning, I don't like this volunteering work at all. I do this just because I am capable of doing this. However, after a few weeks, the kids start to wave me hello when I step in the classroom. I started to know that earning money is not the reason I teach. it's the growing of students that counts. At the end of last summer, I finally realized I am no the one who gives, but the one who takes.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many nonprofit organizations have settled to help people, such as World Vision, Tsu-Zi and red cross. They are focusing on different kinds of serves. For example, the World Vision is helping the young children to keep alive and be educated. On the other hand, Tsu-Zi helps the poor people to rebuild their life by food, living and education. The services that they provided do help many people, and of course they need volunteers to help with their work.
I am one of the volunteers in World Vision. I have translated many letters from Africa children to their sponsers. The descriptions in the letters are very similar and simple, mostly about how their supports are useful. They thank about the gift so that they can buy the goat, food and the educations. It is very glad to see how people get others' help and improve their life.
In the future, I am planning to be the volunteers of the other nonprofit organization, Tsu-Zi, to help the poor people with my mother. I think people shold help others if they are available. It will be better to provide than to accept things and help. You will have good friends there.

subject: HW0901
content:
This is a real world, and usually reality is cruel. Somehow, we can make it different by doing something small but important. Some organizations hold activities which help the people in need. For example, they recruit volunteers to help them tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan or run refugee camps in developing countries. All of these events are done not for money sake but for the hopes which is trying to make the world better.
These organizations devote themselves to help the needy persons. They raise money for sick children and the fundations. They take care of the elderly who are helpless or poor.
If I got a chance, I want to tutor children in remote ares in Taiwan. Kids are our hopes and they should be taught well no matter where they live. But, this is a reality that some kids are not well-educated because of the environment where they live. Therefore, I would like to be their tutor and help them find out their ways of life and their hopes for the future.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, we can see a lot of people who need help on the newspaper. For example, some family is poor and don't have enough money to raise family members. There are lots of people became homeless in the world not only because their countries are unprosperity, but also because they experienced wars. As you can see, that is why nonprofit organizations become more and more important. There are some important services that these organizations provide us. First, they provide not only food and water, but good service and good care to the refugee, they make them feel warm. Second, they will send volunteers to the place and help people who are in their difficulties. Third, they always take good concern to old men who are lonely and help them deal with their life. Last but not least, when there is an emergency, such as earthquack, they will help to find the survivors and give them what they need. To make a conclution, they help everything if it is possible for them to do. Actually, I didn't really have this kind of experience before, but I have been a one-day volunteer in nursing home. I took care of old people and talked with them so they weren't feel alone. I helped them carry things and made them feel happy. I can remember that it was the happiest day I have ever had. Since helping people makes me feel happy, I want to volunteer more in the future. I would like to fly to other countries and help the people who are in difficulties and visit the poor family. In my opinion, volunteering is really a fantastic work for me to enrich my life and make my life more colorful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Lots of people around the world suffer from starvation due to the lack of money. It results in the great distance between the poor and the rich. So we should spare no effort helping the poor live more happily to get rid of the big problem.
Now, there are a lot of nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, including tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, running refugee camps in developing countries, helping raise their family and giving money to the poor, etc. These services not only help them live better but also warm their heart.
I once had a volunteer work in the hospital to help the sick or physical injured people. The most unforgettable experience is helping a nine year old girl. She had a lung cancer when aged six and become gradually weak. I saw her every day lying on the bed, watching her favorite cartoons with her sad face. At night, I even heard crying from her room. My heart was deeply broken "Why god do such things to her? It's unfair!" The miserable experience forced me to help the sick people and I'm satisfied with it.
When people need help, we should help them. Through the help of others, I can grow up, have a positive attitude toward a thing and be more satisfied what I have now.

subject: HW0901
content:
The world has been gradually changing as well as its people. People are now willing to help others with no return. Nonprofit organizations are popping out!
One organization which everyone knows is the Red Cross. The organization is everywhere especially in those undeveloped countries. The services that the organization provides is significant to those countries in need. The organization provides medical and finance services which those countries are really lacking of. Countries like Africa are suffering in famine, the Red Cross then helps them with sufficient food and some education about the population that leads to their economic issuse. There's an organization called Trust-Hope-Love which I've been to. It helps people who are seriously handicaped or people whose brain are damaged. The volunteer work that I've done was helping the kids who were unable to do things by themselves. I washed their bodies, teached them to walk and filled their hearts with love! That was the most facsinating experience I've ever had.
All in all, helping people is not difficult. This is a talent that you were given at the moment you were born. Try to participate in those nonprofit organizations, because it leads you to a better mood and a better life!

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, more and more nonprofit organizations are being noticed for some important services. Usually, they recruit volunteers to help with the work, such as tutoring children in remote areas, helping unemployers finding jobs, taking care for the homeless people or running refugee camps in developing countries. These important services make people believe that their donation, love and kindness toward the world and the public can be used in a proper way.
In fact, this summer vacation, I will join a small nonprofit organizations to tutor the children English in some remote areas in the mountains. Different from the children in cities, it's hardly to have abundant and complete English inputs for the children in countrysides. Of course it may affect their language learning willingness and performance. In order to result these circumstances, I will design some interesting and creative activities with the basic English concepts to arise the children's interests and confidence. Then, I will help them to understand the content of their English textbooks in school. In this way, I think their English can have a big progress. It's my pleasure to see their growth and smile during the service time in that organization.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the nonprofit organizations have attracted the attention of the public. More and more people volunteer to join these organizations and help those who are in need. For example, wherever has a disator, we can see lots of volunteers helping reconstruct the community. Hardly can we imagine how important the help from those volunteers is to those who suffered from the disator. Next, in the remote areas, we can see volunteers teaching the children who don't have school to go and study in with the efforts of the volunteers, those children will finally be stop from becoming an useless person in the soceity.
Few years ago, I joined a nonprofit organization myself. In my volunteer work, I was sent to a hospital to talk with sick longly old men and play with some injured children. I learned a lot from my volunteer work. For example, I broadened my mind and enriched my knowledge in the talk with some wise old man, and I learn the skill of encouraging the sad children. Furthermore, I found it joyful to help others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations are founded. They recruit volunteers from all over the world to help do their work. When there is a war, they will send doctors, nurses and some medicine to the place to treat the people injured. Food, waters and clothes are sent to places where there are floods or famine. Not only international work do they do, but they also provide some services in their own country. Some organizations will visit old people who live alone and help clean their houses or give them some supplyment. Besides, we often see some people clean the streets. They are volunteers, not workers. I admire these people and I have also done some volunteer work.
When I was in junior high, I joined an organization. We visited a nursing home every weekend. I told jokes to the old ladies and played majang with them. They seemed to be very happy everytime they saw me. I also took a walk with them and helped them clean their bedrooms. I enjoyed the work because it made people happy. Although I am not in the organization now due to my busy schoolwork, I think I will do more volunteer work to help people in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: At the present, more and more nonprofit organizations make contributions to the society. Many volunteers participate in these organizations and provide their services without asking any payment Such institutions contribute to education, environment, proverty and so on. For example, a lot of university students teach children in rural areas or hold summer camps for them; some people volunteer to do garbage recycling in order to protect our environment; there are also some people donate their time and money in order to help the poor to pursue the better quality of lives. I am of no exception. I have proceeded in the summer camp of natural observation for children. I also have tell the stories in the library for pre-school students. Have taken part in these actives, I really get involved in it happily and then hope to have opportunities to do other volunteer work in the future

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations (or NGO) help needy people in society. For example, CCF (or TFCF, ) supplys poor families money every month, provides new homes for abused children, runs many education programs for children in Mongolia...etc. The World Vision () tutors hungry children in Africa. The Red Cross () runs refugee camps in after-war countries. Tsuzi () aids people in need whether in 911 Earthquake in Taiwan or Xiqun () Earthquake in China...etc. What they do for this world is really touched me. Their giving and humanity make me as a volunteer at present.
I am a volunteer in CCF. My usual responsibility is to teach poor children English and music. When I teach them something new, they always eager to learn that I can perceive their learing motivations. To me, helping poor children is to provide them learing opportunities-- education. Unfortunately, their condition is not well enough, so I always worry about them. As soon as I have free time, I am willing to spend weekends to teach them schoolworks. Recently, I am glad to see that a child who has passed the GEPT elementary level. This kind of success is hard to describe beyond my description. I hope I can do more for these needy children in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
It's true that nowadays nonprofit organizations play an important and crucial rule almost every-where around the world. Some organizations gather proffessional skilled people to assist people who suffer from giant nature disasters, like earthquakes, tsunamis or floods; while some collect citizens' love, care and donations to far away mountain areas in Taiwan or some other places in developing countries. They consequently realize the saying, "Love makes the world go around."
When I was studying in the university, I have volunteered to work in a dancing group whenever they performed in my school campus. From that experience, I truely learned the happiness of helping people. It was so interesting to work with so many people who have had the same simple passion for servicing people. What we usually have done were like delivering the advertisement papers, collecting the tickets, and guiding audiances to their seats. These actions may seem easy and little but they were meaningful.
In a word, being a volunteer can not only help others but also enrich my life. It reminds me life is not only filled with work, it may somehow exist another meaning. "Action speaks louder than a word." If I have a chance to be a volunteer, this time I would like to be an English tutor to guide more kids on the moutain areas in Taiwan. Let's start our little effort to make our environment a better place!

subject: HW0901
content:
As far as I am concerned, there are a lot of nonprofit organizations provide those who are in need with their help. The volunteers devote themselves in medication, education and environment protection.
For instance, when the horrible earthquake happened in Mainland China last year, many nonprofit organizations around the world sent volunteers and rescuers to the disaster area for help. They set many temporary shelters for the people who lost their house. They also had some doctors to help the wounded. Not long after, they continued to help the refugees to rebuild their home and they also established some schools for the students.
As for me, I have once gone to a charity to take care of the old people who live in there for a long time. My friends and I played some interesting games with the cute old people who are just like our grandparents. We also chatted with them, though they talked much more than us and we were just listening. During the process, I found that the old people living in there were not happy, even lonely. They need people who are kind and patient to be accompany with them. Therefore, I decide to visit them once I have free time. Being a volunteer and doing some good things makes me feel happy and content, and I would like to continue doing it in my future.

subject: HW0901
content:
When it comes to nonprofit organizations, there are a lot of stories to say.
Nowadays, people have discovered that we need to help each other more, especially for some simple kind reasons instead of money or payment. There are more and more services provided by nonprofit organizations in Taiwan now, including services for kids, for the elders, for the sick or someone helpless.
For children in poor or in remote areas in Taiwan, our government excutes a special project. In that project, some children, who have difficulties to have better educational environment, can be tutored by some volunteers coming from nearby universities.
For the elders who live alone, some non-profit organizations will send their volunteers to visit them and take care of them. For girls who have baby without marriage, there are also non-profit organizations to protect them and teach them how to deal with their lives.
So many people silently make efforts on volunteering and helping others. In my own experiences, tutoring children in the junior high school near my university is one of the most precious memories during my life in university.
Besides, the experience of being a volunteer in the post office in my hometwon helped me to know more about others and myself, too.
I think all these things are not only good for me, but also good for all human beings. My mother is a volunteer in a hospital now and in the future, there will be more people understanding how great volunteering is!

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many organizations provide services for people in need. They recruit money to build orphanages, schools refugee camps for the poor, provide aids by outstanding doctors. They also have teachers to teach children who are handicaps or with disabilities in learning. Moreover, they will visit the older who live alone regularly, to help them with cleaning houses, having meals and so on.
I have been a volunteer at the library. It was an meaningful experience. What I had to do is to make sure every books are put in the right place and help people who are in search of books. I learned how to catalog books and interact with people. What's better, I could read books as many as I like.
In the future, I would like to help children with learning difficulties, and teach children who are too poor to learn English well. In my opinion, it never be too overemphasis on learning.
Everyone can help others as long as you have abilities and desires to devote to the poor. Even just a little, as long as you keep helping people in need, you are making the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations all over the world. They are used to take care of refugees or the old. In addition, the young must focus on its job. I think many young people should devote themselves to the society. In so doing, our life and environment will be better.
I have looked after remote area's children for one day. I realize that only love and concern make them happy and warm. I also go to the library to be a volunteer. I work happily because this try tells me that I can serve for the public. And In the future, I hope I can keep my hot heart helping our society. I want to go to remote area to teach children English and share them with my things, even play with them. Because I graduate from the English department, I think I can make the most of my proficiency.
I agree volunteers very much. In the future, I hope there are many nonprofit organizations created.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations trying their best to help people who need others' help. No matter where it is, they will arrive at there as soon as possible. For example, the nonprofit organization, red cross, provide free medical services for people who live in the area where lack of medical resource. Sometime they also go to countries where happened horrible desease. Moreover, they also go to refugee camps regularly to take care of patients. Above all, no matter where need medical help, you can see the red cross signals.
However, these nonprofit organizations always need money and recruit volunteers to help with their work. Therefore, if I had free time, I would try to join them. Although I am just a student, I can be the volunteer to help them to provide services for people who need help. Moreover, I can take advantage of my weeken to help them to prepare anything which they would like to send to remote area or refugee camps.

subject: HW0901
content:

When I was little, I had wondered that why these organizations can always help the people they don't really understand. subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, child-torturing has been an increasing broblem in our sociaty. Those voluteers hope they could save those children who once lived under pressure and go on their new lifes. It's a great work and I hope one day I could also help those children because I insist that everyone should have a good childhood memory.

subject: HW0901
content:
A poet has said, "Life will be richer if you share love with people and reach out your hands to the people in need." I admire the people who work in nonprofit organizations so much. Some people starved to death or died from thirst. Lots of children in Africa are lack of nutritions. Thanks to the important services provided by these organizations. They have big hearts, because they have held many compaigns of helping the people in need. Moreover, they even took the planes to the developing countries like Africa to take care of the ill people for several years. What they have done touched my heart so much.
I have joined a volunteer work. When I was in the second grade of elementary school, I have helped some blind people by a dancing show. My classmates and I gave out the show and got the money to help people who suffer from it. Helping people makes me happy. In the future, I want to teach the childrens in remote areas in Taiwan. Besides, I want to be a member of a nonprofit organization to help the poor all over the world. I'll try my best to fill the world with love.

subject: HW0901
content: Recent years, many nonprofit organizations have raised the public's attention to tutoring children or the problems in developing countries. They also expect that more and more people will show their compassion on these issues. In order to solve these problems, they have taken some actions. First, these organizations will gather the second-hand clothes, and deliever to those who can't afford to buy new clothes. For example, my family will donate the clothes that are too big or too small for us to wear once two years. For instance, one of my cousin has taken part in such activity, and prescribed medicine for free. Third, they will throw variety of activites for teenagers to let us know the problems that happen in the remote areas or the developing countries. To illustrate, I have taken part in an activity that is to teach the children whose parents have devorced and have economic problems on their homework and talk about the school life. From then on, I think that I should do more for them, such as being volunteers, and that is a kind of way that I can show my compassion to them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Volunteer work is becoming more and more important these days. The volunteer works are provide by many nonprofit organizations. These works help people in need.
Their are many important services provided by such organization. For example, medical treatment, algrecultural helps and educational helps. Many Taiwanese doctors go to African countries to provide needed medical treatment. They help locals defeat virus like AIDs. Many Taiwanese farmer also go to developing countries to teach them how to produce produce. Urban teacher go to places where education is poor. They teach children how to read and write.
I help the community to sort the trash every Sunday. My job is to make sure all the cans and bottles are in correct position. I feel great to help the environment and people living in the community.
Nowaday, volunteering is very important. Volunteer works should be done by people who can help others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. In my oppinon, it is a keenly great retreatment to our socielty. As a proverb goes, "A volunteer is better than two workers." It means that the volunteers have more enthuis to their works.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the modern era, technology is highly developed. It bring us not only the convenience but also the harm, so many organizations are formed, and devoted to realizing their dreams which are based on making a better and more ideal world.
This nonprofit organizations provide several and various help to both human beings and the enviroment. For example, they supply foods to remote areas, teaching techniques which can help people make the both ends meet to the extremely poors, and most important of all, saving our earth from the harmful destroys through forcing the government to make laws or teaching people the right view point.

I will work with people from different country and make the enviroment better through the ways, such as planting trees, picking up the garbage in mountains and taking care of the animals. As one part of our Earth, I want to try my best to make this world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
I believe that every drop of rain that falls, a flower grows. I believe that somewhere in the darkness, a candle glows. I believe for everyone who goes astray, someone will come to show the way. And these are what the nonprofit organizations want to do all over the world. Sometimes, the natural disaster may cause a lot of damages and even take people's lives away. In this case, the nonprofit organizations will bring sunshine to those who are suffering. They will provide them with plenty of food, water, and considerate caring to see them through the hardness. And then they will make every efforts to help them back to their ordinary life.
As far as I am concerned, there are too many people in my life reaching to me when I am depressed. So, if I have the chance to help others. I will take action without delay. And then I will broaden my ability to help more people. Just like the movie "Pay It Forward", even little thing can still do much to someone.
That's what I believe.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people participate nonprofit organizations to help people who are in need in the world. The organization supply people with their pure and enthusiastic heart, they don't want any bonus when they are doing work.
For example, when the country had earthquakes, people have no food to eat, the organization will bring a lot of foods and fast food to let people get warm. Moreover, if the houses were crushed, the organization will help them build their houses. By doing so, what the organization done is not only help people's need, but also warm the people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, many people still have problems to maintain their life. They need people to give them a hand. Therefore, nonprofit organizations play an important role.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there are many poor children in remote mountains and refugees on the streets who need for our helps. So, there are some nonprofit organizations established, such as Red Cross Organization. Volunteers in Red Cross Organization help the poor to get through their rough lives, and aid the refugees in 911 earthquake, giving them a hand to build their houses. in the future, after I graduate from high school, I will join the Red Cross Organization, dedicated myself to helping some poor aboriginal children, teaching them some knowledges and sloving their problems on their homework. In addition, I hope I can go abroad to Africa, helping the kid there to improve their environment. This is the dream that I dream, and I hope I can fulfill someday.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations established to give a hand to those who need help. It's quite common to see many people work as volunteers contributing to different social affairs in areas lack of help. Take the recent news for example, the big earthquake in western China has caused numerous damages and a large amount of casualty Many refugees lost their families, property, even their lives. In this bad situation, many global institutions like "The Red Cross Organization" and "WHO" were not only busy running refugee camps but also giving first aids to people suffering from the disaster.
In Taiwan, there are also lots of nonprofit organizations. I have done a volunteer work which needs my help to take care of the elderly in a caring center. The person I looked after was an old man who had been suffering a stroke for two years. He can only talk slowly. I always sat beside him and read some stories or told jokes to make him feel happy. I also take him to the park near the center to breathe in the fresh air. During the time with him, I was totally touched by his spirit of life and the positive attitude when facing the disease.
Actually, I am the person who really get a big help. Being a volunteer enables me to become more responsible and pleased. I won't stop this work, and I will help more people in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Along with the economical improvement of a society or a country, people nowadays have been fulfilled their basic needs in life and therefore have spare time to pursue a deeper level of self-achievement. They seek the spiritual comfort and ask themselves what they can contribute to their people or their society. This is why non-profit organizations most likely exist in developing countries instead of the third world. I, as a citizen in Taiwan, I feel honored to see that more important services by such organizations are arranged for volunteers to help people in needs. Being capable of something other than just to make a living is indeed, one kind of happiness in my eyes.
There are different services available to assist the minority group and they are not limited to be put into executions by a non-profit organizations. More and more commercialized businesses see themselves own the responsibility of giving feedbacks as well. However, regardless of the organization types you belong, crutial services for people who live in remote area in Taiwai like providing essential medical treatments and consultants to sick people, tutoring children, fundraising transition cost for children to schools are available. "Zhi-Ji" for example even established a system to run refugee camps in other countries during natural crisis.
I haven't done any serious volunteer work so far and my dream is that one day, I may go to a third world country to help those poor and sick children and adults with whatever skills I have on hand. Life is too short to suffer from diseases and hunger.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the society today, there are many nonprofit organizations recruiting volunteers to help with their work. It is because a lot of people need some help certainly. These nonprofit organizations help people in many ways.
As everyone knows, every time there is a serious diaster like earthquake, typhoon, wars, and so forth, nonprofit organizations will give a hand to the victims at once. The organizations first try to understand the situation, and then they beging to make a charity to encourage people all over the world to donate money to help the victims. In addition, these organizations can assist people to rebuild their home and set up a certain system to teach people some new skills so that people can live on by themselves. Of course, the organizations also cooperate with some psychologists to soothe people and make victims look more on the bright side.
I have taken part in some volunteer works in hospitals. In hospitals, I help to lead the patients to the right counter to take their prescription. Besides I have also assisted nurses to move some information about patients, and I tried to learn how to measure the patients' blood pressure. These experiences are important in my life.
In the future, I will become a doctor. If I have a chance, I hope that I can go abroad to some developing countries and help local residents who need medical treatment and assistance. It's my dream that I can contribute myself to the whole society and world!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in the world. Their main idea is to help people who are in the danger of difficulty. Before, people always said the rich can only think about themselves. But now, the situation is different. The rich people find they have power to help people and they start to do. So that the nonprofit organization were made.
Take Taiwan for instance, a few years ago when the 921 earthquake happened, the damage was huge. Although the organization in our country do their best to help, it's not enough. And then, the rescue group from all of the world came to help. Other countries would donate money to help people rebuild their family. It's really the nice deed.
The Red Cross Organization spreads all over the world, and they really give people help and warmth. They do a lot of things such as going to the remote areas to teaching the children or also providing them the medical service. They really want to do their best to help people.
If I have chance, I also want to be a volunteer to help others. Comparing with them, I am lucky enough so I should be satisfied and trying to make them happy. What I want to do is to tutor the children in the orphanage, and give them the love they are lack of. Besides, I'd like to adopt some African kids. Eight hundreds per month can make a child live the better life and go to school.
I always consider that people in the world should help each other. Now, we have the ability and glad to help others. We can get the satisfication from this. And if one day we need other's help, they'll do their best to help us without any excuse.

subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901
content:

The volunteers will take advantage of their free time to help those people who need help. In some festivals, such as Moon Festival, they will give them moon cakes for free. In addition, they will hold some activities to raise money from the public.
When I was a first grade in senior high school, I had a chance to be a volunteer. I joined the activity that was held by the World Vision. My classmates and I raised money in the shopping mall. Although some are pleasant to donate money, others are unwilling to give little penny. By the experience, I have known that it is meaningful to help others in need. In the future, I am willing to be a volunteer. I will donate money as possible as I can and teach children in remote areas. I hope I can make most use of my capbility to help others and do something good to our society.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is a proverb goes, Giving is better than reciving". More and more volunteers sacrifice their weekends to help people who need help in the society. Take Providence University for example, there is a program called "service-learn-ing". The whole freshmen have to use their specialties to help people. Some of them go to hospitals for chating or helping the elders. They take care of the elders. Some of them go the orphanages for companing with those homeless children. They all spend not only one day but several weeks. The purpose of this program is going to make students to have more patient, reponsibility and cherish what they have had.
As an English major, I participated this program with my English ability. My classmates and I went to Si Wei elementary for teaching those elemantary students English. These children are not normal ones. Some of them are from single parents family, some of them are raised by grandparents, others famiy are poverty. We designed the courses, made flash card to tools. We enjoied playing games or doing outdoor activities with them. The most important one is we enjoied seeing their innocent and naive smile.
Indeed, I felt I reaped more than what I had given them. I became more mature on treating others. I learned cherich I was born in healthy body and complete family. Thus, I decided that at the time I can raise myself- which means I can earn money by myself, I would like to make good use of my weekend or rest time to help people in this society! Be a volunteers!

content:

While we were buying Starbucks coffee or shopping in the department store, other people in those poor countries were starving, suffering and dying. Since we are all fragile human beings, we should forget about race and skin color. It's no doubt we can't ignore their pain.
Because more and more people aware that we should help those who are in pain, so many nonprofit and non-goverment organizations were set. They fly to Africa to provide safe drinking water and fine education the the local residents. And there are also many docters volunteer to provide free medical service and surgery to those sick people. Besides, there are also some professional people provide agriculutral skills to help them stay awary from huger.
When I get retired, I definitely want to join these organizations, And I want to help those poor to get safe drinking water, because 8000 people die a day because of dirty drinking water. I think that's the most emerget problem.

subject: HW0901
content:
According to the reports, there are more and more people willing to spend their time helping the homeless, the jobless, and the poor. I associated with a friend who participated in this kind of associations; Hence, I knew some works they do for others.
First, they sometimes spend their weekends recycling the gabage and waste. They believe the more waste they try to reuse the more opportunities they can protect the earth from the polutions. Second, I knew there are some volunteers use the time after school or work to teach the children who live in a remote area that the education resources aren't enough. By teaching them, the rural-urban differences will not so serious. Last but not least, some of them go to the hospitals to accompany with cancer patients. They knew the things caner patients want most are accompanions, so they arrange time to talk with them, making their minds more sooth.
