Of course, there are arguments to be made for other opinions as well. Nevertheless, the opinions I presented above, I believe they're the realest ones.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations, the organization charging nothing to help people in need, are sort of charity services. The main servies provided by them are after class lessons for children, winter and summer camps for all ages, and emergency assisstant for those suffured. All these helps cost less but benefit a lot to our society.
In my experience, YMCA, one of the nonprofit organizations, plays a vital and indispensitive role, and even become part of my life. In my childhood, I spend most of time there after class learning some excurricular knowledge, such as art, music and so on. When the long vacation comes, I definitely stay at the camp to enjoy the group activities. In this period of time, touched by those studying-hard student, I have incredible fulfillment that I had never receive. And, I believe I will continue to maintain this feeling, and do more of it.

subject: HW0901
content:

Though I always get carsick when driving the mountain roads, I insist to go their and give them suppliments by myself. I like the blue sky and the gorgeous view on the mountain, yet I love the beautiful smile from those children and the famous feeling I have after the exausting day.
There are charities like Tsu-Gi organization or people like my family that want to do something to make this island a better place. I expect that there will be more and more people donte themselves helping people in the near future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, most people have comfortable life, but still there are the less fortunate. subject: HW0901
content:
Although there are plenty of profit organizations, there are lots of nonprofit organizations as well. Instead of getting business benifits, the goal of nonprofit organizations is helping refugees or the poor in the world. I have been a volunteer once in one of these organization, which is called "The fairies in the mountains".
The main goal of this organization is tutoring children in remote areas, especially central area, in Taiwan, since most of these children live with their grandparents, unable to receive good education. With the reasons above, our works are teaching and taking care of them.
Since there are many tragic people in the world, I would like to join more nonprofit organizations and help them. I believe that if I do so, the destiny of those people may change.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, some nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. They provide many important services such as medical services and free tutoring to the old, the poor and children who cannot go to school. The organizations will first find out who really need their help and then send some people and neccessary supplies to them in order to help them to have a better life. They also run some refugee camps while some countries are in war so that people who do not have a home can find a place to stay and live until they rebuild their new home. In addition, they even encourage and help the unemployed people to find jobs. If I were one of them, I think I would like to be the one who takes care of the old. I would be happy to bathe, feed and dress them. Also, I would chat with them and take them for a walk everyday. Because they remind me of my grandmother and grandfather who always love me. In my opinion, people all need love, especially children and old people. I would do my best to make them feel happy and alive.

subject: HW0901
content: There are more and more nonprofit orgni-zations foundating around the world. They are foundated to help those poor and unable people. The orgnizations usually use almost the same way to assist them. For instance, they hope that people can donate money to these orgnizations, therefore, they can have ample assets to build schools, provide abundant food and give the poor a better environment. Some people don't consider that the money is indeed, because they are apt to giving them the necesarilies in their daily lives. Howevery, money is not at the least making no sense. Those who are in dilemma all need it very much. The orgnizations should take actions to prove the reality. Sometimes Ithink, if one day I can be a volunteer in any kinds of nonprofit orgnizations, I will want to tutor children in remote areas. For me, education needs no feebacks, but I can get more from the experience, including happiness, fulfillments and the childlike faces they give me. Those will be the most momentous things in my whole life. And the most important of all, it makes sense in my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
The gap between the rich and the poor grows dipper as our technology improves faster. But the number of nonp-rofit organizations and volunteers related are growing, too.
We can hear from all kinds of media oftenly that nonprofit organizations are recruiting volunteers again for some charity activities. They recruit volunteers to donate anything they can, such as second-hand stuff or their pe-fesesiona ability, not always money. The commonest examples are the schools and hospitals built by such organizations for the needed. Necessary living stuff such as water, food as well as a shoot given by volunteers and those organizations are important and useful, too. Everytime I see the smiles of those who are helped on TV, no matter which corn-er on the Earth, I feel so toughted. I think that the most important thing nonprofit organizations give them isn't the visible and realistic material we can hold, but the idea of that they're not alone or given up because there is still love at any corner in this world.
Therefore, although I haven't done any such volunteer work before, I want to join them now and in the future. Those smiles are the best motive and appreciation for me. I want to be a volunteer like teacher and teach those kids who live in mountains English. (The transportation is the biggest obstcule to their learning.) I love kids and I love teaching. What about you?

subject: HW0901
content:
In modern days, the living quality of human has improved. Most of us are able to live safely and comfortablely. However, there are still some people in need. They have no place to live, no food to eat, and no books to read. They need our help.
Fortunatly, nowdays, many nonprofit organizations are established. Although they are doing different things, they all devote themselves to help needy people. Those organizations provide many important services. Such as sending food and clothes to the poors, giving the refugee medical cares, or building a school in a remote village.
I have join those organizations once. As a volunteer, I went to many place to ask for some old books. After we assembled lots of books. We send it to a small town, which is far away in the mountan.
I felt very happy after doing so. It is because I thought I have helped lots of kids in need. I am glad that there have so many good organizations, which try their best helping others. In the future, no matter what job I do, I will join one of those. So that I can do effort to make the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the advance of transportation, more and more people are capable to help those who are poor. For instance, more and more universities have society serving clubs. Those society serving clubs will usually go tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan during winter and summer vacations or or help orphans learning in daily lives. There are also many refugee camps running in Taiwan to help poor people in developing countries.
When I was a freshman in university, I joined a club of society serving. We went to an orphanage to tutor children twice a week, and during the winter vacation, the members of our club sacraficed our holidays to held a learning camp in an elementary school in a deep mountain. Most of their parents of the students there are farmers, thus they don't have enough money to afford them a good education and are too busy to take care of them. Some of them even don't have lights in their home. Therefore, we went there to lead them playing games, drawing and singing with them and also help them solve the problems of schoolwork. Since that I learned a lot from this experience and felt satisfied of helping others. I aware of there are still many people need help in this world, so I would like to join refugee camps in developing countries when I graduate from the university.

subject: HW0901
content:
In modern society, nonprofit organizations play a more and more important role. Volunteers working in those organizations devoted to helping the minorities give their warm hands to not only people in our country but also those abroad. News about raising money for children living in remote areas in Taiwan is commonly reported, but what impresses me most is the timely aid those organization gave over the sea to help the foreigners in need.
I remember,after the disastrous tsunami struck Sounthern Asia, I saw the volunteers of a nonprofit organization hold boxes in their hands standing right outside my school raising money. I saw them every day after school, and I was so touched by their passion. They sacrificed their time to help people they event didn't know. From then on, I made up my mind to do their job one day. I want to promote Taiwanese hospitality and let more and more country know our nation through kind and friendly help; I hope one day in Africa or somewhere else on earth there will be a person sincerely grateful for the aid I once give him; I believe even one dollar can change the world. That's what I'm determined to do.

subject: HW0901
content: In this mordern world, although there are lots of people have a perfect life, there are still a few people have no clothes to wear or no food to eat. Fortunately, there are some nonprofit organizations to help them. For example, they would send a number of volunteers to provide some poor people lots of second-hand clothes or some food that are good for them. What's better, they even taught them to help them reading books. Though I don't have much time and money, I still want to help some people. Therefore, I always go to the hospital which is in my neighborhood on the weekend. In my first time being a student volunteer, I was sent to the department where takes charge of the elders. Because of my shy personality, I didn't do anything until a old lady ask me if I could help her. During the time I sent her to the room, she told me a lot of things about when she was young. After that, I enjoyed being a volunteer every weekend, and I think I would not stop until forever.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are some people who have a special bahavior and thought. Although they work hard, they don't expect an adaquent payment in their career. They working content is always for others but not themselves. Who are they? they are volunteers!
More and more people devote themselves to be a volunteer. They services which they offer are vary. If an earthquake hit, volunteers would go to the dangerous area in order to help victims rebuild their houses. If there is a outbreak of flu, volunteers would go to hospitals help patients and doctors. They also raise funds for poor family, teach children in remote areas and even be a firefighter if needed.
I have never been a volunteer. If having a chance, I will devote myself in hospitals to take care of children, to comfort the sicks and to accompany with elder people.
Some people can't realize the reasons to be a volunteer. According to no salary, people generally think there is not any advantages. In fact, help others will increase the confidence. Besides, people must learn different things when sharing experices to each other. These are treasures in everyone's lives. In conclusion, catch the opportunities to be a volunteer as soon as possible. Therefore, we could totally understand the happiness of being a giver.

subject: HW0901
content: In recent years, the number of people who joins nonprofit organizations has increase more and more. They volunteer to do things that helps people who needs help. Nonprofit organizations provides many kinds of help in different inspects. lets' take some examples. Decades ago, some doctors in Paris founded an organization that helps people or refugees in remote areas. they provides medical treatment, sugeries, and efforts on everything they can to help those people. subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, people in Taiwan have been doing their best to help the needed. They founded some nonprofit organizations and found several volunteers to assist their objection. subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have become an important role in the world. These organizations offer different kinds of services to the people in need. Many achievements have been done by them, even in some countries which our nation does not have formal diplomatic relations.
I have heard that these nonprofit organization recruit volunteers to rebuild the areas which just suffered from natural disasters. Volunteers in the nonprofit organization will assist the rescue job, build some temporary houses for the homeless residents, and also cook meals for them. Once, I watched a TV program and knew that peoples in that area really appreciated these volunteers. I was very touched by their thankful expressions.
If there is the chance to help people in the areas suffered from natural disasters, I would be willing to go. Although I do not have volunteer work experience, I still would do my best because these organizations have taught me the values of lives and also the best side of human natures.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations in the world, helping many people who live in poor conditions. The nonprofit organization provide many services to help poor people like providing temporary shelters, clean water and foods. The most important is the feeling of safety in their heart. Because of the nonprofit organization, people can slowly forget the hurt in the heart of disasters, I had been volunteer in a nonprofit organization before, they gathered few people as a group, and everytime we went out to help people in a group, we went to poor people's house to help them clean their house and also took some things they will use in life to them. I will be volunteer in this nonprofit organization to help more people who live in difficult conditions in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays nonprofit organizations like Tsiz-Chi or Red-Cross organization recruit volunteers to help with their work involved with tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, running refugee camps in developing countries, providing relief materials to some countries striken by natural disasters, building hospitals to give medical reliefs in undeveloped or developing countries. All these volunteer tasks are extremely meaningful. Admittedly, people in remote areas in Taiwan as well as in developing countries cannot easily obtain sufficient education or modern information. There is no deny that people suffering from being stricken by natural disasters cannot easily acquire medical aids and relief materials. However, the nonprofit organizations provide those who are in need with food, education, medical aids and so on by the assistance of volunteers. And therefore, those who are in need or despair can survive better in their future.
As far as I am concerned, I have no spare time to be a volunteer right now. However, I often donate some money to those nonprofit organization. Maybe one thousand dollars or sometimes five thousand dollars each time is not a large amount of money, but I do believe it can help some people and that is what I can do right now. I am teaching in a private school at present. I have made up my mind to do more good deeds after retiring. I hope one day what I can do is beyond teaching at school. I hope I can teach those poor orphans in the orphanage near my home. Each time I pass away the orphange, I sympathize those children without parents' love and care. Therefore, being a volunteer in the orphange is what I wat to do in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, more people and organizations help others in need. They've brought love and peace to everywhere in Taiwan. subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations calls voluntees to help people around the world, and some of them broke the walls between races and nations. Some provide medical services to those who are wounded or ill in developing countries. Other provide food and drinks for those who are lack of resources. Anothers focus on education. Since I was trained on computer science and information engineering, I might have the ability to participate in free software development. subject: HW0901
content:
It is universally accepted that nonprofit organizations had helped countless people in need all over the world. Without their help, many poor people would still live in miserable, shiver in cold nights, and even beg for food in the streets. These organizations are truely the angels to the poor people. There are a lot of nonprofit organizations in the world, and one of the most important organizations is the Red Cross. This organization always come to people's aid and offer resources to the people in need. For example, when Taiwan encountered a destructive earthquake many years ago, the organization came for help without a moment of hesitation.
However, volunteers are the most important factor to form a nonprofit organization. I really admire these people and respect what they have done, so I decided to become a volunteer like them. Since I am still too young to do such great things like them, I decided to do some simple works as a volunteer. I became one of the volunteers in the Science Museum two years ago, though the works were not difficult. I still did them carefully and I really enjoyed the time I worked with my teammates.
Working as a volunteer is truely a wonderful experience, I hope that I can help more people who are in poor conditions in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an irreplacable part in public services these days, as they recruit volunteers to help those in need.
The Red Cross, for instance, is one of the largest international nonprofit organization, which provides medical services to people affected by wars. This kind of work might seem pointless and unprofitable, but they surely make the world a better place.
As for me, I would like to be a volunteer worker at hospitals or the Science Museum. Life is the most marvelous gift from above, so we should treasure it like nothing else. By working at the hospital I can help preserve others' lives.
Science is the greatest human invention ever. The more people knows about it the better it becomes. That is why I would love to work at the Science Museum, to help bring the secret of science to everyone who visit the museum.
While nonprofit organizations are nonprofit they still makes profit - profit that can be enjoyed by anyone on earth: they make the world a better place.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, more and more people respect and are willing to be volunteers in nonprofit organizations. Such organizations are essential in the world and they have provided some important services for the needs. First of all, the volunteers may work as tutors to teach the children in remote areas or in poverty. They provide some teaching materials for the children who live far away from towns or cities and for those who have less opportunity to be educated. Another service is that they run refugee camps in developing countries by providing them clean water, sufficient food, and safe places to stay. Furthermore, the organizations would send medical equipments to cure those who have diseases. Lastly, when catastrophe happened, the organizations are always the first one to provide supplement or money to help them rebuild the damaged place. For example, when the severe earthquake took place in China last year, people donate lots of fortune to let them rebuild their home. And the organizations provide some clothe and comfort for the injured. In the future, I would like to tutor children who are unable to get higher education. Seeing their innocent smile could satisfy my heart after tutoring them. Hopefully in the near future I will have the chance to work for a nonprofit organization.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are significant power of humanity in the capital society. They provide instant and momentous help to people who need it, donating themselves only for a great dream - to make the earth a better place to live while most people and countries only care about the productivity and profitability.
Nonprofit organizations offer services to two major target, men and environment. For men, they help the minority of the society in a wide range of way, such as education and economy. Besides, they also provide a pivotal assistance to the world - the restruction after a dire catastrophe. Nonprofit organizations play a critical role in restruction because they hold immense resources donated by people around the world and stand for a positive power to give the victims confidence and inspire them. Furthermore, some nonprofit organizations provide vital help to our environment to protect the animals, forests, the water we use and the land we live.
I come from a remote area in Taiwan, experiencing the lack of education resource and lag of information. Therefore, I would like to join in the nonprofit organizations to help the children in remote areas, making them as competitive as the children in cities.

subject: HW0901
content:
Tzu-Chi Foundation is a well-known nonprofit organization in Taiwan. It was founded by Master Zheng-Yen decades ago.
What the members have done are quite impressive. They always help poor, sick, or handicaped people. Also, every time there comes a natural disaster, such as typhoon, earthquake, or flood, they are always the first ones going to help people. Nowadays, the organization has spread to all over the world. We can see Tzu-Chi Volunteers almost everywhere!
Every time I watch Da-Ai TV. I am always touched by what they do. I am now a second-year medical student, and there are still five years before I become a doctor. However, do I really have to become a doctor so that I can help people? Seeing the Tzu-Chi foundation, I know I can help people from now on! I have no volunteer experience, but I hope one day I can join the Tzu-Chi Foundation, following the steps of Master Zheng-Yen, so that I can help a lot of people in need. I'm sure I can make it!

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit many volunteers to help with their work. They not only raise the money for those who really need it but also give them love and good cares. They tutoring children in remote areas nomatter the life there is how hard. They also running refugee camps in developing countries provide them with food, money, medical help and let the kids can learn something. Their kindness and willing helping heart can be seen in everywhere, like the areas which have destroyed by earthquake or tsunami. I have never join any nonprofit organizations but if I have the chance, I would like to be one of them. I would like to helping the hungers in India or victims in China and even the people who needs help in Taiwan. I think it will be a good experience to help people instead of always get help from others. Also, helping people must be a happy thing to do.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are so many volunteers helping people in this world everyday. They all stick to one goal, "love". "Love" drive them to give hands to those in need.
The nonprofit organizations have reached their tantacles to many domains. They helped women and children who are suffered from domestic violence, they provide food and residence for those homeless, they tutor adolesence and children in remote areas and training them to be skillful people and thus can contribute their abilities to the society, they show the brightness of human's heart and make the world better.

In addition to tutoring their homework, we also ignite their interest toward science through some fun experiment we designed previously. During the camp, I was moved by the passion and innocence of the obrigional children and really learned a lot! I was an unforgettable experience for me!

subject: HW0901
content:
In the age of fast-paced and modern times, nonprofit organizations have played instrumental roles in our lives and become increasingly popular. People are willing to lavish their money and love on the destitute and the poor in no return. Thanks to these organizations, our society is filled with warmth and care. Take the charity for instance, caregivers and voluteers look after the disabled and orphanges with all their hearts. To them, the recovery and brilliant smile are the most precious gifts in the world.
Last summer, I joined a team to help children with their homework. Most of these children fell behind their schoolwork. At that time, I tried my best to see them through the darkness of their lives. During the process, I also learned the important philosophy of my life. In my opinion, helping others is the most pleasant things in my mind.
If everyone is willing to spare some time to help those who are in need. The more we involve in, the more we get and appreciate. Besides, the tasks of helping others seems to make our world come closer and wonderful!

subject: HW0901
content:
During this decade, more and more nonprofit organization have provided services for children in remote areas. These organizations have done many things to improve lives and offer many opportunities of education for poor people. The organizations are established not for profit but for improvement of the whole society.
Some young adults, including students of universities, have devoted to volunteer works. They teach children in remoted area. Some children are from low-income families. Their parents cannot afford to send them to cram schools. The volunteer workers tutor those children, in hope that they can become as competent as children living in the cities.
In the future, if I would get an opportunity to be a volunteer worker, I would like to take a job in hospitals. Some patients who are administered in the hospital are very poor. Some even cannot afford basal medical treatments. Although we have health insurance in Taiwan for more than two decade, some people do not benefit from this system. I woule like to care those patients. I could take care of their daily lives, wash clothes and buy foods for them. I would be a happy volunteer worker, and I would do a good job because I am an expert in caring the ill patients.

subject: HW0901
content:
In modern times, there are lots of nonprofit organizations all around the world helping those who are in need at every corner. For instance, a worldwide organization raises daily staples for a large amount of children who are starving to death in Africa. Even more, one of its branches hold a special activity each year in which the participants are requested to starve for thirty hours without any food but water. As for me, I have been to a library to tell fairytales to little kids and clean the surroundings there. It is really a wonderful experience, from which I learn how to get along with little kids in proper ways and gain more patience and enthusiasm. In the future, I'd like to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan because I think receiving good education is rather essential for children, whenever or whoever they are.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provid many kind of important services, such as, helping poor people building houses, teaching some African tribute how to grow crops, tutoring children in remote areas, running refugee camps in developing countries, helping victims of great diseaster to rebuild their house...etc.

I know its a tiring job, it takes a lot of effort but after all that hard working the feed back is happiness. When I see the big smile on their face, I will know that I'm doing something right and its well worthy.

subject: HW0901
content:

For others, volunteering may be a way to show that they are with love and care, also to prove that they have the ability to take care of others.
Today, we can see many modern people just sitting at home with nothing to do. they never came up with the idea to help others. In my opinion, volunteering is a great experience. I looking forward to another chance.

subject: HW0901
content: I'm very appreciate to the nonprofit organizations. They help the people with kindness and ask for no return. Every time I see the volunteers of Red Cross organization rescue the people who suffer from typhoon, earthquake or other nature disasters, I'm very touched by their actions. Some times when I walk on the street, there're people from the nonprofit organization taking the food from the bread store. They give the bread to the helpless people. Some organization may provide the homeless people a meal or let them stay one night. Last year I volunteered to help retarded children at the "Love House" facility in Taichung in two mouths. I like to watch them laughing and learning in the class.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more people nowadays are willing to join nonprofit organizations, such as World Vision or Red Cross. These organizations plays an important role in the world today, they provide help for people who need help, such as the poors or people who are home-less because of natural disasters and war. There are some major services listed below which are provided by those organizations around the world.
Health care is one of the most important and common service provided by nonprofit organizations. They recruit doctors from different places around the world, and send them to places where health care are urgently needed. They fight with diseases and natural environments just like warriors who fight on battlefields.
Finacial aid is another major services that those organizations provide. They gather money from the riches to little citizens such as us and give them to people who need them, this also helps their government to fight with the poverty that they might be facing. Sometimes those organization provide the poors or the homeless more help on substances than just giving them the money. For example, they may help to rebuild houses or other sanitary equipments to people who lost their homes in a natural disaster.
I would want to become a doctor in the future, even though there's nothing much a high school student like me can do for the world, but I'm sure that if I study hard, I'll have the ability to help the people who need help in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations established now. They help people and even animals in different ways. They help poor by raising money for them; they help old people by taking care of them; they help animals by protecting and finding new owners for them. The most important thing they provide is "secure". For people who are in need, they feel insecure and they are helpless and panic, with the help of vounteers, they get help and feel safe.
