Most people don't want to do things without pay, so I certainly respect all volunteers from the bottom of my heart. I wish them have a happiness, too.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people need help in different corners. Even in developed country such as Taiwan. Some people lack of foods, shoes, and clothes. Some children do not have better education environment. There are many nonprofit organizations provide services to these people. It's really a good thing. They fulfill them basial need in their daily life. Also they provide education materials to remote areas. It's very important beacause education is the only way to get rid of poorlish.
I feel regret that I have never been a volunteer for this kind of non-goverment organizations. But I had ever tranfered money to support some foundations. Because I do believe it's a right thing I have to do. In the future, If I have time to be a volunteer, I would like to go to aborignal villege to teach computer class. That's the only thing I have self-confidence. Furthermore, computer is a way to communicate with the world. It would be very useful for the aboriginal children.

subject: HW0901
content:
When the tsunami struck Thailand, India, Shrilanka, and other countries, rescuers from Taiwan were sent to help, representing the ROC government and love from Taiwanese people. Organizations of all kinds tried to gather everything they have that's useful to help, they raise founds, set up foundations, deliver materials, and send volunteers just to help them, just to lower the damage of everything. Its the kind of love from the bottom of our heart, its the love to all human beings.
Trying not to be left behind, I also donate money to charities, and I joined the activity of Sarvation 30 foundation. I volunteered to help in hospital, charities, small villages. Because I want to help, I have a heart that's eagerly wanting the world to be better. In the future, I think I won't stop donating money, it's the most workable way I think. Although I am not planning to go to places to help, I would like to start a found that can really do they favors. Even if it takes me alot of effort, I won't quit and I will apparently dig myself into it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, there have been more and more nonprofit organizations all over the world. These organizations provide lots of sevices. Take some foundations in Taiwan for example, they take care of children from poor families. Not only do they teach these children but also they provide them enough food. Preventing them from being hurted, they spare no effort to improve their living environment. For instance, the Red-cross in Taiwan ever let volunteer medicians go to several countries in southern Africa to provide some medical sevice. After approaching there, these medicians not merely treated local people well but also helped them build some structures to live. What they did is great, and the importance of these organizations cannot be overemphasized.
Although I didn't have chance to join these activities before, I will try my best to do voluteer works in the future. I am keen to devote myself to education works. I believe I'll have enough ability to teach children in remote areas after entering an university. I consider education a holy job. I'll teach all I know to them. And if my students get somewhere in the future, I'll be proud of them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations emerging in our society. They provide many important services for those who are in need of help. They take good care of the helpless old people, the discarded children, the adults out of job or in danger, and even offer the agricultural or the medical services to the developing countries.
One volunteer work I have done is tutoring children in remote areas when I was a senior high school student. During one summer vacation, I went to a junior high school with other member of the school club. THe high school was located in a mountainous area in Nantou county. We went there to tutor the students. We spent much time helping them with their math or English problems. Besides, we played basketball or baseball with them. That schol was full of our laughters during that time. I did cherish those good memories. I hope one day I can return to that school and do some services to the children again.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the progress of technology and computer science, we do live a better life than the past of few decades. However, some of the countries in the world are striken by famine, draught, typhoons, floods and so on. Thus, people of those countries inevitably live in poverty and misery, awaiting our help.
To save people from those unfortunate situations, nonprofit organizations arise. They provide lots of charitable services such as food distribution, offering temporary accommodation for those who are homeless, and foster family for orphans. Even though they are not likely to meet everyone's need, they do show the bright side of human nature, which set a good example for us to follow.
If I have a chance to join the volunteer work, I would choose to tutor children and teach them English. Thus, I hope I can help those minority groups and disadvantaged people. By doing so I think my future experience will make my life more colorful and meaningful and I am sure it will be an unforgettable memory.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the proverb goes "It more blessed to give than to receive". Many nonprofit organizations were founded to help poor or children, giving them practical things and love. They devote themselves without complainations, and it is the spirit that every one should learn. Not only Taiwan but some developing countries, many poor and children are suffering horrible disease and hungur. Therefore, they don't have a lot of opportunities to receive education. These helpful organizations build schools, donate them textbooks or even go to their home to teach them common knowledge as only education can make these people create their different future. Besides, these organizations also hold a lot of activities to appeal people and government to take some pratical actions on these problems. I once joined an activities that you couldn't eat for 30 hours to experience the pain that you feel extremely hungry. Through the activities, people can take these kind of problems more seriously. What's more, some organizations invite some celebraties to go to the remote area and deliver love and courages to those poor and desperate children. We give them practical things, but I think the more important things they need is courage. People who feel upset or desperate would wonder the meaning of the life, so we should show our love to let them know that they are not alone and many people still care about them.
I once read a book which was written by a Korean movie star, and she wrote down all the scenes that she had seen in Africa. After reading the book, I told myself that if I have chance, I must go to that place at least one time in my life. Maybe I can go to the old man centers to keep them company or be a volunteer first to learn how to care about people. Love makes the world round, if every one contributes a little, those poor or hungry people can get a lot. I hope I can be a great man who can make whole world filled with love and smile in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is very common to see some advertisements about charities recruit young people to donate theirselves as volunteers. In my school, there is also a club which regards helping people as it's priority. Why being volunteers is so prevailing now, and what are them going to do?
Those charities or nonprofit organizations do many things to help others including donating money, teaching poor children after school, or diagnosing without any pay. Last year, I attended a camp which held by church. They hired some dentists and asked them to do some basic examination to the poor children in Taitung. The thing other teenagers and I needed to do was playing and singing with those children. In there, I found that many of children were homeless or physical challengers but they always wore big smile on their faces. I remembered that one day a little girl told me that she wanted to grow up soon and found her mother who works in Taichung. In that time, I couldn't help but cry. Maybe it was an easy thing to us, but it was an impossible dream to her. Suddenly, I realized that how lucky I was.
Being volunteer was a very special experience in my life. It can broaden my horizon and help me to have more sympathy to others. So precious the chance of being volunteer that I hope that it can be more and more people to join it.

subject: HW0901
content:
The newspaper reports: in Taiwan, more and more young people give up their jobs or not hurry step into the workfield, they choose to be a volunteers in NPO, nonprofit organizations, to help people to pass the difficulties of life. The volunteers can provide their knowledge, skills, time to common people who need. Some volunteers are college students, they spend summer and winter vacation on tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, to accompany the children with activities. Some volunteers take care of the elderly, bringing them lunchboxes, staying with them. When the elderly without children got sick and no one can help them, the NPD's volunteers will take them to see a doctor and bring them back to the hospital to check health situation regularly.
Some volunteers may not show up in front of the people who need help, but they can hear people complaints, sorrow, sad things through teleplone, they will listen to the bottom of their heart, and then give some advice. I joined the environmental protection organization when I was twenty-five years old. On weekends my friend and I will go hiking with backpack. We picked up the garbage, trash along the road and put it in backpack instead of food. We love mountains in Taiwan, and want the everyone can cherish the land of Taiwan to give a better place for next generation.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more nonprofit organizations are set up in the world, and they provide some important services for people. First, they often run refugee camps when disasters broke out, providing food and care for refugees. They help victims of the disaster to rebuild their house and school, and they also protect refugees from the disease.
Second, they give their hand to the poor in remote areas or developing countries. They set up a simple school for poor students, educating them and making them laugh. On the other hand, they also provide the poor with food and shelter.
If I had the chance to take participate in nonprofit organizations in the future. I would like to follow their teams to teach poor children and those in remote areas. Because I major in Chinese in the university, I wish that I can teach them some essential words and sentences in an interesting way. I will make those students laugh and make them feel that they are not alone in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Volunteer work really means a lot to not only individuals but also nonprofit organizations. Today, these kind of organizations recruit volunteers to have their assistance. For example, some could be sent to the remote areas to help with these children's schoolwork. What's more, another would go to disastrous places to deliver food and necessities as well as help to reconstruct their houses. Also, the other may fly to some developing countries to run refugee camps, setting the homeless down to make the operation of their society more stable. Accordingly, the services provided by these organizations has been played an indispensible role in this advanced world.
With the conciousness that volunteer work is meaningful in one's life, I have been to some hospitals to be a volunteer. The work I have done brough a wealth of merits to me. To begin with, it is through this activity that I have acquainted with people who have same ideas with me and know the importance of the relationship among people. In addition, I have put into practice what I learned in school. No matter how much I learned in school, I think it is more important to put it into practice. Last but not least, as the saying goes, "It is more blessing to give than to take." Through these experiences, I received lots of appreciation from the patients and their smiles after get along with them.
With the work I mentioned above, volunteer work really means a lot to me, and so will it do to you if you take on it.

subject: HW0901
content:
I think that helping people who have no money to see a doctor is such an important service. Many people are too poor to see a doctor, and the disease will make them unable to make money. In other words, they will become more poor and weaker. It is important that doctors volunteer to treat those who are in need with no return.
I went to a hospital to help patients two years ago. It impressed me a lot. I saw many people yelling in pain in emergency room, and I even saw a person whose shirt was dyed red by his blood. But luckily, they were all cured and went home a few days ago.
I have gathered hundreds of books to sent to a school which was located deep in mountain. The children in that school had a little book to read, so I thought that they needed book to expand their knowledge. The children were so happy when they saw piles of books was sent to their school's library. Seeing their laughter, I felt proud of myself.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many nonprofit organizations have been founded so far. Some of them provide education for children in remote areas, and some of them run refugee camps in poor countries where forgotten wars continue to cause suffering. There are also other important services that are provided by these organizations, such as emergency medical aid, medical care, and so on.
I have been a volunteer in several hospitals. I listen to the patients, providing what they need. I also tell them fascinating stories so that they won't feel bored. Not until I have done these things did I realize that the true happiness lies in helping others. In the future, I would like to do more things to help more people. I may join the organization called "Doctors without Borders." Their philosophy that everyone has the right to medical care, regardless of race, religion, or nationality, is similar to mine. I am impressed by their attitude toward anyone who needs help. I would like to provide any kind of help as long as I can. It may be a life-changing experience. At the thought of helping more and more people, I can't wait to apply for the membership of the organization.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, a great number of human beings have donated themselves into charities and thus leads to a phenomenon that nonprofit organizations have established in a rapid speed. Even though the contribution they offer is hardly to calculate, it can still be divided into different aspects.
Primarily, whenever and no matter where a natural disaster occurs, citizens there will receive immediate supports and inspirations from those organizations, which somewhat even faster than the goveronnment. Additionally, volunteers in those parties would love to improve and even transform the countries not so developed. Undar this circumstance, supporting their education, benefiting their economy and applying some essential goods in daily life as well will be the main actions they take.
With the understanding that I should have done some volunteer work which benefits the humankind, I desire to take part in it by two means. Briefly speaking, I prefer donating little amount of capital and teaching children who live long distance from cities, where is not enough educational facilities and resource as well since I don't possess much time and money.
In conclusion, the exist of various nonporofit organizations indicates than man are not only willing but be able to help others. As a consequence, to contribute more to those charities can leads the world to a improved and more helpful condition, which is the most important destination of those organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
Todays, we can see many nonprofit organizations work out to help people around the world. These nonprofit organizations try their best to help people, such as visiting the residents in developing countries and gave them economic helps, saving those who were under starvations, and giving a hand to whom suffered from disasters.
While I was surfing the Internet, I visited a website where if you answered the questions correctly, they would give twenty pieces of rice for each question to those who are starved to death in developing countries. Think of how many people will be saved by you just through a click on the mouse. It's worth doing it.
I have also volunteered to raise money, too. Just after standing on the street and felt exhausted did I know that how great those who devoted themselves to nonprofit organizations are However, I had a sense of fulfillment after I accomplish it. I knew that I will join in more nonprofit organizations in the future, and if I were rich enough, I would share what I have to people in need.
Just a little time or money to you, it would be helpful to them. So, why not volunteer to help others?

subject: HW0901
content:
In my opinion, I suggest that some nonprofit organizations provide some food, clean water and clothes. I think clean water is the most important, because once the children drink some dirty water from poluted rivers, they will get sick quickly.
As far as I'm concemed, I have been a volunteer in an ophrage. Before the day I went, I found some clean clothes that I no longer wore. While I were doing this, I felt happy and excited, because I knew the children may be very happy when they see these beautiful clothes. I went to the ophrage with excitement the next day. When I entered a small classroom, all of the children ran over there and said "thanks for visiting us". I'm almost moved when I saw their faces with happiness. But a few minutes passed, I noticed a little boy whose face wore some saddness. I walked foreward and talked to him; however, he smiled at me. Then I just knew he is a shy boy. He just needed someone that can chat and play with him. I also taught him how to make new friends.
To sum up, although food, clean water and clothes can be bought or donate, there is one thing that money never can buy: ture love and care.

subject: HW0901
content:
What's the basic power to support Taiwan? We have profit organizations in Taiwan, and we also have nonprofit organizations. Nowadays, the developing nonprofit organizations play an important role in Taiwan.
There are several famous nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. Like , this kind of nonprofit foundations are setting goal to help people those who are poor or suffering dramatic disasters. Some nonprofit organizations are devoted themselves to prove and protect environment. Besides, if you suffer unfair treatment, you can ask for help to another kind of organizations.
Though I never being an volunter to help people in society, I will devoted myself to do something good for them in the future. I am quiet willing to tutor children in remote areas with what I learned from lesson.
In my opinion, we receive people's help in society from time to time. Thus, if we have ability or money, we should be a giver to help people who are in need. We pass our passion and kindness from giving. The passionate and kind features of Taiwanese will be the basic power to support and lead Taiwan to a better society.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are serveral kinds of nonprofit organizations running different kinds of services all over the world.
Most of them provide services such as helping the poor in undevelopment countries. They give food, various kinds of source, and even provide medical service, and education to the poor. These kind of nonprofit organizations, not only support them to sustain their life, but also teach them how to survive.
The other kind of organization is like the Green. They protect the global, the environment that we are keeping destroying. They send information about how the enviromental condition on the earth is getting worse and warming us that the climate has changed a lot since last decades. The Green organization help us to understand the importance of respecting the environment.
Last year, I was a member in Amnesity International. What we do is write letters to different countries and ask the government to release innocent prisoners and respect human right. The main point of the group is to protect human right.
In the future, I would like to be a volunteer in various areas. I want to tutor childrens in poor countries such as North Thiland and Africa, and I also would like to help with rebuild historical building in Europe.
Invoving in an nonprofit organization is always very meaningful. You are not just giving out your ability to help the sociaity, but you also learn a lot from them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play a center role in some region suffering the disasters. They provide relief goods for victims and help them reconstruct their home after the catastrophe. For examples, if an earthquake happened and buildings collapsed critically, these nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers went to the site in no time and rescued the residents under threat to keep away from this area. Furthermore, these volunteers provided the victims with medical resources and shelters to see them through the difficulty. Another things that nonprofit organizations would do is to help developing countries construct better life standards and finance the poor and remote areas.
As far as I am concerned, I would like to do such works to help those people in need. I will serve as a doctor to combat the patients' pain without profit-driven mind. I want to help people ride out the storm in that I can't endure to see them suffering such torture. What's more, I would like to teach the poor children about common sense or professional skills. I believe that if everyone has a willing and kind heart to help, the world will be different from today and a wonderful one.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organization are set up and recruit volunteers to help people who are ignored and tutored phsically and mentally in our society. These organization and volunteers are so kind that they devote themselves and try their best to arose and explore the bright side of the society.
The nonprofit organizations provide all kinds of important services. In the world, many people are too poor to have enough money to eat and survive. They can't support themselves, don't mention to raise their children. Therefore, organizations and funds collect money and food to help them. What the volunteers give them is not only dialy uses but also their love and compassion. Moreover, they gather old or second-hand books to remote areas in Taiwan. Children there are lacking in many resources, including educational materials. Through this way, it can decrease the gap between cities and countries.
For me, I don't have any experience as a volunteer. However, I am very willing to join in nonprofit organization in the futurs, such as the member of Red-Cross. It means that I have extra ability to help people and it can prove my worth. I have a lot of enthusiasm to be one of their members. There are many bright sides in the society, in fact.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, people lead a much convenience and happy life than before as our government and society keeping in progress. However, there are still numerous people who need others' help. As I know, many charities and orphanages were constructed by government's financial support. They provide food and accomidation for orphans, abandoned elderlies and they also distribute money to poor families. I think it is indispensable to have these charities and organizations. Without them, many people will probably under starvation or even die.
As a student, I can't donate much money to help them, all I can do is to be a volunteer. I have been thinking of being a volunteer. I have been thinking of being a volunteer for a long period, and to my surprise, I was admitted to the college on April, so I joined in volentary work two months ago. I work three times a week in the morning. There are many physically and mentally challenged kids, most of them are under ten years old. My job is to assist teachers. For example, I take children who are in wheelchairs to the bathroom. I also feed them lunch because they like to play with their food or they can't concentrate on eating. Although it's not a tough job, I still learn a lot from it, and I have started to cherish what I own.
After summer vacation, I will quit this job and study in Taipei. I think I will miss those kids and teachers very much!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations are established. It is a organization that help people in need or safeguard our social well-being. Some of them like charitable organizations devote their time to caring for elders. Due to their help, Our society is full of love. No one die in a circumstance that nobody knows. Because of them, people will not feel hopeless when natural disaster happen to us.
On the other hand, some nonprofit organizations are set up for consumer interests. They spare no effort to find out some illigal companys. For instance, a growing number of companies either exaggerate their quality of products or make false claims. As a result, many customers may incur losses because of it. they can ask this kind of organization for help if they want to sue someone.
To sum up, we have benefited a lot from nonprofit organizations. Owing to them, we always can find someone to help us. If I have a chance to serve in nonprofit organizations, I'm firmly conviced that I will be as happy as a lark. After all, offer is alway better than gain.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations nowadays. They become an important part in our society that nothing can replace. Some provide occupation training to the disabled while others reach out to the refugees. Take the Red Cross for example. The Red Cross sells little things and takes the money they earn to provide food and supplies to those in need, such as victims in natural disasters.
I've once been a volunteer selling things on the streets to raise money for the vegetables. My friends and I got a tray full of products and a can to collect the receipt. We peddled all day and made quite some money. That day, I went home exhausted and yet very satisfied.
There are many people out there waiting for a helping hand. These organizations and volunteers can bring them supports and warmth. Besides, it is not just the receivers that gain happiness. The happiness of being a volunteer is also incomparable.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are some nonprofit organizations in Taiwan, and all of them provide some services to help people in need. First of all, they provide free meals for homeless people and poor people. Some refugee camps are also established to maintain the sufficient of food for homeless people. Take my experience as an example, when I was in my senior year, there was a meal plan of Tsu-Zi organisiation for children with serious symdrome. I became one of the volunteers to serve meals for them. The smiling face and delighted words which they showed is always in my memories. The next important service is to teach people understand how to help in emergency. There are some advertisements and flyers delivering a telephone number for preventing children abuse. If you over-heard the violence taking place, the number is handy for you to save a life.
There are many services that organizations try to help people in needs. Nevertheless, they are lack of human resource to deliver the blessing message. It may be our chance to share our love, to understand and to join a volunteer project now and in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations devolop. They give a favor to those who are in need.
In the world of what nonprofit organizations do, turtore children in remote area, build refugee house, and spread food or drinks when disasters happen or so. Turtore kids in remote area so that they can catch up with people in city. Running refugee camps keeps the poor from terrible weather after they lose where they live. Not only do volunteers appear in disasterous time, but they also take activities for donating money in daily. Things they do are beyond description.
I did this kind of work when I was in elementary school. I took care of patients in the hospital and prayed for those who were still in danger. What's more, I donated money or clothes once a week.
I will continue to support nonprofit organizations. "Heal the world and make it better place for entire human place." Michael Jackson said.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations play an extremely significant part in our lives. Contributions are given by many people after they join these groups. Regarding the phenomenon, I believe there are probably some important reasons.
Primarily, people are under impression of helping others can somewhat make them feel happier in a high-pressure life. Therefore, they dedicate to those organization to set out giving people who are in need a hand. Take the recent disaster in Taiwan for example, H1N1 virus has amazingly influence our livings. Consequently, people from the charities head for the area which are in danger to offer medical supply, food and rescuing devices. Also, they soothe people suffering from the disease. What they do really make a difference in our society.
As far as I am concerned, I have volunteered in the library. Not only did I settle all the books on the shelves, but also helped readers find the books appealed to them. I have acquired a lot of knowledge for helping people. Obviously, I have as well gained many tips to getting along with others. Thus, many obstacles in my life are solved easily owing to my volunteering in the library.
In conclusion, no matter how busy we are under the stress of working, those nonprofit organizations deserve our attention. Only can we participate in the groups can we live a more wonderful and abundant life.

subject: HW0901
content:
From my point of view, nonprofit organizations benefit our world. They provide us with spiritual and material services. For example, after a disaster, they always go there as soon as possible to calm the crowd and help people to rebuild their hometwon. Under these circumstances, they conduct the crowd to face any problems. On the other hand, the organizations supply the medical treatment to the poor. Also, educating the children is a part of their plan.
In my experience, I have been a volunteer teacher to tutor children. Several years ago, I participated a group. The leader was nice and taught us to love children. At that time, I learned a lot from the process of training. Tutoring children is an amazing job. Although some of them were naughty, I loved them so much. It's known to us that time and tide wait for no man. We should seize time to do anything possible to help others in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
As far as I am concerned, I attended an organization for doing nonprofit job. In the job, numerous university students and I helped junior high school students doing their assignment, solving their problem in class. The parents of junior high school students are divorced. In brief, they had to work hard to earn money to make-ends-meet. They couldn't put too much mind on their children's grade or speeding time with them. In addition, those children felt sorrow and grief when they encounter their parents broke up. So they would be too shy or timid when I tried to talk to him/her. Every time they asked me how to dissolve some promble, I would teach they how to use the formula. If they solved the problem correctly, I would carrass their head. Sometimes the organization will prepare snack to the students who behaved well. For doing the job, I feel happy and become ecatasy. Happiness prevailed in the atomosphere, It goes without saying that I sacrifice my time on it. But I didn't mind it because I gained much valueless experience.
In Taiwan, there are several non-profit organization. For example, "Teacher Chan" helps people share their saddness, talking to someone when people feel helpless. Furthermore, "Chi Zai" is an organization which sends shirt or food all over the world. "Chi Zai" even shares food in the Africa!! They also organize a foundation to earn money for people who encounter earthquake in South Asia. To sum up, the organization on above try their best to help others. I made up my mind to join them in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Seeing the heavy casualties caused by an earthquake, I was frightened and admired what nonprofit organizations had done to the damaged areas. Since then, I've decided to join them as a volunteer.
Nonprofit organizations always give those who in need a helping hand. They supply food, clean water, clothes, shoes, money and so on. They help people in need get through their difficulties. It is nonprofit organizations that make the world more peaceful.
I have an unforgettable experience that made me become a more mature man of being a volunteer in Swaziland, a country in Africa. Our main goal was to help them how to use computers which were supplied by a company in Taiwan. At first, I felt a bit nervous and scared due to the stereotype that countries in Africa are full of diseases and political chaoses. However, I've learned a lot from this experience. Well goes an old saying, "Never judge a book by its cover." Although we belongs to different races, we still can become good friends.
As a result of the special experience, I've altered my attitude toward life. Whenever I feel frustrated, I will tell myself that it's not the end of the world, there are still people living from hand to mouth. Moreover, I've made up my mind to spend more time doing volunteer work instead of idling my life away. Doing volunteer work is sure to make you know how lucky you are.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations help those who in need with their facilities and volunteers. For example, the Red Cross organization help the poor and sick people around the world and provide them the equipments of treatment and medicine which can cure the aliment. And the Consumer Protection fundation do their best to make sure that the manufacters won't produce the products with low quality and keep the price of goods from raising and inflating. Their services help the world to be better, and their power is combined by the donation of incorporation or individual and, the most important, the enthusiastic volunteers.
When I was a high school students, I volunted to attend a kind of activity called "The fairy in the mountain" every winter vacation. Being the fairy is a kind of work to teach the students in the mountain. Because they don't have enough source of education, their study may be difficult and that's why we wanted to help them. When I met them in a little school in the mountain, I was surprised at their classroom. All they had was slagge dask, broken chair and a blackboard seems to be used for more than twenty years. To my amazing, they students were very happy and when we taught them some knowledge, they were all ears, not like the lazy urban children. Although our mission was teaching math and English, we were usually taught by the little students. Some aborginial children taught me how to distinguish the different between two kinds of toxic flower and how to sing with the whole holy and great nature. I broadened my mind and enriched my knowledge during the time I stayed in the mountain. Though these works and dedication were not lucrative, they brough a lot of meaning and lecture about paying regardless of gain. There ideas were strange to the previous indifferent me, but they were all means when teaching the little students poor in substain but rich in soul.
When I left the forest and waved goodye to my excellent students, I felt honorable and be proud of myself. I will never forget the child like faces of them. So if I have the opportunity of being the fairy in the mountain again in the future, I will be bound to be the first without hesitate and devote all myself on the "real fairies in the mountain."

subject: HW0901
content: There are so many services provided by nonprofit organizations. First, they donate money to charities. Second, they also collect some clothes and shoes from everybody and then distribute to people who are in need. Third, they can also help to built a hospital to cure the people in poor country of their disease. Take myself as an example. When I was in the third year of junior high school, I had such experience to help other people. I went to an organization, called "Home of Love", and its goal is to let homeless children have chances to study. I went there for one week as those children's teacher and I also told them a couple of interesting stories. It was the happiest memory for me, and such good behavior made me feel my soul was purified. Seeing the smile on those children's faces, I felt so satisfied. If I had chances to help other people in the future, I would like to cure patients in poverty countries. To realize this dream, I have to study hard so that I can persue my goal of becoming a generous doctor. At that time, I will be able to devote myself to society, and make different meanings of my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
People show a sense of union in difficult times. We take pity on those who suffer from starvation, diseases, natural disasters, and wars, being sympathetic to them. While seldom do we take concrete actions to help them get through the difficulties besides raising money for them. In view of this, some active and passionate people set up many nonprofit organizations, such as the Red Cross Organization, the Green Peace Organization, etc. They have the same essence, that is, to have all the humans in the world live a better life. Take the Red Cross Organization for example, they go to countries at war to save the wounded soldiers and people living there regardless of their own safety. And they also provide medication services in many developing countries. Another example is the World Health Organization. It is devoted to preventing some epedemics from spreading, such as AIDS and the New Flu.
I hope someday I can be a member of the Red Cross since I'm touched by their spirit of sacrifying. And my dream is to be a doctor. Being capable of saving people who are in estreme pain means a lot for me.

subject: HW0901
content:
Helping others is the essence of happiness. As a matter of fact, everyone needs other's help sometimes. That is to say, one cannot live in the world alone without other's help. To the best of my knowledge, there are some nonprofit organization springing up nowadays, recruiting some volunteers to lend helping hands to those who are in need. To begin with, some organizations send handouts to those who are suffer starvation-striken pains in some poor countries. Furthermore, they would raise money to help people rebuilt their homeland in some countries that are prone to happen natural disasters such as earthquakes or droughts. Above all, they also offer medication services to people in some undiveloped countries. With these organizations helps, our world would become better and better. Afterwards, it is human's helping each other that contributes to human's posperity and existences.
I would like to take some volunteer work in the future. If I could, I would like to be a tutor to teach children who are lack of educations. Helping others is so important that we should all do our best to help those who are in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
Just like the old saying, Giving is better than receiving. Nowadays, more and more people like to work as volunteers to help others who are needed. Some nonprofit organizations offer tutor and medical care in remote areas in Taiwan.
I was a member of a volunteers' team last summer. We went to a small villige located in the mountains in Hwalian. We gave tutor and medical care to the villigers. We also brought some books and groceries for them. I taught the children in the morning and helped the medical care at night. We stayed there for two weeks.
At the day we were leaving. The villigers hosted a thanking party for us. I learned a lot in the volunteer's team, like how to teach children and how to nurse the patients. I felt joyce filled my mind after helping others. So I decided to join the volunteer work again this summer.

subject: HW0901
content:
When you turned on TV, you could see many disasters happen. Upon these happening, nonprofit organizations must be there to rescue wounded people. Taiwan is earthprone. There were a horrible earthquake hitting Taiwan ten years ago called 921. Also, there were a terrible earthquake happening in China last year. But we also could see these organizations volunteering to rescue people. I thought that they were worth respecting.
As for me, I have been to hospital to volunteer once. At that time, I spent three hours a day and went there for ten days. I helped the doctors do some trivial work there. When I volunteered there, I saw many wounded patients and sad relatives. On seeing these, I would not only stay with them but encourage them that never give up. I believed the saying, "Giving is better than receiving." So I was not regretting being a volunteer. I even could learn some skills from it. If I had another oppotunity to volunteer, I would like to volunteer again.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations that volunteer to provide services. To begin with the help they give after disasters, they help government rescue people in danger. Besides, they offer food and clothes to those people who lost everything in the disaster. Moreover, they take care of the sick. By doing this, they not only help sick people but also relieve the pressure of their families. It's because that their family will have time to work and to earn money if someone could look after the sick member. What's more, they go to countries that aren't developed like Africa to educate their people. They believe that education will reduce the problem of poverty.
In my experience, I have gone to a remote area in Taiwan to show science experiments to the children. I prepared a simple experiment and showed it in front of the kids that studied in a school that was in mountains. After the experiment, I explained the reason in the way they could understand. It was a great time with the children.
To sum up, I firmly believe that no matter what service a person or an organiznation provides, it's alway a good action and a pleasure to do it.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are lots of organizations in all over the world are helping people in different ways. For instance, there are lots of doctors devote theirselves to check out people's body in poor countries without any salary. They give people in poor countries some treatments and make them more healthy. There also some organizations are helping the elder people. They take care of the old people there and talk with them. These organizations make the elder people warmer and not feel lonely at all. These kinds of organizations all origined from some volunteers.
I have once been a volunteer. I went to help elder people with my friends in club. We performed for these people and talk with them. I considered it was an easy work at first. But after the day, I thought that is hard to communicate with a person you haven't meet with. I learned a lot of new things from this experience and felt quite happy from it. With this good experience, I will go to the same place once a month a Sunday. I wish what I do will make them happy.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more organizations today. They always volunteer to help those who have economic problems. They no only give some money to the poor, but also concern about the children's education and the old people's lives. They might also provide some food and clothings. In addition, they give phone calls to concern these disadventaged people. No matter how far, they will still reach there to give a help hand. Their love can spread to everywhere in the world.
Since I went to senior high school, I have done a lot of volunteers. I spent my summer vacation to library helping how to arrange the books and read the books with little children. Besides, I also went to hospital to help the patients. I learned to take care of them well and see many scared scenes. I think to help others can let me aquire a lot of good experiences. Just like the saying, "Giving is better than receiving."

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people giving out love around the world. The nonprofit organizations provide not only mental services but also physical services to help people get through tough time.
Take those who take care of the children that are abused, not only do they provide them with safe places to live in, but also comfort them with love. As for the refugee camps in developing countries, those volunteers take the risk of getting diseases just to make sure the need can live on clean water and enough food. Some organizations also help the orphans with their education, such as the Children Profit Organization where I once voluteered to help. Most of the children live there because their families couldn't afford their livings. All we have to do was keep accompany with the children. I spent the time after school with a little boy there. Sometimes, I help him with his homework, sometimes I play with him. It's not what presents or cookies you gave him that matters, but the love and happiness you brought to him.
"Giving is better than receiving", this is the saying that affects me the most. While you sacrifice and provide the world with your efforts, the world will be filled with love and become more harmonious.

subject: HW0901
content:
It has become a trend in recent years that people anticipate in the nonprofit organizations to share their loves to every corner around the world. People who volunteer in the lines of sharing their loves have risen up rapidly, too.
Some nonprofit organizations take a big part in making the world better. Due to the wars, starvations, or other reasons, people which are in needed of medical cares, clean water, or food are provided by these kinds of organizations.
When the trend of being volunteers had started, the ideas of giving was better than receiving appeared in my brain. I decided to volunteer in an emergency room in a local hospital. First, I was horrified about the bloody things. However, I learned life was precious after doing the volunteers in the hospital.
According to my opinions, these volunteered acitivities taught me an unforgettable lesson, and what I believed was that the nonprofit organization's volunteers would still raising. The volunteers weren't just concerned about their own benefits but sharing the loves. Sharing the loves worldwide, and they were the people should be honored.

subject: HW0901
content:
Love is power. Having love, people can do many things. In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations where we can give our love to others.
World Vision is the one that people can often heard. They have an activity called "hunger for thirty hours." During these hours, people can drink water only. It's a wonderful way for people to experience what most Africans have been through. The money saved from meals will be used to establish school, build shelters and offer food to those in need.
I have done some volunteer work in my neighborhood. Every Saturday afternoon, I help to rearrange books and dust desks in the library near my house. But the most exciting thing was that I read stories to children last summer. We really had a good time.
Why do many people in Taiwan do volunteer work? It's because they receive the most precious present, smiles, as I do. The payback is priceless. When we serve others, we serve ourselves, too.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are no denying that some people who are in need live in the serious way. It's important for us to give them our hands and help them to earn some money and live in the more comfortable way.
Nonprofit organization is prevail now, which courage people to help others who are in need. They go to the elders home, who live by themselves, giving them some money for them to buy some food. They go to the remote areas to help the tutoring children who love reading and studying. Nonprofit organization also go abroad and help the people who live in the city which is poor or was devasted by earthquake, typhoon, and so on. The volunteers of the nonprofit organization deliver their unselfish love to all over the world and make our world getting better and better.
I was a volunteer in the hopsital which nearby my home. Being a volunteer is the most happy and unforgettable thing in my life, which adds color to my life.
In the hosptial, I have to take care of patients and help the nurses to tackle many kinds of urgent condition. In the begining, I was nervous and shocked by the patients' scars and their sickness. After a long time of practice, I became a good helper in the hospital. This experiment is an important period of my life. The unforgettable memory plays an important role in my life.
I will continuously be a volunteer in the future, because I think helping other people who are in need is a good thing.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent decades, nonprofit organizations become more and more essential towards people in need. Volunteers are need every corner in the world to help those with living problems. Take Taiwan as an example, there are some important services provided by such organizations.
First of all, free lunch is provided to children that are unable afford it. As every youth should have equal chances to learn under the same conditions, it is definately unfair for them while having no food to eat. As a result, such organizations may reach out and raise money and goods for them by holding parties and performances. Second, as every students should be treated equally, every single individual shoud have the same chance to learn. Therefore, volunteers then may be sent out from organizations to remote areas in Taiwan to tutore those kids in different aspect. They will not be taught only in how to study text books and also the attitude when facing people.
Last lunar new year, I had a chance from my school to help the old around my community. I help them to clean up their houses and put up some decorations to show the coming of the new year. Though it was a hard work while cleaning, I were fulfilled finishing the task.
As a old saying goes, "Giving is better than receiving", you will absolutely experience and receive more than you can imagine. Show respect to those who are willing to sacrifice themselves. Last but not the least, be thankful to people around you!

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, more and more nonprofit organizations have appeared. No matter devoting money or time, they all want to acheive a same goal, do their best to help even rescue those who need their help, such as: running the refugee and taking care with the old.
First begin with, they are so many natural disasters, tsunami, earthquake, typhoon...ex cetra. All of these horrible disasters might damage not only the building but the family. After these disasters, the country might appear lots of hugry, homeless and depressed refugee. At that time, the volunteers of such organizations will pop up and provide some nessesary staff, food. They will help them overcome the difficulties. Moreover, taking care of the old in hospital or at home might have a great patient and passion. The volunteers might endure the "stranger" bad habbit. Combined with lonely and unhappiness they might have bad temper. At that time, the volunteers should use there wisdow and profession to encourage and persuade the old to accept them and their help.
There still have abundance kinds of sevices provided by nonprofit organizations. Due to my age, I haven't done any works of it. But I know in the future I will do my best to participate in these kinds of organizations. I have to be so thankful of my life, holding the cherished heart to become a volunteer and help those who really need my help.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the global economy soaring, the developed countries have become even stronger. On the contrary, some developing countries economy worsen, which arouses people's attention to this extreme situation.
Food Bank, an nonprofit organization, found by a middle-age American. He has been aware of the food shortage for a long time and determined to establish an organization to solve this problem by calling for people's generosity to donate money and food and distributing it to areas and people in need.
Nursing home, an important and also nonprofit organization, found by a group of nurses, who realized that there are lacks of medical assitances in battle fields. Kind and sacrificed, this organization sends many nurses to these dangerous areas.
As for me, I have worked as an volunteer in a hospital. I ran some errands such as typing some reports and buying medical equipments. Easy as it may be, I've learned a lot from this precious experience.
In the future, I will devote myself to be a doctor and dedicate all my life in helping those who need me. After all, everyone is a unique individual given some abilities to help others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people realize that to live a meaningful life is to help others. An creasing number of volunteers attend nonprofit organization such as Tsi-gi, churchs, or budist organizations to help with their work and to cultivate their self-growth.
As I know, Tsi-Gi has always been one of the first arrivals on the site of any disasters to help the victims who suffered from it. They are there to provide food, comfort, or medical assistance. I didn't join this organization, but I donate money to this charity.
I am a volunteer story-teller in Taichung Story-telling organization. We often go up to mountain area to tell stories to the kids up there. Thanks to the lack of educational resources, the kids up in the mountain do not receive the same quality of educational rights.
This coming summer, several friends and I are organizing a free summer camp up in Qi-Li mountain for grade 1 to grade 4 students there. We hope to help the students up in the mountain to build a positive life value, to learn English and to expose to different life styles.
Giving is better than receiving. Every time when I help someone, I feel so happy. Actually I am the one who has learned a lot of things from them. To live a meaningful life is to help others!

subject: HW0901
content:
Every now and then, we heard from the news about volunteers funding charities to assist those people in need. For instance, we may acknowledge that organizations are calling for volunteers to help rescuing rafugees in a damage area when a disaster had just strock, or to donate goods or clothes to the poverty, to say is just a few.
Take me as an example. I have never devoted myself into voluntary, but deep in my mind, I symphasize those who are in sufferance, so, if possible, I will really willing to devote myself into helping the poor, the handicape, or the elder.
These days in Taiwan, given the economy recession, poverty rate are booming. Despite the fact that government has take steps to resolve the problem, yet, the result is still under observation. Therefore, to revive our society, we will have to resort to the volunteers who can help decreasing the unemployment rate by teaching people in need skills of running a business, and also, we need volunteers to donate some money in order to let those people who are eager to run a business to realize their dreams.
Finally, even if voluntary asks for no feedback; nevertheless, I deeply believe that while taking actions to help someone in need, you may feel a sense of consciousness, which definately makes you feel good about it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide lots of services to help not only people but also environment. Such as 1. Invoices collection: Put collection boxes around stores. Shopping mall, etc for invoices collecting. Use the bonus of invoice to support their activities. 2. Trash recycle: To classify variety of trash with the types of material. Cans, metal, paper, plastic, then reuse by manufaturer. 3. To be accompany with orphant or elders: During holiday, to have a party with them to fulfill empty in their mind.
I would like to be a volunteer guide in the hospital to help people who are handicap, elders and not capble of writing. In the hospital, we can see that life is so fragile. I hope that I can think more about the life during service in the hospital.I want make it happen some day in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide a wide range of servies. They offer immediate assistance when a violent natural disaster happens. Food, water and daily necessities are brought into the stricken areas. They also form a rescue team to search for survivors. The help of reconstruction of houses is also provided. Besides the immediate help when there is a natural disaster, they also send books, clothes or food to impoverished developing countries in order to help them get through. What's more, some volunteering doctors go to such countries to offer medical services, such as free physical examination and health care. Nonprofit organizations do better the lives of needy people and warm the hearts of victims in stricken areas.
As a senior high school student, I don't have sufficient money to provide nonprofit organizations finantial support. But there are small things that I can do. I collect the old clothes which are too small for me and send them to a recycling station. There, old clothes will be given to poor families who can't afford to buy new clothes. In addition to the collection of clothes, I take part in a meaningful activity at my school. With the approach of summer vacation, my school asks for volunteers to help tutor the children in the remote mountains. In this activity, I not only teach them how to read but also play with them, and therefore form a firm friendship with them. I feel a sense of happiness when I do this work. It is the volunteer work that gives people warmth of society and inner happiness.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, the economic tsunami sweaps many countries in the world, and Taiwan is no exception!
M-shape society has been formed in Taiwan. The number of disadvantaged groups is growing continuously. Therefore, nonprofit organizations intensively recruit volunteers to help with their work, because there are more and more needy people in our society, and who need a great help to get through this hard time.
These organizations provide many services, such as nurishment for the elders, abandoned children, single parents, handicapped, etc. The international nonprofit organizations are more concerned about worsened situations in the developing countries and the third world's countries, which have even threated their people's lives. So they set many refugee camps for those who are homeless.
I am very busy at my work, and therefore, I have few experiences and opportunities to involve these activities, but I truely care about these issues. I hope I may devote myself in the future in this array to help people who are in need, because it is a great honor to have a capacity to help others, and it is a kind of fulfilment of my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are three vital services provided by the nonprofit organizations recently.
First of all, nonprofit organizations donate some money or buy things which are frequently used in daily life to the poor family. With the coming of the financial tsunami, everyone has no option but to only care about themselves. Fortunately, those who are having financial problems are helped by the nonprofit organizations. What they receive from the nonprofit organizations includes money, food, clothes or even computers.
Secondly, nonprofit organizations go abroad to help those who always suffer from the natural disasters. One of the nonfit organization go to the countries which were struck by a tsunami. the volunteers in the organizations not only care to the lives of the people there but also give comfort to them. To illustrate one of my cousins, Alexander, went to help the victims of the tsunami a few years ago. He talked to me that he carry the bodies of dead people as well as cook for the local people on the phone. From that, he had realized how valuable life was. Last but no the least, some doctors in the nonprofit organizations go to some uncivilized countries in African countries. They not only practice medicine but become part of the tribes in the local areas. Without the help of non profit organizations, the people there can never lead a better life with happiness and delight.
There are also some volunteer works I want to do in the future. First, I will clean up the neighborhood I live in, which will protect the environment. Second, the other volunteer work is going to the hospitals to give assistance to the nurses or doctors. This will broaden my horizons if I try it. Finally, the last volunteer work is accompying the elderly who live alone. By talking or chatting with the old, I will learn some Chinese cultures as well as traditions.
In conclusion, there are three services provided by non profict organizations. there are also three volunteer work I want do in the future. The trend of helping others is surely destined to prevalent in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Because people who live in a modern city nowadays can have easier, wealthier and more comfortable lives, a large number of them have more leisure time to participate in some voluntary events. And the most of them will choose to join a nonprofit organization.
The nonprofit organizations provides dozens of services helping people that are in need, such as transportating food, clothes and other daily needs to those encounter landslides, tunami or earthquakes to help them go through the difficulties. What's more, some organizations help with the homeless animals to live a better life, while others try to reach a solution about some unusual disease so that thousands of people that suffer from the sick and can have healthy brand new lives.
In fact, I have just done a volunteer work this week. I went to a foundation whose aim is to make the people who can't move by their own mind in the world be taken care of. I helped them clean the bed and the surroundings there all afternoon. That was not an easy job definitely, but I felt wonderful after the time. This wasn't my first time to such a thing, and, of course, it wouldn't be the last time. If I have another chance, I would love to raise money, and I will tell the people how and where their money is going to be used, this might make them feel more pleased to donate their money.
Doing volunteer work is an unforgettable experience. Furthermore, that really means much to me. I hope that the people with enough ability can do more to make the society much better.

subject: HW0901
content:
I've read a chapter about Jet-Lee's non-profit organization in Reader's Digest few weeks ago. The name of the organization is The One. They help people around the world, especially countries that have been devastated by natural calamity. The organization provides food, human resources, money, daily necessity and medical services...etc. These non-profit organization are also the first to get to the damaged places. Helping with the government settling down some homeless people and injuries.
What they are doing is really beyond description. Although I haven't joined any of these organizations, and may not have the chance to serve for refugees in other countries. I'll like to start after I enter college. I'm planning to spend my free time to teach kids English who live in remote villages, bring them knowledge and joy. Give them what they deserve as we all do. I've recieved lots of help from different people, now is the time for me to pay back, and time to pass down the love we have. The love that's willing to help others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, we often see some volunteers working in nonprofit organizations to help the people in need. They may be helping to take care of the elderly or some physically-challenged people, others may help tutoing children in remote areas, and still others may help to clean up the streets. These organizations are important to us, for they run not for benifits but to help the people in need.
I have never been a volunteer due to my heavy schoolwork, but I would really like to help those who are in need in the future. I would like to help out by tutoring children in remote areas. Those areas are in great lack of educational resources, so the children there couldn't get good education. This may lead to their lose in the highly competitive society nowadays. By helping them out, they could not only enhance their knowledge and abilities but also have contact with the modern society. Only by doing this in my spare time, it could mean a lot to the children. I would really like to help them out.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is no doubt that volunteer works are the good opportunities to contribute what you have to those in need, and it is exactly what nonprofit organizations do. They donate to schools to construct their facilities and advanced computer equipment so that students can learn happily in those environments. What's more, These organizations do favors to the contry during the destruction of natural disaters or economic recession, thus making civilizens here can more easier. The nonprofit organizations also help other contries in many fields, which in the result enhance the national relationship. According to these contribution, I admire those who devoted themselves to the volunteer works.
I did the volunteer work in the hospital before. Because I major in medicine, this experience help me in the future. For example, I got acquinted with many friends with same background there, so we can discuss what we had learned in schools. In addition, I built the close relationship between those friends, and I think it might help me in the future. Last but not least, I got numerous knowledge in this field, which is not taught in the school but important to the career life. With these advantages mentioned above, just try and do it now with no hesitation.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more charities have founded around the world. Due to the huge amount of people exist worldwide. They have no food, nor do water. And we have a very rich society, which bring us much comfort and the sense of security. So some nonprofit organizations are popping up for this kind of situation.
In Taiwan, hospitals built by nonprofit organizations are everywhere, they make those who are poor or disabled could have the services first. And this type of facilities often locate in remote areas. Espencially in eastern Taiwan, Most of the locations are lack of medical services, and these special hospitals certainly save their lives and maintain their quality of health.
In our daily lives, we could easily find numerous boxes of some nonprofit organizations. If we have some money left, we should throw it in. It would not only help miserable people but also make you delightful. We always discover that there are lots of volunteers work no matter in Taiwan or other nations. These days, I also heard a Canadian boy developed his own foundation, which help children in Middle East. We should cooperate and help those people who are suffered.
In the future, if I have a chance, I'll work in such organizations. I think "Giving is better than receiving". We much help each other as we are all human, we should unite and a truly peaceful community. I hope I'll be a man that help people in Africa and Latin America. It will not only save the residents from wars and shortage of food and water but also maintain a good relationship with the countries. Helping others are kindness itself, we should show our kindness and let the human be harmony forever.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have become worldwide since 1990. Undoubtedly, they do lots of efforts to help the people in need and strive to make the world better. We can say that nonprofit organizations are the bright site of humanity.
Nonprofit organizations offer diverse services, dealing with problems from numerous aspects. For instance, international humanity rescuing in country encountering warfare or disease. Few years ago, southeast Asia suffered great tsunami. Nonprofit organizations played an important role, whether in rescuing or reconstruction. Let's turn our view on individual. There're people facing injustice sentence in the world. They can do nothing, but face their doom. Therefore, some nonprofit organizations are dedicated to help those people.
When I was in senior high, I volunteered to be the picket of my school. My duty is to make sure there's no traffic jam in fron of our school's gate. I did my work every morning from Monday to Friday, and earned respect from other students after graduating. In the future, I'd like to visit refugee camps in other country, and do my best to help those in need. I can hardly imagine how bad the condition is in those striken regions, so I think I should do something to change that.
If there was no nonprofit organization in the world, we wouldn't live without worry and would detest humanity. Therefore, we shall regard nonprofit organizations as savior to the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an important role in the modern time. Their intention is not to get money, or win the praise from anyone, but to help people who are in need of them. They provide many services to people, such as giving money to those who confront difficulties, building orphanages to children who don't have parents, or raising money to assit people who are in need, or poor. The reason why they are willing to do so many services to people is that they want to do all they can to help people.
Last month, I went to take care of the old who were lonely. During the period of my visit, I helped them clean the beds, and cooked food for them. When I was talking to them, I found that they were very happy, and tried to say anything they knew to me. As it was time for me to say good-bye to them, what I saw was the sadness appeared on their faces. Then, I made up my mind to help more people in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Here is an old say goes, "Giving is receiving," and more and more people in this world would like to offer their hands to those people in need. If someone doesn't know how to help others, there are some nonprofit organizations can choose. After passing some basic tests, like language tests for those who wants to go overseas, and some trainings, you will become a qualified volunteer to provide some services.
Some important and necessary services provided by these organizations. For example, if you have a M.D. degree, they will sent you to a developing country where is lack of doctors. They also provide language exchange services for those countries that don't have good education systems, or help disable people with daily care.
Take myself for example, I was a volunteer in college club. We provided our help to some junior high school students that don't like to study. We listened to what they were thinking about and what they really care about. Our final mission was to help them find the joy of increasing knowledge.
I would like to be a volunteer in running refugee camps in developing countries. I believe everyone in this world deserved a better life. My life for now is good, it's time for me to help them. I can teach them how to build their own house or how to fix it. I can also teach them some basic English or Chinese to increase their language abilities. To be a volunteer can extend my vision and let me think things with a positive attitude.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this modern society, many things can't be done by the government and the individual because individuals can't achieve the massion on their own and the government has to concern many aspects of problem. For example, concerning the elders, women and children is the most important services in our country. Nursing rooms and orphanges help society to solve some serious problem which many elders and children are neglect by their family. These nonprofit organizations really give hands to those needed people. Additionally, people living in the remote mountain don't have enough resource of medicine care and education. Therefore, many volunteers go to remote areas to help those people get rid of these difficulties. Above of these are common contribution toward the society.
In the past time, I volunteer to spend my relaxing time turtoring children. Not only can I gain my academic knowledge, but I really sense the happy of giving and efforts. After a while, I make lot of friends and receive many unforgetable memory. However, I want to change my nonprofit job. I want to join nursing care in hospital to take care of elders in the future because I can learn the value of lives and deads. In the contemperary, we can't learn the knowledge just from formal school, and we have to walk into society to face some difficulties and salve it in appropriate massure. In conclusion, I will seize every opportunity to be volunteers and contribute myself to our society.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, more and more people value the protection of environment and people rights, and it led to the rise of nonprofit organizations. In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations that provide several different services, such as helping the stray dogs which roam on the street with no food to eat or helping the elderly who are being abandoned by their child and can't live on their own. As for protecting the environment, they would advertise on TV or held some activities to make people buy some environmental friendly products. To me, I have also volunteered to do some works. One of them is to stand on the corner of the streets or in front of the department stores to sell some useful products without any pay. Though, it was really exhausted, somehow the satisfication was such that it filled up my heart with love and happiness. Because I know those money I earned might help many poors. Volunteer works are not only just for help but make you deeply think the true need of those poors. And I hope everyone whether you are busy can support these nonprofit organizations and just do it from now on!

subject: HW0901
content:

In our society, there are still many people get stuggle in life. We should take some actions to help those people from life difficulties.

subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901
content:

I will keep trying my hard to help others. It's not only meanful but also cool. Now, the old sodier regards me as his own grandchildren.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the past, the communicating advices were not so good that we could not know what happened in the world easily but now you can conveniently get any information from internet, TV or radio about the world immediatly and realize that there are still a lot of people need our help. What the organization do is try to gather everyone's little contribution becoming a big power to help different people who needs help. Food supplying can help people who may hunger for a while and stop them eating unclear food to harm their wealth. Free education which especialy in children is very important which can teach them how to read, how to speak and make the right decition. The poor life could easily change a person's mind from good to bad and since we can't change their enviroment totally at least we could teach them how to keep a kind mind. The most important thing that the nonprofit organization do must be free medical treatment. As we know, there're a lot of people died just because they could not get the immediate and propriate medical treatment. The free medical treatment saved a lot of lives in the world.
I have volunteered to teach the orphans in the orphanage before. subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play a crucial role in our society, as well as our world. There are many kinds of nonprofit organizations, for example, some offer relief services in areas striked by earthquakes or tsunamis, another give supplies to children and adults alike in remote areas. Still others help those who are disabled or the elderly voice their needs to improve their poor life quality. No matter what purpose are these nonprofit organizations appeal to, the only thing in common is that they lend their helping hands to those in need without asking for repayments.
I have once gone to a nursing home and helped take care of the elderly. I told them some interesting stories I had heard before or some anecdotes happened in my life. When telling them something funny, they always laugh out loud in great joy. Their happiness not only make themselves healthier but also give me a sense of accomplishment. When taking care of them, I realized the old saying that goes "giving is better than receiving." And I will continue being a volunteer to offer helps for those in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more people pay attention to helping those who are in need. As a result, more people volunteer to help poor people. They will take participation in the nonprofit organizations.
Nonprofit organizations play an important role in our society. They always help people who are in need. For an example, if there are children abused by their family members, they would help children find a safe place to stay. And they would give out food, water, things we need in our daliy lives after big earthquakes. Some organizations even help people quit smoking. They always try their best to help the smokers get through the hard time. They also hold great activities on special days. We always have a good time taking part in the activities.
I have volunteered to teach the children from poor family homework. It was a difficult work but I was really fond of that work. During teaching, I could feel that they were so eager to learn more. They liked to ask questions and solve problems. Furthermore, they always paid much attention to me while I was teaching. It meant a lot to me. I felt a sense of achievement and I thought they were so adorable when they were doing homework attentively. Not only did I teach them many knowledges, but they also broaden my mind and taught me lots of things that I hadn't known before. I had a very good time then, and I wish I could have the chance to do the work one more time.

subject: HW0901
content:
These days, there are many nonprofit organizations in the world. They go to different places to help children or refugees who are tutoring by disasters or wars. We can see these organizations from newspapers. They are always in the first line to help people and they are faster than government. When the China disasterous earthquake happened, they immediately brought a lot of food and water to help the refugees.
