Some children escaped from death and they received a lot of goods and money from the nonprofit organizations. After they grew up, they became a company in nonprofit organizations, too. They want to help people like others helped them when they were children. I wanted to join some volunteer group in the future. I will go to the hospital to be a volunteer this summer vacation. Being a volunteer is one of my dream in the future.
Giving is better than receiving. The nonprofit organizations are the best example for it.

subject: HW0901
content:

The Red cross organization provided many different services to many poor countries, such as, Africa, south America and middle eastern. They gave them no matter foods, clothes and even the medical help. They done all those things with no repay. That is the reason why the organization is so important.

I would do anything I can in the organization to help the poor. No matter provid food, clothes, medical help and even build houses for them. If I can not join the organization, I will send as much money as I can to the organization, to help them buy the things they need to help those poor countries. That is all what I would like to do in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more important services provided by nonprofit organizations. They not only offer free tutoring and refugee camps, but also provide the people who are ill with nursing, take care of veges while their relatives can not stay with them, and rise money for the orphans, etc.
The most famous nonprofit organization which is also impressed me is called Tsu-Chi. The things they do is to help anyone who are inneed. Every time, my heart fufills with happiness when I am hearing this kind of news.

"Giving is better than receiving." I always believe in it. We all have responsibilities to make our world better, don't we?

subject: HW0901
content:
Non-profit organizations, or NPOs surely are today's major social force around the globe. Some NPOs focus on rescue work, national or international. Some notice about enviromental issues. Some work on children carrying. There are also NPOs that made up for people of the same interest like music, sports or arts.
I myself am currently a member of a headphone-loving circle. By joining the web forum we are able to show the equipments we have and the reviews about them. Since the headphones are for listening music, we also discuss it in the forum. Some time we would setup a meeting for the members. subject: HW0901
content:
While most of us live a comfortable and sufficient life, there are still some people living in poverty and crying for help. And this is why nonprofit organizations sprout from the ground. I think some of these organizations DO play a important role in our life, and what they do gradually effect people and make the world better and better.
Some of them send supplies to Africa and have some doctors in there to give people the best care. Some urge us to love the earth by letting us know how beautiful the earth was and what we did to it. Some help people who got AIDS.
Some protect people who don't have human rights. And there are still lots of organizations trying their best to let everyone live in the same and a better way. As to me, I would like to throw myself into protecting the environment. I will take some courses and training about the environment and become a volunteer to let people know the beauty of the earth and teach them what we should and shouldn't do to make the planet as beautiful as before.I want to use my little power to change the world, and this is how every volunteer think.

subject: HW0901
content:
During these years, there are more and more charity organizations appeared around the world. There's no exception in Taiwan. Some of them were founded by religion groups; some of them were established by other specific groups. Both of these groups have the same purpose, "to help people."
These nonprofit groups play an important role in Taiwan nowadays. For instance, if there's a natural disaster happened, they often try their best to help people from danger, and show up immediately, even faster than the goverment. Also, some of them would also take care of those specific groups in our society. For example, there are some charity organizations especially take care people with family-violence, rare disease, or old people with no relatives. With their help, the goverment can realse some heavy burdens of the society.
I used to have some experiences to work as a volunteer in some charity organizations. I used to go to hospitals to comfort those unfortunate patients with cancer. I try to make them happy by playing instruments, and encourage them to fight with the disease by a positive attitude. I also helped those aborigin children with their schoolwork.
I've learned a lot from those experiences. It teaches me how to help people with their needs, and makes me realize that how lucky I am. By seeing these suffering people, I started to learn to cherish what I have. In the future, I would like to keep helping those unfortunate people in these non-profit groups.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many organizations in the world are doing something the make the world better, especially for the life of people in developing or non-developed countries. These organizations recruit volunteers to help them, many people who is willing to help the world become better join them. No matter what happen, these organizations and volunteers will be the first one to arrive at the place where have something needed. These organizations provide everything to help people. Some volunteers become a cook, some become a doctor, a diver, or even a teacher. So people are being helped can continue their basic life tempeoraryly.
In my experience, I have join a club called AISEC in my school. Last winter, I propose a plan to go to India to be a volunteer in local hospital at a place called Mon, where there is also an AISEC there. And finally the proposal was being submitted. I am so glad that my dream come true. I was in India for about one and a half month. Though I have just two hours working time a day, I still stay in the hospital if I was free that afternoon. I know nothing about medicine and the works of doctors and nurses, but I tried to do my best to take care of patient there, passed some document, invited people from AISEC. I think I was doing a wonderful and meaningful work, and I hope I have another chance to go back or go to another place next time.

subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901
content:
I have heard many nonprofit organizations since grade five. In my memory, I donated twenty dollars in exchange for an elaborated card. That was my first donation.
With the time passed by, I knew more clearly what these nonprofit organizations do. They help people in need in many aspects. Some help those who live in remote areas in Taiwan, as the topic description mentions. Volunteers might help them in homework because their parents cannot afford them to cram school.
One nonprofit organizations impressed me tremendously is "." It founded just a few decades. It was founded by a mother whose child was seriously disabled. In Taiwan, the resources in this area is very insufficient. So the founded this organization. It's services are as follows. First, they help take care people who are disabled whether in body or in mind. And the age range from children to old people. Second, they help them to work. Through the work, they found their values in themselves. Third, they recorded their daily lifes and made the films. And showed them in every city in Taiwan, such as Taipei, Hsinchu, and so on. I knew this organization because I saw their films! Since then, I donated all the receipts when I went shopping.
In the future, if I had chance, I might help them in person. If I had no time, I would do my best in the aspect of donations. I know these jobs' cost is very high. And this might be the best thing that I can do.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this society, there are many kind organizations and voluteers. They help people without any profit. Their love is sent to everywhere.
When it comes to these organizations, theyprovide variety of services. Red Cross, an international organization, always rescues people hurt in wars. No matter what racial groups you are, they certainly give you a hand. Besides, some organizations focus on the poor. Education, health, life are included. For example, they provide money for the poor to see a doctor. All these things are done by them. They are really great.
Next, so painstaking the volunteer work is but I obtain and learn more things than I expect. Last summer vacation, I took care of patients in the hospital. Their affectioned parts brought dirty smells; however, I had to endure that and help them to change clothes or chatted with them. It wasn't easy at first. I adapt to it step by step. Now, I know how painstaking doctors and nurses are. I really admire them.
In short, how colorful life we have. It is so nice of you. Thank all the people doing volunteer works for the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, although the financial crisis have struck the economy worldwidely, there are still a numerous of people have volunteered at various nonprofit organizations, such as Tsu-Chi in Taiwan.
As I have known so far, Tsu-Chi offers shelters and camps, provides food and basic living facilities to those disastrous people who lost houses to live during the catastrophic earthquake of 921 in 1999, Taiwan. In addition, Tsu-Chi recycle used clothes from residents and then they will hold flea markets to fund money. Or, they will directly send these abandoned clothes to the poor or someone needed in a short time.
As for me, I had volunteered at the Girls' Dormitory in the University for almost three years. During these three years, I was responsible for cleaning the kitchen and refrigirators, doing dishes and examining the safety facilities in the dormitory. As a matter of fact, I was not used to do so many laboral works; fortunately, I had learned to distribute my leisure time to finish these works during the last year of being a volunteer.
In the future, I would rather go overseas to help other people rebuid houses or educate them about knowledge of disease. Volunteering at any nonprofit organizations makes people happy and enrich their minds. For me, I would take volunteer as my responsibility for my whole life no matter I am rich or poor.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is a growing number of nonprofit organization such as red cross, an international one, and tzu-gi, which first established in Taiwan, recruit volunteers to help with their work. They provided many kind of services, the most important two are as follow.
first, they not only called for large number of volunteer to join them, causing widly concern in cities all over the world, but also remind people around the world have a heart to reach out to the poor and refugees. They provided the connection between the peoples above and below the poor line.
Second, they advocated that volunteers to join the activity of tutoring children in remote areas and running refugee camps in developing countries in person. The more they contrubited, the more love the refugees could be touched by. They told people that only by money or stuffs could only solve the starvation and exposure, we also have to warm their mind by interacting with them. They provided the difect relationship between human beings.
For me, the experience that having been to school in rural areas twice made me really realize that what they really long for is not money, stuffs and equipment, which they are lack of, they need love. Every time I played with them, teaching them somethings, their smiles always make me happy. In addition, they would go into raptures at the merely motion of promising to come again.

subject: HW0901
content:

subject: HW0901
content:
In this time of era, some nonprofit organizations play an integral part in our society. "Nonprofit" organization, as its literal meaning implies, such an organization voluntarily help those who are in need or underpriviladged without return or wage. It not only provides those impoverished with abundant resources, but also assist them in rising above their toughest time in life.
Take me for example. I've worked as an English assistant to instruct those poor children in a church since I was a sophemore in university. In the beginning, I had difficulty communicating with those children since they were naughty and playful. Even though, I still worked on and focused all my concentration on teaching them English alphabet and fundamental grammatical rules. Gradually, they focused their attention on textbooks. From that moment on, I gradually perceived that it takes great effort to kindle children's interest in learning. My heart was replete with joy and contentment when I found that they made grave progress in their academic performance.
From my standpoint, we human beings should be more concerned about our current society. Many people may think that it is time-consuming and meaningless to participate in a nonprofit organization. However, as a member of the society, we should still do our utmost to contribute to the society. Under no circumstances can we always take it for granted that the government should do everything for us. Only when we always think of others can we find our live filled with hope and delight.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, many people enjoy high economic status. By contraction, there are so many people still having nothing to eat. On account of this miserable situation, lots of nonprofit organizations grow up one after another.
Community care is one of the most significant aids. Thanks to the increasing rate of elders, more and more people devote theirselves helping old people made their lives more delighted. They occassionally prepare lunch for the old people. Now and then, they will hold up a party to offer them a leisure time. Always, we can see the elders dance with their beautiful singing voice simultaneously.
Another symbolic volunteer works is to help tutoring children in remote areas. With the astonishing impression in my mind, I will never forget the sight that a child living beside the cemetories was abandoned by his parents. Fortunately, the volunteers of the organization arrived in time or the boy would die in huger.
There are many organizations in this society, but how can I make a contribution to this country? Last summer, I made up my mind to be the volunteer of a hospital without a second thought. I had to take care of the patients and direct people to the correct place. Having experienced this work, I find myself more mature and realize the meaning of life. To my relief, I got the trust from the patient that I took care of. Sometimes, he would pour his heart out to me even cry his eyes out. Believe it or not, we still keep in touch and he has already recovered.
It really take effort to help people in misery. I know that I can't do something marvelous just like these well-known organizations. But the only thing that I know is to cherish everything we have. Don't make your greed blind your heart. Just be content! In the future, if I have the opportunities to be a volunteer via the organizations, I think it will absolutely make my life to the fullest.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more NGO (non-profit organization) groups which develop for specific goals and hopes in Taiwan. I have been a member for some NGO groups for many years, and I hope that I would be their permanent volunteers as long as I could.
When I was a university student, I encountered Would Vision Foundation stuff. He told me about their duties and services provided by their NGO group. For example, they help children who are in single parent family and are insufficent finace for meals to receive donations from everyone. After I graduated and found a job, I have donated some money every month for this group. I have adopted a little boy who lives in aboriginal tribe in Taitung and he sends me a Thanks card every year. For so many years, I can feel his appreciation for the foundation and donor. Every year this foundation would help the hungry strike for thirty hours, and people who join this activity can experience the hungry and suffering that happened in the poor countries.
I also work for AIDS (Aquired Immunode-ficiency syndromes) Foundation which provides AIDS prevention and education for people, shelters for HIV carriers who are rejected by their family then become homeless. This foundation also provides AIDS suffers medical aides, such us medical bills, condoms or other subsidies. From these experience as a voluteer, I receive more than I pay. Every time I see people suffer pain or miserable accidents, I value what I have. As long as I have ability to give others, I would provide without consideration. In my opinion, our society can be safer and warm from these kinds of NGO groups installed.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, helping people from different countries is not a dream anymore. By searching the services provided by nonprofit organizations, you can find work such as transfering foods and medical help to developing countries or war-triggered countries, tutoring young children in suburban areas in remote countries, or running refugee camps in developing countries.
When I was fourteen, I had a chance to see the situation by myself. I went to South Africa for traveling and found out that there were tens and thousands of refugee camps in rural areas and could not figure out how much difference there was between the rich and the poor. My aunt happened to be a member of Tsu-Zi organization and she wanted us to accompany her to the rural areas for offering nutritious foods and medical help. As soon as I got off the car, I was astonished. The mission was not as easy as everyone had thought. You must be friendly so that the residents there would believe in you. And you must be patient or they might get angry because of your careless mistake.
I really had a memberable experience during my two-month stay there, and hopefully one day in the near future, I can help more people by donating my pocket money.

subject: HW0901
content:

They must be afraid after having those terrible experiences. Comforting them and helping them overcome the nightmare are not difficult. On the other hand, you can also run refugee camps in developing countries. Giving them clothes and stationaries would help them live a better life.
I would like to go to hospitals to help doctors and nurses with their work. Though I am afraid of seeing blood, I would try to overcome it. Helping others will make me feel happy and proud of myself.

subject: HW0901
content:

Some nonprofit organizations such as Red Cross, NAL, etc, teach people to take sympathy on developing countries by running refugee camps, other organizations may bring some food or second-hand clothes donated by people to help the poor survive.

Since then, I have made up my mind to help the people in Africa when I'm graduated from the university. subject: HW0901
content:

Though I'm just a teenager, I'll do my best and try to make the world more equal.

subject: HW0901
content:

In conclusion, if people do not have the caring of others, the distance between each other will become bigger. If other people have difficulties and you did not help them, at the time you are in trouble, no one will help you.

subject: HW0901
content:

The chief goal of this organization is to help people who suffer from natural problems, who injured in wars and the place they dwell in don't have sufficient medical equipment. As far as I am concerned, nonprofit organizations always spare their effort to help others. They provide a variety of services. Some mainly offer the service of tutoring children in remote areas; some are devoted to running refugee camps in developing countries, and still others help the old or homeless people.
I have been a volunteer when I was a six-grade student in elementary school. My homeroom teacher took the class to a hospital to take care of, to chat with and to play games with old people. It was an unforgetable experience to me. From then on, I have been decided to be a volunteer work not only in hospitals but also other noneprofit organizations. During the activity, it makes me realize the more I help others, the more joy I will gain. Now, I am a eighteen-year-old girl. I am about to get into a university. I want to join any club that can help people owing to the love of helping others personality.

subject: HW0901
content:
A great appreciation should be deserved by those volunteers recruited by those nonprofit organizations. They devote themselves to help children in remote areas in Taiwan. They also run refugee camps in developing countries. There are some important services provided by such organizations. Firstly, communication support such as Internet and computer hardware and software. It is the most significant which helps shorten the distance and connect between urbans and cities. It also gives the children an opportunity to keep up with the Electronic world. Secondly, these organizations also provide 'language learning' service. It helps kids to build up their studying habits. They also donate lots of reading books to schools and provide free reading lessons. Of course, they also send foreign teachers there to teach English as well. Next, as we know in Taiwan. The children in countries love sports. However, schools or parents are always short of fees and money to support the children, especially hardware facilities. Let's take 'baseball' as an example. The organizations employ retired professional players to coach the children and supply them with bats, gloves and all relevant equipments and facilities to help training our next generation. It's just great that another Cheng-Ming Wang is about to make Taiwan proud again. Lastly, they also provide 'skills training' to help the unemployed and low-income families find their carrer again.
Luckily, I was once assigned by my company to run a camp in countries in Hualian. Basically, we teach kids English there and help them with their daily lives. It was great experience to really see what lives like their and try everything we can to pass positive attitude to those kids there. They are just as the normal kids in cities but with great natural talents.
If there is another vacancy to go to the remote areas. I will definitely voluntee myself and probably this time, I would like to teach the adults English there. In exchange, I would like to know how they educate their children and pass on their experience to them. It will be a treasure for me as I am going to take their suggestions to educate my son without giving him too much pressure.
Once again, these organizations are really doing the right things to help the people and the society.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organization founded to do social welfare affairs. These institutes help not only poor families in remote areas in Taiwan but also people suffering from war and poverty abroad. The organizations help people in need in varieties of ways, such as tutoring children whose parents can not afford them to go to cram schools, or fund to run refugee camps in developing countries.
I admire what those nonprofit organization volunteers do for those people who are suffering. I am moved that how those volunteers devote themself to help people they do know. I think those kind nonprofit organization members must be living god. I haven't done any volunteer work before, but I have my mind to help people who are in need in my daily life. And of course, I will ask my family members and friends to do good things. I would like to live in a world full of love and kindness.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations pop up in our society to help those in need. They provide a variety of services, including coming to refugee's aid. Volunteers of organizations always send medical products, clothes and food to developing countries for the purpose of helping the poor to lead a better life. Without those help, a large amount of people may be confined in broken houses and suffering from fatal epdemices. Besides, volunteers spare no efforts to teach children in remote areas where the government places little attention. The children may have a bright future and be an outstanding person with their help. As a consequence, nonprofit organizations play an significant role in our society out of question, and the mercy which those volunteers do strikes chord with me that I eager for helping others in the future. Since I am good at English, I make plan to teach those who don't have enough money to contact foreign language. With my willing heart, I believe that I can be a successful volunteer and give them opportunities to get in touch with English. To sum up, all of us have to place emphasis on nonprofit organizations. If people are capable to come to others' aid, be volunteers and improve their lives quality. We can find that the world become lovely and joyful with everybody's time and efforts.

subject: HW0901
content:
It can't be over emphasized that people should do something helpful and beneficial to those who are in need. As a result, more and more nonprofit organizations were founded. Because their financial support are mostly from people who donate money, they don't have much money to hire people to carry out the work which they pay attetion to. Therefore, they tend to recruit volunteers to help them. They send food and clothes to the needy, help poor people rebuilt their houses which were destroyed in disasters and teach children for free. Besides, they also run refugee camps in developing countries and provide medical treatments to the countries at war. The purpose of providing these services is quite simple: they want to help others. That's why they devote themselves to the deeds.
As far as I am concerned, I am touched deeply by those who work in such organizations. Doing volunteer work actually is not that hard even for a student like me. I have tutored a boy who was in elementary school for half an year. He lived with his old grandmother and he didn't have enough money to go to cram schools to improve his study. So every evening, I helped him with his homework and corrected the errors. Though he moved to somewhere else after six months, I still cherish the precious experience. From the experience, I knew how happy a person can be when helping others.
Modern people seem to be busy working in their daily lives. But I suggest that they should help do some volunteer work in their spare time. Because they will feel the sweet feeling and happiness of helping others by doing so.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations founded in the world. They provide various important services. When a disaster befalls, and causes lots of destruction or deaths, we can see some nonprofit organizations send volunteers to the area to help people rebuild their houses or cure their phisical and mental injuries.
Apart from that, there are still many services, one of which is lending money to poor people. Will they return the money back? And will this method work? Actually the answer is yes. The poor would make good use of the money, earn more money, and they return the money the borrowed back. This can improve their financial situations.
What's more, tutoring children in remote areas and running refugee camps are also included, and provided by the volunteers in these organizations.
As far as I'm concerned, I would like to volunteer to give an aid to poor or sick people. I want to do my volunteer work in Africa. People in Africa need help. They need education and money to lead better lives, and medical services to have better health, declining the death rate.
It's more blessing to give than to receive. Volunteering to help others will make this world more beautiful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, we can see more and more nonprofit organizations. I once thought of it, why do people do such thing without getting money? As time goes by, I see that the distance between the rich and poor is getting longer, in other words, the rich are getting richer and the poor are getting poorer. What's next? We can also see it between the developing countries and the developed countries. In developing countries, like some in south Africa, naked children with no shoes roaming around, diseases spreading people to people and soon died one by one is commonly seen. But thanks to the nonprofit organizations, nowadays thoes people in Africa have clothes and shoes to protect them from the bumpy roads and also they have hospitals built near their homes. Moreover they give the children advanced education, schools were built and they recruit teachers from all over the world with high salary to teach thoes kids, and the kids don't have to pay any money.
I remember that once their's a commercial made by "Crocs" encouraging people to buy two pair of sandles and give one pair to the company then they will give it to the kids in the undeveloped or developing countries, it also give us lots of pictures of them. Suddenly, it occured to me that there are more people out there that need our help immediatly. So I bought two pairs and encourged my friends, family and teachers to attend this activity. The true nobility is not being superior or advanced to others but to help those in need with all we can do!

subject: HW0901
content:
I could only know things about nonprofit organization providing some services with people in need from TV news or newspaper, until once my friend told me about his experience of being a volunteer.
Such organizations usually provide those in need with food, medical care, and education. Every summer, my friend, Gary, who takes part in such organization, feels good about doing such thing. The organization recruit volunteers to tutor children in remote area in Taiwan every summer. Gary is one of the volunteer who teaches aborigional children living in the mountain. He shared every detail of living with those naughty children, though it's not always easy, but worth doing! I'm kind of want to participate the activity with Gary this summer!

subject: HW0901
content:
I have always appriciated those nonprofit organizations and the volunteers who devote themselves to helping people in need. These nonprofit organizations provide a lot of services like medical services, giving daliy supplements and comforting the refugees when their heart are fill with sorrow. They not only provides physical and material services, but also reach a helping hand on the emotional and spritual aspect. They are just like angels from heaven.
The nonprofit organization can't stand long without the volunteers' help. So I personally think to be a volunteer in the future is the direct way to show my appriciation. Maybe when I retire from my career few years later, I would devote the rest of my lifetime to helping others. Since there are more people who need helps in the third world, I would like to go there if my health allows.
We have recived love and mercy from others during our life. So when it is the time you can let the chain of love keep going, don't be selfish, just help others who in need to make the world sparkle.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations founded in the world. There are not only local organizations but also global or international organizations. The tend seems that the nonprofit organizations replace more and more functions from governments.
In all of the tasks of the nonprofit organizations, tutoring children areas in remote areas is one of the meaningful messions. It is a shortcut for a peron who wants to get a higher social and economical status through education. However, children who lives in remote areas usually are lack of educational resources. Thus, they don't have too many chances to get a better life in future.
I will study and learn as more as I can now. In the future, I want to bring my knowledge to the children who live in remote areas or the children who are lack of proper education.

subject: HW0901
content:
Everyday we can see many people in need throughout the world via TV or newspaper; in the meantime, there are also lots of activities launched by some organizations to help them. Some of the organizations recruit volunteers to Africa where children have no books to read and people always suffer from famine. There is shortage of food all the time. Therefore, some of these volunteers go to there teaching children now to spell words and give them books to read; still some are doctors going to Africa to practice medicine for dying people. These organizations also encourge people to donate their money to help those in need.
To give my love to the poor around the world, I have joined a activity this summer. The goal of it is to be hungry for 30 hours to experience the feeling of being hungry. I think it means a lot to me and it will make my summer vacation more wonderful. I will keep join activities like this to make my life meaningful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are common these day, and more people are willing to participate their works as volunteers. Such as garbages recycling, house cleaning for the elders, offerring supports for homeless people and etc., these organizations do so to solve some social problems in modern life. That's very honorable.
Above all, I think taking care of homeless people is nice, but also some better way for them. If they could provide some jobs or train them with some skills, at least they could have a different life. Instead of offerring the fishes, it would be better to let them know how to fish.
That's why I want to be join the clues of teaching programs after schools. Children in a poor family, their parents would not have so much time to help their children's homework, and they would not come home until midnight.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations has been in Taiwan for a long time. They provide many different service. For example, the red cross provided medical help and food for the people that suffered from earthquake and some other organizations helps people quit smoking. These nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work nowdays.
I haven't being a volunteers for these organizations. But I was a volunteer for a hospital. I do things such as telling people where to go, helping them find the things they lost and some do some simple hand writing work; I learned a lot by being a volunteer.
In the future, I would like to try being a volunteer of nonprofit organizations. I don't know which of them I will chose and what will I do when I am a volunteer in the nonprofit organization, but what I know is that the feeling after helping other peoples. I will never forget.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations highly increases, and so does people who join these organizations all over the world.
What do they do? Helping people who live in such poor enviroments is the most basic thing they do for them. The organizations also provide medical helps to cure the poor who suffer from disease. Another help they do is offering food to keep people from being hungry. What they do are too many for me to put them into words.
I have always seen the picture of the poor and their countries. I wish I could help them by my own self in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work to do charities to the society. They go to the remote areas in Taiwan to serve people. When people are in need, they will show up. If some place is striked by typoon or earthquakes, volunteers will arrive there to serve food, clothes, money and medicines. Some volunteers do charities in another way. They go to the hospital to help and console the patients. They are really willing to help others, and so am I. Being a selfish person wouldn't bring us happiness. I have a dream. I want to be a good doctor in the future. I would like to go to the remote areas to cure people suffering from diseases. That's what volunteer work I would like to do in the future. And I will do my best to make my dream come true.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is no denying that there are more and more nonprofit organizations recruiting volunteers in Taiwan. As a matter of fact, the volunteers have played a critical role in Taiwanese society. The services they provide are as follows.
For one thing, you can see volunteers picking up the trash on the ground at anytime. People nowadays generally lack a sense of moral, throwing rubbish everywhere. To keep our environment clean, the volunteers pick up the garbage and put it into public trash cans. For another, there are also some people teaching the children who live in remote arears, and consequently don't have good teachers to teach them. What's better, the teachers teach the kids nonprofitly, trying to relieve the parents' economic pressure.
As far as I'm concerned, I once taught English to the poor students in a certain elementary school. At first, they were so shy that they didn't talk to me. However, after my English teaching, they spoke English to me happily. In the afternoon, we even sang songs and danced together. Seeing smiles on their faces, I indeed felt a sense of achievement in my mind. Without a doubt, it was certainly a sweet memory.
In a word, those volunteers are definitely vital to our society. They have significantly benefited the environmental cleanness, standard of living, and education. Touched by their efforts, I myself make up my mind to spend more time on volunteering activities to make the society as well as the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many people say that modern people are indifferent and selfish. Nevertheless, I think the majority of Taiwanese are friendly and willing to give the need a helping hand. In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations helping people without asking any reward.
Some organizations will go around Taiwan, taking care of the elderly living alone. They also go to some remote areas to help some children with their homework. Still, some of them will go abroad, and bring necessities to developing countries, giving the local children the opportunity to have education. What these organizations expect is ensure the happiness and welfare of everyone in the world.
Though I'm a Taiwanese, I've never been a volunteer in these organizations. Yet, I try to assist others around me in daily life. For instance, I once helped an old lady carry her stuff when she was trying hard to walk on the staircase with those heavy things. In comparison to others' devotion, I know what I've done is nothing. As a civilian of the world, I should make more efforts to help the need. Were it not for everyone's hard work, the world would never be beautiful. And I'm willing to play a role in making this world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
At present, nonprofit organizations are thirving in many countries, and Taiwan is not exceptional. In Taiwan, many nonprofit organizations were founded by the religious organizations. For example, Tzu-Zi is a very famous nonprofit organization. It provides a lot of helps to the needy and poor. In 921 earthquake, this organization offered lots of donations and volunteers, helping many refugees. After this disaster, many people appreciate of their kind and charitiful behaviors, and want to be a volunteer in this organization.
However, there are still some disadvantages in these kind organizations. Because some volunteers in the organizations are too aggressive to help people. Sometimes they maybe force their friends to do something about charity. These behaviors arise many people's dislikings. For this reason, we should realize what kinds of volunteers really benefit our lives.
In my opinions, I want help the poor children who live in remote areas. Because I'm a graduated student, and I want to teach them many different knowledges. I hope them have a bright future. But I still study in the school. I don't have much time to join them. I hope I can keep with them one day in the future. This is my best desire.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations putting emphasis on sacrifications provide people in need with a wide variety of helps. Some orgaizations are devoted to reconstruct destructions as well as offer material supply for people living in damaged areas while others make every effort to help the poors or homeless people with steady lives. Asking nothing in return, nonprofit organizations would like to have people in need of helps lead better lives. What they are doing is really beneficial to a great number of people.
In my own experience, I have been a volunteer working for such organizations. I consider it a memorable experience because I learn a lot from it. During those days, I tutored children who lack opportunities of learning in school. They all had enthusiasm for learning and I had good time teaching them. Thanks to this experience, it occurred to me that I should do more meaningful things to help others. By all means do I attend nonprofit organizations in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, a lot of nonprofit organizations have founded to help people or animal in Taiwan, and World Stray Animal Protect Organization (WSAPO) is one of them. WSAPO is a very important organization in Taiwan, what they are doing, is mainly saving stray dogs or cats on the street.
WSAPO will fist search stray animals on the street, and then bring them to vet to ensure if they have any health problem. Second, WSAPO will take good care of these stray animals, finding some warm place to sleep, also some food to eat. Third, WASPO will need some volunteers to bring these pretty, cute animals to a place, where can let citizens to adapt them.
I had being the volunteer of WSAPO when I was in high school, I like to see these animals find a proper home, and I also like to take care of them. I love animals, I really hope that there is no more stray animals on the street.

subject: HW0901
content: In recent years, nonprofit organizations have been recruiting volunteers to help with their work. These organizations help with all kinds of things, such as giving out scholarships to poor people who study hard, providing Food and medical care for places with natural disasters, or even reading Fairy tales to children at an orphanage. The year before, I helped an organization set up a concert to earn money for homeless people. I relized that if no one volunteered to help, these types of concerts wouldn't even be able to proceed. In the future, I would like to go to an old peoples' daycare center and help take care of them. I think that if you have the ability to take care of yourself, and also be able to help others, then, you should spend more time helping others than yourself. By helping others, you recieve their gratefulness and happiness in return.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is indeed that these kinds of activities held by nonprofit organization have become more popular than ever now. The promotion is also powerful and speedy through the Announcement of celebrities and politicians, not to mention its variety and amazing content.
I had joined the one of the most famous activity in taiwan called "30". I can still remembered that hundreds of people sitting on the ground of square all day without any food. That was my first time to experienced this kind of activity, which left me the strongest imagine of my entire life, especially when they show us the photos taken in Africa.
With those poor faces, kids lived in the refugee camp with limited resources, is still shock me every time when it comes to my mind.
Growing in a peaceful country likes taiwan, I think that I can never understand how hard they have been through and what kind of life they have. But every night when their faces come up with my mind, I know that what I've done is always not enough.

subject: HW0901
content:
In my personal opinion, there are a lot of important services can be done in the nonprofit organizations, such as visiting the elder (aging old people) who are living alone to assit them any help they need for daily life. Another work the organization can do is sending people to the healthcare organization like hospital or nursing home to help the non-medical needs. Starting last year the whole world are facing economic down turn, a lot people lose job or homeless, the organization can support these people temorary shelter and food even the money to help them livings. Any work as long as can help the society, make the world better tomorrow are the important service which need to be provided from the nonprofit organization.
I have done a lot volunteer works in temple. After the lunch I usually clean the trash, mop the dinning table. In the afternoon, I usually stay in the library to put the retural books back to the shelf. Every year the buyer I help selling the goods and tickets to collect money for providing chariety services in any needs from temple. Doing the volunteer work will be the second job for me. I do enjoy it and also help me more understand the meaning of life. I should thank it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organization nowadays not only recruit volunteers to help poor people but also provide the refugee living in a developing country with free food. Volunteers usually spend their free time in teaching and getting along with children who live in remote areas. They even send meals to the elderly every day. It does take time, love and patience to take care of these minor people, but they never complain. Raising money on the street when the sun shines is not a big deal for these volunteers. They wear a smile on their faces all the time.
Sometimes they take dogs to the hospital to bring great joy to sick people and cheer them up. Volunteers who are good at animals can educate dogs to be guide dogs. Guide dogs are the most helpful for blind people because they need to be lead the way while going outside. More importantly, some volunteers who are going to be veteranarians can treat stray, injured and abandoned animals well.
I've heard that some nonprofit organizations provide free computer courses in the neighborhood. It's really useful for people who want to improve themselves. Free courses can reduce people's financial burden and teach them some practical skills.
If I have a chance to be a volunteer in these nonprofit organizations. I would like to teach students English in remote areas. With my experience, I think I'm ready to take on new tasks. Of course, I do love children.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are some worldwise nonprofit organizations which provide the important services for the globle such as medicinal support to the poor countries, enmergence rucuses, send doctors to the remote counties and donate for building the hospitals or schools which have the newest equipments.
I never done any volunteer works so far. In the future, I would like to help needly paitients in the hosplitals.

subject: HW0901
content:
It is very common for people to join nonprofit organizations these days. There are many kinds of such organizations which help different kinds of people. Those organizations may provide survices like helping the poor to learn some skills to find a job, helping the badly injured people to recover from their illness, helping the orphans to find a warm home, helping the countries which encounter a disaster like earthquake or tsunami, and so on. Take Taiwan for example, we encountered a big earthquake nine years ago. Many buildings collapsed and lots of people were dead or badly injured. At that time, whatever country they come from, those nonprofit organizations' volunteers help us with rescue people, take care of the injuries, and so on. All of us are very thankful.
In my opinion, all of us are receieving help from other people, and it is important for us to help other people when they need help. I am a seventeen years old teenager that I don't know whether I can join those organizations or not, but I am sure that when I get older, I will take part of my salary to give to the organizations that help homeless children, and I will be the volunteer to help take care of the old people in the hospital.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their works. More and more nonprofit organizations now provide a lot of services. Some will help the children in poverty or the poor in other countries.
First, they will help the children who can't afford to enter a school. They will give them some money to pay for the tuition and their lunch, so that they can study like others.
Second, they will help people to quit smoking. Besides giving the smokers some advice, they will also teach them the disadvantages of smoking.
Third, they will donate some money to developing countries, helping them to build the hospitals or schools so that the people in there can get enough cares.
Take me for example. I was a volunteer last summer. I went to an elementary school in a remote region in Taiwan. My friends and I played with the children and shared our experiences. We had to wake up early in the morning to prepare the games or other needs and discussed if we did any thing wrong at night. Although it was an exhausting work, I felt very wonderful when I saw or heared the children's laugh.
Being a volunteer is a glorious work. You can do your best to help others and you will be thrilled as well. Also you can learn a lot of imformation and make yourself more independent.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, being volunteers is so trendy. That is, more people are attending nonprofit organizations to serve as a volunteer. Among those services, turing children in remote areas is especially suited to colleges students to take part in. At one time, I attened a summer camp to tutor students. I find it inspining since I could gain a great sense of achievement through tutoring. I felt so confident to be not only a tutor but also a good compainion. In many cases, tutors sent by nonprofit organization are a good access to the world for them. All in all, being volunteers is the thing that cannot be waited. Keep in mind it's not a trivial thing at all.

subject: HW0901
content:
Because of the developments and improvments of technology, people can easily get everything they want in a short time. However, there are still some people who suffering from difficult situation in the places which we can not see. In order to solve these problems, some nonprofit organizations start to help these people.
There are many international nonprofit organizations all over the world. They not only help others but also invite people to join them. There are various kinds of services which they provide, for instance, teach the citizens some air-craft abilities to make them alive in some poor areas, donate medience or send some doctors to the places which full of diseases. However, from my own perspective, the best way to help them is by doing some small actions, such as being a volunteer instead of donating money. We can learn a lot from this kind of true experience.
When I was a junior high school student, I had a chance to work as a volunteer in a care-center with my classmates. The only thing for us to do is to chat with the grandpas and grandmas there. Because of suffering from sickness and loneness, they felt happy when we could listen to them with smile on our faces. It was a unforgettable experience to me.
To summarize, only when we can put ourselves in their shoes can we cherish the things we have now more. Being a person who can give appericiation and help to other people is the best thing in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Albert Einstein once said "Only the life lived for others is a life worthwhile." In the global villiage, more and more internationl nonprofit organizations are set up to help those who are in need all over the world. These organizations provide a great number of services. For example, the International Red-cross Organization always gives aid to those who are suffering from famine in Africa. What's more, some organizations will take care of the homeless children and old people so that they can have safe refugees. Least but not last, some voluteers also help those who are encountering violence in their families. There are indeed various services provided by these nonprofit organizations in the whole world!

Most important of all, Emily Dickson once said "If I could stop one heart from breaking, I should not live in vain!"

subject: HW0901
content:

Take something impressive to me for example, we have Mengnore supplying meals for the helpless elder, providing homes for the disabled; we have Tsichi helping those who lost their houses due to natural disasters or wars; we have Transhi Foundation that takes care of the vegetables; also, we have many college students with young passion willing to volunteer to do something good.

I hope that more and more people will lend a helping hand and we will have a society full of love.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the world is a global village, everyone is associated with each event occured in the world. international organizations like , Green Peace, World Vision are cruiting volunteers to rescue refugee in non-developed countries in Africa by providing them shelters, food, water.....

With rightous medical attartions they would have the chance to live long and thrive.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, more and more people are willing to be volunteers of nonprofit organizations. What do those organizations do? The the world-famous one, the Red Cross, for example. If a catastrophe hits a place, causing lots of damages, claiming lots of lives, the Red Cross will send its volunteers and plenty of necessities to the area. Some nonprofit organizations will raise money to give aid to those victims there. With the gratitude to those organizations and volunteers, I have volunteed to teach children from sigle-parent families or poor families. I am also a volunteer in the city library to read for kids. I understand that patients in hospitals usually feel uncertain and nervous, so I want to be there to comfort them. My final aim is to become a international volunteer with the hope to help more people.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent decades, nonprofit organizations try their best to make the world better. Such as helping refugee and giving education to people in remote areas. Some actives are worthy for us to discuss.
To begin with, they offer the humane support in developing countries. If the people get sick, they take good care of them and give them some medication. subject: HW0901
content:
I once went to a rural village in the mountains of Taiwan. I was going there to live in one of the few tourist huts they had there. THe Jeep I was in bounced along the rocky trail, and some loose pebbles rattled down in our wake. From far away I could hear a low hum, most likely from the aborigines. When I reached my destination, however, I was surprised to see that it was a large electric plant, no the aborigines that was making the noise. Although I was disappointed at not seeing any natives, I was also pleased that they had electricity here, and I wouldn't have to do everything by myself, as I had originally thought.
The huts, as it turned out, were pretty well furnished, with air conditioners as well as hot water. After I had unpacked, the guide asked me if I would like a tour round the surrounding villages. I heartily agreed.
He led me out the front door, and we walked for about ten minutes. When we reached the outskirts of the village, everything looked all right. But when I looked more closely at the small huts the natives were living in, I was horrified to find them in a dilopidated state. One of them had even caved in! I was startled by the contrast between the tourist huts and the native huts. I stomached all this, and went home. Two weeks later, I sent a letter to a nonprofit organization complaining about the horrifying state of the huts.
Three years passed, and I recieved a bonful of snapshots from the organization. I was pleased to find that they had repaired the huts and even built a school! I was so pleased that I donated some mo-ney to the organization and even went on some trips with them to other poor villages.
If ever I would do some more volunteer work, I would go abroad, maybe to Africa, as everyone knows, is one of the poorest countries in the world.
I would readily and happily devoted my whole life towards rescuing hose homeless and foodless refugees if only it were any use.

With these kinds of experiences, I feel I am very happiness and I think I have abilities to help people in need. What's more, I found my value toward life of future, and I deeply believe that it's more of a blessing to give than to take and so will you if you take on it.
Although the world isn't as perfect as we thought, but we can pass the chain of love by doing volunteer work and it's believed that the world will become better and better in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are hundreds of activites held by the nonprofit organizations in Taiwan to help the poor or remote school students for their homework and skills for them to find a job in the future, such as computer programing, website setting or fruit and plant planting. I have once been to a far away small town in Mt. A-Li, to teach the students there.
I was a volunteer and I was good at computers, so they want me to teach them the basic things of computers like surfing the Internet, send e-mails and chat with their friends far away. I spent a week there, and it was really happy to see the students all did a good job. This may be the most happy experience I've had.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, more and more nonprofit organizations cried out for more help or donation, because these organizations don't have enough resources to help people in need. How do they help people in need? For example, formed in France, MSF is helping people suffering from AIDS or wars in developing countries. They offer medication, food supplies and even help people experienced wars to build shelters. Volunteers in MSF also teach people in developing countries how to prevent some diseases. Moreover, MSF puts meaningful TV commercials and ads to let the public know there are still people living in bad quality. Last but not least, MSF works with some medical school in order to develop new medicine to cure the suffering.
In my point of view, these organizations are really great since I have volunteer experience. As a senior high school student, I often go to some hospitals to take care of patients, chat with the old and entertain some kids suffering from cancers. When I volunteer, I feel that actually helping others is a wonderful thing because I can see patients smiling with vigour. The experience also makes me become mature and be more willing to offer help. If I still have the chance to be a volunteer, I'll definitely grasp the chance and try to help more people!

subject: HW0901
content:
Taiwan is now a country which is fully developed. Thus most people can take care of themselves and they spread their love to the people who are in need.
In my opinion, I would like to go to the remote area to teach students. In my childhood, I was raised by my grandmother due to the divorce of my parents. At that time, I played day by day until the student volunteers came to our school in one summer vacation. They taught us how to learn English happily, At the summer vacation, I gradually love study because of the fulfillment the English took to me. And now, I'm a student in college major in English.
In conclusion, volunteer sometime can change somebody's life. Then, why not go and try one in your life time.

subject: HW0901
content:
In our society, most organizations try their best to get profits and revenue. There are still some nonprofit organizations running their business to help people instead of making profits for themselves. Profit organizations create wealth, but nonprofit organizations create value.
Nonprofit organizations provide a lot of important services for the children, the poor and the elder. They also provide services for the foreign countries which have political relations with Taiwan, such as some under-develop or developing countries in South America. These organizations recruit volunteer doctors and nurses to provide the poor people and the old people with free medical help or body check-up. Volunteer teachers can tutor countryside students in order to help them catch up with the city students. Some volunteer soldiers may go to the poor nations and help the local people cultivate their farms and improve their living quality.
I am a warm-hearted person, and I would like to be a volunteer in the future. Taking care of others is my interest, so I think I would help take care of the old people in the nursery hospital. The people who live there are usually lonely and pessimistic. I want to bring my happiness to them, and accompany with them. They can also share their experience with me. I believe I can be a helpful volunteer.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations has always been an important role for both human society and nature. They often help the society when they were in need, and when things were not so busy, they determined on goals of how to improve the society and protecting enviroment. They guard the responsibility of taking care of the weak and ask no return for the favors they had done.
We can often see uniformed volunteers on the television or newspaper. On crime scenes or disaster wrekages, they took care of the scared victims and kindly asked them what they want; they cleaned the wounds of wounded and fed the hunger and thirst of the starved. Some organization even went cross country to help the third country world to improved their skills of medication, food-growing technology, and knowledge of health and cleaning. They brought hope to the hopless and brightness to the dark.
What's more, these organizations sometimes held meaningful activities, whether to raise funds or as simply as just to picked garbages from the beach, these activies helped to bound the colder and colder relationship between people, nevertheless to give us some lessons which will never learned in class.
I, myself, has been a volunteer of Tzu-Chi foundation for three years. I make small donations each month and go out to the neighborhood to help single-living elders every weekend or two. I start small because I was only a student, but, every snowball starts as a snowflake, I was hoping to help more people in the future and spread out the love of the foundation across the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations pop out in recent decades. Maybe their services vary from each other, but they have only one ultimate determination "To improve the world and human rights."
These nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. For instance, provide medical help to the rural or remote areas, establish schools to educate children who live in poverty and couldn't afford expensive education expense, etc. What's more, some international nonprofit organizations aid those people who live in ghetto or undeveloping countries such as Africa and South America. Through their aids, these people who live in the edge of death and desperate can have the opportunity to stand up and restart their lives.
As for me, these volunteer works are essentiall. I had this kind of experience before. I volunteered in an orphanage in Mt. Ali last year with my classmates. Children there often spent 3 hours walking to school and back to the orphanage. After the school, they still had to help do works in the orphanage. Hardly did they have time to study and do their homework. Some of the kids were not interested in academics at all. But by tutoring them, I found out that these children were smart and were eager to learn more. In the meantime, I also learned their spirits, "Belive in yourself and face the difficulties bravely." At first I thought I was helping them, but actually this experience was a lively lesson to me. Since then, I have always wanted to do the same volunteer work again in the future.
Through volunteering, I find the beauty of life. Volunteering can definately broaden your eyesight and give you diffSrent valuable lessons. Furthermore, you can find your confidence and what you are excel at. As a result, participate in the volunteer work! You can find your life much more colorful and meaningful than before.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is no denying that an increasing number of nonprofit organizations have mushroomed for many years. Without their help, maybe the world will become more terrible.
As far as I am concerned, such organizations provide multified aspects of services. First, they build shelters to enable those who are homeless or undergo something miserable, like wars and famines. Second, they would launch some activities to spur some enterprises or kind-hearted persons to donate money or necessities. In sum, they play a crucial role in rescuiting those in need.
For me, I also did some volunteer work before. As a senior high school student, I had gone to a hospital to take care of patients. In spite of piles of work waiting for me to do, I still thought they were worth it. In the future, I dream to educate children living in remote areas, for children are Taiwan's hope. Without a good education, can they compete with children in cities?
In conclusion, such organizations make the world more promising and hopeful. Without them, maybe the world will become more miserable and hopeless, won't it?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations. They provid some services for those who are in disadvantage. For instance, they collected used stuffs and sold them. They gave all the money they earned to those who are in need. What they gave is not only money but also company. They also went to some remote areas to accompany children or old people.
Now, let me share my experiences of being a volunteer. I went to an aboriginal tribe to turtor children last summer vacation. Although the evironment is not as good as ours, both the children and volunteers had a great time. What's more, I ever sold used things in a rainy day. I am glad I participated in those activities. I make a lot of friends there. Also, I learn to help others. I would like to go to other countries to do volunteer work in the future. Just spend some of your free time, then you can get happiness by helping others and gain some special experiences. Why not?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the gap between rich and poor has been widen. In order to give a helping hand to those who are in need. Nonprofit organizations have been playing an important role.
For one thing, sending daily neccessities like food and clothes is what most nonprofit organizations do. The red-cross organization is one of the special ones. It rise above others by their perfect care for soldiers and their families. There is another special one, which is built up by doctors who travel around the world to places where it is lack of medical equipment. They devote themselves to the poor and sick without asking any rewards.
I took part in a volunteer work when I was in my second year of high school. We went to the romote areas in Taiwan and tutor childrens whose age was about six or seven. They had to work in such an early age because of poverty. After the journey, it gave me a whole new perspective toward my life. It let me understand that I should be grateful for all that I own.
Whenever we see someone in need, we should always reach out our hands and give them a leap.

subject: HW0901
content: During the development of human's civilizations, people also learn that the world needs love and that people can't live without others company. I think that's why nonprofit organizations come into being. Things you get during helping people are much more than you've anticipated. People who join the nonprofit organizations go to wherever there is someone who needs help. They tutor children in remote areas or see afte the old man who lives alone. I can't list what they have done because they have done a lot. All I know is that they devote themselves to others unconditionally and they never ask anything in return. With their pure, noble love, the world becomes better and lots of helpless people recover from their grief. Actually, there's not much I can contribute to our society because I am just an ordinary senior high student. I am neither mature nor reliable but I've realized that it is terrific to help others. I am not able to do something profitable to our society now but I have made my mind that I am going to be a doctor in order to give a hand to others. I have determination and I have confidence that my dream will eventually come true.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, voluntary services are more and more popular in Taiwan, and for most nonprofit organizations, what kinds of services do they provide? Following are three points that I want to explain to you. The first one is fund-raising. For most nonprofit organizations, they always don't have enough money to buy things they need to help those in need. Therefore, they need volunteers to raise money or donate by themselves. The second one is to clear the environment of these nonprofit organizations. Take one welfare foundation for an good example, it it often full of donations which are ned volunteers to classify and organize. The last but not the least, they also provide some activities for volunteers to join, such as some small nonprofit markets or raising recepites along streets. Volunteers will have a lot of fun when they enjoy those activities. For me, I do really enjoy being a volunteer. It has become one of my favorit habits since I was in senior high school. I service at many organizations, such as World Vision, NGO and Welfare Genesic Foundation, etc. I make lots of friends, and I learn a lot when I help those who are in need. As long as I see their smiles, I will also feel happy.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the prosperous outside of our society, there are still some parts that are not so brightly in existence. To help the situation get better, many nonprofit oragnizations have been established. They do a lot of charity work to help those who are in need. For example, in some remote areas in Taiwan, especially in the moutain, children have little access to education. As a result, some groups will recruit volunteers to tutor the childrean and help them with their homework. Since there might be a cram school or the parants can't afford it, these children may unable to catch up with those who have many resources. Through the voluntary work, children in remote areas can get more chances in their education and this might benefit them a lot.
Another example is Doctors without Boaders. It is a well-known international organization. The members in it included engineers, doctors, nurces and some professional people, all nearly unpaid. They go to some areas in Africa where people can't get well medical care. In spite of being in the risk of getting malaria and some terrible disease, they set up camps and do operation for sick people. It's very brave of them to do so. One goal of the organization is to help every people get good medical care, no matter where they are.
As a medical student now, I do voluntary work in the hospital every week. Sometimes I play computers or tell stories to the children. Sometimes I sit behind the counter and answer the question from people, such as how to go to the medical building or where to lend the wheelchair. I also spend some time talking to patients and their families. Since people come to the hospital are sick and feeling upset, I want to bring some smile to them.

subject: HW0901
content:
As capitalism has brought some negative effect to our society, the non-profit organizations are trying real hard, in order to solve some problem without the ask for "profit". In Taiwan, some non-profit organization volunteer to take care of those really old people whom have been left alone by their families, and some drive all the way into the mountainous area in Taiwan, provide second-hand books and clothes for those who can't afford to buy any of these stuffs. And most important of all, they are always more efficient than the authorities.
So far, I have not yet participate in any of the activities held by these organizations. But in the future, I wish I could go to those remote areas in Taiwan, and teach those kids some basic knowledges for free. As we saw on TV, newspaper and internet, there are a lot of children in those areas could not go to school, simply because their parents could not afford the tuitions. But education, is probably the best way for the kids to change their situation in the future. As an university freshman, it is my duty and honor to tutoring those children for free, but with the greatest pleasure.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations have played an important role in our society, such as Chi-Zi Charity and some foundations. They devote their whole life to assist people whoever he/she is. And in the following paragraphs, I will describe it in details.
First of all, take Chi-Zi Charity as an example, people in this group travel around to help people. For instance, one of the charity members has given me a lecture. He has been in a remote area in China, where with no water. Besides, people there only take shower three times in their lifetime. He feels sorry about that and volunteer to help them build a water storage. From then on, the villagers do not have to spend much time on this problem.
Helping others is the happiness. My homeroom teacher has took my class to the charity and helped them with garbage classification. Though it is hot, I never regret and view it as the most wonderful experience in my life. Finally, I am likly to devote my life to the person who need me in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations in Taiwan have helped nurture the humanistic spirit of this island by providing many volunteered services, such as health care for the elderly and the poor, emergency aid in a natural disaster or post-traumatic reconstruction. The above-mentioned are all about life-and death, while some services are less urgent, like muzeum tour guiding or website constructing for other NPOs.
Ever since taking the ESL programs in the U.S., I've learned the spirit of volunteering, and have been searching for voluteer work that suits and needs me. I started getting associated with VYA, a volunteer institution founded and run by a group of enthusiastic youth, through the website of NPO.org. two years ago.
I got my first nonprofit job as a website programmer for a research assosiation of Europe. and had learned a lot of communication skills through explaing and negotiating with my employer. However, I want some more experience in providing more urgent aid in remote area in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: From today's many kinds of nonprofit organizations, I think the "Doctors No Boundaries" is the most essential organizations around the world, for they provide plenty of services-- setting the emergency rooms in remote and impoverished countries and helping them fight the terrible diseases, giving them the free vaccines-- especially for those children with low immune system. There are still having different organizations providing not only the food after severe catastrophy but the immediate help in their daily life. I love the volunteer works, any kind, if there is any opportunity to help others, I always join in them. I used to be in an orphanage with my friends to teach them their homework or play with them, and to my surprise, they were almost very very satisfied with their life and what they have especially the affectionate between their teacher or people like us. I can say I learn a lot from these children. In the future, Partly the result of those poverty-stricken children, partly because I want to do something to help improve their low living quality, I want to join the "Doctors No Frontiers" to help more people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, more and more nonprofit organizations have been founded. This is because it has much to do with helping the poor in remote areas. Such organizations provide the poor with daily necessities like food, clothes, and so on. What's more, some volunteers in these organizations spend their spared time teaching those who lack sources in their studies. The most important of all, the organizations spare no efforts to help those who are in need, which enables the poor to understand that they're emphasized by the society.
I have an unforgettable experience as a volunteer as well. When I was in the first year in senior high, my family and I spent our summer vacations visiting the poor living in Taitung. As members of the Red Cross Organization, we brought lots of candy, clothes, books, and food for the poor. Besides, we had a good time playing basketball with the children there. It was so amazing that I still remember the experience vividly. From the experience, I have learned that "the more sacrifices that you make to help others who are in need, the happier you will be."

subject: HW0901
content:
As the high developement of technology and the rising conscience of human right, there are so many nonprofit organizations mushroomed throughout the world nowadays.
Those organizations are founded by a group of people who are not the offical or government members. And all of the people who are willing to help poor people or destroyed place can join them as well. No sooner do they hear about the people is in need than they go and provide help before the government take action to deal with the catastrophe. They not only tutor children in the low developed countries but also run refugee camps in poor areas. They also help the locals to develope some important facilities, such as schools, water utilities, and power plant. Most important of all, they remind those people of the bright side of the world.
I am a high school student; as a result, I actually don't have so much time to do the volunteer work like I mentioned above; however, I do some in school, such as helping the students in lower grades with their work or providing some labor for the school's activities. I regard it as a meaningful thing. And I plan to join the international organization to spread my love to every corner in the world after I graduate from high school. And I especially feel like helping the poor and starved children in Africa. They are truly living in misery with so many wars, unclean water, and shortage of food. And even they can't grow up and be educated as well. For those reasons and the large passions, I have planned to help those forgotten angels and share my love with them. I also consider the dream to be the most important and meaningful thing in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Undeniably, the volunteering assistance by those nonprofit organizations did help this world a lot. While a devastating disaster happened, nonprofit organizations would always on the first line to help the injuries and casualties without hesitation.
