Whenever a destructive disaster happened, these nonprofit organization will always be there and efficiently help the victims such as providing food and water or the medical assistance. Some organization is famous for its volunteering assistance. Take World Vision for an example, it holds 30 hours famine every year for donation to the Africans who suffer from hunger. In fact, I am a volunteer, too. I have done the volunteering assistance for the Red Cross for over 100 hours already. My volunteer work are the teaching progam for the elemantary school in majority. I have also been to Myanmar to teach children there English and Chinese, and it is a really unforgettable experience.
Although we may feel ourselves small and useless sometimes, the power accumulated by everyone of us will still be powerful. Therefore, do not belittle the strength you have, let's help this world together by joining the voluteer assistance. Can we change the world? Yes, we can.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the domination of capitalism around the world, those developed countries are becoming more and more powerful. In contrast, the relatively disavantaged minority living in slums in Africa or India are still suffering from all kinds of woes. What can give them a hand? Well, the nonprofit organizations can!
To begin with, I would like to introduce a well-known one, that is, Doctors Without Borders. This organization is composed of a group of volunteering doctors, who are determined to spare no efforts on saving the poor and expect nothing in return. On hearing a devastating catastrophe happening, the organization always rush to the place immediately. For example, in 2008, no sooner had they heard the serious earthquake happening in China did they arrive the area. Apart from this example, they also came to the African's aid, helping them fight against the diseases. Thier passion and perseverance indeed touch me a lot.
Therefore, if I had a opportunity, I would without suspicion participate in such a love-filled organization. In the future, I will take part in more and more activities like this, such as being a volunteer in a hospital, raising money for the Red Cross and so on. I am deeply convinced that with more and more participants, we can beyond doubt make the world a better place to live!

subject: HW0901
content:
For the purpose of helping those who need our help, many nonprofit organizations have been founded.
As far as I am concerned, instead of making fortune, nonprofit organizations provide many services. I would like to take Red Cross Association for example and mention some services it provides. First, it is an internation organization and willing to help people despite of their countries and races. Second, it recruits volunteers and gives hands to victims when the damages such as earthquakes happen. Third, it collects the things people donate and send those things to those who need them.
I feel sympathic to those who encounter unfortunes and always thinking of making every endeavor to help them. However, as a student, I don't have much time and money to contribute myself. Mother Teresa, the person I respect the most once said "It is better to give than to receive." I am a Catholic, so I want to join the charities that held by the church when I grow up. I also hope that one day I can be the next"Mother Teresa.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the development of the economy, more and more people are able to lead a comfortable life without having to worry about the shortage of foods. Therefore, people start to have extra time and strength to help those with disadvantages in our society, so nonprofit organizations pop up quickly.
The Red Cross Organization is one of them. It helps people who live in poverty, having difficulties to survive due to the shortage of foods, and those who suffer from catastrophies, such as earthquakes and typhoons. They will provide those people with medical survice and give them foods to eat as well as shelters to live. Besides, people can donate their money to those in need through this organization. The organization provides people a good chance to show their love to the poor and gives warmth to them.
I hope I can join nonprofit organizations in the future. I would like to spend my time with children that are lack of education resource, such as those who can't receive good education, because of their laking of financial support. I think it's important for one to receive good education, for it's the chance for them to get rid of the poverty. Thus, I'm willing to teach them and provide them with aboundant knowledge. I hope my devotion to them can fulfill their lives and warm their hearts.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have held numerous campaigns to help needy people recently. Take Worldvision for example. They have a campaign about helping children suffering from AIDS. By donating some money every month and communicating through the letters, we can help a desperate child or even an orphan to live a better life. There're still some other campaigns. For instance, you can donate rice to those who are going to starve to death by playing a game. Everytime you select a right answer, the nonprofit organization will donate rice to the needy for you.
Although I've never participated in such services, I'm very fund of being tutore for little kids living in remote areas of Taiwan. It's a chance to make good use of what I've learned at school and to learn even more precious experiences about getting along with others. During the time, there may be lots of unexpected obstacles, but instead of being knocked down by them. I think I'll learn more from all of them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations play an irreplaceble part in Taiwan. More and more people take parts in the volunteering work, and together they are really making a difference.
There're a wide variety of nonprofit organizations, each of them has a specific purpose. Some organizations sell stamps, birthday cards, or even food for a higher prize to get money for those disabled. Others recruit volunteers in colleges to help tutor kids in remote areas or to help with the elders in nursing home. Personally, I had a very special experience at volunteer work. Last summer I joined an oversea volunteer camp at China to help with the children in a developing area. Through loads of activities we held for the kids, I've learned so much. I know that I'm the one benefited from the volunteer work because I feel geniune happiness.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, nonprofit organizations have played vital roles in this indifferent modern society. They recruit lots of volunteers from every part of the world to achieve their goals.
We can see figures of nonprofit organizations wherever tragedies take place. Victims to Tsunami or earthquakes, tutoring children and refugees are people who they really care about. They will send food and clothes no matter how remote the area is. Sometimes, they even stay there to reconstruct and rebuild houses voluntarily. Through nonprofit organizations' help, those who are in need are indeed starting their new lives.
Once, I had the chance to visit the elderly. The stereotypes of annoying old men are rooted in our mind. Actually, they just want to share their feelings and emotion with people. Being lonely for so long, they desire to seek comforts from others. After cleaning their house and chatting with them, I'm proud of myself to help them. The sense of achievement and appreciation are what I will never forget.
The existence of nonprofit organizations do help people all over the world. Their spirit and kindness deserve to be passed on forever and ever.

subject: HW0901
content:
Advocated by the former prime minister, Ko-ting Lee, nonprofit organizations have played an important role in Taiwan. Since they are nonprofitable, they need some volunteers to provide important services. I know at least three important services provided by them. To begin with, some of the volunteers will tutor the native children in remote areas in Taiwan. Lacking of modern learning equippments, such as computers, these children need the help from the volunteers to lessen the gap between childrens in the cities and them. Secondly, some volunteers will run refugee camps not only in Taiwan, but also in some developing countries, such as Nepel and Balis. With their behaviors, not only do we spread our love, but we also strengthen the relationship between the two countries. Last but not least, in my home town Chiayi, there is a group of volunteers whose leader is Ming-te Ho. Ho's elder brother died in an accident caused by the bad construction of a bridge, so he vowed to build enough bridges to help others. To date, about half of the numbers of bridges in Chiayi were built by his group.
As far as I am concerned, I have been a volunteer in the hospital near my home during summer or winter vacations. Since I had no professional skills to help the patients, I could only mop the floors and pass the papers for them. However, when I saw their sights of appreciation, I felt happy and had a sense of achievement. As a result, I will keep on as a volunteer to help more patients.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people devoting their life to helping others in this world. Therefore, nonprofit organizations spread like the hot springs now. For example, the Red Cross helps the refugee when there happen a disaster. They send food and clothes to support them. And in Africa, a great number of children is starving. They have shortage of food because of the weather. Then the Red Cross will dispatch their materials to save them.
Besides, I also like to dedicate my power to helping others. Long time ago, there was a tsunami in Southern Asia. And many family became broken. So our school established a charity to help them. I donated my money as well. Though I couldn't help them in person, my heart would follow with them. My dream is to teach those poor children. Once they get better education, their country will be able to become strong. Consequently, these things proves the saying "Charity begins at home."

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many kinds of nonprofit organizations in many countries recently, and each of their goal can be a little different. But their final destination is the same: to help more people. Some of them founded as foundation are set up for education. Their members are volunteer to go to remote areas and teach children there. Some of them were established for certain environmental issues. They would do research and monitor governments to prevent our country from polluting due to some bad policies. Also, they would tell every to save energy, not to throw garbage everywhere and etc. We have known the above.
I used to be a volunteer working in the library. My job was to send books to the bookshelves and filed some magazines, DVDs and newspaper. The job was not very easy because the mount of them was so amazing that I had to work overtime. Also, there were usually heavy dusts covering some old books, my hands almost became gray after the job. However, I was proud of my job then because that it not only made it easy to find books for people but I felt happy for helping others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, with the concerns of human rights increasing rapidly, more and more nonprofit organizations are founded to help those in need. We may see them sending food or some daily necessities to some remote villages and providing help to the poor. Besides, they also go abroad to some developing countries to assist the people there and make their hometown better. What's more, they even take the burden of the promotion of some important issues that every residents should know. With their help, we may lead a more beautiful and comfortable life.
To me, I may also choose to take part in the work of volunteering in the future. I can start from the basic actions, and if I've gained enough experiences and self-confidence, I will be willing to go abroad and make every effort to help those poor dwellers. Helping people in need alway makes me happy.
Thanks to those nonprofit organizations, we have a safer hometown to live in. To my humble opinion, there is always should be some persons just like the ones working in nonprofit organizations. They use their heart to help everyone and ask for no reward. I have always dream of becoming a person with kind heart and even have strength and ability to assist people around me. So, I will do my best to learn from them and one day become a kind-hearted person that can provide assistance to all those people who need help.

subject: HW0901
content:
Indeed, in this contemporary world, more and more people take heed of those who suffer from wars, famine or catastrophes. Thus, there are more and more organizations which are set for helping these kind of victims.
These kinds of groups, such as Red-Cross or WPF, always care about people who cronically stay in unfair situation. They may offer food, water, the apliances or the acceries to the victims. Even more, the Red-Cross also provide them medical rescues for free. There is also one notable organization in Taiwan, which is so-called Zsi-Tsi charity. So kind and generous that they are volunteered to tribute their money and aptitude to save the world. Es-pecially in the 921 earthquake, the view which I saw on TV that they were eager to rescue those victims with no complainment really impressed me a lot.
And, in my own experience, I've ever gone to a nursing house which is set to take care of the elders. Being a volunteer, I helped the nurses to change the elders' diapers, lead them to a game or even entertain them by singing a song. That was a great experience I've ever had.
In the future, if I have money and power, I must spare no effort to help others because giving is better than receiving. Weather or not the love would be taken notice of, I will keep going on. It's the faith I have. It's the love I long for spreading. In the long run, I hope there is no poverty-striken but only kind people. Wars won't explode on account of the profits conflict. Famine won't happen to the poor. The world is becoming better and warmer. That's the reason why char-ities should be instituted to help people.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, there have been more and more nonprofit organizations aiming to help those who are needed around the world. They encourage people to participate in such activities to make poor people live a good life. For example, after an earthquake, these organizations provide the homeless with some food and shelters. They help them to build houses after the disasters. Besides, they also give donations from the kind-hearted people to the poorer. Morever, such organizations also invite celebrities to take part in a series of activities to rise the concern over people to help who are in need. They help many children who used to be unable to go to school with an access to having opportunities to receive education. I really show respect for these organizations because of their devotion to the society.
To me, I have never been a volunteer. I want to devote myself to providing help for others in need. I can also donate money regularly to such organizations. In the future, when I have free time, I would like to go to hospitals to volunteer at taking care of the old patients. They've very lonely so I want to make them happy. I really want to see the smile on their faces.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations such as Red Cross provide important services around the world. They provide education to the children living in remote areas, building access to knowledge for them. If there is any natural damage happening, those organizations will go to run refugee camps for those helpless victims. Most of the time there are doctors participating the nonprofit organizations, so they can provide not only food but also medicine to cure those refugees.
As for me, I have joined a volunteer team as being an interpreter. I worked for a ship named Doulous, which is also known as an on-sea bookstore. It's regular crew, with no pay, is composed with people from all over the world. That's why they needed interpreters when they came to Taiwain. I was impressed by their spirit of bring knowledge to everywhere. If I have chance to do volunteer work again, I would like to give it a try because I believe it will make my life colorful by helping others.

subject: HW0901
content:
As time goes by, more and more nonprofit organizations are established with an eye to providing aid or help to people in need. They appeare wherever needs them, including remote mountain areas, disaster-stricken places or charity flea markets. In disaster-stricken area like the 921 earthquake and South-Asia disastrous tsunami, nonprofit organizations were usually the fatest to arrive there, setting up temporary tents and provided the victims with foods. A celebrated nonprofit organization Doctors Without Boarders, or known as MSF, consists of a group of doctors and volunteers. They go to developing countries, most of which are caught in poverty and diseases. Providing emergency relief and medical care, they show to the world that they can do a great job with simple methods.
As to me, I've done volunteer work during the 3rd grade in Senior High. My teacher took our class to a near hospital in which we had a close contact with the elders. Most of the old people there were partly impaired such as deaf or physically challenged. We were separated in groups and one group was designated to take a stroll with an elder. My classmate and I had a great time with our counterpart. She talked about her family and what she liked to eat and so on. Not until then did I notice that there were still much people that needed our compassion and care. After the hands-on experience, I know that doing volunteer work is such a great thing that I want to do more. Well goes the Chinese proverb, "Giving is much blessed than receiving." To me, I think I have understood the meaning of the saying.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays in Taiwan, there are lots of people to be the volunteers to help others. They serve the public with a warm-hearted and postive attitude. No matter what they do, they contribute their passion without taking money just because they anticipate our Taiwan will become better.
Actually, if we take a notice to our daily life, it is easy to find they devote themselves around us. Some of them cook the meals and deliver them to homeless people or elders lived alone, even taking care of their life; others may be the traffic policemen, helping people to drive smoothly and protect passers-by in rush hours. Every time when I drive my schooter and watch them to help everybody, I always appreciate what they are doing deeply and sincerely.
As I was a junior student in colleage, I had selected one course which I have to be a volunteer in orphanage every Sunday in a semester. Thus, learning how to serve those children, I always regarded them as my brothers and sisters to take care of. I taught them English in classes, and played basketball with them in the sport field. Gradually, I acquired a sense of achievement not just because their smile. Most importantly, I found that on serving people there, I was happy generated from my heart automatically.
Although there are still people around us don't accept our help and concern yet, I will contribute my rest of life to make them feel that this world is still warm. Only can do help others sincerely, we can also feel the same happy feeling from their appreciation.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations nowadays. They not only provide services to the people who need help but also give opportunities to the volunteers to experience the pleasure to help people. These organizations often provide services to the poor, the old and children, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. They also help people to rebuild home after wars or natural disasters. Take Zui Chi for instance, this nonprofit organizations of Taiwan is well-known to the world in result from providing services all around the world.
Well goes an old saying, "It's better to give than to receive." I was cultivated to reach out my hands to those who are in need. Nevertheless, as a senior high school student, I spend most of my time in studying. Therefore, I'm planning to do some volunteer works after the exam of university entrance. I would like to take care of the children in the orphans or to help patients in the hospitals. Growing up in a family which is full of happiness. I think I can convey the love to those people with a genuine heart through the volunteer works.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an important role in modern society, which provide a crucial education to people in need. And I am of the opinion that government should help these organizations continually run for good. The details and reasons will be elaborated in the following paragraphs.
To begin with, nonprofit organizations help poor children widen their knowledge by accepting the education from volunteers. For example, jogging the memory of my high school life, I had a similar chance to teach children whose parents couldn't afford the educational budget. Those cute children got a variety of information, for volunteers who taught them from all works of life. Because of this experience, I got a lot. I think only through the nonprofit organizations could people in need got best care.
Next to go would be, it's hard to run this kind of organizations, so that government should offer help due to the tension budget. In a nutshell, according to aforementioned, running nonprofit organizations is a better way to improve people's knowledge level and promote cultural features to our generations.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations now in the world. Some of them are doing things that help protect our environment, like cleaning up trash on the beach or mountains or trying to persuade others riding bicycles to work. Others help people who may not have equal opportunities as most people. By giving them more resorces or training them some skills, the aboriginals, the disabled and orphans can become better. Still others help people overseas. They usually provide food and clothes for those living in countries with insufficient daily necessities.
For me, I attended a volunteer work at a hospital in summer vacation in 2007. There, I saw many patients suffering from diseases and pain. I felt great sympathy for them. But since we, the groups of volunteers, were not proficient enough for the caring job, what we could do was push the patient downfloor with a wheelchair to see the doctor and help the nurses typing some document. I think helping others make me become a mature person, and through this experience, I realize the important value of health.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many people enjoy being volunteers during their free time. Not only helping the poor, but volunteering does provide people to obtain a sense of satisfaction. Also, people can experience different walks of life when participating various volunteer activities. For instance, we'll realize what kind of life that the old having no relatives and friends lead as helping in that kind of organization. Therefore, I perceive that volunteering is another education which can't be taught in school.
I have joined some volunteer work held by hospital during vacation for three years due to the job in the future. I might become a nurse, so I'm always looking for some opportunities for me to learn more about nursing. I chose emergency department and I helped patients to take blood pressure, temperature or X-ray pictures. Though sometimes I bustled about, I still enjoy this feeling. Preparing to fit the future job, I understand that patients teach more than as well.
Continuing to volunteer remains out of question to me. Instead of being bored and doing nothing at home, it seems that going out and offering help are wiser choices. In addition, I find it a great chance for me to improve my mental health suffering from big exams at school. I get happiness and relax when giving a hand to the injured. So, I'll definitely do the same volunteer work during the coming summer vacation and I have already filled in the form and handed in.
Some people rather have a part-time job than dedicating their time to volunteer work. But I deem that the things I have learned from helping people is precious and it can't be replaced by any single coin. You won't regret after trying volunteer work!

subject: HW0901
content:
All kinds of charities appear nowadays. Most of them are nonprofit. The job for the charities is to provide important service to people who need help. Being a volunteer to help the needs is an opportunity to make the world full of love.
These nonprofit organizations provide significant service such as tutoring the oboriginal childrens in the mountain areas, cooking meals for the lonely old men. Obriginal children don't have sufficient resources like us. Their parents work in the factory. They have no time to teach their children homeworks. Without parents' concerning, the children learn how to smoke, fight, even join in gangs. They give up themselves because no one stretch his hands to help the poor children. Being a tutor to help the children with their studies. They would have confidence in theirselves as they got good grade. If they could become somebodies in the future by doing this. Why don't we do? In the fast-paced society, people go to cities to find their jobs. But, the old men can't follow the tempo of this new age. They would be forgotten by their relatives. They spent most of time staying in their home. No one would call them, greet to them. They felt lonely. If we spent our time cooking meals for them, they would feel happiness.
I've been a volunteer for Cheng-Kung hospital in last winter vacation. I helped the old patients get on the elavator and key in their basic information.
As a senior high school's student, I think it's meaningful to be a volunteer in a hospital during my leisure time. If I had another opportunity to help others, I would do it without thinking twice.

subject: HW0901
content:
Have you ever got the chance to be a volunteer? How would you feel after you finished your volunteer's work? I have a lot of experiences of being volunteers, and now I become happier and more satisfied.
Recently, more and more nonprofit organizations provide the opportunities to volunteers, such as teaching children in the east of Taiwan, running refugee camps in poor countries, visiting the old people who live on their own and so on. The main reason that organizations want volunteers to do these is that they hope more people can help the poor people, be satisfied with their life now and care about the people who need help. Actually, since a few years ago, I became one of the volunteers until now. I have the experiences of visiting the patients in the hospital, teaching elementary school students English etc. I discover I become much happier and more satisfied, and I don't conplain anymore.
To sum up, being a volunteer not only ease my mind but also help a lot of people. I expect if I have free time, I will still be a volunteer in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Under the domination of capitalism, prosperious countries are getting richer, but the people from developing countries are still fighting for the next day to live. Nonprofit organizations are trying hard to make a balance in this situation.
Some of the nonprofit organizations are regional. They offer services like taking care of the disable and old people, helping kids from remote areas to accept better education. These kinds of works help the society become stabler. The other sort of nonprofit organizations is more international. They focus on bigger issues, breaking the country borders, strengthening their influences all over the world. Regularly, their services are running refugee camps in developing countries or environment issues.
I have joined the regional nonprofit organization before. I told stories to little kids, playing games with them as well as teaching them to recognize the Chinese characters. To me, it was not only a good chance to make friend with others but also widen my point of view to life. Though I'm busy studying now, I still attend the group, which teaches kids every Friday night, in our school. Volunteering life helps to figure out what is more prescious to me, not the good grades but the passion to life.
So now it's your turn to reach out your hand. There are many nonprofit organizations waiting for you to join. You can also find your passion to life.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations nowadays. They will help people who are in need without asking for anything in return. These nonprofit organizations provide many services like protecting children from violence, rescuing victims suffer from difficulties and offer refugee enough foods, etc. Whenever I hear of some children or women are under threat of violence, I'll feel pity for them. Thanks to these nonprofit organizations will help them find another place avoid torturing. In addition, they will appear to rescue victims encounter earthquakes or floods. Their courage, devine behaviors and love really touch me.
I have been to a hospital to do the volunteer work. I acted as a nurse to take care of aged people. My work was to feed them and have conversations with them lest they feel lonely or helpless. With these experiences, I firmly convinced that everyone needs love. With love, we are willing to help others. I really admire what these nonprofit organizations have done. I wish someday I could join them to make the world more peace and happy.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this busy society, it seems that people are indifferent with each other. However, in some parts of our worlds, there are some organizations giving out their passions and warm worldwide. They provide a plenty of food, money and clothes to the country in need. Some organizations also raise volunteers from all over the world to the developing countries to teach them some life-using methods or give them a big help.
I used to do this kind of service in the community. For instance, I used to join the Global Youth Service Day, which was an activity that a large number of volunteers in the world do the voluntary serivces. First we took some classes to get more information and thoughts about serving. Next, we began our services. In several services, the most impressed one is that some elementary students and I made some delicious food and sent to the elders in the community. In order to keep them company, we chatted with them, took a walk with them and helped them to do more they want.
During these activities, I felt sense of accomplishment. Also, I found the value of myself and treasure people around me more. This kind of service really make room for me to grow and give me a variety of inspiration about life.

subject: HW0901
content: There are more and more noneprofit organizations in Taiwan during last twenty years. Some of them may collect used textbooks or story books from schools in big cities like Taipei or Tainan to give poor studients in developing cities. Also some of them would find volunteers to teach pupils or just read stories for children. Not to mention, in addition to above educational activies, there are numerous kinds of noneprofit organizations in Taiwan. For example, I did a volunteer work during last summer vacation to learn knowledge of preventing smoking and introduce this knowledge to passengers in MRT system and bus station. The organization taught each volunteer that Do not judge a person only by his or her appearence, and we are ought to do our best to lead more and more adult or teenagers to the right way no matter the smoking person looks innocent or bad-attitude. That is, keep teaching them "Smoking is harmful to our health." by lively pictures and statistics from different countries. If they adopt our advice, they would get special presents. This kind of noneprofit volunteer work did influence me a lot. Therefore, I think this summer vacation I am sure to take part in the meaningful activity in different noneprofit organization!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations are necessary in our daily life. They help the olds and the needs without paying, but for their true loves.
Those teenagers volunteer to help those poor childen read because they might not have enough money to go to cram school. So, the news have said that some college students record their teaching and share it in the Internet for those who need it. Also, nonprofit organizations will help collect money and food from the people who want to care the needs. What's more, some vonlunteers even visit the elder who live alone to help them clean the house, take a walk with them and share happiness. These careness can make the needs feel that they are not alone, the are loved.
With this kind of love, I have attended the volunteer's activity to help the olds, that is - collecting receipes. It was not a easy job, I should put on a rest and hold a box, waking in a very hot day, and that makes me sweat all over my body. When I met passerby, I need to ask for their receipe, and that made me embarrassed at first. But I thought after a while, "it was a good way to help the needs, why should I feel embarrassed?" After all, happiness depends on ourselves, it was not only a happy day but also a good experience for me. And I would like to do more volunteer's activities in the furture, such as going to hospital to take care of the patient, I believe that it will also be a good experience for me to learn and expand my horizon.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations held by creating a prosperious future in Taiwan. They recruit volunteers who are filled with patience, love and enthusiasum. No matter how bad the weather is, volunteers still sacrifice their time to help others without any complaints.
There are some important services provided by such organizations: First, taking care of elders in nursery home. Volunteers spend lots of time to accompany elders, so that elders won't feel lonely. Second, providing clothes and food to orphans. Volunteers give them groceries and toys to let orphans have great time. Last but not least, volunteers also recycle garbages. Since, we have only one Earth, volunteers try their best to keep our environment clean.
I think volunteers are great. When I was a college student, I did volunteer work, too. At that time, it was very hot and we, volunteers, swept a long street together. I was exhausted but I felt glad that I can work for our society and make our environment clean. In the future, I would like to join nonprofit organizations to help more people. Now there are many kids with single Dad or Mom. They don't have too much food and they don't do very well at school, either. I hope I can give them a hand and tutore them one day.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more people voluteering to help people in need. Which I think is a very good way to help the others. Volunteering to help not only help others, but also help yourself.
One of the nonprofit organizations which I think has done the must to help human beings is the Red Cross. It was establised by a man named Herny. Its goal is to help the needy people. Whenever there are disasters, no matter they are nature disasters such as floods, tyhoons or serious diseases like SARS, AIDs, the Red Cross are also the first one to arrive and provide help. They would provide food, water and refugee camps to those who lost their familys and houses because of the disasters. Which is a good way to calm those people's hearts down. They would also give shots to pervent people from getting AIDs or SARs.
Since I am just fourteen years old, I am not old enough to voluteer in hosatels. But when I can, I'd be loved to help the patients in the hospitals or old people living by themselves, giving them lots of care, love and helping them to overcome their problems.
Above all, I encourage people to volunteer to help others. They will experience a new way of life, new value of seeing things and also make the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the transportation becoming more and more convenient, a lot of people in Taiwan started to travel in remote areas. Some people began to think of problems why resources in remote areas were less than metropolitan when traveling. Then, more and more nonprofit organizations were built by some people who wanted to do something for our country. To help people in remote areas, these nonprofit organizations make efforts to improve their living quality. First of all, they built some hospitals in remote areas. In addition, there are many docters who go to remote areas to help people. Although these docters may have lower salaries, they also do so. Second, nonprofit organizations will give remote areas a helping hand like food and clothes when the catastrophe happends. Last, they may offer free law consult. These nonprofit organizations do a lot of things for our society, but I also want to do something.
My dream is to be a docter. I want to enter a medical school first and study hard. After ten years, maybe I will be a docter with license. I will participate in those nonprofit organizations and do some volunteer works. I want to help the poor without receiving their money. Helping people makes me happy. To make my dream come true, I will make efforts to do so.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations have already provided too many services in Taiwan. Such as show their loves to the orphans and help them to learn and go to school for educating, take care of the olders who live only by themselves and hold the summer or winter camps in order to let students know more about themselves and so on. These things have already let us know that in this "cold society" still have some people who want to denote their knowledge and power to help people. For me, I really appreciate that in Taiwan still have these "kind people." Thus I would like to join the camps to help those who are still blind for themselves and decide to denote one sixth of my salaries to help those poor children who are desire to go to school for educating. Every day on my way to school, I always can see some poor children selling gums on the streets. However, there are less people will stop and buy some. That's why I believe I will try my best to help them in the future, and I think to help others is not only my business but also everyone should do.

subject: HW0901
content:
As more and more nonprofit organizations are established, people are getting more familiar with what they do. They provide a variety of services to help those in need, and they try to have influence on our society.
There are many kinds of services provided by them. For example, they help the poor, the handicapped and the lonely elderly by giving them money, finding work for them and accompany them. Also, they go to remote areas, such as mountains or countryside, to tutor children who live far from cities and thus have fewer opportunities to learn. Moreover, they go to developing countries to set up refugee camps so that some people don't have to live in slums. They help the needy.
I have done some volunteer work. Among my experiences, I think that time when I went to the house of the elderly is the most impressive one. I didn't expect much before going because I didn't think I could learn a lot from this. Be that as it may, I found the elderly people wise and friendly, and they were willing to chat with me, a youngster. I was surprised to know the fact that it was their married sons and daughters who sent them here. By having conversations and playing chess with them, I got the motivation to come here every weekend. The volunteers there were excited to know that I filled the form to come to this house of the elderly every week.
We now live in a competitive society and to most people, wealth and fame are their only goals. However, I believe that we, who are able to help others, should give them a hand. This is what the nonprofit organizations want to provoke and I think if everyone reaches out, we can live in a more harmonious society.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there have been many nonprofit organizations which offer a great deal of different assistance to those in need or in poverty.
Take the Red Cross Association for example. Whenever some terrible disasters or catastrophes happen in all parts of the world, the institution will try its ultmost to rescuse victims either by raising fund or going directly into the refugee area to provide in-time help with all of its available rescources. It goes without saying that the world would get back to the normal and peaceful situation with the important services provided by such organizations.
I've never done any volunteer work before; however, it's my further plan that I would devote the rest of my life to surviving people from miserable living, especially for those young kids whose parents can't afford good education. As an English teacher, I am extremely willing to educate the homeless or parentless children with my knowledge and enthusiasm as well partly because every child has equal opportunities to receive education and partly because by doing so, I can make myself more confirmed of the irreplaceable value of being an teacher.
As far as I am concerned, we should pay more attention to those living at the edge of our society or in the world as long as we are capable of doing some good deeds. After all, it is not only the nonprofit organizations' responsibilities but also the whole humans' that to make the world more lovely and safer.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the world nowadays, we have innovative technology and don't have to worry about many things. However, the difference between the rich and the poor have become further than we can imagine. Though people get busier than before, some nonprofit organizations still make some time to do the cherity or recruit volunteers to aid those in need. Take my school for example, we have an opportunity to visit aboriginees during one semester. Sometimes help them clean the environment, get notice about the financial problems and bring them some information from cities. It is such a fantastic experience that I participate in this activity at all times.
I am just a little girl, but I have a great dream. I hope I could major in the subject which is associated with our society. Thinking of the happy memories I have and those poeple's genuine realationships with me, I will keep on volunteering with all my heart. Not only did I make lots of friends but I recognize their culture and show my respect for various tribes.
Last but no the least, only do we volunteer to take measures can make our society more lovely and prettier.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help their work. The reason why they do this is that globalization is becoming more and more mainstream,big cities, such as Taipei and New York, are getting more and more connected than before. The distance between big cities are erased, while the countryside still can not get more useful resources they want.
As a result, these groups are involved in helping the people who can not be accepted to the society or improving the area to connect with the current events...etc. For instance, these group may go on a parade to claim the goals in order to attract more people to help or donate money. They may hold a refugee camps to let people enjoy their movement and at the same time, crowds will focus on the main problem or the organizations' aim.
I have been to a hospital to do volunteer work before. At that time, I helped some patient by talking to them or just stayed with them. Also, I did some work like being an secretary, check how many patients today, send the documents to each department or copy some paper...etc. I worked in the hospital about five days, during the time, I have learned whoever you are treating, you should be as much patient and generous as you can. Besides, "Always be on a good mood whatever jobs you choose" a docter said to me. I think it was very correct and useful. It was really an invaluable experience.
In the future, I would like to do some teaching jobs, so next time maybe I will go tutoring children in remote areas. Or teaching the students whose families can not afford them to go to cram school. I think it must be the best way for me to help people. I will keep holding on it.

subject: HW0901
content:
As nonprofit organizations being established in Taiwan commonly, they gradually play an important role in our society. They train lots of people to be volunteers in order to help those who are in need.
Some of the volunteers are professional. They can consult those who experience great grief or toture in their life, such as women suffer from family violence. The professional volunteers may also be doctors who are willing to curing the patients in refugee camps in developing countries. This volunteers are not only well-educated but also very kind-hearted.
Other volunteers are not that professional but definitely very kind. These volunteers are mainly students, they may teach some poor children with their homework or do other easy volunteering services. Both kinds of volunteers are provided by those organizations to help those who are in need. From a small villiage to the whole world, nonprofit organizations are willing to reach their hands out.
I have been a volunteer for a long time. I help poor children with their studies and do some easy job in the organizations. I enjoy the happiness of helping others. In the future, I'll try my best to become a more professional volunteer. As the good saying goes, to give is better than to receive. I always regard being a volunteer as an important experience of my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
When the earthquake occurred few years ago in Taiwan. We can see many nonprofit organizations from other countries came to help people suffering severe disaster. They not only provide the food or drinks we need but also rebuilt our hometown. Even some nonprofit religion organization they know how to help those people lose their parents or friends. With these help, people can survive with something they can rely on.
As a student graduated from university of education, I know that I should have more responsibility to do the volunteer work on educated field. So I have inteled in mountain area which near my home. I teach aboriginal people who are not accept good quality of education when they was young. Although during that period of time I got little support from government but I got achievement from doing volunteer work.
In the future, I hope I can join the worldwild known non-profit organization such as Red Cross. By doing this I can spread my love and dedicated myself to the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Undoubtedly, nonprofit organizations have provided lots of important services in many different area. This kind of movement not only help the people in those area, but do a big favor for local government. For example, running a refugee camps in developing country is such an essential thing for the government. In developing country, the government always has so much work to do, such as taking care of orphans, controlling the disease, even making the country progress. That is why the government usually can not finish the work completely. Because the government is too busy to finish everything perfectly. Nowadays, the nonprofit organizations exactly play an important role for those countries which is in developing.
When I was in junior high, I attended an activity which held by our school. This activity's goal is the tell people there are so many people suffering from starvation, and we, as a healthy child, should cherish everything that we own, and make efforts to take care of the people who need help. We could not eat any food for thirty hours, except for water. During these thirty hours, the participants should bring a box to go through the Tainan city in order to collect things that was destitute. After the activity, these collections would be selled and the money we earned was totally sended to the charity. This activity really made me learn a lesson that not everyone is as fortunate as we are, so we should be more grateful to everything and give hands to those who need our help!

subject: HW0901
content: There are some organizations that strive to improve the wellbeing of mankind by acts of charity such as free medical assistances in some war-torn regions or volunteered works of maintaining the natural ecology balance in places that are devastated by industrial fire. Those services are crucial not only in ways of changing the world physically, but also in delivering an important message. And the message is there are people who will selflessly devoting their lives to create a better tomorrow. I, for one, wish to participate in the work of such organizations. Despite the fact that I'm only a student, I'm convinced that there're still much I can do to help. Personally, I'd like to be working in a hospitol and lend a hand to people who are sick or dying. I understand that while there's not much I can do to improve the patient's physically conditions, I can still be there with them to share their pain, lessen the burden or their minds by talking to them, and make them feel safe and comfortable.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations are founded and they have great influence around the world. For instance, the international nonprofit organization, The Red Cross, has helped thousands of injures and refugees by running hospitols and refugee camps. They send doctors and volunteers to places such as war area and Africa. Doctors cure the locals and volunteers take care of those residents' children. Another example, in Taiwan many organizations form volunteer groups to tutor children and also help elders whose family can't take care of them in the hospital. These services are important, without the effort made by such organizations, many people in war areas would die owing to lack of remedy. Children in remote areas wouldn't have chance to learn. Moreover, imagine when you were old and stayed in a hospital, what would you feel if neither your family nor volunteers take care of you? It shows the significance of these services.
I've done several volunteer works with my church. One time we went to Hospital of Chen-Kong University. I remember some of us were pushing wheelchairs for elders while I was singing to the patients with the chorus of church. Some of us even brought instruments such as flutes! We could see all the patients' face were pleasant, and they seemed to be really enjoy our performance.
"Contribute to our society." is what I dream to do when I grow up. With a view to reaching my goal, I'm going to do several volunteer works during this summer vacation. I have scheduled to tutor children in Ping-tung and Pun-Hu next month. I firmly believe "Giving is better than receiving."

subject: HW0901
content:
There are so many nonprofit organizations helping people all over the world. They provide many services. For example, they help those who live in remote areas and the elder who live alone. They do the helping work like giving them food, teaching them in studies, or even more, building or refurbishing their houses or utilities for them. Sometimes, they would collect lots of things, such as money and stuff old but usable, to give those in need. After disasters like typhoons or earthquakes, they even go to the strictly stricken places to help the refugees rebuild their houses. Those organizations do everything they can to help others get rid of grief and suffering.
In the future, if I could, I would do the volunteer work to help others. People always take the favors from others, so we should always do others a favor. I'm no exception. If I can, I will donate some money or go to remote areas to tutor children or play with them, even help them with housework. If everyone can help those in need, the world will be better and more beautiful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more people who need our helps. There are nonprofit organizations everywhere. They encourages teenagers to join them and help the people in need to overcome.
People are busier in this few centuries, there are lots of old people who are lack of care, the children left them in their home or the hospital, they're so poor that they need others to take care and also be with them. Nonprofit organizations are used to help this kind of people, they send some volunteers to be with the lonely old man and also teach them some fun thing to do, the most important thing is to make them not feeling lonely at all. Also, nonprofit organizations send volunteers to foreign countries to help rescue refugees. When there are earthquacks or tsunami, they'll always be pleased to help.
Last year, I had joined a camp that we couldn't eat for thirty hours. We wanted to know how the people in Africa are. They didn't have enough food to eat, they're unhealthy and weak because of the lack of food. After I joined the camp, I totally realize that we are so lucky to have born in Taiwan. I would also like to volunteer to go abroad to help poor people in foreign countries. Although it will be tired. I could help others on my own, I'll forget all of the difficulties.
In sum, being a volunteer can not only help others but also increase myself. I can learn lots of experiences and lessons through the activities.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations all around the world. They spread love and care making the Earth a better place to live in. The first thing they do is that they give donations to the poor. These donations are money, food, and clothing. Second of all, they work with volunteers to bring love, care, and warmth to the hearts of people that need help. Some of these volunteers could be doctors that can do medical services for free. The last but not the least thing they do is to get the government's help. National organizations such as the Green Peace or Red Cross even got many countries to contribute to people that need help. Thanks to them, handicaps, ill people, the poor are treated better and better.
I always dreamed of attending an organization. I especially hope to work for the Green Peace. I think that environmental problems are the most urgent to humans right now. If we don't get motivated immediately, it's likely that human beings are going to become extinct. As a result, I want people to follow my steps to reduce the use of fossil fuels. I also hope leaders from all over the world could also help fix this issue. If we all work as a team, than there's always hope!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have become more and more common. Some are friendly to our earth and do a lot of things to protect our nature. Others like charities show their great aspiration to help victims who encounter earthquakes, typhoons, or tsunamis.
For example, Red Cross Organization went to poor country in Africa to give a hand to starving children who usually eat only one or two meals a week. The organization also send docters to battles to take care of poor patients losing their limbs due to bombs.
In the future, I'd like to be a volunteer in a hospital. I have already decided to spend two weeks helping nurses to look after patients. Only if you use your heart to touch a patient, do you realize how sad and unfortable a patient is. I have a strong ambition to make myself into a patient's shoes. I hope I can be a good volunteer, and bring love and wishes to all the patients, all the people I met, I meet, and I will meet.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations helping people on the world, such as red-cross. They help many people to cross over some hard times, and give them hope to live on the world. What they done is really important.
They also recruit volunteers to help with their work. Before that, they will train you for over a year. What you will do will effect many people's lifes so you have to well-prepared and have enough knowledges and techniques to do your work. It sounds difficult to join the red-cross, right? Yes, before you want to volunteer to do these works, you should ensure yourself you really want to help people, and you have to be patience before you can go out to help people.
Such this organization, they travel all over the world to help poors in Africa or some low life qualities society and people suffer in earthquake or flood. They provide them some foods, water and medical help until people can do teir own. After that, they go to another place to continue their work.
When I first time hear this kind of organization, I don't believe some people can help others not for their money. But now, I would like to be the volunteer in the future. I want to help people although before that I have to be trained for many years. Everytime I see those suffered after the earthquake, I really want to do something but not just donate money.
But now I am still a student, I can't really get rid of everything to do this work. My plan is when I am 25 and get master's degree, I can volunteer to be volunteers. My parents also agree with me. What I have to do now is to learn more and be ready to be a volunteer after 4 years!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more cherities involve in volunteer works, for example, the Red Cross and YMCA, which has many volunteers to get the job. As soon as there is any dicaster in the world, they will provide any kind of help they can do. Like 911 in the USA, the earthquake in mainland China and in Taiwan. The organizations would send many professions and supplies to help. We have this kind of organization in Taiwan, Chi-Zih, which has many branches all over the world and could get to the place immediately.
I had attenuated a cherity, YWCA, for many years, although, that was 10 years ago. I got a job to serve in the hospital. I just stayed in the information counter to answer some questions. Sometimes, we would go to the senior day-care center. We applied some entertainments to joy the seniors.
In the future, I hope I can be a volunteer again. As long as my children get old enough and I am free to do whatever I wish, I will enter YWCA once more. Because they provide many works to help the poor, the elders, the handicaped people and children, I can join the job as I can.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organization is very important. Since there is a very large gap between dos-and-donts, it is an organization who gives a hand to those people who need resources when they're helpless.
Such organizations provide different kind of services, such as, they would send foods, water, tents, medical volunteers to the place where suffering from disasters; they would also gathering moneys, receipts to help students, sick people or minorities economically. Of course there are still lots of things they do for orphants, they would gathering toys, books or clothes for kids to use. The most meaningful thing they do is to be volunteers in the hospital.
I always give my old clothes and books to nonprofit organization, I feel very happy when I am capable to help others. I think we all must cherish things we own, because think of the kids who are lack of resources, education, or any necessary stuffs, we should be more satisfy and appreciate of what we have.
I have always appreciated volunteers in the hospital and set them as my role-model. I could feel their love and patience to the patients. Being a patients, they must feel very weak psycologically or physically, but their love can always touch their heart, even my heart was touched. Nonprofit organization helps the society and provide resources or even happiness when need. I totally appreciate and hope I may feedback to the society even much more in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are lots of groups helping people in need with no pay. Such is the charible act that the nonprofit organizations are born.
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations gathers volunteers to make the world even better. Their footsteps can be found the entire world. Where the nature disaster happens, they are always the first groups that go to the frontline. Several years ago, when the 921 earthquake hit the middle of Taiwan, hundreds of people died from the earthquake. If it were not for the nonprofit organizations, the recovery wouldn't have been so fast. Furthermore, they also contribute themselves to the environmental protection. You may see them convincing people to do well garbage recycling and clean the street. They do really do a lot of things for the world.
Last but not least, I am a part of the world, so I have the responsibility to make the world better. Since I was little, I have donated some money to the nonprofit organizations. But I think I should do even more things as I have grown up. Let me jump into the organizations and help people living in remote areas. So that I will be truely happy and calm.

subject: HW0901
content: In modern times, most of people enjoy their life in comfortable. We almost get everything we want and easily waste the resource around our life. However, there are some people spread over the world live the miserable life, they certainly need our help. Fortunately, there are some organizations to help these people. For instance, taking care of the orphans or the elderly, being the volunteers to accompany with patients, or even help the poor in foreign countries. For those who reach out their hands to the people in need, it is not a job but the joy of life. In fact, I havent done any volunteer work, but I have been looking forward to volunteering in Africa to educate the children. To sum up, it will be a great way to live my life to the fullest.

subject: HW0901
content: In a so-called nonprofit organizations, they are known as charity organizations. They run the business not for making profits, but for taking care of people who need help. Take Red-Cross as an example, they build some hospitals in developing countries to cure the ill people. Furthermore, in Taiwan, there are many kind-hearted people volunteer to tutor children in remote areas. In my opinion, to give is better than to receive. As a result, I was once a volunteer teaching English in Taidong. Children there were so innocent and curious. Although we had to stay up late to prepare the materials, it's still my most wonderful experience as an English teacher.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are so many nonprofit organizations in the world. More and more people volunteer to help with their work. They have helped a lot of people not only in Taiwan but also in other countries. If there is a serious earthquake or flood, these organizations will go to that place and do their best to help those people who need helps. They also go to remote areas to take care of children and the old, providing them food, clean water and medicine equipments. Most importantly, they give refugee a sweety home.
I have done volunteer work in the hospital. I helped the old who were disabled and played with children in the toy room. I think it was wonderful experience. I learned many things. If I have chance next time, I will do it.

subject: HW0901
content:
The world is unfair. Some people were born with a silver spoon while others were born with nothing. Even when we think the world is peaceful and we don't have to worry everything about our lives, there is still plenty of people who need our helps. They don't have water, foods and future.
However, there are so many organizations funded, such as the Red Cross Organization. Everytime when there is some disasters, they'll come to help them. First, owing to being poor, people live in developing countries don't have houses to live. When the nonprofit organizations are award of this, they'll come to help them build houses without any repay. Second, they'll also teach the children in order to let more people be literate because this is very important for a developing country. Third, some places don't have clean water to drink so they dig some holes for finding clean water. The nonprofit organizations are very helpful for those who are in need. They never ask for repay and always feel happy helping them.
Last year, I was invited by a church to tutor children in the mountains. At first, I was afraid that I couldn't do well on this job and tutoring children who live in the mountain would not be so easy. But I went for a try. However, it was not like a nightmare but a wonderful experience. Children were so cute and I taught them English. Although it might be the first time for them to speak English, they still tried hard doing well. I was totally touched. Thus, I taught them everything they were not taught from their teacher. We all had a wonderful summer vacation. This year, I would like to go abroad to help more people who are in need and I think I'll join the refugee camps.
The nonprofit organizations play an important role of helping people. Helping those who are in need not only is a greatful job but also will enrich your lives. If you want to help people, why not join the nonprofit organizations?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are now famous and helpful in Taiwan. Take Red Cross for example, it provides the medical care and some food supplies for the poor. Besides, sometimes it will hold an activity to raise money for people suffering from proverty, natural disasters, and some inevitable health diseases. Others nonprofit organizations do these similar job just like the Red Cross. Some of them even recruit volunteer teachers to teach children living in mountains and distant countries in Taiwan. In short, people in Taiwan live a better place because of these kind-hearted help.
As for me, being a student in educational university provides plenty of ability and eagerness for me to help the students in the remote areas in Taiwan. Every time I read the news of poor family and their children unable to go to school, I feel sorrowful and willingness to help in my mind. One day, if I get the chance and have enough ability, I would like to join nonprofit organizations to do my best to help those children in need!

subject: HW0901
content:
Volunteer works has become popular with this decades. Those nonprofit organizations which provide such opportunities hiring the volunteers for charity but not business. Due to some of the works are tiring, less efficient for earning money and need more patient, most people tended not to do such job in the past. However, through educating as well as public advertising, more people have realized the importance of these jobs, such as constructing aggrecultural and medical systems in developing countries. It is quite an important issue for us to understand that there are still things other than political and economical problems needed to be figuring out.
To my personal interest, I would like to be a teacher in a poor country. I would be pleasant introducing them some news happening in the world. In virtue of education, I believe the children may achieve their goals and thus enable to feed their families. I hope to construct their philosophy of live, help them have abilities to tell what to do is right and how to do that by means of the information from the books. In conclusion, the works provided by nonprofit organizations seem a necessity in our present days.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, many nonprofit organizations have appeared in an increasing rate. They're available not only in Taiwan but in the whole world.
Those organizations provide many means to help people. First, when people are injured in the natural damage, they always provide food, water and some necessities for those injured people. They may also build a temporary house for them. Second, they also send teachers to those remote areas to help children living there being educated.
I remember once I was in a nonprofit organizations as a volunteer. I took many products which the organization were planned to sell. In that case money which is provided by people, who bought the products could be given to poor children. Though walking across the roads was really tiring, I still had a great sense of happiness in my mind due to volunteering.
There are still many poor people lie in the world. Those nonprofit organizations' volunteers are respectful to me. To help people is the basic of happiness. If I have the chance, I'll help people as more as I can.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowaday, nonprofit organizations paly an important role to help the poor people. Some organizations focus on the welfare of the elders and children. They encourage people to donate and sometimes they sell something to get money, and then they use this sum of money to help those who need help desperatly. On the other hand, some organizations help the poverty in other countries. Their love transcend the boundries of our nation. They recruit volenteers to form a team to support the people in developing countries.
When I was in university. I attended a student association - Social Service Team. I joined many plans, programs and activities in this team and learned a lot from it. There was one teaching assistance impressed me deeply was to teach in an elementary school in mountain area. That is a small school with less than one hundred students and nine teachers there. Most of the students were Taroko Tribe. Their learning resources was poor and they even have no library there. Compared with the students in normal schools, their language abilities were very bad including Chinese and English. I considered that bad language ability would affect one person's learning and development in any field in future. We went there to teach them English and Art. They studied very hard and cherish the learning chance. I like to chat with them after class. I found them are really positive and happy even though their life and learning quality was not as good as that of city students. I really like to keep company with them so I decided to dedicate myself in education and I will do a lot of teaching assistance in mountain areas.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the increasing percentage of people in this world are educated more and more, individuals tend to recognize that there is a risponsibility to help those who are in need, so now these individuals gather together and many nonprofit organizations are founded. Where there is disaster or help in need they are surely to be there, you name it the Red cross, Chi Qi...etc.
For example when the 921 earthquake struck Taiwan, the disatrous Tsunami in the south east and recently when the Si Chuan earthquake ocurred, countless of these organizations gather up and came to help in the first place. In the future I would like to help more as a volunteer, because it is always a nice thing that you know at least you can do this world a favor.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas or running refugee camps in developing countries. Such organization could help the people in remote area to get more resources. For example, the volunteers may teach the childrens in their school learning, so the kids can get more information around the world. Some helpers may try to teach those people how to grow vagetables and how to purify their water, and this kind of training can promote the quality of food in developing contries.
