In the remote area, the residues there always can not get medical therapy very well, and these medical volunteers will take care of them. Above all, the nonprofit organizations can provid many kinds of services for the people who needed. As for me, I have never been a volunteer before. However, if I have the oppitunity, I would like to be a tutor to teach those kids. In the remote area, the children there always can not get great and complete training programs. I want to be the tutor to teach those children many things, not only teaching them the school courses, but also some basic attitude toward the society and some behaviors or thinkings to communicate with others. I think the children is the base of a country, so I would like to try any posibilities to take care of them and make them feel more better in their mind. And I also hope he could be a great man in the future due to the thinkings I gave him.

subject: HW0901
content: Bathed in the setting sun, the plastic box in my arms carried a glimmer of gold. The box was very heavy; neverless, I walked on the road with a joyful smile on my face. I was a volunteer of a nonprofit organization last summer. We collected toys, clothes and rice and gave them to the orphans. I know there are a lot of nonprofit organizations out there, such as Free The Children and Chi-Yu, which give a hand to these children and ask for no repay. During my time of volunteering, I saw many children expressed an optimistic attitude and dealed with the difficulties in their lives courageously. Even though some of them were haunted by some traumatic experiences, they still view the world in a positive fashion and faced challenges bravely. They taught me a significant lesson: look on the bright side at all times. As far as I consider, join these unprofit organizations can not only help people in need but help ourselves to precious what we have.

subject: HW0901
content: Today, everyone knows the world is a globle villiage. We are supposed to help others who are in difficult situations. So, there are nonprofit organizations showed up. They not only devote themselves but also give a lot of resources for those people who really need others' help. For me, I ever took part in serval of these activities. I learned a lot from them. There are many children who live in a proverty condition. All they want is to have a big dinner or some clothes to wear. They can't take education even they have some kind of illness that born to be. You may hear a saying "Giving is better than Receiving". In Taiwan, most of the people don't have to worry about basic living. I think the government should encourage our people who have abilities to donate or join the nonprofit organizations. In the future, I would like to go abroad, such as Africa- the developing country. I saw a lot of information about some countries in Africa. The people live there suffer a lot of pain and shortage of food, medicine, education and so on. I wish I could give them a hand and set them free from such unfortune.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, many people like to join this work. They provide some important services. For example, go to their home to give them some food or books. Sometimes they will build some school for children who don't have enough money to go to school or live in remote areas. They will go to their home and stay with them. Let them know there are many people care about them and tell them don't give up and move on.
If I have a chance to be a volunteer, I will go to abroad and run refugee camps in developing countries. I have saw some TV programs which take photos in Africa so this is why I want to go there. I am good at cooking so I can make some food or snacks for them. Maybe I can teach them some math or chinese. Most important, I want to give them some hope, they still have hope. We can do it step by step. They will have better life in the future.
Some people live in developing countries have passive thoughts and live very poor. Some situation will make us think "Is it will happen in our earth?" Yes, it's. In our life, we have a lot of convience and we don't know there are still some areas need our help. This is why need volunteer.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are lots of organizations around the world. Some of them do not fight for their countries, or argue with others. What kind of job do they do? They help those who are in need. They build bridges for villages in mountain areas, buy some food for the poor, educate the orphans, help to tidy up the slums.
In modern society, the gap between the rich and the poor becomes bigger and bigger. However, we always ignore the people who need help. But things will be changed. More and more volunteers and nonprofit organizations start to be helpers. You can see them in almost every corner where needs assistance.
As a teenager, I help the world by doing volunteer work in elderly center. Though I was shy at the beginning, I still overcame my fear. Every Sunday, I go there and chat with them. Occasionally, I clean their bedrooms or even cook for them. I got the achievement from their laughter, and the elderly center didn't mean "dying" anymore. Because of our help, those old people pick up their happiness again.
"Giving is better than receiving." As the saying goes, we should try our best to do something for others. The nonprofit organizations set a good example for all of us. As long as we join the volunteer work, we can not only learn from it but also perfect the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many services provided by the nonprofit organization. According to the knowledge that I knew, there are the services of food supplyment, education and establishment. Now, I'll going to explain my reasons.
First, in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries, the food is very less, since they can not produce food or produce less food by themselves. Furthermore, they don't have enough money to buy the food. Therefore, the nonprofit organization supply the food to maintain their food. Everyone should know that human can not live without water and food.
Second, they have less resource of education because they even always in the starving situation. However, if people don't have chance to accept education from childhood, their knowlege and the attitude for life must be affected. They may have wrong value of life or less competitive ability after working. After all, education plays a key role for every children.
Third, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to establish their house. Many people they don't have their own house due to the earthquake or the typhoon. The volunteers help them to build their house, and make them have the place to live. Although it takes a lot of time, the thanks from the victims is priceless.
To sum up, nonprofit organizations provid the service of food supplyment, education and establishment. In my view, I would like to teach the children in remote areas or developing countries in the future. I believe I can get a lot from teaching because helping others is the source of happiness.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the past, people always concern about themselves because cultures are not as developed as it do now. Some people nowadays do not have to work so hard to keep their life going, so they will use their money or useful ability to help others, and this is also the reason of the excistance of charities and nonprofit organizations.
Greenpeace have been a very stable and helpful organization. The services that Greenpeace provides are always related to global issues, and one of it is about reducing cow fart. According to a science study of global warming, scientists defined that the main cause of global warming is the abundant amount of releasing cow fart. Due to this study, Greenpeace decide to gather all the people on Earth to decrease the amount of eating cows, and finally they had a great success on this project. Also, there are many people around the world decide to be a vagetarian to reach the goal of reducing cow fart.
During senior high, our school provides us the oportunities to service other people who need help. For instance, school will take us to a nursing house where lots of homeless old people stayed, and gives us some work to do, such as chatting with those elder people or cleaning up the mess after they finish their meal. This is a unforgetable precious experience that I will never forget, and it makes me more cherish the things or people that I own now.
In the future, I still want to do more volunteer work to help other people and donate the things that I do not need or money to those nonprofit organizations. This help me become a better person, and I will do my best to persuade the people I know to join me.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, many nonprofit organizations not only take care those who need help but also sprade the concept that we should help others as much as we can.
The organizations have done lots of services. For example, teaching students who are poor or live far from the cities, caring for disableds and old people, job-training, finding opportunities for words, and, go to the places where have natural disasters or wars and supply them medical-helps. With more and more volunteers and the donations from the sociaty, numerous people have recieved help.
Being a student, because I don't have many money for donating, therefore, I've gone to the orphanage and taught orphans. I also have been a volunteer in the hospital and donate some books and clothes to the related organizations. In the future, I hope I can take part in the organizations and take care of the disableds. I believe that as we share our love and warm with them, people who need help will have a better life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Since governments can't handle all the situations in the society, nonprofit organizations have become more and more important in recent years. Nonprofit organizations consist of volunteers from everywhere who are willing to help those in need. They make their efforts to beautify the world.
Some nonprofit organizations offer a way you can share your downs and they will give you some advice. This service can reduce the rate of suicide. Other organizations can offer medical and financial helps. With this service, the poor can change their original lifestyles. They can lead a better life and have abilities to learn and work. In addition, this service can narrow the gap between the rich and the poor, and this can make the whole society prosperous.
Last year, I went to a hospital as a volunteer. All I did was put the information in order and cleaned the enviroment. The most impressive thing was that I saw a doctor help a little girl with her leg's recovery. Her face was full of pain but the doctor kept encouraging her. From then on, I have decided to be a doctor and work in a nonprofit organization. Because I think offer medical care is a way to express love and love is priceless. I just want to help others but I don't want to be paid back.
Nonprofit organizations help many people in the world. If we can do something to make the world more beautiful, try our best!

subject: HW0901
content:
Recent years, more and more nonprofit organizations around the world is trying hard to help the ones in deep seas, such as people that suffers from natural disaster, wars, disease or even poverty. And Taiwan is no exceptional.
Nonprofit organization throughout the world provides a wide range of services, and each with its expertise. For instance, some organizations like red cross specializes on medical help in wars and natural disasters while the LION specializes on helping the poverty in Africa and other places. Still others like Chi-mei, specializes on building educational system for children in remote areas. Apart from these, there are still a lot of organizations, each with its own mission, helping to improve the enviorment around us.
As a senior high school student, I have volunteered in a few organizations, such as Chi-ji and Red cross. What I did was just gathering receipts from passerbys for the homeless. I don't think this is enough to help the world, thus, I still look forward to go abroad and join some international nonprofit organizations someday.
Without these volunteering organizations, our society would be a selfish world with everybody minding their own business, thus, we should held out our helping hands to the world from new on!

subject: HW0901
content:
Some groups such as Buddism Tsi-Chi and Red-Cross Foundation, do a lot of chality all over the world.
Take Tsi-Chi for example, the group has a lot of volunteers from all walks of life. At my working place, Jia-ba Elementary School, these volunteers teach students how to save energy and don't waste resources in our earth. The students learn to recycle the cans, papers, plastic bottles and used textbooks, furthermore, the kids were effected by the volunteers, so they know it's important to cherish what they have and make a wonderful environment for people to live in.
These volunteers in Tsi-Chi use their spare time and dedicate their life to the children. All what they have done did move my mind and emotion. Although I don't have particular religion belief, their service let me believe in the proverb "Giving is better than receiving." Their unprivite spirit also make a good modle for people.
I used to be a volunteer in National Taichunug Veterinarian Hospital when I were a student in Providence University. I also saw some good kind people doing voluntary service for patients. Those volunteers teach me a big lesson. Each one is just like the sister Teresa in India. I hope that one day, I'll keep on doing this kind of service to make the world glitter, be better and more wonderful.

subject: HW0901
content:
In some far-flung nations, volunteers of nonprofit organizations (NPO) are the saviors to local people. They don't just help make the lives better, they devote their own lives wholeheartedly. I just attended a speech by a volunteer in an orphanage in Thailand. They feed the children, and because the kids are too poor to receive the education, volunteers also have to teach the kids. Apart from that, many NPOs also provide services in countries with on-going civil wars, like Sudan. Volunteers help the people build their own houses and offer food so that they don't starve.
During the summer vacation of 2005, I offered to be a volunteer in a remote village in Pintung. There, the school library was not equipped with enough books, students didn't have many resources. And because everyone was poor, not many of them were motivated to study hard and make life better. Although life was hard, everyone was surprisingly satisfied and happy. I imagine they were born to be optimistic. After two months, I went home with a humble and less materialist mind.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations and volunteers work hard helping people all over the world. They educate children who live far from the city and they run camps to help developing countries.
One of the organizations, The Red Cross, runs an meaningful camp called "Thirty Hours of Hunger." The Red Cross wants to tell everyone that we should always be thankful when we are having meals, for there are still many poor people can hardly bear the cost of the meals.
Another nonprofit organization, Zhi-Chi (), which is founded in Huai-Lian () in Taiwan, always encourage people to contribute money for the poors in the whole world. In addition, whenever there are disasters happened, Zhi-Chi always sends volunteers to help people there restarting their lifes. Few years ago, when the tsunami happened in South Asia, Zhi-Chi send thousands of volunteers and food and water there to help saving people. All of the volunteers from Zhi-Chi devoted their lifes to the work of looking for survivals.
In my own experience, I've once been a volunteer to help my uncle curing patients in remote areas in Tainan County. Since I was young at that time, I could only help with some easy work, such as directing the elders to the correct place and serving medicines for the patients. It's a good experience for me that I started helping others since then. If there is a chance, I wish I could volunteer more and help more people in the future.
Giving is always better than receiving. We should help others more without expecting to get paid. If we do so, once we need help in a rush, others will also help us in no doubt.

subject: HW0901
content:
There would be parents who cannot afford their children's education tuition and poor guys who would starve to death if he doesn't beg in the street even in a well-developed country. Instead of sitting and doing nothing, some kind people set up nonprofit organizations to recruit volunteers who are willing to devote their contribution to the society.
Different kind of nonprofit organizations focus on different fields of contribution. Generally speaking, they are all volunteers willing to help wherever and whenever it is necessary. They may help to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan, or run refugee camps in developing countries. In addition, when there is a natural disaster, they would come and try to decrease the damages of that country's victims, like the severe damages caused by hurricanes in southern America.
These kind of brave and kind activities really inspire me, making me start to ponder what I can do for this society. I've participated in a club called "kind children" in my university. Every week, we took a bus to a institution where a lot of children who had no parents stayed. We not only played games with them but also teach them to do their homework. Seeing the beautiful smiles on their faces, I always felt very touched and want like to do much more to make them happy as well.
Nowadays, it is awesome that more and more nonprofit organizations spring up and more and more people are involved in these kind of activities. I'm very happy to be one of volunteers to help as well as contribute to this society and I'm willing to do more in the future.

To take care of crying babies and teach math, we lived in the small town for a week. No computers, no TV, there were only crying kids and hard works waiting. Why didn't we stay home and play onlines games during the summer vacation? What we found after the hard time is the great experience of helping others.
As the world changes, most people's lives get better and better. It seems like our world is such a great place. But there're still people who can't enjoy the way we live. Why don't we spread the joy to them and change their lives. Having a great world everyone enjoying is much better than the heaven of yourself.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many organizations founded to help the needed in the world. They will appear in the area which was struck by natural disasters. They provided both the volunteers and the food to help the country.
I have never done such volunteer works before. But in this summer vacation, I decide to do it. Try to do my best to help the needed. I will take part in the volunteer work in the hosiptal. To learn how to take care of the patients is my first step in my schedule. Later, I may join the bigger organization such as the "Red Cross Church."
Although what I can do is little but I will try my best. I think everyone has to do such volunteer works once a life at least. It can make us be more appreciated to present life. I think the more you do, the more happy you might be.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the advance of our world, people have chances to understand what it really is outside our own country. However, there are still many places under developing and in need of helping to solve their problems or to ease their situation. Thus, that is why more and more nonprofit organizations pop up in recent years.
What nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers do to the world can be divided into a few sections as follows. First, it is the aid of medical resources that prvents many people to die from diseases which we know how to cure them. Second, it is in terms of farming teaching that help people in remote area to plant so that they could live on their own without little food supply. Third, it is the help of education resources, such as books and computers, that enables kids to learn more knowledge and connect with the world.
With three above mentioned are the basic yet important services from organizations. As a citizen in global society, I should devote myself in such organizations. Thus, I decide to help to solve the problem of education resources. It is not about reputation and wealth, just a matter to make the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the modem society, nonprofit organizations play an important and indispensable roles in our daily lives. They recruit some generous people to do volunteer work such as taking good care of the elderly, tutoring students in remote areas, or helping those who suffer from sickness or accidence. These nonprofit organizations provide all kinds of assisstance with those need help. For example, Whenever there is earthquake, volunteers around the work give a hand to those who get struck in the ground. What's more, children who live in remote areas are usually lack of the oppotunities to learn knowledge, and some volunteers would devotes themselves to teaching and educating them. For greying people, some nonprofit organizations would take good care of them, keep accompany with them and provide them with the medical resource.
I have done volunteer work when I was in my college life. I went to a remote area to be a teacher. I was happy to teach those students. Unlike children in a big city, they were very cute and simple. I liked to shared my learning experiences with them, and they were immersed in those interesting stories. What's more, I prepared many second-hand books and English vedios for them. Through the mass-media, it was knowledge that broadened their horizons and enriched their lives. At that time, I dedicated myself to teaching them what I know. I hoped that those children could realize their dream one day.
I really benefits a lot from this experience. As the Chinese saying goes, "Helping others is a source of pleasure." Teaching children in remore areas adds varieties to my life. I am very happy to help others and so do those in need. If I have oppotunites to join nonprofit organizations in the future, I will devote myself to helping other people.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are different kinds nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They usually take care about something or someone that nobody really cares. For example Tzu-Chi do the trash recycle in the community for many years. All they want is to make our life better and to protect our planet. Some people may choose to donate money to those people who need help. I know some of the students will go to the remote area like Hua-lien or Tai-Tung to accompany the children in these country. They may study with the children or do some activities with them in the summer or winter vacation.
When I was a student, I usually do the volunteer work in the church. We held the summer camp for the children. Every year, in the beginning of the semeaster we had to make up the plan, then disscused for all the details to make sure everybody in the camp will have fun and sweet memories. It was not an easy job, because I have to take care of my study at the same time. For me, it was kind of pressure. Sometimes, I'll think of why I have to afford such of heavy work, why can't I just enjoy my student life and have fun in the summer vacation. At last, I got the answer, when I had the disscustions with my partners, we got to know each other more, and at the end of the summer camps I can also have the best memories about it. I think that is the most important thing I've learned in the volunteer work.

subject: HW0901
content: Due to the amazing progress of people's lives, the whole world is just like a global village. We can get the lastest news or converse with people in different countries. And this is the main factor that volunteer works are gaining popularity. There is a wide variety of volunteer work, including tutoring poor children, running refugee camps, providing food or nursing for people in disastrous areas, etc. Thus, the nonprofit organizations play an important role in planning these services. Take the Red Cross for an example, giving a helping hand to the poor is its chief purpose. Wherever there are some disasters, the Red Cross always spares no effort to give their help. So far, there are countless people receiving their helpful services to get through the obstacles. As far as I am concerned, the behavior of those merciful volunteers really touch me. Consequently, I am always willing to help with their volunteer work. That is why I have done some meaningful volunteer work. That is why I have done some meaningful volunteer work like going to the hospital to look after the elderly and taking part in Hunger 30. These activities fill my life with pleasure. Maybe in the future, I will continue to do these kinds of volunteer work and learn to give love and help to the needy people.

subject: HW0901
content:
In our society, there are lots of social problems waited to be solved. Fortunately, we have many volunteers who committed themself to working on those subject.
Some organizations help people who suffer from marriage violence. Not only husband and wife but the whole family may live under the threat when it happen. Organizations provide the access to medical care and shelters as well. Sometimes they will help suffers recover from the mental problems.
Globlizism makes us meet different people. However, there are discrimination among us. Some consider their own cultural are the best, and others are forced to live under their shadow. Volunteers fight for racial subject. They help to prevent some culture from disappear and have some parades.
Although I am just a student, I would love to be a volunteer. I do my best to protect the environment and keep the concept of 3R in mind, reduce, reuse and recyle. I hope I can do more things in the future and the world will be better because of all the volunteers hard work.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations have show on the news. These organizations help people without the bound of the country lines. From the cities to the deepest mountain, they help those who need help without any pay back. They help the refugee in flood, the country suffer from the war. They provide clean space, water, hot food for living. They sometimes ever have financial support to raise the economy of the area.
In the college I studied, we have several this kind of group, some take care of the child, some go into the maintain in holiday to care for the people, some even take care of the street dog.

I barely seen young man or adult, instade of old people and children, we spand a day and half is that town, we perform some shows and made some activites with them, I can feel the happiness, It really makes me unforgetable.

subject: HW0901
content:
We can't doubt the dedication of those nonprofit organizations all over the world. Without these devotions and efforts offered by those volunteers from different countries, people in need would be suffering and miserable. Once there is a natural disaster happening in developing countries, these volunteers always prepare sufficient food and daily necessities and bring them there without hesitation. They also give help to the poor everywhere in the world, giving them what they need and teaching them how to earn a living on their own. Thanks to their kindness, the world becomes wonderful and better because of their sacrifice.
I really appreciate people who always be in other's shoes and try their best to help others. Recently, many singers or movie stars have made good use of their popularity and influence to help people in need in the foreign countries. They experienced the lives in the poorest area and understood how grave and severe the situation was. I hope I can do the same thing to help others by going to those countries in need, giving them the first-hand help and trying my best to influence those people who ignore and don't pay attention to the problem. Only by everyone's help and devotion, the world can become more peaceful and hopeful.

subject: HW0901
content:
I really admire the members of those nonprofit organizations. Then are always the first group of people to arrive at the place that need help. For example, after the szunami in southern Asia, people from different countries came to rescue someone they never met before! Another recent example was that those rescue teams went to China, after the great earthquake! They're not afraid of death, all they want to do is to save more lives, that's why I admire them so much. They are still saving this world by doing many other things.
First, they adopt orphans and help them with their education. They find a shelter for beggars to live. They run refugee camps in developing countries and support those people with medicines, and food. Furthermore, they send volunteers to hospital to stay with the patients. That's what I've been doing lately. I go to the hospital every weekend to stay and talk with the patients.
I want to do something! I'm going to study hard and save those sick and homeless people by being a doctor in the future. I want to help this world!

subject: HW0901
content:
It is some nonprofit organizations' goals to narrow the gap between the rich and poor. It is of good importance to recruit volunteers to help the poor. Everyone is in a global village and is supposed to help others, especially, those in need.

I think I will not only learn from teaching but also get smiles from those willing to learn. I hope one day in the future I will become a great teacher to teach those who are thirsty for knowledge and those who are poor and willing to learn.

subject: HW0901
content:
Can you image a person is starved to death and no one help him? This really happaned in Asia. There are lots people suffering danger, hunger and pain without any help. Therefore, more and more people regard nonprofit organizations as a necessity. Nonprofit organizations solve the difference between the city and country. They recruit volunteers to tutor children in remote areas and give lots donations to improve the life of the poor. I didn't join the nonprofit organizations before, but I have a plan to join them after one year. Knowing there are still many people suffering pain in the world, I want to help some out of their trouble.

subject: HW0901
content:
There's no denying that nonprofit organizations play a very prominent role in our world nowaday. It's no exaggration to say that we can't do without them. There are many important services provided by such organizations. For example, many years age, there was a serious earthquake in Taiwan. The nonprofit organizations from all around the world came to help us. They rescued many precious lives and provide medication that in need. If it hadn't been for them, we wouldn't be able to get through that by ourselves. Besides, the organizations like Red Cross save many people in Africa. Those underdeveloped countries are so lack of clean water, food and money. They couldn't survive without the help from those nonprofit organizations. I'm really thankful to those nonprofit organizations. They try hard to make the world better. They save many lives,
If I have chance to do volunteer work in the future, I would probably go to Africa. I've heard of so many sad stories of those poor children. That would be an unforgettable experience. We always take what we have for granted and even don't satisfy to what we own. I want to experience their life, and help them. I could teach those children reading. Education is powerful than everything. Additionally, I want to teach them how to get rid of terrible diseases. Last but not least, I would donate some money to nonprofit organizations. Those money would be used to buy their food, water or clothes in need. The world would be better because of my voluteer work and these nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
In hospitals, we often see some people in bright yellow vests, pushing wheelchairs or talking to patients. Volunteering has become a quite popular activity in Taiwan these years which emphasizes the generousity needed in the modern society.
Indeed, more and more organizations have been created to help the disabled, the elderly or orphans. Volunteers would go to small villages or into the mountains to visit places like orphantages to take care of the kids. There, they teach the children to read, help the children with their daily requirements and have fun with the children. These services can be seen with the disable and elderlies, too. It might be tiring to help these people, but it's a very generous thing to do.
Though I haven't been a volunteer thus my life, but just to think of it gives me an anxious feeling. From the basic, I would like to help the patients in hospitals, and enjoy the achievement of helping others.

subject: HW0901
content:
It goes without saying that it's better to give than to receive. People around the world believe in this creed, and I'm no exception. Take the most prestigious nonprofit organization - THe World Vision - for example. it has done many things for those in need. First, this organization raises money for the poor in order to give them enough food to eat. Second, the volunteers of the organization are devoted themseves to helping African children with their education. Third, the organization hold a lot of campaigns with a view to showing people the truth that not everyone in the world are lucky. Some people suffer from sickness and some are starving to death.
Student as I am, I am willing to be a volunteer. Last year, I took part in the activity "thirty-hour famine" held by World Vision. It was an activity that called for everyone's sympathy for those who have no food to eat. At first, it was painful for me to eat nothing. However, after watching videos about the misfortune in Africa, I began to cry and thought how lucky I was to be able to live in Taiwan. In the end, I made it. I eat nothing for 30 hours, but I got a lot from the experience. I should always keep gratitude in mind and offer help for who are less fortunate than me. After all, it's better to give than to receive.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations, which consist of lots of passionate and active volunteers. As volunteers are not based on the profit, the services are by heart more than others' orders.
There are a lot of nonprofit organizations serving the people in need worldwide; some of people can't even live without them. They provide every kinds of helps such as offering benefits to those in need, rescuing those in catastrophe, educating those who couldn't be educated and spotting on the administrations.
Since I was a students, I had little time to be volunteers in nonprofit organizations, I would like to be the doctor and serving people in devastations after natural disaster or war. Curing people who in need is the most briefing way to rescue them from phsical pain. Disaster take place every where, therfore people in need are every where. I hope I can do my best in curing others in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations exist in all kinds of styles and play a essential role on humanitarian assistance.
One of the most remarkable organizations is World Food Program. It launched a fascinating website which allows Internet users to help those who suffer from hunger. All you have to do is answer questions that are related to school academy. Once you get a question right, the organization donates five grains of rice to famine-stricken regions!
The other impressive one is Taiwan Route Medical Peace Corpse. It provides countries of poor sanitary conditions with medical assistance, including medicine, vaccines and volunteers. Last year, when the cholera erupted in Zimbabwe, the Corpse sent a team consisted of doctors and nurses there, to the local residents' aid. As a consequence, their deeds recieved high praise from the international media!
As for myself, I've been a voluntary worker for Yellow Ribbon Organization. I tutor junior high school students who can't catch up with their studies once every week. Just lately, I learned a voluntary job which is to translate feedback letters from foreign kids who received donations from World Vision. I'm very fond of this volunteer work and look forward to giving it a try.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations helping the poor in the world. They often go to warzone and some poor developing countries to help the local people. Clean water, food and refugee are provided by them. Also, there are some doctors working in such organization, so they can give the local patient proper treatment and improve they sanitary system.
I have ever been a volunteer in the hospital. In that period. I worked in the hall of the hospital to help people who want to borrow wheelchairs. Everyday I saw many people go into hospital with different purpose. Some are go to visit their family member who is sick. Some are go to see the doctors And some are go to be a volunteer just like me. I think that be a volunteer working in the hospital is very meanful and I find that when I help others, I will feel happy. So in order to continue being happy, I would still like to be a volunteer when having free time.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there're many kinds of nonprofit organizations which help people not only in our country, Taiwan, but also in other poor countries. When there are serious disasters happened, they work out for the unlucky people.
The nature disaster such as earthquake, usually cause buildings fall and people frightened. These people without their home need things to maintain their lifes. The nonprofit organizations will send foods and water help them and save alive but seriously hurt people. The nonprofit organizations also concentrate on the enviorment issue. They make sign words and tell people to protect the enviorment. To avoid people from humanbeing disasters, they do their best.
I've been a volunteer for an activity named "Starving 30" which tried to let people understand the starving people in Africa. We walked along roads and streets as many as we could and asked for money to help the starving poor people. It was so tired, but I was so happy to help poor people.
In the future, I would like to join nonprofit activities as many as I can. To me helping people without taking back anything doesn't mean waste time, but brings happiness.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations, whose number is growing swiftly, have helped countless people from all over the world thanks to those worldwide volunteers. Frequently, we received news about civil wars, hunger of the poor, and even disasters......etc. As we pitied the victims, however, we saw the hope of the world as well. There would always be nonprofit organizations offering money, food, and drinks to people in trouble, and medical crews giving first-aid to victims. Being voluteers, they asked for nothing given back. They helped out of charity.
Right now, right here, I am still a 16-year-old student studying in high school. Neverthless, my heart is always filled with love and concern. As for the future, I would like to be a long-term volunteer, offering all that I possess, to make the world full of happiness and joyness.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations is now important in modern society because they provide people in need with help. For example, they run refugee camps during wars and help people in remote areas to have contact with the world.
I once read a report about those nonprofit organizations's services. They will train volunteers for months with knowledge about how to treat people with medicine and then send those volunteers to the places in need. Almost all these nonprofit organizations are established for the purpose of rescuing people who are suffering. That's why I have always been willing to be a volunteer.

Noneprofit organization which aims to improve everone's lives recruit volunteers to help with their work nowadays, and I think we should give them a hand out of compassion for others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Non-profit organizations has increased greatly nowadays. Not only do they recruit volunteers to help the needy around the world, but also donate the necessity to the poor. All the volunteers with kind-hearted notion bear in mind, willing to pass on their love and care to every corner in the world.

For instance, when it comes to throw an auction, many kind-hearted people will donate their clothes, shoes, or the second-hand things to the charity so that the charity could raise the fund to go on their next rescue movement. The organization also running refugee camps and teaching children in remote areas in Taiwan. That's the opportunity that I go for and learn lots of lessons in my lifetime. Last summer, hearing that there was going to recruit some teenagers to go to remote school to tutor the children. How naive and cute the kids are that I did my best to teach them what I have learned. They also shared their ups and down with us and had a lot of fun. It was until I joined this acitivity that I knew that there are still someone who was in need of our help. subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations, and these organizations provide many services that are very helpful to the poor. For example, some volunteers in the organization may spend their time with single-parent children. Very often, these children's mothers or fathers are too busy to take care of them. After school, these children usually fool around on the street, or play video games. With the help of the volunteers, the children can find a place to do their homework, and when they have problems in their studies, the volunteers can help them.
Another example is the free medical care. Some doctors and nurses may use their holidays to go to remote areas, and the poor people can go to see the doctor without paying any money. This service really helps a lot, because some poor people don't have money, they may have a serious disease, but couldn't go to the hospital, and that disease would claim their lives.
My personality is patient, sympathetic, and I like to help people. So last summer vacation I went to the hospital to be a volunteer. Although my work was running some erands, it was very simple, but to the hospital, my work really helped it a lot. I enjoy being an volunteer, and I learn a lot from it. And this summer I will be a volunteer again!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have been an important characteristic of today's modern society. Because those volunteers find out that there are so many people in need today but the government can't come to their aid, with this in mind, they start to do something to help those who are in need with their passion. For instance, many volunteers are willing to take care of the patients with chornic diseases, talk with those who have spiritual problems, and also enter the hospital to give different kinds of assistence. When they don't know how to deal with these kind of problems, having no choice but to concede. Due to their helpless situation, nonprofit organizations are always there, providing warm services like angels.
With those social news broadcasting on TV everyday, it dawned on me that I could to something to make the world more fascinating by helping those who are in need, even though I am a senior high school student at the age of seventeen, I devoted myself tutoring the elementary school students in the aspect of teaching Chinese, math and English subjects. At first, I thought that those children would be difficult to get along with. Instead, I realized that they were so innocent that they always wore a smile. Though I have to stop tutoring these children for a year, I resolve to continue coming to their aid in the future.

subject: HW0901

Usually, such organizations can be separated in two parts. One is the oranizations which dedicate to environmental protection, the other is which put more focus on humanitarian. The former organizations are usually comprised of professional environmental or biological experts who are determined to save the earth, they observe endangered animal species constantly to handle the situations or difficulties animals are facing. They even negociate with government in order to save forests in higher mountains. The latter organizations are more often seem on reports or news. They collect the money donated from people and use it to buy daily necessities for remote area's people. They also establish a lot of health secure stations in many areas in order to provide medical aims to people in need.
I didn't join any kind of voluntary work before. But I'm expecting the summer vacation this year because I'm going to join an organization established by our school. Its goal is to grow trees in cities as much as we can. Though the efforts may not be seen in recent, I believe that the things we do will make tomorrow's world better!

It is also important because if we don't assemble them, they might look down upon themselves and commit suicide. Last but not least, giving a hand to those people who disemployeed by their company. It is also important because if we don't help them, they might turn into those people who idle around everyday and act as "pickpockets".
I am a volunteer now, and my work contains those I mentioned above. As a proverb goes, "When you fall down, you have to stand up right away and also with strength." That is the reason why I would do those work.
In sum, without our help, they might not stand up again. So, why don't we give them a hand?

subject: HW0901
content:
With the advance of technology, the life in Taiwan has become more and more affluent. Yes, we ought to admit that we are fortunate enough to lead a enjoyable life, but there are still minority of the population live in poverty. And that's the reason why these nonprofit organizations exist. Mostly, these foundations raise found for poor children, jobless families, and the disabled. Sometimes, they provide necessities for the victims of the disasters. All in all, what they do is so tremendous that we can't count it. However, these organizations are in danger.
The decrease of economy in Taiwan has made they hard to live on. Not only the supply of money, but also the number of the volunteers has decrease. As a student, all I can aid is being a volunteer on weekends. But if I had more leisure time, I would participate in the activities which they hold. Furthermore, I would invite all my family members and friends to join these educational events. I believe that if we keep working on, we can make this world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
The population of people needing help is beyond our imaginations. In certain developing countries, their government sometimes ignore the problems resulted as they merely focus on the industal development.
Today, nonprofit organizations have pulled out agendas about like the weak environment, or human rights. For example, some victims in Africa or South America not only have to face the destroying from the wars, but also need healthy food and clean water to survive. They eager our help which while this is the perfect moment for us, the volunteers, to give them a hand in different ways.
Developing countries usually lack medical resources, including medicines and doctors. I intend to enter medical school and become a doctor. As long as I get the chance to go to those locations that suffer from the attacks of wars or disease, I would always like to be the volunteer to try my best to complete their demands.
To conclude, there are people needing our help. If we have the ability to do so, never be cheap in giving our hands to people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an important role in today's society. They provide lots of services to those people who need help and those areas which need more developments. Take the 921 earthquake as an example. Nonprofit organization made their best to encourage people donating money for rebuilding these disastered areas. In the same time They could also be psychological counsellors to accompany those thrilled people. They also offered the broken family some working opportunities, the orphanes free housing and help the victums walk out from the horrible disasters. Besides the 921, nonprofit group arould the world try to minimize the differentiations between rural area and urban one. They collects free used books from everyone and bring them to the developing or undeveloped country. Some volunteers even take out their pocket money to buy new books for this valuable activities. These nonprofit organizations spread their kindnesses to everywhere through all kinds of ways, just want to make people feel warm and stand by those people who just need some assistances.
Everytime when it comes to the time at summer vacation and winter vacation, I always the very first volunteer to go some abriginal areas for teaching kids English. Even I am not paid during the whole period, the kids' smiles can charge my psychological battery to study hard for bringing them more. Moreover, I also attend a cherity group to financially adopt kids who lose his parents. We have a meet once a half year. Everytime we met, I always bring a audible English book and try to tell him the story in an activity way. I exactly enjoy the perfect experiences through these processes. It takes me to a certain place where I know why I exist.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, there have been more and more nonprofit organizations all over the world. For one thing, the poors and those who suffer from domestic abuse have been increasing; therefore more and more charities have begun to spring up. They will certainly provide many services to those needed. For instance, a few months ago, an earthquake hit a province in China, and accordingly caused considerable damage to the province. Those nonprofit oranizations around the world immediately poured in to come to the victims' rescue. On top of it, they also dedicated themselves to looking after the elderly who are solitary.
I have done several volunteer works in the hospital. Seeing various kinds of patients lying on the bed, I didn't know how to express my sadness. From then on, I have decided to commit myself to becomming a doctor in the future so as to rid the patients of such painful torments.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, the number of the nonprofit organizations is increasing. These nonprofit organizations not only help those who are in need in Taiwan but also give a helping hand to the refugees who met with a terrible damage in other countries. These organizations help people who are in need by providing some important services such as the medical treatments, supplying food or finding shelters for the refugees. One of the most important services is medical treatments. Due to the shortage of medical equipments, people in developing countries or remote areas in Taiwan can't receive any help when they get sick. With the medical treatments from these nonprofit oganizations, people in these areas would not be afraid of the sickness and the pain they suffer would also decrease. Thanks to these organizations, people there would live a more stable live.
Since I am a high school student, I don't have much time to do volunteer work. After I enter a college, I would like to join the volunteer clubs. By taking part in such a club, I would go to the remote areas in Taiwan, helping the children there to learn some knowledge or teaching them to speak foreign language. In addition, I would buy many books for them because they don't have a good enviornment for learning. Last, if I have enough money, I would donate the money to the nonprofit organizations. By this way, the organizations would keep going and our love would also keep spreading all over the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations benefit lots of people who needs help. Some organizations have spreaded all over the world. There are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. They always help people in the nick time.
These organizations always support and help poor children to go to school. In my opinion, Education is the most needed help, because studying is the only way to get rid of poverty. They usually offer food to the poor family as well. Without food supply those people may on the edge of being sick. I think food supply is also one of the most important resources to help them.
In the future, if I have enough ability to help the poor, I feel like teaching children whose family can't afford them to study. I think teaching is a meaningful volunteer work that I want to experience, maybe not in the future, just in this summer I can find some part time works to help people. As the saying goes, "Giving is receiving." I concluded. When I help those people who need help, I feel pleased in my mind.

subject: HW0901
content:
In modern world, people are more isolated with others than that in the countryside. Somehow, there are still many friendly people. And there are more charities being established like the Red Cross organization...etc. In Taiwan ,we have lots of charties and nonprofit organizations. These organizations not only help the poor in Taiwan but also in other countries.
I've once seen people from those kinds of organizations raising money on the street. And as I know, those donations are for children in remote areas in Taiwan so that they can go to school. These organizations are really doing there best effort to help the poor and the need.
As for me, I do volunteer work in my school. I do recycle for my class. But if I have a chance, I would love to teach students in remote areas or help to make the earth a better place for all creatures in the future.
It is more blessed to give than to take, isn't it?

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, many people and colleage students spend their time joining the nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. And what all these volunteers do is help the needy people wherever they are. Take Chi-zei for an example. They would use their time to visit the elders lived by themselves, donate the finance or food to someone who needs it or comfort the people who meet the sorrowful thing. Beside of Chi-zei, there are still many nonprofit organizations go to the remote area in Taiwan to tutor the children, improve their impoverished life or run refugee camps in developing countries. Seeing all the things they do, I would like to go to developing country to help those children who lived in a poor family, such as giving the food, books or even my love. Moreover, I also want to help the people there to grow the crops to improve their life. In conclusion, I think everyone can give our love or action to make their life become much better.

subject: HW0901
content: Although most part of our world has been well developed, Some places are still facing problem like lack of water, crops or sometimes chace of education. A great number of people who affirms this kind of situation stands out and help with their assets or professions. So now many nonprofit organizations recruits volunteer to help their work in Taiwan as well as in the world. Some of them build hospital and treat patients without taking any fees in tribes of aboriginal people. Some nonprofit organizations recruit students to go to remote areas to teach and tutor children English as these children may not have other chance to learn English unlike students who lives in big cities. Personally, I would like to tutor students in remote areas in eastern Taiwan in the future. Education is uneasy there. I would like to try my best to help them study. Also, I would like to show them the world out of there, after they grow up, they may go back to their hometown and rebuild there to a better place, just like what I expected.

subject: HW0901
content:
In my school, there are always some student groups that are trying to tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan. They usually design activities and hold summer camps for those children. For example, students who volunteers to help may preparing teaching materials for those children. They may teach them how to operate computers or teach them how to play with instruments. In this case, those children may learn how to perform these skills they have ever learned. Another example is that students in my school may hold summer camps for those children who lives in remote areas. The camp won't cost a dollar in order to attract those children. By giving them such an excellent activity, they may enrich their life in summer vacation.
I have participated in a volunteer work like this a year ago. Since I'm the leader of the guitar group, my members and I held a summer camp like this. We play free music for children in remote areas and we raised a fund for them. We also teach them how to play the guitar and how to sing a song. Needless to say, we all enjoy a wonderful time with them.

subject: HW0901
content: Not all of the organizations or groups in the world are aim of making money. There are some nonprofit organizations which do help people by recruiting volunteers to teach children in remote areas and to take care of the elderly. In addition to helping people, they also protect our environments. For instane, they may recruit volunteers to make the dirty rivers clean. They care about people who live under the poverty line and hope all they have done would change the world into a better one, even if the change was just a little bit. Nothing in the world can delight me so much as helping people. During this summer vacation, I am going to Nepal to teach the children English or math. To me, I've received help from so many people; and now, as I grow up, I feel happy to help people even if I don't know them. In my opinion, only if people help each other would make this world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations working in different fields in the world. Their existences provide important services for people in need and what they've achieved must be respected.
Those nonprofit organizations really provide so many services. For example, Doctors without Borders go into places that are having wars to rescue the suffering people. Besides, Red Cross organization have their volunteers run refugee camps and provide refugees with humanitarian aid.
I really respect what those nonprofit organizations have achieved. Some doctors may even get shot at or be wounded when they make efforts to save people. Some volunteers may confront horrible scenes in their experiences, but they conquer their fear and finish their work. Their attitudes should be respected by all people.
After taking a look at what nonprofit organizations have done, I would like to work for Doctors without Borders. One of the members says that it's a life-changing experience. I believe this kind of experiences can make me appreciate more and be humble toward life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, this society have become a M-shaped society. Some wear Chanel and drive Ferrari, but others don't have any clothes to wear, and they even have no food to eat. The quality of life is making a bigger and bigger distance between the rich and the poor now. So, now is the best time we should give those who needs help a big hand. We have many different ways to show our love and kindness. For example, we can play with some children whose parents are divorced that they don't have a happy family, or we can go to the hospital to make elders happy.
Just a few weeks ago, I signed up for being a volunteer in a institute which helps children in elementary school do their homework during my summer vacation. I want to help more people oversea if I have the chance. Don't waste your life playing video games anymore, go do some meaningful things right away! It will make your life more colorful and valuable.

subject: HW0901
content:
As time passes by, more progress the technology becomes, more problems are found in our society everywhere, especially the corners that we seldom put our eyes on. Nowasday, have us every cared about the starving children in developing countries, or the sick confined to bed even one or two minutes? No, we haven't! But, some people have been doing this. The nonprofit organizations not only improve the unequal condition on the poor, but give them warm and make them taken good cares in good hand. The spirit is what we must to learn!
Owing that my aunt works as a nurse in a hospital. I have been a volunteer every summer and winter vacation since I was little. And that is the reason why I have so much sympathy on the sick and the poor. Because I have seen so many people suffering in pain. Some of them born of criple, even deaf and blind. So I hope that, in the future, I can sacrifice myself more to make "them" live a life much more better!

subject: HW0901
content:
Although it is more and more advanced in this world, there're still many places suffered from many problems. However, the government of those places many not have enough resources or materials to solve those problems. At this moment, nonprofit organization would give their hand to the countries or places which eagerly need help, such as taking care of some sick people, tutoring kids, etc.
I used to be a volunteer in a nonprofit organization, rotary club. It is founded by the wealthy people who want provide some help to the men who suffered from some difficulties in their life. I went to Hualien and Taitung to tutor some aboriginal children who did not have money to have proper education. I am really glad to have to chance to help the children. I was also inspired by those children at that time. Looking at their face, I felt grateful that I have such a happy and wealthy life.
Being a voluteer in such organization is really meanigful for me. I'm also very proud of being in this kind of organization. In the future, I hope I could have the chance to help more people around the world. Not only tutoring kids but also taking care of some incovinient people or helping the people under starvation are all the things I really want to do.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations around the world, giving their efforts to make the world a better place. Just to name a few, after a fierce typhoon or earthquake, you can often see members of Tsi Chi giving people who are injured or trapped a helping hand. Besides helping people out in Taiwan, Tsi Chis is also know to have helped the Indonasia clean the Red River, which was infamous for being extremely stinky and dirty due to the garbage residents threw into it.
Another charity organization - World Vision noticed the serious problem of orphants in west Africa and reached out to these kids. These orphants lost their parents mostly because of AIDS. And constant wars between or even within countries also leads to great number of orphants. World Vision recruits volunteers to keep them company. They not only take care of them but also care about them.
Confined by a large amount of schoolwork, I have little time to join some volunteer works. Fortunately, a wonderful chance just landed in our school. A class of orphants from Uganda who are raised by a American priest came to visit Taiwan. Their first stop was our school. What's luckier, my class was appointed to recept these children. We spent a whole afternoon flying kites, singing and dancing with them. The children were full of smiles and we were very grateful to the kids as well. Because their smile, we all learned a very precious lesson. Namely, no matter what hardship you have been through, you can always be happy.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations provide a lot of services to help people. First, some organizations provide daily necessaries to the old people who live alone. Besides, they take care of these old people's health to some degree. Second, they will send supplies to people who live in the remote area. This makes sure that those people are able to have enough resources. In addition, some organizations like Chih-Zi may build a hospital to take care of people who live in the remote area. There are many volunteers in the hospital helping doctors to completely take care of the patients. Most important of all, many nonprofit organizations around the world are eager to help when a severe disaster occurs. They will help provide necessary supplies and even help look for surviors.
The summer vacation is coming. I would like to take care of the patients in the hospital. The treatment may be so hard and long to the patients. Even eating can be difficult to them. I would like to be the one who keeps them accompany and helps them fight the disease. The process may be hard, but I would try my best to help them. It would be a meaningful summer vacation. I can't wait to see the smile on their face after they recover.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an important role in our society. Have you ever wondered who takes care of the people suffering from poverty? Nonprofit organizations not only takes care of their physical needs, but also provides other services to the needy.
These nonprofit organizations serve the povertized in many ways. They recruit volunteers to collect charities, tutoring children in more remote areas, and running refugee camps in developing countries. Nonprofit organizations provide different services depending on the subject they serve. They would send rations to the hungry, and medical care to the sick. Therefore they wouldn't send books to the people who really needed food.
I have participated in some events held by nonprofit organizations. I was a volunteer for the World Vision organization. I collected reciepts and cash as charity for the victims of poverty. It was a great experience for me as a volunteer. Currently, I am a volunteer to help old people. In the future, I hope I could have the chance to be a volunteer in a hospital. Being a volunteer is doing something for our society, and I recommend being one.

subject: HW0901
content:
When it comes to nonprofit organizations, many people regard them as a very important part in modern communities. From tutoring children in remote area to helping care the old, there are countless kinds of nonprofit organizations now in our lives. They help others just based on their enthusiasm and passion, asking for nothing in return. Some nonprofit organizations work on protecting our environment and pursade people not to kill those unique wildlife. Others may work on educating and teaching teenagers who commited crimes or did something wrong. To sum up, the nonprofit organizations is a power that helps mankind communities move foward.
I used to be a tutor when I was a junior high school student. Yet I didn't teach math, English or physics. I teach the Rubik's Cube. Sometimes I would go to some elementary school to introduce the Rubik's Cube to those kids, leading them to the world of Rubik's Cube and using some math formula to show them how interesting it was. That was really a great experience even now I'm a college student.

subject: HW0901
content: Nonprofit organizations have been being the trend in worldwide. Some protect endanger animals while some care about orphen. So far as I'm concern, Global Warming Decreasing Project is one of my favorite nonprofit organization. They teach people how to reduce the gas that will accelerate global warming such as Nitrogen...etc. They also invent a new building method includes using green material which is able to recycle. They declaim that people are able to own a comfortable living with these methods instead of spending lots of money on a luxurious house. I'm quite agree with them. I decide to dedicate myself to help with their work after my graduation in high school. I'm not only following their methods' but also invite some of my friends to raise a foundation in Taiwan in order to make some progress to protect our Earth and make it better.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, with the rapid development of economy in the past, ther are still some people living in poverty. And most of them are from remote areas. Few persons notice this problem except for some volunteers recruited by nonprofit organization.
Such organizations will recruit some volunteers, including teachers, doctors, even college students. Because people in remote areas may run out of food, volunteers will provide them with some essential supplies. Moreover, childrens in remote areas often don't have sufficient learning resources. Volunteers will tutor children and read books for them. Finally, last but not the least, such organization will let more people know this condidion and make more poeple be volunteers to help these children.
As for me, I would like to be a doctor and help people in remote areas. When they get sick, I hope I can cure them for free. And then, I can suggest my family and friends to be volunteers with me. You don't have to spare no effort to do everything for them. All you have to do is do what you can do and let them know that there is still love in this country. In my opinion, it will make my life to be more meaningful.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are some famous nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. The one I appreciate is Tsu-Chi fundation. Wherever, there is a disaster, you'll find Tsu-Chi is there.
The Tsu-Chi fundation provide various services. For example, they take care of homeless people by offering them food THey go to some places which suffering natural disaster. Even, they go anywhere that is facing problems.
I always dream about being a voluteer. Because I could help people with a happy mind I could tell myself I help them is nothing about business or money I am freely help people. I could see people's true smile.
I would like to be a voluteer who can take care of children In my opinion, children is the base of a contry. If children couldn't get good cares, they won't have a good future. If they couldn't get a good future, our society or our country should be getting badly day by day.
All in all, If I could be a voluteer one day. I would like to work for Tsu-Chi fundation. And I would like work for children. The children have good futures. That means our country got a bunch of good futures.

subject: HW0901
content:
Without those nonprofit organization, I think the world will be in a terrible mass. The nonprofit organizations I know best is Tsu-Zi and Red Cross organization.
