At that time, so many people got enjure, became homeless, had their heart broken or with no sufficient supply. I remembered Tsu-Zi provided food supply and confer people's heart. They also provided some living place for those homeless people. And they help to build new school that was distroied in the earthquake. Beside Tsu-Zi there are many other organizations help people pass the hard time. I think it's the most important functions of those organizations.
I never be volunteer to any kind of nonprofit organization. Because I always busy in study. I hope one day when I get a job and have som spare time, I will do some work for those organizations and help the society.

subject: HW0901
content:
Noneprofit organizations provide a variety of services for those who are in need. Some of them appear aftermath a serious natural disaster. Another serve food and care for the senior citizens who lost their family. The others recruit volunteers from senior high school or universities to help children's schoolwork.
Last summer, I joined the group of volunteers to be accompany with children from six to twelve years old. It was a unforgettable experience when I saw kids' lovely smile and their hard-working attitude. I taught them when they got any problem in books.
If I could get another oppertunity next time,I would like to work in a nursing home. I can feed and chat with senior citizens in patience. I want to use my little effort to join noneprofit organizations' work and make the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Since the start of the 21st century, more and more people from youth to elders in Taiwan rely on nonprofit organizations to make a living. Nowadays, more and more people in Taiwan understand their poor way of life and are willing to become a volunteer to take care of the poor people.
In the last few years, the rates of unemployment has increased by leaps and bounds. Even though there are subsities, it is not enough for them to survive the harsh conditions. Therefore, the organizations will give them food to make their living. In addition, more and more elders in the aging society of Taiwan are living alone. They have pensions, but they need somebody to take care of them. The charity organizations provide them with a cozy home in which they can play with other elders. Moreover, when natural disasters come, the organizations can send some helicopters or other transportations to rescue the victims.
Even though, the organizations can provide a lot of services, they need money from the residents and government. I suggest that everybody who don't have economic problems can give some money to the foundations of the organizations. Also, the government should give some welfare to the organizations so that they can keep on helping people who need help.
To be a good citizen, I will like to be a volunteer when I retire and have a lot of spare time. I think being a volunteer can help people of all ages and know the current news around the world.
To sum up, when anyone has spare time, I think that being a volunteer is a good way to develop the habits of helping others. I believe that the developments of the nonprofit organizations will have a bearing on the future of Taiwan.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have set up many important and helpful services in Taiwan. They also gather lots of volunteers to spread their love to everywhere. Those services really help our society a lot. They not only solve some society problems but also save many poor people drifting on the street.
For instance, some orphanages help lots of little kids who have no parents. They provide them a shelter and also educate them. Most of all, they give those kids love. They let them see their hope. The volunteers teach them how to be a useful person. In addition, there are also some medical teams that help those people who can not afford to see a doctor for free. Those doctors are full of love. They are willing to go into the mountains to help people. They think it is far more important than making money. There are so many charity organizations in Taiwan.
I also have had such experience as a volunteers to help kids living in the orphanage. I was a the leader of Street Dance Club. We made many performaces for those little kids during that time. Those kids were really innocent and adorable. They were easy to be fullfilled. We all felt a great sence of achievement from their smiles.
I am an English teacher now. Therefore, I would like to go to the mountains to teach children English in the future. I want to diffuse knowledge to those kids for free. I think those people who devote their whole life time to help others are really great.

subject: HW0901
content:
In every country, there are some society problems existance. How to solve these society problems depend on the power coming from the people, who will be called "volunteers" from different organizations.
First, the helping from them can help some tutoring children to have healthy bodies and mind. With their assisting these problems, some tutoring children won't live under the volient situation. On the other hand, these children have the protection from a new family, who can give them different style of life or more important inflience on them in the future.
Second, our society will become more stable and knowing helping each other by this kind of organizations like the Master of Zin Yi and her group and they like to help people in no time. If we have more people like to help others that the crimal things will be less. Therefore, if you want to live in a safe and no fear or healthier country, we should do some serivces to others.
When I studied in university, I join the club to help the orphans. This make me to understand how important to own a family is. No one can understand the way to live without parents or relatives. I really hope I can join some teams in the hospital after I retire from my job. I want to take care of some old and sick people, and especially who doesn't have a family to take care of them in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are so many nonprofit organizations set up to help people in need. For instance, we can see volunteers spare out their free time to provide goods and other services for the old. Those volunteers keep showing concern for those old people who are deliberately neglected by their children. What's more, from time to time they will have an earnest talk with them. When the old are in frustration or low emotion, those kind volunteers would invariably be generous enough to lend a symphathetic ear. Through their works, I am convinced that those volunteers would be rich in their spiritual lives.
Years ago, I used to be a volunteer who went to the city hospital once a week. It still remains vivid in my mind that one day when I stepped into a sickroom, I was immediately shocked by what I saw. It was a little cute girl lying attached to all kinds of life-supporting machines. Tears kept welling up from her eyes. She turned her head away, giving me a helpless look, as if she wanted someone to accompany her. I could not bear to see that and quickly walked out of the room. Three months later I learned that she had passed away. There was nothing I could do for her. In fact, it is a torture whenever I thought of this image. The sound of her cry would often ring in my ears whenever I step into a hospital. From this event, I vow to be a lifelong volunteer for those who are in need. Thanks to this girl, I think I really have grown a lot from this experience and here I am - a less childish and more mature man who is ready to take up challenges and work through all difficulties.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the rapid development of technology, our lives have become more and more convenient. We get what we desired easily, we go to school everyday and we go to hospital while we are sick. What's more, we go abroad for entertainments. However, do you know there is someone in need? Someone who lived in remote areas without closes; someone who are in the hospital tortured by serious illness. Fortunately, there are some nonprofit organizations in Taiwan are willing to give them a helping hand in volunteer. These organizations provided them with clean closes, fresh foods and even education. These organizations also support their living by the money donated from kind-hearted peocle.
As far as I am concerned, I am a student who has no capability to earn money, hense, I devoted myself in volunteer work. Last summer, I went to a hospital for volunteer work. I helped the nurse to deal with some easy documents, and that's what I could do. In spite of the fact that I am not an expert in medical field, I had done my best to help those in need. Another work in hospital I done was pushing wheelchairs, by doing so, I could ease the disable of their pain and they could get around easily. Althought being a volunteer might be tired, I enjoy in it at all. After all, it is happier to give than to receive. Helping others can never be too much emphasized!

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, I have read an article that talked about NGOs (non-governmental organizations). In this article, it mentioned that more and more young people are willing to join this kinds of organizations and are willing to give their hands to those who need assistants. They went to South Asia to help those survivors rebuild their country and their houses because of the devastation of tsunami. They also donated some money and necessities to poor countries. Not only the teenagers but also adults work as a volunteer to help the poors.
I still remembered that there was a severe accident in Tainan few years ago. It's very terrible because the whole bus fell into the valley. Through the TV, I watched that horrible scene. However, I also saw some "angels" in the spot of the accident. Those volunteers came from a famous nonprofit organization in Taiwan. They provided aids. They also told survivors to be calm. They soothed tense atmosphere in the spot of the accident. I felt so touching because at that night, I saw how kind human nature is!
Because the inspiration of this incident, I decided to join a club in my college to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan. It was a wonderful experience. We played with those children and taught them some medical knowledge. When I saw their smile on their faces, I felt so satisfied and touched because I knew I did a right thing.
I will keep joining this kinds of activities. I'm so lucky to be born at a happy family and to live happily. I want those poor people to feel as the same as how I feel. I want them to see the wonderful part in the world.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations have provided many services to people. They sacrifised to help the poor and the hurts without any profit. subject: HW0901
content: About ten years ago, the term of global villiage was mentioned, and its ideas were spread widely. People in the world were informed and educated to have a kind heart and an open mind. Since then, there are more and more nonprofit organizations appearing around the world. They are established by meaningful goals. It was set up by a group of young people who are looking forward to seeing the change of the world. Those young people began to recruit volunteers around the world and fund to travel overseas. subject: HW0901
content:
In my perspective, I think these nonprofit organizations are very important. Except tutoring children in remote areas or running refugee camps in third-world countries, they have positive influences in many other ways. Firstly, they offer opportunites for volunteers to see this world more broadly. Secondly, they can play an important role when disasters happen, such as earthquakes, typhoons, or wars. No matter how dangerous the surroundings may be, you can always see their efforts in places that you seldom notice.
I used to be a volunteer in hospitals, private ones mainly, such as Chung-Gang Memorial Hospital. It was a special experience for me. I met people from all kinds of families, rich people, poor people, farmers, policemen, or even politicians. They suffer from different diseases, some people are badly wounded, yet going home in a few weeks, others are not so blessed. I am a volunteer in Taoyuan now. My job is tutoring kids in the community and doing some field works about old villages which used to be settled with soldiers and their families. I love this job.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the proverb goes, "it's better to give than to receive." I couldn't agree more. Nowadays, an increasing number of nonprofit organizations are helping those in need all over the world. What services are provided by such organizations?
They urge the public to contribute some money to the refugees at any corner of the world in order to help them survive in some hard-to-live regions. Some volunteers go to developing countries in person to give the residents a hand, sparing no effort to make them better. They do a wide range of work, including education, economy support and so on.
I, a sixteen-year-old girl, would like to try my best to help those in need. Never think that someone is too young to do such things. Even a little girl can give out her small amount of pocket money. After all, "half a loaf is better than no bread." Last summer, I went to a hospital to take care of the patients as a volunteer. I really cherish this valuable experience because it was my honor to help the patients go through their hardtime. I listened to the words from the bottom of their heart and told them to stick on. In addition, I'd like to tutor children in poor areas in the future because I believe that people are born equally and have their rights to receive education. I think I can make it by hook or by crook and spread love to every corner on the earth.

subject: HW0901
content:

This is because social developments are often accompanied with some social disorders, such as the increasing distance between the rich and the poor, common health problems, and the great numbers of the elders that is alone. Therefore, the services provided by the nonprofit organizations become significant. Take Red Cross for example, they offer medical care to many developing countries. Aside from Red Cross, there are also many active organizations that benefit quite a lot families in Taiwan. For instance, Xuan Shi Foundation is a well-known for their assistants to the vegetables and the elders lacking cares. They also hold flea markets to raise their founds or the campaigns that help people to understand how it feels to starves. Moreover, there are organizations promoting quitting smoking, helping wowen and children, or tutoring the students in remote area.
Lucky to say, I have also contributed my dedication to encourage the nonprofit organizations. I often apply for volunteering in hospitals and other organizations in summer or winter vacation. I have once voluntarily worked in Chi-Mei Hospital, where I delivered the meals to patients. What's more, I have helped a organization to hold a flea market. As a student, I think these are positive ways to promote the quality of our society.
Nowadays, people are donating more and more money to nonprofit organizations. However, in my viewpoint, only when people volunteer in these organizations can they understand the true meaning of service and therefore do good to our society.

subject: HW0901
content:
A great number of people lead to a miserable life and little do they survive on their own. content:

The service which the nonprofit organizations offer are different from each other, that's because the concentration that they focus on. Take for example, Red cross primarily provides the medical service in remote areas in Taiwan or in some developing country, such as Africa where they don't have enough medical resource. Eden is an organization which focus on the overseas volunteers. They train a lot of young men to be a tutor and send them to the places where they don't have much resources every year. Zue-Tsi cares about people who live in suffer of the society. Therefore, the service they often offer is to finding some donations or giving the resource to some people that they cannot live by themselves. As we can see, different nonprofit organizations provide different services for the society.
If I had a chance to be a volunteer, I would like to offer the medical service in remote areas. Owing to that I am a medical student now, I care much about the medical problems. As far as I know there aren't so much medical resources in remote areas. If there is some one who gets a cold, he may have to drive a long way to see the doctor. Therefore, if I have a chance to be a volunteer, I will provide the medical sevice for free in the future. In my opinion, every one has its own right to get the medical service equally, no matter what jobs or religions.

subject: HW0901
content:

FIrst, they provide free education to poor students and help them improve their living conditions in remote areas not only in Taiwan but also in other countries. Second, they also provide medical care to people who cannot afford the health insurance. Last but not least, the volunteers of these organizations acompany the old people who live alone. They visit the old people frequently and try to make them feel less lonely.
I have been a volunteer of an English summer camp once. It was a summer camp for children in remote areas in Pingtung. We met each other everyday for a week. As a volunteer, I taught them some English words and songs. We also did some very interesting activities together. At the last two days of the summer camp, all the volunteers and children went to Kenting National Park. Those children have never been to other places besides Pingtung. I could tell that they were so happy and excited. After the activity ended, I thought to myself. It was a very meaningful experience to me. I can make so many children smile and happy from the bottom of their heart by spending a little time and getting together with them. I am very sure that I will be a volunteer again if I had a chance in the future. Because people always say "Giving is better than receiving." If you have ability and time to help people, why don't you do so?

subject: HW0901
content: In the recent years, more and more tutoring children or poor people are benefited from nonprofit organizations. They provide many important services to those who need help. subject: HW0901
content:

For example, they recruit volunteers to take care of children in remote areas and provide resources to those in need. Most people may be too busy with their own lives to acknowledge the efforts of such organizations. However, they often come to realize the hard work and show their appreciation when something terrible happen to themselves and the organizations offer their help. A case in point is the earthquake on Sep. 21st a few years ago in Taiwan.
As far as I am concerned, I have done some volunteer work before. As a matter of fact, just last year I was sent a remote area in Tainan County to help children with their studies. It was a lot of fun because I got to make use of my abilities and actually help the people in need. It might not be much considering I only stayed there for just a year, but I always feel a sense of content rising inside me when those days come to my mind. Therefore, I would like to do more volunteer work and contribute what I have learned to the society in the future as long as there is an opportunity.

In general, people retire at the age between sixty and sixty-five. Most of people at this age are still heathy. I encourge them to join some nonprofit organizations as the volunteers. If they have money they can also donnate some money to the organizations. We should feeback something to the socity that we live whe we afford to do so.
In summary, I respect a lot to those who work free for charity and noprofit organizations. Because of them, people who need helps get the helps they need, and get better lives.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, as industry develops, many people become rich and most people pay their attention on the advatages. Nonetheless, there are still many people live in poor, needing our help, so numerous nonprofit organizations are founded to help those who need our help.
The "Rotary Club" is one of the nonprofit organizations. It was founded to service for others. The members donate money to build libraries in the country where the students lack of education. They also hold some activities to urge others to pay attention to the poor. Moreover, they volunteer to sweep roads in the morning, giving us clean environment.
The "Red Cross" is also an nonprofit organization. It provides some medical services to those who live in low-developed countries. The member teach them how to prevent from disease and help them clean the environment. And due to the organization's efforts, many countries have become clean and away from some disease.
For me, I have taken part in a activity to teach students English in remote areas. I teach them to see the vocabularies and inspire them to read and write English. From this process, I found those children were actually smart; however, they were lack the opportunities to learn. They were so eager for education that it motivated me to study hard. If I can, in the future, I will be devoted myself to help the students not only on studies but also on everything they are lack.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the modern society, it seems that people around the world live in happy lives. Nonetheless, there are some people who do not have the ability to ensure their basic lives, especially residents in poor countries. As far as I am concerned, all of us should try our best to do the poor a favor if we are able to do. In Taiwan, there is an organization called the Red Cross. The Red Cross provide a project that we only have to donate one thousand dollars a month in order to support people in the world who are lack of the daily neccessities.
As a senior high school student, I do not have a chance to do more great behavior like some famous celebrities on account of my academy. Therefore, I seize the oppurtunity to participate in the service of the Red Cross. I am economical of my daily expenses so that I can donate my pocket money to support the activity. Not until I received a card from a child I helped by my donation did I realize how satisfied I would be. It is this kind of satisfaction that grants me the energy to tackle the challenges I will face in the future. To sum up, if we can gain such advantages by helping others, why don't we give it a try?

subject: HW0901
content:
Though the world develops rapidly, there are still many poverty-striken areas around the globe. The issue, helping the poor has been reported by media more and more in recent years. As a result, those nonprofit organization sprout all over like mashrooms in last few years.
The generate of this kind of organizations is very important and meaningful. With their help, the poor and the homeless can at least have a shelter and food to survive. These charities also help them attending to schools to acquire knowledge. In this case, they would have a tool to feed themselves and make their families a better life after they graduate.
I would like to help those children study in my future volunter work. When those children acquire knowledge, they would know what to do when they grow up. This is important for them to get a job to have a better life. They can be away from poverty.

subject: HW0901
content: In this modern society, nonprofit organizations play an important role. They can make up for what the government and profit organizations can't do with many services. For example, some of them tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan, which will improve the education in such places. Besides, they may raise a fund to help the poor on a regular basis or the people who encounter with terrible accidents. All of the things mentioned above are great. But, it needs a lot of people to help finishing these things. However, they are nonprofit, so, they always recruit volunteers to help them. For me, being a volunteer would be very meaningful. As a result, if I have the chance to volunteer, I would go without any hesitation. And, I think I would like to choose to tutor children in remote area when I am a volunteer. Because I like to teach others and get along with children, I think it would be the best choice for me.

subject: HW0901
content:
With such fast paced growing of development, our living standard is becoming better and the place we live is getting more prosperous than before. However, there are still many developing countries lead a poor life and need more of us to give them a hand.
Recently, there are more people discover these problems such as the lack of food, education, and environment of healthy system. Some doctors set a nonprofit organization trying to use their professional skills to help more people in remote areas. Besides, some charity organizations will bring clothes, foods, or any other kinds of stuffs to those poor countries in oder to help them as possible as they can.
I used to donate some money to help those children who can not get the chance of receiving education. In the future, I'll still do my best to engage in volunteer works like help the poors within my ability.

subject: HW0901
content:
In accordance with newspaper and various media nowadays, we can be easily informed that more and more nonprofit organizations are mushrooming, where there occurs people in need, there comes this forms of rescue alliance. When our society develops advancedly and rapidly, it seems that our authorities and public do not emphasize the poverty and less-right group's profits. So we can observe a large number of volunteers participate in many loscales from environmental disasters, refugee camps and complements, daily supplement pour in spots; victims suffer from diseases or succumb of infections get appropriate cares and helps in developing countries, all that are supplied from nonprofit organizations, their top target is provides timely helps to people globally, not mention to races, colors or religions, try our best to save our mates lives and improve their living circumstances during the earth village, via our human instinctly responsibility movements.
To me, I have taken part in nonprofit organizations since my childhood. It's an organization of Buddhism groups, branches many parts into the world, they drop by refugee-center, clean up the environments, take care of patients in hospitals, or when any of the international corners have attacked by tsunami or gigantive earthquake, they arrive there as soon as possible. In my opinion, attending volunteer activities is valuable, for helping others is our indispensable duties, it goes without denying that our developments eventually lead to the phenomenon that the riches more rich, the poors more poor, and the homonization of world is seemly impossible, but fortunately, we are the group luckily to enjoy better resources and facilities, so we should try our best to help those who are not so lucky and balance their lifes to a level, I think helping human beings ourselves by truly actions is more valid instead of donating money to charity facilities in our homes.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the popularity of nonprofit organizations, more and more people are devoted themselves to being volunteers, and I am no exception.
These nonprofit organizations have different ways to help people. The most common thing is to raise money and donate them to poor countries. Other organizations may bring some food and clothes to the remote areas where are on the mountains and are hard for common people to get into. Besides, there are some organizations recruit some volunteers to send them to countrysides and help local residents, like teaching local kids to speak English, or help adults take care of their children.
As far as I am concerned, I had a special experience when I volunteered to help children in the remote area. I was shocked by the scene I saw at first when I arrived at the area. There was nothing but old people and very little kids. All I had to do was to teach the kids to speak English. It was very difficult, because the kids even couldn't speak Chinese very well. They could only speak Taiwanese. In addition, I had to prepare food for those old people. It was difficult for me, to. Because I didn't know how to cook. However, other volunteers taught me how to do everything in those days, and I could even make some delicious dishes finally. I was very happy to be a volunteer which can let me learn many things that schools won't tell you.

subject: HW0901
content:
With the improvements of technology, people now do have better life than before. But is it true that everyone live comfortably and well? Or is it just the surface of this "M-shaped" society? Some people now wonder about these questions, and they start to look into the corners of this society. Unfortunately, there are still some people living at the edge of hunger, death and illiteracy.
To solve these problems, people who are willing and being capable of helping gather together and organize some groups and associations. They recruit the volunteers to help tutor the poor or take care of refugee. For example, the "Red Cross" is a world-known organization. They save people from wars natural disasters and so on. They gave their hands out to victims of earthquake in China and to the refugee of tsunami in southern Asia. They not only offered food and shelters but also helped to rebuild their villages. Another famous organization - Hsin Ji, orginated in Taiwan, did a lot of effort to help the people in need. When the "921 earthquake" happened, they were the first volunteering group to step into the disater spot.
I'm looking forward to being a volunteer again. I have volunteered in some cultural associations and hospitals. I learned a lot from these special experiences. I realized the beauty of our traditional culture and the amazements of Mother Nature when I volunteered in cultural protecting association. Also, I volunteered in the hospital and it inspired me to be a doctor in the future. I have a lot of passion toward being a doctor and helping others. The volunteering experience give me the thoughts of being respect to life and taking care of patients. I will never forget the smiles the patients wore when they recieved good medical treatments and careness of doctors' at the same time.
Volunteering work offers a different view to life. While helping others, we learn to be mature and be independent, and most of all, we'll learn to cherish what we have. I'm now determined to be a doctor. I'll try my best to enter medical school and use my knowledge and treatments to help people in need.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations contribute to the society in different aspects, and we can discuss it from three parts. The first part is about people-caring. They provide services in hospitals to take care of the elderly or sick children from poor families for free. They comfort these sick and poor people no matter in spirit and material parts. Especially, they may provide scholarship to encourage the children from poor families to study hard for their own future. The second part is about the environment. Nonprofit organizations encourage the public to do recycling and cherich what we have. We can save energy to protect the earth and reduce trash to make our enviroment better. The last part is about animal-caring. Stray dogs are one of the serious problems in Taiwan. Some nonprofit organizations donate money or land to settle down stray dogs. They take care of not only people but animals, which makes our world and the whole environment better.
In the future, I'd like to donate myself to the elderly and stray dogs. Working in hospitals or animal homeless organizations will be a good experience. I can talk with the elderly, take a walk with them, or do some help. I can help to wash stray dogs, feed them, and encourage people to love their pets. At least, what I can do now is to protect the environment from small parts, such as turning off light when I don't need it. Like nonprofit organizations, I can do my best to contribute to the society.

subject: HW0901
content:
In general, nonprofit organizations provide many important services to help the people in need. A lot of people who have time and money are willing to devote themselves to care about the children in remote areas. I think it is a great idea for them to join these nonprofit organizations to do some meaningful things for our society and the whole community.
Moreover, taking care of the stray animals are the other important service provided by these organizations. It is not an easy task to deal with many stray dogs and cats. So, some people would donate money or spend time to be a volunteer when they are in their free time.
As for me, I've been a free tutor when I was a college student. I taught some elementary students to learn English. These aboriginal students can't even be afford to school. It is impossible to them to learn English in the cram school. So, I taught these students for free. And both of us enjoyed learning and teaching at that time.
As a result, helping other people is a wonderful experience for me. Joining these nonprofit organization is a lot of fun and meaningful for anyone.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play important roles in helping those poor and desperate people in different countries. These organizations provide not only food but also helpful volunteers. Some volunteers go into remote areas to tutor the children or help to clean the environment, and others even go abroad to devote themselves to those who living in refugee camps or homeless people after the wars and earthquakes.
There are many nonprofit organizations of this kind in Taiwan. They recruit volunteers to help with raising money for donation, building new houses for those people who lost their shelters after natural damages, tutoring students who have difficulties going to school or keeping accompany with some lonely elders.
Every summer, I am involved with the volunteering work for the Bunun Tribe in Taitung. I help to clean the tribe in the early morning. After that, I take some elder people to take a walk. During the day, I even help to sew the traditional Bunun costume, which I enjoy a lot. In the evening, I help the children with their school work. The volunteering is a wonderful experience to me. Only by helping people do I realize how lucky I am.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations are organizations that help or hold activities to interact with people. Personally, I think that they're really doing a great job by holding children summer camps, refugee camps......and so on. Theese organizations are important to many people nowadays. For example: Some organizations sometime visit the hospital to cheer the sick up, some help parents that has to work take care of their children. And, the most important thing is that most of it is for free. Why? Well that because the workers of the organization are volunteers.
Being a volunteer is now a kind of popular activity in Taiwan. Most people are volunteers because: they wish to help people in various ways, or they want to look for something fun yet challenging to do on the weekend. They may also learn something new everytime they be a volunteer. But in generation, helping people is the ultimate goal of being a volunteer.
I had an experience being a volunteer, and it was great. I was a volunteer of an oranization that helps people learn more about protecting the enviroment and animals. Sometimes, it was hard to answer some of the questions asked by the people, but I learned a lot from their questions and other volunteers ansewrs. I think that people really should try be a volunteer sometime. Trust me, it will bring you great benifits.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations play an important role in the world, and there are many kinds of services provided by such organization. In my opinion, I think health care and teach the residents to grow their crops are the most important services. First, in some Africa countries, people easy to get sick by drinking water, so the first mission is to provide them clean water. Some nonprofit organization will put some medicines into the water that it can insure the water's quality. Second, most of remote area or indevelop countries don't have enough food to feed their residents, so it also became a mission to conquer. Some nonprofit organization will go to those place and bring the newest technology to help the farmers there to increase the crops, and it really useful in some countries, unless those countries won't have to afraid they don't have enough food now.
I am interested in medical and want to major it in college. By this professional skill, I think I would like to do some medical volunteer works in the future, such as develop some new medicines to help people in remote areas to defeat their diseases or went to Africa to teach the people there how to reduse the chance of getting AIDS. I think volunteer works are really meaningful, all of us should take out our hand to help those people. Also, I will put this in my future blueprint.

subject: HW0901
content:
In modern society, most of the people can fulfill themselves by enormous material life and healthy body. However, there are also some people who is suffered from poor and disease everyday. Therefore, nonprofit organizations play an vital role in our life.
Nonprofit organization provides lots of services for the people who need help, such as tutoring children in remote areas, running refugee camps in developing countries, helping the blind or deaf people find job oppotunities, raising money to help the people who meet economic difficulties...ect. All the things they do help the world become warm and peaceful.
In my opinion, as a collage student who majors in literature, I'd like to be a volunteer who can tutor Chinese to those poor children in the future, I believe that it'll be a meaningful and valuable experience for me,
It can't be denied that helping others is the source of happiness. If everyone could regard the volunteer work as our obligations and try our best to help others, our world will always full of love and peace.

subject: HW0901
content:
As you know, many children lives in the city of Taiwan were fortunate. People who lives in the city should always have enough money for their children so that they could eat well, wear new clothes, and had something like cell phone, or laptops.
But, some chidren in remote area in Taiwan were not so "rich". In some areas like the east part of Taiwan or in the mountain, some children lives even like whom lives in Taiwan thirty-years ago. Thus, there were many organization volunteer to "do something" for these children.
The most important thing for them should be giving the children a good education. It's not the school education but some others like sport, camp, or somethings which was more important for them. The common work for these organization may be holding a camp for them.
I had been a part of these organization before when I was in senior high school. We had a camp for them. Our job is to teach some different knowledge by having some activities. It was tired because you couldn't even have a good sleep. We should take care of them for all days we have the camp. It was still a unforgotable experience for me, especially when hearning that they say "thank you" to you. It would make you forget all the difficulties you met before!!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, most people in Taiwan lead wealthy and comfortable lives. They don't have to worry about their living. However, there are still some people who are unable to survive and find it difficult to sustain their lives. This is the reason why some nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work.
Some important services provided by such organizations inclues tutoring school children in remote areas, helping the old and sick elderly people with their houseworks, rasing money from the people and donating money to people and countries who suffer from tremendous disasters.
The volunteer work I have ever done is to take care of the disabled children in a nursing center for one day in Kaohsiung. I believe it is not enough for doing volunteer work for only one day because there are still so many people need our help. Therefore, I would have to do some more as well as try my best to figure out some spare time to do volunteer work regularly. I am interested in teaching English and taking care of poor people. Thus, I can contribute myself in volunteer work in these fields.
This society will be more warming if there are more and more people willing to pay efforts on helping poor people without any rewards. And if everyone in this country do so, then there will be less unfortunate lives and tragedies happen in our society.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there are many nonprofit organizations asking for volunteers. Due to the amount of nonprofit organizations are many, the volunteers have a lot of choices to decide. However, how can we know which organization is better? The volunteers should know what kind of services are provided.
A good nonpofit organization should show the volunteers that what kind of purpose they are focused on. By doing this, the volunteers can decide whether he or she wants to join this organization or not. Another important service is the organization should provide the volunteers' security insurances. For example, if a nonprofit organization inquires volunteers to go to some dangerous areas, the organization should promise their life security. These are two things that a good nonprofit organization should require.
Last summer, I joined a nonprofit organization with my mom. That was a very unforgetable experience. My mom and I went to Africa to help the kinds in those developing countries. We brought food, candies, books, and some toys to Africa. We spent two weeks there, playing with those kids and helping with some poor families. It was two incredible weeks.
During these two weeks, the organization help my mom and I a lot. Before we go, they showed us what kind of job we are going to do and explained every details to us. ALso, they took us to hospital to do some preparations in order to prevend us having some disease there. Anyway, the organization I joined is very good and I learned a lot from it.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many organizations about helping poors or homeless people. These organizations provide good resource to the needed people. They provide something to eat, to drink or teach children how to read. We have so many people who need help in the world. In my school, we will pick out a group of students to help these people. I'm glad that I was the chosen one. It was a great experience for me. It was a hard time but when I saw there are so many people who had nothing to eat, nowhere to sleep, my heart was very hurt. So all I have to do is do it as well as I can to help them.
Even though the place was dirty or there were bugs everywhere, I still did my work. Every one should have some experiences like that because experience is the best teacher in life. We learn from experience and we'll progress.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations provide lots of help to many people. Every evening, when I watch news of Chinese TV, there are many information about people who really need help. I think it is a very good idea because almost everyone watches TV news. We can help people by providing food, clothes, or money through the account or address of Chinese TV. They tell us how and where our donations go through TV. I think they do help a lot of people.
Last summer vocation, I joined a volunteer work of Chinese TV. It was a summer camp and I teached children English. Some of them were really smart, but their parents are too poor to let them go to cram schools. They studied very hard and loved to help teachers and classmates. They were very thankful to everyone who have helped them. That was an excellent experience being a volunteer and I wish I can join that kind of work again.
Helping people makes us happy and it can very easy. We don't have to go to another countries or cities. There are many information and ways to do. Just notice thing around us and open our heart to help others.

subject: HW0901
content:
I think nonprofit oranizations recruit volunteers to help with their work is important, because people are all worry about their life and forget the organizations now. Though there are services provid by such organizations, it is still not enough. Some people protect the forest from being cut down can save our environment. This can also keep our organizations as beautiful as it was.
Now, I'm just a junior high school student. I can't help much because of my age, but I have a dream for my future is to be a volunteer of tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan. There are a lot of reasons for this dream. First, I was born in Taiwan. Second is that I can have a chance to help my country. Although I can only help a little bit, I believe that if people have the same thought and work as a team with me. Taiwan can be the most wonderful island in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
Every day, when I read the newspaper, I see many volunteers of nonprofit organizations help people in need with what they are lacking in. The followings are some important services these volunteers provide.
As far as I know, those volunteers would drive vehicles filled with food, clothes and tissues to remote areas in Taiwan. Because some residents there are too poor to have those necessities. They would even pick up them from litter. Moreover, a good many volunteers would serve as instructors to teach children in remote areas, on the ground that those children are too poor to go to school.
I used to be such kind of volunteers last year. I was assigned to look after the old then. No sooner had I come there than some bad smells swept over me. It was the food that had spoiled! Accordingly, I cleared all the spoiled food, giving the old fresh food to eat. Furthermore, I washed one of the old man's body. After such kind of experience, I learned I should cherish the old, respecting them as well.

subject: HW0901
content:
At the same time we are enjoying the Internet in an air-conditioned room, do we think of the victims in the romote poverty-stricken countries waiting for help?
Actually, I have read some eassays introducing some of the nonprofit organizations that are making efforts continually to rescue the victims in Middle Asia, where battles and wars break out easily. Because wars there can occur unexpectedly, all the volunteers of the rescue team have to be able to think and act quickly in any emergency situation. Food supplies and refugee camps settings alike are the most important.
When reading the reports, they always rise my desire to get myself involved in the organization. In fact, I had just attended to three elementary school in Nantao, the middle of Taiwan, last summer acting as a volunteer to help the students learn English, for the 921 Earthquake had placed too many destroys in the area, which made it seemed more isolated.
So next time there is any opportunity to help the people, I will make sure I will be counted in. (I prefer to help learning English witv the students.)

subject: HW0901
content:
Thanks to the progress of technoledge and advanced economy, people worldwide can lead a convenient and better life. There are still many people suffering from disasters, hunger and illness though. As a result, nonprofit organizations show up to help those poor people.
These nonprofit organizations provided plenty of services. To begin with, they provides the poor with free medical cure and food. Take Red Cross as an example. Red Cross runs refugee camps in developing countries. What is more, they help the people in disaster areas. Take a big earthquke happened in Taiwan a few years ago. The nonprofit organizations gave hand to the disaster areas without delay.
In conclusion, I think helping people is a great behavior. I have volunteered in hospital and the orphan place to play with the elderly and the orphans. They indeed require everyone's concern and love. As a result, don't be shy to be a volunteer. Just join me. You will learn whatever you cannot learn on books.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have been mushrooming in modern society, and they aim at nonprofit charity, such as distributing the food to slums, especially in south-east Asia, rescuing victims suffering from natural catastrophe, raising money to whom experience the serious disease, even the incurable included, most important of all, eradicating the genesis of ordeal, for example, war, bribe among officials and businessman, autocratic government via giving discourses, condensing our conscienceness, and so on.
Praiseworthy as they are, finance, strength of members are problematic to cope with. As a denizen, I participated in tutoring children in remote areas where equipment are required, especially educational resource. I masqueraded as a clown to delight the children and intergrated the education and funny performance so as to illuminate them in happiness. Smiles overflowing from their face and penetrated into my ardent heart, it dawned on me that I had erected a poster child. Therefore, I firmly believe that they would be a volunteer out of their philanthrophy which warms up people throughout the world. I am proud to have this experience for not only solving the problem of organizations but spread my wings of charity all over the world, even nowhere could be reached!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, they do a great help for the whole society. But they ask for nothing. It is not easy to donate himself to someone really needs. We should respect them and try our best to help others.
I can see many volunteers in the hospital, they help persons who is not able to read the informations, and which needs to borrow an unbrella or wheel chairs. If the nurse or doctor is busy, the volunteer would ask them what they can do. They are really good helpers in the hospital.
When I was in college, my classmates and I ever went to a remote village, we brought a lot of clothes and toys for their children, and we taught them playing and writing. After a week, we asked them if there is anything we could help, and told them we have to go home, and we will come back next year.
It is an unforgettable experience, I really like to help persons, that makes me feel grow up and excist. I will keep doing volunteer as long as I have free time. In the future I will teach my children how important to be a volunteer, we can attain a lot of fun and satisfy from that.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, it can be seen that more people get help from nonprofit organizations than before. As people start to be aware this is a global village, and only by helping each other can bring everyone a better life. The main services from those organizations are listed as follows: they gather volunteers to give lessons to children in romote areas as well as take care of homeless or disable people until those helpless people can obtain better treatment.
Lots of people believe that those kinds of services will help to develope whole country Moreover, it also let those volunteers reach achivements when they are helping, which creates positive effect to the society. Although some people claim that nonprofit services consume too much human resorces just for a small group of people, it is obvious that advantages weight more on disavantages.
As the result, in my opinion, nonprofit services deserve everyone to take part in that. For me as an example, I would like to be a volunteer to read Bible stories to comfort those people used to commit crime; however how to encourage more volunteers needs furthure discussion.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many poor and unfortunate people in the world, and there are kind-minded volunteers who are always willing to help those in need of help. Those nonprofit organizations deliver food and clean water to poor places. There are hundreds of thousands children are starving and drinking unsanitate water, with those help, they can live a better life. The organizations also give loves to old men live alone, help torturing children get away from the situations and give chances to those who were once in jail.
I would like to join these kind of organizations one day in the future. I will donate money and spend my spare time to talk to old men live alone, and sometimes bring lunch to them, letting they know that there are still someone caring about them. I would also like to go to church playing with orphans and bring some gifts to them, making them feel loved like what my parents give to me. Aside from helping people, I want to help animals suffering due to the change of its habitates. One of my plan in this summer vacation is to go "tsu gee ()" asking if there is anything I can help.
In the last, I want to thank all nonprofit organizations to make this world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Worldpeace or totally non-poluted earth may be a daydream out of reality, though, there are people doing their parts to make our planet a better place. Nonprofit organizations all over the globe offer a broad spectrum of versatile works such as cleaning beaches, taking care of the elders who live alone to running refugee camps in conflicted areas.
Among all the abovementioned works, the environment-related items attract me tHe most. Because, in my opinion, they are the most down-to-earth way to make a difference. And I did take action recently. I have arranged two-week long voluntering experience in my upcoming journey to Australia in Tasmania for CVA, one of the most prestigious nonprofit organization in Australia. In the project, I'll help to maintain the environments in some reserves or national park. By doing it I hope I can spend my vacation in a constructive and gain some truely priceless experience.

subject: HW0901
content:
In traditional Chinese points of view, helping people in your life time not only can let you receive more compliments but also become a honor, better human in next furtune. I do not agree with next furtune theory, but I absolutely have an agreement on helping people can promote the peace of world and decrease the unfair situation in our society.
Therefore, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to provide assistant to those who needed help. In Taiwan, there are lots of people needed help in a hurry, however, govenment can not provide them good caring immediatedly. For example, elderly live alone without great caring, children live in remote areas without enough education resources, ect. Those examples show how important of nonprofit organizations. In our society, goverments can not take care of everyone especially people in the lower, poor situation, and social status. Therefore, nonprofit organizations provide lots of caring services to make up the role of government.
I deeply know the importance of nonprofit organizations. When I was a college students, I engaged in many volunteers activities. I had worked for Hello! U.K. organizations to tutor children English in remote areas in summer vacation. Otherwise, I joined church activity to visit some patients who I have never known and bring them blessings. Those are my wonderful experiences even without any salary in the work. Those memories still inspire my life and make my life meaningful in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Since the government has it's own inconvenience to carry out all the service claimed by people, the prevailing development of nonprofit organizations has a reasonable explaination. Amid all the organizations, some services such as taking notice of the running of specific official organizations, tutoring ineducated children in remote areas and setting up refugee camps in developing countries are rather vital.
First, as far as I am concerned, the motivation of establishing nonprofit organizations is in the hope of making up for the incomplete service offered by the official and keeping an eye on the government in case it make any self-beneficial decisions. Therefore, taking notice of the running of official organitations is fundamental and indispensible. Second, since the children in remote areas have the same right as children living in the cities, it is undoubtedly necessary for them to have access to education. Moreover, if they didn't receive equal knowledge as the children in cities does, they could hardly obtain the equal competence as others do. Last, in order to improve the environment and give a hand to develop the society, running refugee camps is an important process.
xxxx According to all the advantages such as broaden one's horizon and helping the needy ones, though I haven't done any work like this, I would love to try tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, there are more and more people willing to be volunteers in nonprofit organizations. Some of my friends also became the international volunteers to help those children in need. Nonprofit organizations are really provide a bridge between those people who need things and want to give things. This is what we need in this huge world.

subject: HW0901
content: The important services provided by nonprofit organization contain various kinds, besides tutoring children and running refugee camps, the organization like Red Cross Institute is one of them. As long as there is terrible messing happened, the institute immidiately announce the information to the public and hold any kind of fund to gather the money or resources people contribute, and deliver to the place where the messing occured. When some outcoming visiters including foreigners ask me how to get to the stand they want, I show them the direction and point the some kind of stands to give them as the reference. As for me, I would like to serve in the refugee camps in the future. Although there are some people far from us, still they need our help and support. Though these services, I can elervate myself to understand the pain and the suffering of other people.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, more and more people are willing to help people in many countries. They work as volunteers in their free time. They have realized how important the love is, and would like to pass it to others. I'm one of these people and spend a little time on this work every month.
Without love, the world will become horrible. No one can live alone. I have been helped by many people, and now want to appreciate them by helping others. Every weekend, I go to the recycling center near my house to do the recycling. We donate the money to help students from poor families. In addition, we also invite these families to make rice dumplings, noodles every 2 weeks. They can bring the food home for free.
Nobody knows what will happen to them in the future. The most important thing to do is to love the people around you. Everyone has the ability to love. It is never too late to do it. some day, when you need help, you will find how beautiful the world is.

subject: HW0901
content:
As our modern society progresses by leaps and bounds, the relationship between people has become aloof. Nevertheless, there are always some people that are passionate for helping those in need. Therefore, they get together and set up a number of nonprofit organizations with different purposes so as to help more people efficiently.
There are a wide variety of nonprofit organizations for the time being. Some accomodate the handicaped and take good care of them; some look after the elder people while their family are not available; some care about the right of minor groups in our society such as femals, children or native residents. As a result, the spirit of these organizations are respectable for us.
Where I am concerned, I have never joined such kind of organizations. As a student, I will do all that I can to help people who are in need. After I graduate from my school, I will participate in one of these organizations with an eye to realizing my dream to help them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have helped millions of people all over the world since they were founded. They help people who are in need in various ways, such as donating money and necessities to those who are in need, or providing free education and medical services.
Some sevices require volunteers and help from other people, for instance, when they provide free education and medical serices, well-educated people and medical staff are essential, while other sevices just essentials and money. The services mentioned first can help those who are in need face to face and it is also the main way to transfer the donations mentioned above to the people who are in need. These services are helpful and also prevents wasting resorces, because when people give out their used and unwanted stuffs, the people who are in need recieve them and keep on using them.
I haven't done any volunteer work like this before, but I am willing to try it in the near future to give my help to those in need, and give them hope to keep on living, because I know that my devote might mean nothing to myself, but it means everything to them.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are some famous or unknown nonprofit organizations which recruit volunteers to assist those people who really need to be helped. They send food to those older people who live alone in remote areas in Taiwan. Moreover, they celebrate some activities regularly to collect some donation like money, clothes or foods to assist those people who really need to be helped. Besides, there are numbers of important services provided by these organizations which I have seen all the time from news or newspaper.
For me, I have never done any important volunteer work before. However, I did some free job in public organization like type the documents or get the phone to answer some questions. If I had chance to do some volunteer work in the future, I would like to teach English for the chidren who don't have parents. Since I don't have much money to donate, that is the only way I can do to serve our society. Moreover, we should cherish what we have got from our society and try to feedback. Besides, we should share our joyness with others and overcome the difficulties with each other. Then we can make our world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, giving medical care to where the disaster happened, or running refugee camps in developing countries.
To the people in need, the volunteers of the nonprofit organizations just like the light in the dark, especially the medical care and food supply to the victim of earthquake, flood or other disasters.
Being a cadet of Republic Of China Military Academy, I woud like to volunteer in running refugee camps in developing countries, it is because I know how cruel the war is, and how hard to live under fire.
The refugee have no place to stay, not enough food or water, and they are lack of cloth or a clean environment to stay healthy, therefore we should help them to get throught the tough time since we have the ability to do so, and teach them how to survive by farming or hunting and then lead them to their own prosperity.

subject: HW0901
content:
It goes without saying that there are lots of people in need waiting for someone that is kind and able to give them a hand. That is why there's a growing need for nonprofit organizations.
These nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers that are willing to help with the work. For example, the organization gathers recycable clothes from every part of our country or even from every corner of the whole world. The volunteers of the organization will then make the clothes clean and send them to poor families or people who live in remote areas that need the clothes. By the way, there are some kind-hearted people who donate money to help the poor. The organization can set up a fund to put these money to good use. Another example is that the organization may organize a medical team which consists of doctors, nurses and other emergency facilities. If someone in remote areas need emergency help, the team can set off to give those people a hand as quickly as they can.
I have once been a volunteer before. Last winter vacation, my partners and I ran an English camp for children in remote areas. We are members of English Language Volunteering (ELV) club in my university. We prepared some interesting games for the children, trying to teach them English speaking ability and we performed dances and sang songs with them as well. I think it's really a unique and precious experience to me. we can't emphasize the importance of volunteering work too much.

subject: HW0901
content: Taiwan has experienced a lot of disaters, most of them were earthquakes. Without those nonprofit organizations how could Taiwan recover from the September twenty-first earthquake? Maybe it is suggesting our politcal parties should take charity seriously. Sister Teresa is a brave woman, she is willing to help poors no matter what kind of disease they got. Red Cross threw a campaign called "Hungry for thirty hours", it helped us to experience how poor the refugees were. I would like to tutor children in remote areas in Taiwan. My dream is to become a teacher, I will be happy to see my students achieve their goal and give me a warm smile. I'm impressed by the news that a family shares a bowl of noodles. It inspired me to help those who in need. Although I have little money but I have big dream waiting for me in future. My history teacher had been to many countries all around the world. Once she was moved to tears by a little boy. She gave him a chocolate bar, but instead of eating all the chocolate by himself, he shared it with people around. Even a little child know how to share why can't us give our hand to those who in need? We should take this young boy as a model of all.

subject: HW0901
content:
Volunteer work itself is a generous deed, by which people volunterily help others without asking anything for return. Nowadays there're thousands of non-governmental organizations and nonprofit organizations around the world, working hard for human rights and world peace. Their positive services, take "Doctors without Boarders" for example, doctors go to disaster-stricken or poor areas and provide medical services. They also try hard to educate developed countries to put more attention on undeveloped or developing countries.
I myself is a senior high school student. I've once participated in an beach-cleaning activity. I picked up trash and planted trees along the beach. By doing this volunteer work, I feel like I'm stepping out of my own shell into a colorful world. Though I'm just a student, I can still spread out my love to the people around me and to the world in which I live. Everyone should not ignore what they can do for the earth. Just as Mother Teresa said, "You feel what you're doing is just a drop in the ocean, but the ocean will be less because of that missing drop!"

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many services provided. One of them which impressed me a lot is the medical team. My uncle, who is a doctor, is in a team of doctors. Every month, they make a team and to to remote areas in Taiwan where no doctors are available. They do free check-up for children and the old, after their works are done. They play games with the children. This really warms their hearts and inspires me as well.
As a senior high school freshman, now I am study hard for the university entrance exam. I want to be a volunteer as my uncle. It must be so great to sweep away their frown faces and have laughters and smiles instead.
Let's talk about a volunteer work I have done before. Once the school wanted a few students to help raise some money to a charity organization, and I participated in it with my friends for joy. It's really an interesting job! All of us put on the jackets of the organization and had big boxs in our hands. We went down the streets and asked for money. "Would you please give us some money? There are so many people need your help! Please! Every dollar helps!" It took us an afternoon to do this, and we had raised three thousand NT dollars! We viewed this as one of our biggest achievements.
Being a volunteer is so great that you won't be enable to stop it once you experienced it. Sometimes it's really tiring and consuming, though, yet we can get great joy from it and help others. So, why not give it a chot? Once you do it, you will get a crush on it!

subject: HW0901
content:
With the progress and development of the world, there are many adults and children living in a happy life. However, some others are not. In some developing or remore countries, the children there suffer from food shortage or lacking of opportunities in learning. What a pity it is! Fortunately, more and more nonprofit organizations coming from all over world help these children.
Take Taiwan for an example, the authorities take some setps and ways to help children's studying with poor background. The volunteers including retired teachers or collage students. They teach the children to study math, or English. Because of the areas and the individual difference, the volunteers try their best to help the children with no rewards day by day, year in year out. I exactly respect them. Although I have never joined this kind of organization, I woud take part in it one day. Such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan. Because I'm a elementary teacher now, I hope I can devote all efforts to help the children.
Because of the power and efforts the nonprofit organization does, I believe there are no children left behind one day.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in international society which play important roles on all kinds of services such as tutoring children in remote areas or running refugee camps in countries which are struck by disasters.
Take MSF for example. MSF, which is called "Doctors without Bonders" in English, is one of the biggest nonprofit organizations in the world. MSF primarily gives medical relief no matter where the incidents happened and helps refugee of wars and natural disasters to find and build a safer refuge. This organization also puts emphasis on the sanition of the developing countries in Africa and middle East. However, most members of MSF are volunteers. Dispite of the dangers, they make their efforts in order to create a better and peaceful world.
Being a student, I don't have much more free time to contribute in these organizations. Nevertheless, I expect myself to join one of the organizations in the future As the proverb goes "Giving is better than receiving," I would like to give my helps to whom are in need and make our society better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have become more and more important in the society today. Although the children today do not have to worry about their livings, there are still some children live in poverty. Then nonprofit organizations will help them in many ways.
On the one hand, they will give them a clean and safe place to live without paying money. On the other hand, they will provide the children with medical aids when they get sick or injuried. These nonprofit organizations have make great effords for the poor and homeless people as well.
As far as I am concerend, I would like to be a teacher of those homeless children. I love children very much so I want to play with them and we can have fun together. Art may help them relax in their holidays.
To sum up, although volunteer works are not easy to do, but for every citizen in this country has the duty to make the society better.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the hustle and bustle city, I am glad to see lots of nonprofit organizations devote themselves to helping improve our societies. Due to human nature, these organizations did varieties of things to reach their goals. For example, the organizations raise funds to build charities. Besides, they also set up refugee camps in developing countries when pandemic breaks out, such as H1N1, a new form of influenza. In addition, they spend plenty of time accompanying the elderly who were left behind by their families. Take National Red Cross for example, it is said that almost 25% people in the world were benefitted from it.
People of all walks of life are doing some actions to help those people in need. Needless to say, I am no exception. In this summer vacation, I have made a plan that I will do as a volunteer in the charities. In fact, this is the only thing that I could do for I am a merely senior high. During the duties, I may encounter a number of difficulties, whereas I think I could overcome them, because most of the barriers result from my mental feelings.
As the old proverb puts "giving is better than receiving," I think I will learn a lot from helping people, which can not be acquired from the books. Just join us readily, only in this way can we open the door to a healthier, far stronger world.

subject: HW0901
content:

With the pace of globalization and the progressing of transportation, those organization can provide variety rescure, which is not only limited in the countries they come from. We had a harsh but sweet experience during the three weeks when we worked there. It is needless to say that I will go back to provide services in the future!

subject: HW0901
content:

I always feel content whenever seeing the satisfactory appearances of others. Therefore, I would sign up and join in the activities held by non-profit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
While we complent about money or profits, there are several nonprofit organizations providing great help to people in need without anything return as reward. They recruit volunteers to complete their work like angels.
In our society, we can see them frequently. They're always so willing to help. When you're too poor to afford to go to school, they raise money for you. When you live too far from hospitals, they come to check your health regularly. When you have unfair chance to get a job, they find one for you.
This is really touching. They work so hard and only want people to live without fear and sadness. It inspired me one day, and an idea came out of my mind "why not be the volunteer? Thus, I had the work to help the sick. I've been loving this job, and really learned a lot from it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play irreplacable roles in our society nowadays. Despite the governments' complex paper works, nonprofit organizations can provide immediate service to those in need, such as natural disasters' victims. They also give a hand to disadvantage people -- cheated consumers, children suffered from violence, exotic spouse, etc. These people may not receive aids from the busy government, but nonprofit organizations lit up their lights of hope for helps and justice.
I have been a volunteer in a club founded by our school. Every Thursday after school, I go to an elementary school to be an assistant teacher in a class. The class is for students whose family don't have spare money for them to go to cram school. I teach them primary Math and English and sometime read English stories for them. They are always happy to have a chance to learn more. Doing this volunteer work, I never think that I am a giver, I get more from them than what I offer them. I would like to do the same work in the future if I have a chance.

subject: HW0901
content:
With our world turns to a global villiage, people start to think more globally, that is to say, we not only care about what's happening in our own country, but also realize that there are people out there suffering. In the future, I would love to be a doctor so that I could relieve others pain from both physical and mental aspects. Volunteering is tiring. But only through helping others can we realize how people are connected with one another by the four simple letters "L.O.V.E.". For this reason alone is why people are sent into this life.

subject: HW0901
content:
In Taiwan, there are more and more incidents of tutoring children and women. Therefore such nonprofit organizations play the important roles to help thoes people in need. They help not only the people that may have instant financial problems, disabled needs and tutoring children and women a way to get on their feet, but give them hope to surive. More importantly, their unselfness giving also gather other people to take part in the volunteer work.
Doing volunteer work is a good way to help people in need. I think everyone should do it at once. Take me for example, I am a homemaker, and I have two young children. Every morning I take my children to school and also do my volunteer work, which is helping school children's safty at school. I help them cross the hustle and bustle streets and read them storybooks, which is my favorite part of being a volunteer. While reading, I can sence their truly joy when I read them all kinds of stories and in return, I feel happy and enjoy the moment being with them. subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in the world. Among these organizations, some give a hand in the war area to help the patients. Others raise money to give the poor. Still others do their best to teach people some views of dieases and the prevention of dieases. All the nonprofit organizations are dedicated to improving the world.
