In there, I felt delighted because the little chids are so cute and considerate. Once I took a nap on the table, I heard the child talking in a low volue and trying not to bother me. I was touched by them and felt happy. During the two weeks of volunteer work, I spent nearly all day being together with them, teaching them English and math, listening to their annoyance and playing with them. I found it's great to do the volunteer work because it made me satisfied and happy. After all, helping other is the resource of joy. And next time if I had a chance, I would like to do another volunteer to enrich my life!

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations in this world, trying to do everything they can to help poor people and improve the circumstances in developing countries. If there were a natural disaster or an explosion of war, these organizations would arrive immediately to the scene with aids and food supplies. They also rescue a lot of lives by sending outstanding doctors to remote areas. In their actions, you can see generous sacrifices of great love without the gaps between nations.
Last year, I've been a volunteer for tutoring kids English for a semester. These kids were not normal kids, they were from families with single parent or foreign moms. We know that their situations could be tough, but we should just treat them as any other kids for their self-esteem. I feel wonderful to have that chance to know them, to see their smiles and to help them out. After that, I understood why so many people would like to devote themselves to doing volunteer: when they brought laughter to others, they found satisfaction and fulfillness in giving rather than recieving.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many ways to help those in need. Nowadays, there are lots of charities and non-profit organizations giving various services, such as giving out food, clothes, money or any daily products. They also send volunteers to help taking care of the disabled, the orphans and the homeless. These are all very kind and helpful, but in my opinion, doing volunteering works is the most effective way.
I've been a volunteer in a hospital near my house since I was twelve. I have helped the homeless people and the disabled. The most unforgettable experience is the one happened to a little girl and me.
The girl's name is Amy. She lost her parents and her arms in a big fire. I helped her cleaning herself. One day, she bit me because I scratched her accidently. I was shocked and stopped to look at her. Suddenly, she bursted out teers. She said that she had been so lonely these days and the harm done to her arms in the fire was absolutely unbearable. I stroked her hair gently while listening to her, I know how I would feel if I were her.
Since the incident, I realize how important it is for people to receive kindness and love after unfortunate events happening to them. Doing volunteer work, after all, can't change the reality, but it's the best way to help them out of the nightmare. It gives me true happiness to see their faces lighten up.
Helping others isn't just helping the one you give help to, but also teaches you that you are one of the lucky ones who can help others. It gives me courage and confidence whenever I encountered problems. It shows me that it's a blessing to live normally and not get injured. Volunteering really teaches me a lot!

subject: HW0901
content:
Today there are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan, such as the founds and the private companies. The famous organization in Taiwan is Chi-Ji which is based on the Buddish. They not only help people who are suffering but also recycle the garbage to save our earth. As long as there are accidents or some huge damage, they would show up before the police. They always provide their care and company with the broken-heart people. The most important of all, they do not ask them to return.
I have done some volunteer work for few years. Four years ago, I took some courses about World Game 2009. I would like to be a volunteer to introduce foreign players what Kaohsiung is and provide them what they need. Moreover, I would tell them about the history, the cultural and must-go. It was really a nice and special experience. In the future, I will still take part in volunteer work as possible as I can.

subject: HW0901
content:
These organizations provide not only resources but also medical services for the coutry in the war. Once the organizations receive the help of the country, it will immediately call out the nearby country to conduct the condition of the country. After realized what the country is need, the organization will deliver the proper resources and medical help. These helps are usually faster and more efficient than the government. The destroyed country may recover quickly by the help these organizations provided.
I used to be a volunteer in a hospital. My work was to chat with the olds and played the piano in lunch to cheer them up. Although I was first sad with their situations that I couldn't even talk to them. After a period of time, I had learned that I should be strong enough to company with them. Otherwise, who would them talk to? I started to open my heart and made them happy by telling joke and my own embarrassing thing. Whenever they said "Thank you! You bring me a lot of happiness." I swore that's the most beatiful sentense in the world that I hadn't ever heard. No matter what the work I will do in the future. I'd like to be a volunteer in the hospital by all means.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, volunteer work and services have become a hot-button issue. According to a survey, people and nonprofit organizations have been attaching greater weight to this service, because it may give rise to a host of benefits. In this essay, I aim to explore this meaningful phenomenon from diverse perspectives, identify the relevant services and bring up some reflections and experience of this kind of activity.
What are some important services provided by nonprofit organizations? To my mind, an array of integrated services contribute to this remarkable program, and here I would illustrate a few of the most important ones. The first important service is that the group of Tsu-zi often recruit their volunteers to give an aid to people who are in poverty or needed for care. Another major service is that the overseas Chinese college students will teach the elementary and junior students English in remote areas when they return to Taiwan in summer vacation. For instance, as I am a teacher in elementary school, I met five overseas Chinese college students in 2008. They were assigned to teach our students English in summer camps. Although they cannot teach as professionally as a normal teacher, they express love and sincerity to my students. Therefore, my students enjoyed the unforgettable camp to great extent.
Last but not least, when everyone is fully aware of the significance of this kind of activity, I firmly believe that it will be beneficial to our people and society. Both the government and citizens should make concerted efforts to carry out and encourage this volunteer work.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofic organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. In the world, there are many undeveloping places, where are lack of food and water, or suffering from disasters, such as earthquack, flood, wars or other diseases. The residents there are in difficult situation, no matter physically or mentally. If such organizations help them in time, they will be rescued from the danger.
What services do such organizations provide? First, they provide life-essential resources, including food, water, clothes, and so on. Second, they establish schools for education. Third, they build hospitals or provide medical service to treat patients' diseases. Last but not least, they show their sympathy on lonely elders, abandant children, or disable people. They devote their life to promote the bight side of human.
As a medical student, I participate in a volunteer club, which perform healthy education, medical service and home-visit in counties where are lack of medical resources every summer break. Meanwhile, I also became a fundraiser of the hospice foundation. All of above are meaningful and I learned how to help others without benefits.
If everyone can give a hand to others who really need help as these nonprofic organizations, the world will be free from disasters in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more nonprofit organizations are founded through the world. Helping the poor has became a popular work, and also the number of volunteers is keep raising. I'm really glad to see the phenomenon which means people's passion still exsist in this bad age of enconimy.
So far, I've done many volunteer work like beach-cleaning, looking after the elders or helping the organizations to get the donations. I felt wonderful because I realized that even if you were a youngster, you still could help each other. You don't need to care about the amount of money you donated will give a shame to you, and also you can exercise to keep yourself healthy when doing volunteer works!
So, why don't you come to be a volunteer, too? You can join the Redcross to help the homeless victims that was hurt by natural diseases. Also, you can be in TsuChi to give a hand to the poor people who live hand in mouth. Or maybe you can join in both two or more to help more people! Just try it, and you won't regret!

subject: HW0901
content:
Thanks to the economic development and social stability, Taiwan has become one of the wealthy countries in the world. Because of the said reason, well-to-do or charitable people started to found organizations or gather volunteers to help those who are in need.
For example, some churches or temples will send their volunteer members to remote areas, such as an aboriginal village or a mountaineous elementary school, to teach children or help clean the village. A charitable team in Chia-yi repairs roads, bridges, and helps to build houses for the poor.
In addition to those who help Taiwan to be a better place to live, we also have some well-known international charitable or volunteer organizations. With a small amount of donation every month, I have helped make a difference for a child in Africa. My friends and I are also in the process of oganizing a group of our own. Our aim is to work with kids in remote orphanages and teach them skills that may be interesting or useful to them.
