Due to the bad textbooks, students can't get good grades; therefore, they don't have much confidence and they have no enthusiasm for learning anymore. That's the reason why I want to edit textbooks. When I get into university, I'll join the club tutoring children and give them my learning tips and help them gain confidence in learning. I'm looking forward to a busy but delighted life in the future.

subject: HW0901
content: Recently, there are more and more nonprofit organizations have set up. As I know, they provide a variety of services such as tutoring children in remote areas or distributing some necessities to refugee camps and so on. As far as I am concerned, I think these services really brought them a lot of benefits. Some children couldn't have a better learning enviroment because their transportation is not well-developed yet. As a result, it really helps them a lot by providing learning access. Moreover, most poor people who live in refugee camps lack of facilities like medical care and food. Owing to the support from the nonpofit organizations, they could have a better environment. There are still many people need help in the world. They need our help. If I have chance to take part in volunteer work someday, I would like to assist them as much as I can. If everyone is willing to dedicate to benevolent careers, I think this world will become more and more beautiful.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations provide many important services such as medicine and secure. They help a lot of people in Taiwan and even in other countries. I had been a volunteer in my high school.
I joined the volunteer club and I enjoyed to help people. We usually visited the old people who lived alone. We couldn't do too much things but had a conversation with them. Their lives were boring and they need someone to be with them. I liked to be with them not because I pitied them. It was all because I thought they were so adorable. They were just like kids. Their thoughts were pure. When I had a conversation with them, I felt so happy to listen their innocent words.
I never joined any voluteer club since I graduated from my senior high school. I enter the college and my life becomes busier than before. But even I don't join the volunteer club, I still love helping people. I like to help my friends around me. I have a scooter and when they ask me to give they a ride, I will do it right away. If I have more time in the future, I think I want to do something to help the animals like dogs or cats. I love animals very much and I want to help the homeless animals. To give them a warm and happy place to live. We should not abandon the animals. We should take response to them. We live in the same earth. Every creature has the right to survive. We should not take their rights away. I would love to fight for the animals' right and help them. If I have more free time, I will do more things to help the world. We should do our best to help the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
In view of the lack of education and resources in remote areas in Taiwan or some poor countries around the world, some nonprofit organizations have donated a lot of necessities like food, clothes, and water or volunteers to these places to help them. Besides, I have heard about some charities have donated lots of computers to developing countries and even send teachers who are endowed with good farming skills there to teach them how to cultivate plants. These organizations and people are willing to sacrify themselves; therefore, they all deserve our respects.
I, as a student, also have this kind of experience. With my English skills, I mustered up my strength and courage to go to an elementary school in a remote place in Taiwan. I taught the young students basic English there and I acquired important things from them simultaneously--happiness and satisfaction. Until now the vivid memory of the smiles on my students' face still lights up the corner of my mind.
As far as I am concerned, I am passionate about volunteering. As we help others, we are helping ourselves at the same time. I believe that being a volunteer will do good to our society and makes this world better and better. May everyone can be a happy volunteer in the future, and as for me, I am sure that I will keep volunteering.

subject: HW0901
content:
There have always been a spectrum of organizations in each society; profit, nonprofit, government organizations and so on. As far as I am concerned, increasing number of the nonprofit organizations and the good deeds they have done volunteerly have gained widespread concerns around the world.
To begin with, these nonprofit organizations have goals to reach, they provide services such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, running refugee camps in developing countries, offering food supplies or medicine to the countries at war.
Secondly, these nonprofit organizations consist of people with love and dedicate hearts. Some people give money, other people may provide some techniques, like doctors, they can help the sick in the devastated war space or the disease-affected area.
I have done volunteer work in the hospital during my high school summer vacation. At that time I thought that I could do something more than just a student. I've always hoped to lead a meaningful life. So I chose to volunteer in the Emergency Room. I helped the nurse to send the patient's paper, and I helped the sick to go to the bathroom. What's more, I told some interesting stories to the children in the "burned department", and many of them forget how painful they physically were.
I think that the volunteering work is so meaningful, so if there's an opportunity to do the volunteering job, I'd do it without hesitation. Maybe in the future, I will participate in these kind of organizations, such as the Red Cross organization. I hope that my mind wanting to help the others can cause the world different, and somehow make it better.

subject: HW0901
content:
I have seen more and more campaigns or institutions held by nonprofit organizations recently. All of them contribute a lot to our world. Take volunteers in Africa for example, some of them work as doctors so that the victims there can consult doctors without paying money. Some of them work as engineers, who build houses or clean the water for the victims so that people can live safer. Some of them teach the people there how to grow grains and fruit plants so that the victims can have fresh foods and they can develop their agriculture by their own.
I had an experience of working as a volunteer in a library. I recalled the books and labeled the books. It was quiet easy but it really needed patience. It took me hours to do the same thing. However, I was very happy about helping others. If I have opportunities to be a volunteer, I would like to go to the developing countries in my future. Because I believe in that peace and love can save all the miserable people.

subject: HW0901
content:
Have you ever seen many people running with fear, shouting and crying in many destructions by yourself? There are still many people suffering from famine and poor. How can we help them? Let's intend the nonprofit organizations.
Nonprofit organizations like the Red Cross give them a hand. They offer medical help, supply food and even teach them to read. The volunteers learn a lot from helping others and receive many appreciate response from those who are thankful. You could help them in home. With a dollar every day, you can donate it to the charity. The old toys, books, clothes are also helpful to them.
I've volunteered in a certain hospital. It teaches me lots of things. In the future, I would like to be devoted in volunteering.

subject: HW0901
content:
As the old saying goes: "God helps those who help themselves." However, human still have to ask for others' assistance whenever a problem is out of their abilities. The red-cross is the one of the organizations establishing for rescuring people from the severe situations. They not only supply the requirements to the poverty countries but send their people to the third world countries to improve their living condition. Besides, they also build hospital in the undeveloped countries to upgrade their medical system.
In Taiwan, there is a great deal of nonprofit religous organizations establishing for people's need. They save a lot of life after the 911 earthquake outbreak. These organization actually contribute much more things for human beings. Although I have never been a volunteer for this kind of work, I will be willing to become a part of them in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Recently, the problems of lack of resources in helpless areas in Taiwan have received a lot of concerns. Because of this, many nonprofit organizations have risen gradually and taken effective action, providing many various sorts of services. For instance, they will use the way of asking people to contribute some money or receits to those who are suffering from ill diseases. They will also send some food and water to poor students whose parents can not afford the fees of studying in remote areas. What's more, they will also ask many teenagers to be volunteers to help people in need or teach the students who want to learn but can not pay the fees. The organizations are trying to improve the problems and try their best to give them a hand in time.
As for my personal experiences, I once volunteered to be a tutor to teach a child whose family having difficulties paying the fees for him to go to school. When I saw him the first day, to my great surprise, he had a lot of desires to study in spite of the poor situation. He concentrated on his studying very much while I was teaching him, which made me very grad and relieved. He said he wanted to be a teacher to teach students in need just like me. From the experience, I have decided to contribute myself to this kind of job and join an organization in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In recent years, nonprofit organizations have played an important role in the whole world. They provided a variety of services and asked nothing in reward. For example, Doctors without Boarder emphasized that everyone should have the same right to medication, regardless of races, genders or nationalities. They provided medical aids to those in need, especially people in developing countries. They need doctors who can take care of patients anytime and anywhere.
One of the most famous nonprofit organizations is the Red Cross. They gave provisions to countries in Africa to keep people from being starving to death. Moreover, they helped rescue the victims in natural disasters and provided comfortable refugees.
I have never done a complete volunteer work because I was just a student. However, I realized that everyone can give out some of our strengths to change the world after reading many international magazines which tell readers that to give is better than to receive. So I'm planning to be a volunteer in the hospital during this summer vacation. I'm sure to learn a lot and pave the way for my dream--to be a doctor. It will be a rewarding experience, and I will enjoy the happiness when helping others.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many organizations out there whose main goal is to help those who are in need. For example, they may send food and supplies to areas where people face a variety of difficulties ranging from diseases to hunger. They also help refugees find a place to live.
I've never volunteered to be a member of such organizations myself. Not only because I'm a student but because I never tried to. But ever since a volunteer who works worldwide came to our school and gave a speech, telling us how important it is to know what some people far away from us are currently suffering from, my mind changes. I think I'd like to go to Africa to give those hungry, homeless children a helping hand in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
I think that people who volunteer to help others who really in need are very good behaviors. In Taiwan, there are many organizations doing so. This kind of organization help others without profits. For example, the dotors go to the remote areas to take care of the people living there and doing some free surgeries for people who are poor. And some organizations will provide money to poor people to help them go to school, dealing with some problems in their life. They also invite some fomous guys to poor countries to experience the life there. All things they do are good for the society.
In my future, I want to adopt a child no matter in Taiwan or foreign countries to help them fulfill their studying and give some helps for them. And I also want to donate money for people in need.
If we have the ability to help other people, we should do it immediately. This is my viewpoint toward the topic.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations put all efforts in helping the inferior ones without hesitations. For example, they would provide countries being hit by disater or countries now in a war with immediate supplies including food, water, temporary camp to live, and medical help costs nothing. What they have done rescue millions of people from starvation and disease. When 921 earthquake hit Taiwan, these nonprofit organizations give out their hand before our useless government do anything. Due to their unselfish contribution to the society, I respect them.
I havn't been a volunteer in these nonprofit organizations, but I will be one in the future. Although I don't have any particular skills, I have a passionate heart, which in my opinion the most important thing to be a volunteer, to serve the world. I can carry the supplies on my shoulder; I can comfort the people in grief losing the loved ones; I can tell kids some jokes and make their smiles show again.
I know that my ability is not sufficient enough, but with a resolute mind, I think I still can make the world better.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an very important role around the world. No matter which area is destroyed by nature disaster, those volunteers are always there to help deliver necessarities, take care of residents, and wait for the miracle with those victims. For example, main land China was hit by the unexpected earthquake and Maldive was swept by the tsunami. Nowadays, China has been rebuilt and Maldive keeps prospering in business of sightseeing; people can hardly believe they were once maltreated! Thanks to those volunteers, the whole world is decorated with warmth and love even though it has been in chaos.
As one member in the world, I have an obligation to do something for this society. Orphans, child abuse, and the stray dogs are social problems that I care most. Sometimes, I really want to give them a hand, but I don't know how to do it. From now on, I will put all my love, care into practice. I can spare some time to teach orphans English; moreover, taking good care of stray dogs is another good way: feed them, wash them, and find a new owner for them on-line.
No one is able to detach from this society. If I have more abilities in the future, I believe I can do it better. Last but not least, I hope I can be that kind of person who can change the world!

subject: HW0901
content:
Such organizations, like MSF (Doctors without Boarder in English) and the Red Cross, may provide emergency medical care. They not only help the wounded in the war but also fight with the fatal diseases in tropical areas.
Others may give extra lessons to children who don't have the proper environment to study. They recuit college or senior high students as volunteers to guide them on studies, and this is what I want to do. I will give all my effort and patience cut to help them. They are the ones who hold little resource from their shools. They'll need someone to give them a hand on schoolworks and make them competitive on the society. And I hope to watch them improve from the bottom of my heart.
In my school, I help to clean the campus on holidays. I truly feel the sense of achievement when I see it becomes tidy and clean. I also once showed some Japanese guests around my school. They asked about everything excitingly, and it was my pleasure to answer them. Although I didn't do much, helping others really makes me happy, and I'm looking forward to doing more in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In western countries, volunteer work is included in students' required courses. Some students even found their own nonprofit organizations or clubs to do the community or campus services. Although there are not as many Taiwan students as western counterparts to get involved in volunteer work, there are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan. Nonprofit organizations provide different kinds of services, such as raising money for the need, protecting the environments or endangered species, constructing some buildings for the homeless, and tutoring children without parents or in the remote areas. Such services not only need budget but human resources.
In my opinion, every college student should participate in nonprofit organizations and do some volunteer work. Therefore, I took part in one of the nonprofit organizations near my school and had an opportunity to tutor a little girl who was abused by her father. Through this experience, I have learned that we have the responsibility to protect or educate those in need after we received so much benefits and blessing from others. Only when we make efforts to help others can we find the meaning in our lives.

subject: HW0901
content:
Despite our advanced technology, certain people around the world are still suffering from starvation, diseases, natural disasters, and wars. In order to prohibit that sort of mishaps continually happening, a wide variety of nonprofit organizations come into being.
These nonprofit, non-governmental organizations offer emergency aids or permanent helps to people who indeed lead harsh lives. For instance, they send rescue teams with well-equipped divices to undeveloped or developing countries. As a result, they can better the residents' living standards. Moreover, they recruit volunteers with professional abilities to help with their work. Not only provisions but also labor and money are sent to distant regions and orphanages so that more and more orphans, refugees, and handicapped people can be taken well care of and saved. They, besides, educate kids and adults about hygiene and epidemic diseases to prevent tragedies ahead of time.
As for me, I have twice volunteered to raise invoices on the street for 5 hours. Even if I held that was adurable and laborous, it was worth doing that. The more invoices I raised, the more old people I could save! So I just tolerated the hot sun and did my best to raise. Ultimately, I totally raised over a thousand invoices! I was very satifisfied. Also, I was very thankful and happy that I could do something for my society.
In conclusion, an account of the hard work the nonprofit organizations do, they are worth awarding. But when you admire their deeds, don't foret to be a volunteer to help people as well!

subject: HW0901
content:
Indeed, nowadays, the whole world is like a global village and there are a number of nonprofit organizations dedicated to make the village better and more peaceful. As far as I know, there are all kinds of nonprofit organizations from goverment, school, church, and hospital. Take school for example. Usually the voluteers are teachers and students. They are used to carring various of learning materials and technology to the rural ares, like mountain region or countryside. Meanwhile they will tutor the children and demonstrate how to use high-tech facilities in the public. What they behave is always make the public feel touched and pleased. Furthermore, the nonprofit organization, such as Red-Cross Foundation, also commit a lot of charity every year. They recruit medical proffessionals and nurces to take care of patients and the injured in the third world countries, like South Africa, Vietnam, Combodia, etc. The volunteers extend their knowledge, skill, enthusiasm and, most important, "love" to the world. I deeply consider them great modle of the modern society and I deeply appreciate what they have done.
On the other hand, I am the one who like to involve in volunteering work since it is the most meaningful activity ever. When I was in America, I went to the churh every Sunday night. Our church members formed volunteering team to various institute. My favorite one is going to the homeless center. The reason is not only that I can prepare abundant and delicious meal for them, but also make them feel that they are concerned and valued by the society.
All in all, as long as I am capable and available, I would be more than happy to participate in the volunteering jobs. These kinds of activities bring hope, love and future to our world. I would also like to encourage my friends to know more about the volunteering field and make contributions for our future generations.

subject: HW0901
content: Volunteers shoulder social responsities because they believe that they should payback to the world. Under the believe, the nonprofit organizations are contributed to reach volunteers' goal. With the strong power from cooperation, the nonprofit organization can help people in need. The Red Cross provides medicle service to the refugee camps and developing countries. To remove fate of poverty from children, World Vision collects teaching metirals and recruits volunteers for the education purpose. Becides those well-known organizations, lots of small nonprofit groups also work hard to make our society a better place. I am now a volunteer in school volunteer group. Though the group is small and doesn't have much fund, it has passionate volunteers like me who use their leisure to tutor children in remote countries. And volunteers believe that they can make our society a better place no matter they belong to a international nonprofit organization or a small group we held up.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with there work. And, there are more and more nonprofit organizations in Taiwan.
According to the news, we could know that the nonprofit organizations often appear after the earthquake. Then, they helped the residents to build up their new house.
Besides, the nonprofit organizations also went to the poor countries. In many third world, they usually have wars and famines. Then, the nonprofit organizations would bring some food there. Moreover, they even run refugee camps there. In the refugee camps, they offered food, water and medicine and so on. That was really helpful for the residents there. Thus, many Taiwanese who didn't have time to go there also donate the money to these nonprofit organizations.
As for me, there are so many ways to help others. When I was a senior high students, I went to a place to visit the elders with my classmates every Sunday. Our teacher said that we should care about the old people who don't have their family. Because when someone is getting older, their friends might leave them. As a result, if they don't have family, they will be very lonely.
In short, I think there are many ways to help others. Moreover, join the nonprofit organizations must be a good choice.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is no denying that everyone should participate in nonprofit organizations at least one time throughout his or her life. I am no exception. For me, dedicating myself to charity institutions is my top priority to contribute to this lovely world. Nonprofit organizations provide a variety of service. First, they offer substantial service such as food, water as well as daily products. In this way, those who don't have money to support their families can live more comfortably by those supportive things. Second, nonprofit organizations provide both the poor and the sickened with free medical diagnosis. Accordingly, they will be more likely to keep in good conditions and keep being in the pink. Last but not least, nonprofit organizations are more than an essential provider, they contribute warmth and care. It is with their encouragements and supports that make the disadvantaged, the handicapped, the poor feel more contended.
As a senior-high school student, my English teacher has always encouraged us to take part in charity organizations. Well goes a sage, "Those who dedicated themselves to the needy are blessed". Consequently, I have been determined to being a volunteer in the future, helping all the disabled person I encounter as well as donating some of my salary to charity organizations. Under no circumstances should we forget, "Giving is more blessful than receiving."

subject: HW0901
content:
For several years, nonprofit organizations have spread blessing and warmness all over the world. They make our world a better place, especially in the developing and poor countries, such as Africa. Also, some regions in Taiwan receive the help of those charity organizations.
For those families which have suffered from wars or terrorist attacks, nonprofit charities will go to help immediately. For example, the World Vision provides a lot of services. They have a fountation which people can donate their money to the poor and people in need. Also, If we pay attention to some corners in our neighborhood, there are the place which collects people's old stuffs or secondhand dressing. Those devices are very important. Although people may regard those abandoned items as garbage, those things will become the precious gifts for those refugee in developing areas. Whenever we shop the convenience store, we may notice that there's a small box for donating money. It shows that these things those nonprofit organizations have done are everywhere. They do not only help tutoring children in remote areas and running refugee camps, but also they reach every corner and seize every oppotunity to help people.
This year, I will be a volunteer in 2009 World Games in Kaohsiung. It's so exciting because it's the first that I have the chance to be a volunteer. As an English major, I can use my talent to help the foreigners from different countries. Besides, I believe that having the experience of being a volunteer will make me confident. I really look forward to joining the volunteer team this year.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are various kinds of nonprofit organizations and they give hands to those who need help world-widely. For example, in 921 earthquake in Taiwan and 911 terrorist attack in America, such charities helped to build refugee camps, take care of those who were injerded or lost their families, and even helped reconstruct refugee's homes. When there is no big disasters, these nonprofit organizations also help those in remote areas in the world, such as Africa or remote villages in the mountain.
Since I am only a high school student, there is not many things I can do now for these great organizations. But in the future, I would like to be a volunteer in charities. I want to teach children in the remote regions in the world or help people there to solve some law problems in life. And if I have enough money to support my family, I will donate the extra for those having more need for it. As a proverb goes, "Giving in better than receiving." We should always do our best to help others whenever we can.

subject: HW0901
content:
More and more volunteers have joined the nonprofit orgnizations in Taiwan. The most famous services that they provide is to take care of the sick or the old in a hospital. You have to chat with the old, play with the children, and encourage them.
There are also other services provided by such organizations. For example, helping the disable, transporting the necessities to the refugee camps or locations destructed by nature disasters, and teaching the orphans are known to most of us. I had a special experience about this kind of services. Last year, my classmates and I went to an elementary school in a remote country. The abriginal children consist the small school. There are about four children in a grade. They can't be well educated because of the lack of the resource. We went there and taught them English. We thought that they wouldn't be interested in the curriculum at first; nevertheless, they were delighted when we were teaching them. They also played games and sports with ecstasy with us. It was really an unforgettable experience, and I also learned that there are many people need our help to get what they should get. As a proverb goes, "Giving is better than receiving", I will do this job many times in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Happiness is derived from mutual support while helping someone in need. Some organizations strive to make life better in poverty-stricken country. Others help rebuilt homes for victims to the earthquakes. Not only do these volunteers support others, they also learn a great deal from it, finding there's love all over the globe.
The Red Cross, for instance, always show up at once where there is in need. They send rescue teams to provide aids after distructive earthquakes or tsunami. They offer provisions to the victims, helping them to survive the strict conditions. Most important of all, the instant hand they give make people feel warm and moved. It is the feeling that really counts.
Everyone can give their hand to others in the way they want, also they can. As far as I'm concerned, I have taught students in the elementary school as a volunteer before. As a high school student, I help with the kids' school assignment. Every sunday morning, twelve kids whose ages range frome seven to ten and two teachers, my friend and I, met at an elementary school. Not only did we teach them school work, we accompany them as well. Most of the students come from single-parent family, who need more care from the society. It is really a great experience for me. During the class, we gave each other mutual feeling of love, just like those nonprofit organizations and charity, we did little but great things, which benefits one another!

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations around the world. They all try to make the world better. Some organizations are dedicated to helping those who are homeless, disease-striken or poor. Some offer help and rescue when the disaster happens. And still some let volunteers go to remote areas to improve the quality of education or medicine. As for me, I had gone to the hospital to visit the children who had serious disease such as cancer, bringing some gifts to them and also encouraging them. Though the gifts are not something expensive, but I felt that they were happy receiving it. Also, I saw optimistism from them. They are just kids but they look things in a bright side. Shouldn't we also have such kind of attitude toward our lives?
"Giving is better than receiving." We can't just "live." We must "exist." If we are capable of helping others, we should try to do something. The value of one's life is not what one have, but how one connect to others. If one day the whole people can realize this. Then, selfishness, indifference, and cruelty will be eliminated from our society.

subject: HW0901
content:
The important services provided by nonprofit organizations include tutoring children, providing safe shelter or running refugee camps. In remote areas, lack of resources makes children unable to receive education since their childhood. Thus, many college students or well-educated people will volunteer to educate those children, helping them enhance their knowledge. Also, due to the increase of domestic violence in Taiwan, more and more organizations begin to provide abused women and children a shelter to live in, and organizations will try to find a adoptive family for those homeless children. They will also train abused women some skills, which help them make a living on their own. Moreover, when unexpected disasters happen, many organizations, such as Red-Cross, will immediately come to the dangerous areas to help them recover their houses, schools, and other building. The most important thing to do is to heal the patients, and save their life.
I used to be a volunteer of Red-Cross. Last summer, I went to Simakusi where people live in the mountains and children are unable to receive appropriate education. My work there was teach them common medical knowledge. Most people in Simakusi still believed in their traditional healing process so that we went there to help them change rooted thoughts. Furthermore, every morning, we went to markets to sell the fruits they grew. Interestingly, we played with children and taught them knowledge through games. After the journey of Simakusi, we check their condition once a week and do our best to help them. During the staying in Simakusi, I learn a lot from living with them. Also, I think it is good opportunity for me to know more about what life is and help others. Appreciation is the best gift I've ever received from them.

subject: HW0901
content:
I am a student in National Kaohsiung Normal University. In this semester, I joined a nonprofit organization which tought the orphant students in . We used every Saturday to go to the mountain and tutor them. At the beginning, I found it hard to teach them because they were lack of training and studying. Moreover, it seems the children there did not like to be clean. They always had dirty hands. I was so afried that they may get sick because they didn't like to wash hands. However, due to getting along with them for this semester, I have found they were very innocent. I think it was because the children there didn't often go out from their mountain.
Although they may not get a lot of improvement in this semester, I think next semester I will do my best to provide my knowlege and energy to teach them. Perhaps this is also a training for me--a train to become a good teacher.

subject: HW0901
content:
In my opinions, nonprofit organization did help a lot in local minority and in developing countries. From what I have heard, some nonprofit organizations organise medical teams, most of those teams' members are medical students, to provide medical aids in developing countries. They go to countries like Soloman or India where people have not even basic medical resourses, let alone doctors and clinics, so many people there are not health and live in messy environment. NPO provide not only medical help, such as medicine and medical treatment, but also help those people with public hygiene.
For me, although to be a overseas volunteer is sort of facinated, that can help the world and experience different culture at the same time, I still prefer to do volunteer work in Taiwan, because here are still many minoritie who need help and are to be neglected. That's why I would like to be a volunteer in women benifit organizations. It's said that women and men are equal nowadays, but there are still power relation unequal in this society, such as women suffer from domestic violence who don't know what to do or are afraid of getting helps so I want to help them in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many people who are in poverty and bad health conditions all over the world. This is why some people found nonprofit organizations. The purpose of those organizations is to help people who are in need have better life.
The most popular and well-known nonprofit organizations is "The Red Cross." It has many branches founded in countries that always have civil wars and natural disasters. There are also more than ten thousand people who devote themselves to this sacred job. Those volunteers help people in poverty because of poor harvest by providing some wheat, rice or even livestocks. The Red Cross also sends many professional doctors and nurses to the coutries which have civil wars to provide some medical resources. There are also some volunteers adopt poor orphans whose parents are killed in wars or disasters. When there are some natural disasters such as earthquakes, typhoons or erruptions of volcanoes, The Red Cross will also send search parties to save people who get hurt or people who are stuck in cruel enviroments.
The volunteer work I would like to do in the future is to help orphans all over the world because those innocent children are not only poor but also lack of love. The way I want to help them is to establish some orphanages where orphans can start their new life. Despite the difficulties of helping orphans, I still want to give it a try. No matter how hard it will be, it is definitely a priceless experience of my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Due to the rising price and natural damage, there are lots of people don't have food to eat, clothes to wear or even house to live. Therefore, there are nonprofit organizations which are lived for people who need help. Evertime when there is a serious damage such as earthquake, we can see lots of volunteers appear at the collapse buildings and busy helping with the homeless people. They will enconrage them and tell them don't give up any hope. For people who just lose their home or family will filled with warm in their heart. Otherwise, some nonprofit organizations are lived for children who were hitted by their parents. Volunteers will take the children away from their home and give them another warm place to live.
I havn't had such an experience of being a volunteer. But I would like to help with the children who don't have parents or are homeless. Because I like children very much, and I think that they are really pity and need love from others, I would play with them and give love to them and let them know that they aren't useless people. Everone of us all have what we're good at, so we can't give up anyone, and encourage them to do what they want to do.

subject: HW0901
content:
There is no doubt that nonprofit organizations play important roles especially in those developing countries because of the help and love they bring to them.
There are several services provided by those organizations such as providing foods and medical care that people there desperately need. However the most important service of all is keeping tutoring and educating children. Because children are the future of their countries. Under these circumstances, they will have abilities and responsiblities to change and rebuild thier mother countries. And that is what the whole services are all about.
I had done volunteer work once back in college. I went to country side to teach children English. That was a forggetable experience in my life. I can still remember the smiles on every child's face until now. This experience not only made me realize how belessed I am but also reminded me that giving is way better than receiving. If I had a chance to do volunteer work in the future, I definitly choose my proficiency to teach to children. After all, it feels so good and rewarding to make a positive difference in someone's life. I think that is the main purpose the nonfit organizations are trying to make people understand.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more people would like to devote themselves to be volunteers after retiring. There are many kind of nonprofit organizations in all the world no matter what type of organization they are, all of them have the same goal "Help the people at any corner of the world as well as possible." For example, Food bank deliver food to Africa or those developing countries to solve the problem of food shortage. There is a proverb goes "Giving is better than receving." When I saw a thinny Africa girl eatting a cookie from Food Bank with a happy smile on the newspaper, I feel it's really wonderful to help people.
I have been a volunteer in the hospital before. It's a really nice and unforgettable experience. My volunteer work in the hospital is talk to the paitents or elders. It's not only a hard work but meaningful. One time I talked to a elder we really had a great time chatting with each, however, she passed away few days after. Suddenly, I truly realize we should cherish our life. Being a volunteer can learn a lot of things about life and you can also help people. I still want to be a volunteer in the future. That's why I major in society work and society policy in my college. There still have a lot of things I want to learn from it.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations in Taiwan and they provide many kinds of services for people who are vulnerable like children, the physically challenged, the senior citizens living alone and so on. The important services they offer include tutoring the children in remote areas after school, holding some interesting activities in which the physically impaired people can participate like picnics or book groups to boost their confidence, and daily life supplies or small gifts on holidays for the old people. Due to these services, the children can get more education, and the people who are senior or impaired can feel that they are the same as normal people and the society is full of warm because of the care they receive. These services will surely greatly make the whole society more and more stable.
I have participated in an activity which is aimed at teaching the elementary school children in remote ares. Because I am a graduate school student studying law, I think I can make good use of my knowledge to teach those children the intellectual property law. In the course of teaching those children, I learned that "giving is better than receiving." From the happy and content expressions from those children, I realized that all children are unlimited and they are the same. No matter the children from city or countryside, they should have the same opportunity of education and information. I love that work and surely I will join any similar activity in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are more and more the minor who are forgotten by people in this modern society; therefore lots of nonprofit organizations provide a lot of survices to help them get through the hard time.
The most important of their services is to offer financial support for those people who need. For instance, many single parent have to raise children by themselves and in many time they can't afford their children to have class in school due to the parent's low salary, so the organizations will provide money to those family.
Second, some organizations will give medical services to those people living in remote areas in Taiwan. In the areas people have little medical resources to cure diseases; due to the kind of situation some organizations build hospitals to solves the problem. The above are some vital services nonprofit organizations provides.
In this summer, I will go to Indonesia to offer information-teach for the orphans by a program. Though the program is supported by the ministry of education, not a nonprofit organization, I think I can learn lots of things by the program. In the future, I plan to take part in AEISEC, an organization which is run by students themselves in all over the world. They will plan how to help the children in remote area in many countries and exchange their own thoughts to set the better way. For me, it is the best way to do volunteer services by participating this organization.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, volunteers have become crucial rules in Taiwan. Most volunteers are from NGOs, and they provide important services such as humantarian aids which I think the most important one, donations for disaster, and aids for low-developed countries. The services I've mentioned are just a little iceberg that volunteers provide; however, those services have helped millions of people.
I had an experience of being a volunteer in 2008 while I was just a freshman in university. Our mission was going to India for humantarian aids, that mission is the most exhausting but also the most enjoyable expericence. The people living in India are leading a life which you can't imagine. They're living in a lack of water, food but full of natural disasters area. There we had experienced 7 days without food and clean water live, and it was just endurable. But as we saw the smiles of the people, we soon realized that the mission was the most enjoyable one. Therefore, I've determined to be a volunteer, and to help others as possible.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowdays, our world has become a global villiage. With the growth of human populations and the downturns of environmental situations, food shortages occurs and conflicts increases. A pendemic flu which breaks out in one country may lead to more problems in the world. Therefore, we should be aware of this and devote ourselves to be volunteers.
In local areas, nonprofit organizations prepare three meals for the poor, the less unfortune and the disable. They even go to those people's house to clean up frequently. Meanwhile, nonprofit organizations offer recycle service. They recycle old clothes, plastic bottles and paper materials. They hold auctions to sell those recycle products and use the money which they earn from auctions to help more people. For the international cases, when diasters happen in one country, those nonprofit organizations sent food, water, medical service and man power to that place very quickly. They even help to build new homes for those homeless people.
Three years ago, when I pursued my master degree in American, I had been a advocate in an crisis center for eight months. With no professional social worker background, I can't comtact with victems directly. Instead, I helped to translate documents in Chinese. This crisis center helped sexual abuse women and children to escape their bad experiences. They offered emotional and medical support. There were many Chinese people in the area which the center served. Most of time, men were the person who used violent to hurt women and children. My duty was to translate documents in paper and then those female victems can read and realize how American government will help them. Therefore, if they would like to go legal process, they will have more understanding about their rights. I'm sure how many Chinese women ever benefit from my translation papers but I feel so happy to have this experience. Now I am in Taiwan, I will find a job like this and keep going to help more people.

subject: HW0901
content: Being a teacher is the only thing I want to be since I was little, especially teaching the children live in countries. The children live in countrysides do not have as good education as the children live in cities. Many good teachers would rather choose to teach in city schools to have better treatment, so to me, it is great to have this kind of nonprofit organizations, some good teachers may like to be the volunteerers to teach the children in remote areas in their free time, the teachers can provide better teaching mateials or the better ways of learning. And that is also what I want to do in the future. I would offer a full-time, stable job first, then, I would like to be a volunteer tutor to teach the children live in country, or to visit and show my care to the old people who live alone or in hospital, I have done that last summer as a volunteer in a bhudish hospital, the old people seem that they really need somebody to keep them company, and it was a great and meaningful experience to me.

subject: HW0901
content: In modern society, we all can't deny that nonprofit organizations play a vitally important role. These organizations, in my opion, indeed help our society a lot and improve our qualities of lives by countless devotion. The volunteers in nonprofit organizations always devote themselves to providing many admirable, respectable and appreciatitive services to make the world become much more better. For instances, they often go to the remote areas to offer an education opportunities for children lacking of resources, help helpless elders find a safe, warm places to live, establishing shelters for those falling victims to the natural disasters, such as typhoons or earthquakes. As far as I am concerned, it is really hard for me to imagine a world without these important organizations. As a high school senior, although I live a busy, competitive and stressful life, I usually go to the hospital, being a volunteer to help patiences on weekends. It is a blessing for me that I have the ability to spare no efforts to help the people in need. No matter how difficult the volunteer work is, as long as I see the delightful face on people, I will feel satisfied and glad. In the hospital, now and than, I chat with patiences, trying my best to help them forget the tension and stress. Sometimes, I help doctors or nurses to file up the patiences' documents. There are so many things I have done in the hospital. Much to my delight, volunteering in the hospital is a distinct and unforgettable experience, and I am convinced that I will always devote myself to it all the time!

subject: HW0901
content:
Not until recent years have nonprofit organizations been established one after another. Such organizations do a great number of work which the governments are incapable of dealing with.
For one thing, nonprofit organizations enhance the educational system in developing contries. Education is the most effective investment. Only by founding schools and improving teaching equipments and quality can a country cultivate more people with professional knowledge. In this way, the rising ability of competition is benefit to its own development.
For another, centain organizations care a lot about the nature. As factories are founded one after the other, our environment suffers from destruction. Volunteers in such organizations make an effort to promote their ideas that we ought to keep notice of the balance between the economic development and the environment.
From my perspective, I would like to go to areas with poor medical standard to offer my professional medical treatment since looking forward to becoming a doctor in the future. I was so touched by the spirit of members of the Red Cross that I decided to follow their steps.
To sum up, nonprofit organizations play an important role in dealing with issues in every aspects. But for them, many problems would be left unsolved.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are a lot of nonprofit organizations around the world. Each organization has it philosophy and goal. Different organizations concern different issues. Take The Red Cross and Greenpeace for examples.
The Red Cross is an international organization. It has offices in every continent. The Red Cross often provides emergency aid. We can see its volunteers in disaster areas. It is also an organization that concern humanitarian issues, so we can see them in war areas as well.
Greenpeace is definitely a different organization. The members always discuss issues about environment, such as animal protecting, pollutions around the world, etc. The demonstration of protecting whales is one of its famous actions. The goal of Greenpeace is to create an environmentally friendly world.
I am a teenage member of The Red Cross. Since I am still a teenager, I can't go to disaster areas or war areas. Therefore, I serve as a volunteer of a hospital on weekends. I think it is a happy thing to help others. After helping others, I always in a good mood. As a result, I will continue to be a volunteer in a hospital. Perhaps after I grow up, I will go to disaster areas and war areas to help people there.

subject: HW0901
content: Since people knew that government can't really understand what people need, some ambitious people have developed nonprofit organizations to offer help to others. First, they may gather food, clothes and money from others and give these things to those who really need. But in long term, it is not a best idea to give them things without any pay. Some organizations will also help them find jobs to avoid these. Next, other organizations have been developing into a national one, which always keep an eye on international news. Whenever there is a disaster, they will participant in resucing people and giving them a place to live. Except the above, there is still another kind of work they will do. That is persuading government to practice laws to protect our benefits. This is the kind I would like to join in the future because every motion I take will affect everyone, from my family to strangers that are in this country, to get a better and more comfortable quality of life.

subject: HW0901
content:
These days, the government requires many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work. To me, the most impressive service is regarding to teach English for free in remote areas in Taiwan.
When I was in the first grade of high school, I joined a volunteer club because I was willing to help people in need. To the best of my memory, I went to the nursing home once with other club members. During the process, I took care of an old woman who was handicapped and sick seriously. In this period of time, I learned a lot of precious lessons from the voluteer work. Now I'm more satisfied with what I have and cherish anyone around me. Most importantly, it reminds me that nothing can compare with health in the world. In the upcoming, I would like to teach English as a voluteer in remote areas. The reason why I do so is because my passion for teaching English. Finally, I think doing volunteer work is quite rewarding and beneficial experience in my life.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowaday, you can see the advertisement of the nonprofit organization everywhere. They claim to help the poor and they are looking for the volunteers to join them.
These organization provide a various kind of services, such as financial supports for the old men or women who live alone, and also for the kids without money to get education. Some of these volunteers help not only the poors in Taiwan but also in the other poor countries, they provide food and medical treatment with the people in Africa, for instance, stands a good example for the volunteers around the world.
Now, the senior high schools in Taiwan have a good system, namely students should be any type of volunteers for ten hours; otherwise, they can't graduate. Therefore, last month I went to a nonprofit organization to take care of an old men who lives alone, the most important thing I have done is to chat with him, this is what he really need. With this experience, I know there are still lots of people who need our help, but why do we need to help them, that's because we all live under the same roof.

subject: HW0901
content:
When going to a convenient store, you'll see a box intended to collect receipts with the eye to helping people disabled. This is a kind of services that the nonprofit organizations provide. The Red Cross is a nonprofit organization mading great influnces all over the world. The organization is established to help people living in the affected areas or places lack of medical supply. Another famous organization is I-Dien Foundation which is established by Liu-sha. The fundation sells some products such as cards, stamps to raise money for people in need.
I have been a volunteer in a hospital once. When I saw patients, I really felt pity for them. Some old people were sick and couldn't walk. It dawned on me that I was so lucky cause I can run, jump and swim.
Another experience in my life is really unforgettable one. Last summer vacation, my class went to a remote area in Kaohsiung County to teach some children in an elementary school with only sixty students. When we arrived, I was shocked due to the difficiency of the equipment. Later, I found they didn't receive good education and some of them couldn't say A to D accurately. We taught them an English song and some vocabulary like red, blue, circle, etc. After the seven days, we come back to kaohsiung. We couldn't stop thinking about the days with happiness. On the other hand, we were sad on account of the scene we saw. The children were happier than us, but what challenges will they meet after they graduate and start finding works? They certainly won't have the same ability as we have. As a result, they won't be able to compete with others.
My math teacher told me that one should help others if he has ability. There are always people needing our help and we must give them a hand. I believe more and more people agree with me. That's why there is an increasing number of the nonprofit organizations.

subject: HW0901
content:
Well goes the proverb "Love makes the world kind", it is nonprofit organization that enable as to help others and share our love to anyone who need it. The nonprofit organizations provide a variety of servies from medical aid to economic support. Generally speaking the nonprofit organizations's help aim at the sick, the poor, and the disaster area. No matter who needs their help, they will do as best as they can.
As far as I'm concerned, I devote to helping the elder and cleaning our community as my daily volunteer works. Because of the ability of speaking fluency Taiwanese, I am able to chat and to take care of the old people live alone, which make they feel the warm of life. Cleaning our community is the other volunteer works I usually take part in. By doing so, I can not only have a clean place to live in but also do good to the environment.
The nonprofit organizations really play a important role in helping the people who are lack of govenmental help. In future, I would like to go abord to participate the international humanitarion aid.
The more people we help, the more happiness we get. It is the love and compassion that set us apart from other animals. With love there is nothing can't be solved and with the compassion for each other, the human beings are sure to have an more bright future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Most people in Taiwan are not short of food or any other kinds of spirit "food". They could live unwarily. But all they want is more and more. They rarely care about others in help, until they found out that they need help when the economy is worse. That's what I though about people in Taiwan.
In western countries, a lot of people are willing do volunteer work. They adopt children from poor situations. They go abroad to help victims of wars or flood. In Taiwan, there are some massures which lead students to do silimar work, such as tutoring children around neighbor hood, cleaning environment in compus and being volunteers in government offices.
I've tried to registrate the volunteer work in World Game in Kaohsiung. Unfortunately, the training time is not suitable for me. I thought I was lucky enough when I learned that there was a training course in last summer vocation. I registrated and took courses of thirty-six hours. Finally, I just knew that it was a back-up training, and I still didn't get informed to be the coming event voluteer. I don't think I still get the chance. But I am now waiting for another great chance which I registrated a couple days ago to be a voluteer in the zoo.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this modern time, there are really many nonprofit organizations or charity wanting to help more and more people in the world. For example, they raise money from the whole country in order to let the poor children go to school. The volunteers also went to help the countries that were just happen to a tragic disaster. Furthermore, they might visit the lonely old men or orphans on weekend. Although they are many volunteers want to help, it still has lots of victims out there are in need.
In fact, I have a course about servicing the people in need this semester. We have to take care of the old men and women, and interact with them. Sometimes we sing song to them or play some easy games, like doing some gesture or drawing pictures. I think the happiness of helping someone is hard to explain, because the smile from their face is real from their hearts. Frankly, they don' want much, they just need someone will understand them and listen to them, so just put yourself in their shoes. If there is any chance I could join the volunteer team, I won't refuse in no doubt.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many kinds of volunteering services from many types of organization, including medicine, charity, education...etc. Take the Red Cross organization for example. They offer emergency help when somewhere happens earthquake or war. In Taiwan, the organization not only train a group of swimming rescuer but also provide some money for those who don't have enough money to study.
In my own experience, I enjoy doing volunteer work. I have once been a volunteer in a small hospital and a animal hospital. In hospital, my work is to help the old eating and talk to them. I learned how to take care of elders and to communicate with them. In addition, my work in animal hospital is to clean animal's rump, cut dog's hair and clean their body. Also, I have assisted an emergency operation with a vet. From this special experience, I learned a lesson: "Animals won't attack someone who help curing them".
Actually, I got admission to the department of medicine. I really want to be a international clinic doctor join the "Doctor without borders" (also called MSF) organization. In the future, I will offer medical services in remote or poor country.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, our society is filled with poor families, helpless people, homeless children and so on. They need the warm from us, to help them live in a better life as we do. Therefore, some organizations recruit volunteers to help these poor people. They gives hands to people who have no work help they find the jobs, they help homeless children find another families, they help children who didn't educated to enter the school, they do lots of works to the someone who really need help, and they always do the works for free but full of love. When I was in senior high school, I volunteered a work to help homeless children find the new families. In the process, I dropped my tears many times. Not because of the hard work, it was the happiness when the children find the families who really wants to adopt them. I deeply feel that, though we don't have lots of money, we still can do things to the one who really needs help. In the future, I will continue to volunteer many works to help others and broaden my horizon.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays nonprofit organizations have expanded worldwide to give aid s to those in need. In Taiwan, there are some important services provided by some of these organizations, such as Tse Ji (), World Hope (), etc. Owing to the expansion of volunteer work, I also participate in these activities during my college life. Because there are quite a few people who are in need, nonprofit organizations are requested to be existed.
First, Tse Ji have provided many services, such as clothes and food donation to those in need. The establisher of Tse Ji also encourage us to take heart even if there are many difficulties.
Second, World Hope Organization's well-known service is the activity called Poor 30. Many people gather together and don't eat anything within 30 minutes.
As for me, I've tutored impoverished children to make them progress in their schoolwork. Furthermore, I've spent two months classifying books in the library. These volunteer works really involve me to do over and over in the future, such as tutoring orphans. Since I'm keen to teach them who are fairly earest but poor.

subject: HW0901
content:
Many nonprofit organizations are developing in these days, there are news on TV every day. Some important services which are provided by these groups are helping the poors and the regions after natural disasters. They use the money dominated worldwide and by sending their volunteers to give a hand.
I've been a young scout since I'm a junior, we used to go to some remote commuity in the mountains and helped them build their houses. We sometimes go to hosipital and care about the childs who are sick.
In the future, I would like to be a volunteers of one of these organizations, and give the full I have to make the world better.

subject: HW0901
content: In my opinion, I think that volunteer for the nonprofit organizations are perfect activities to kill time because it is like doing charities. It is not only a happy thing to do but also helps lot of poor people. However, if I have enough time, I would donate my time to those nonprofit organizations. For me, I think that people should give up some of their time and become volunteers because the more volunteers there are the better the world will be. Also the volunteers not only tutor the kids or running refugee camps but also go on the streets with a donation box asking pedestrians to donate money or receipt in order to gain money to the poor. I think it is a kind thing to do. Since I don't have much time to be a volunteer, I will try my best to be one in the future. By that day, I will go to the orphanages and help those poor orphans, and this is one of my dreams!

subject: HW0901
content:
In nowarday, volunteer work and the nonprofit organizations make the world better -- sometimes their effort is even more powerful and efficient than the government's. nonprofit organizations like Doctors Without Bordline help people all over the world, especially some who are in the poorest countries and have no proper medicial care.
And WWF, for example, protects those animals which can't even voice for themselves. Because of their hardwork, many have got their chances to keep alive.
And since I learned the meaningful work of these volunteers, I made up my mind to join it. Last year my mother, a babysitter, led me to the association of family careness and assistance. There we took care of children who were the victums of family violence or were poor at learning due to their single-parent background. We helped them do their homework or taught them English or Taiwanese songs, and had a great time there. These may be just little things, but I think it's somehow meaningful and important for me. I will keep doing it and hope one day I can help more people.

subject: HW0901
content: During the 911 horror attacks in America, tsunami in south Asia, earthquake in our hometown Taiwan, you saw some people wear face masks and gloves standing on the collapses destroyed by disters searching for the survivors; through the televison. Who are they? They are volunteers which come from the nonprofit organizations. In such organizations, it offer daily suppliments and meditation cares to the developing countries, searching motions for the disaster-damaged area. Those volunteers always stand on the first line to help the victims and stay in the last. It is these voluters of the nonprofit organizations that make the world full of love and hope. If I have a chance to join the organization to become a voluteer, I will like to help those children in remote area of Taiwan. I can teach them how to write, how to speak, how to draw and how to live. These children are born to be loved instead to suffer from such tragedies like food shortage or resources of education shortage. I deeply believe that these tiny actions will make the children understood a true goal -- Hopeless doesn't exist in the world.

subject: HW0901
content:
NGOs and NPOs are prevailed in Taiwan nowadays because people are more selfless. It's an opportunity to strengthen our mind and learn how to take care of others.
The easy way to get closer to others is through help. Help is the key to establish a harmonious global village. For example: former AP of U.S.A Clinton talked about "interdepedence", Barack Obama tell Americans to be one, Luther King said, "everyone is equal". They should hand side by side. So, it's good to help others.
NPOs provide all kinds of services to improve progress and relief misery. As I know, aid funds to help children in poor countries to make dreams come true, provide lunches for school students, take care of them after school hours, teach them to read, to learn and to behave themselves...and so on.
It's a good thing to help others even we don't know because it's a beacon of excellence for humanity. These are a few things that we can not skip out in our life time. I have made some volunteer works when I was free. Such as calling students who are always alone at home, visiting the olds in Taiwan who live alone, bringing children (students) to visit some places where are worthy of visiting; superioring classes when students study by their own; cleansing the surroundings of my community...and so on. If I have more time of freedom, I will keep doing volunteer works because them make me happy even they are hard work. I'm planning to join volunteer camp when I retire. I want to go to remote area to teach children. Cutivating their souls, in order to devote myself to virtue. It's clear to see that volunteer work is a mission of mankind.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are plenty of nonprofit organizations working in Taiwan nowadays. You can see them almost everywhere, providing aids to people in need. In fact, they do not only appear in Taiwan, but throughout the world, scattering the messages of love to folks.
Some important services provided by nonprofit organizations include rescue, food aid, fund raising, and organ donations. First, when natural disasters or wars occur, organizations such as Red Cross will send crews with fundamental medical resources to the frontline to rescue civilians and bring them to safer places. Later, refugee camps will be built and necessities will be flowing from other countries' charity organizations. Before the truse, the organizations play an important role -- the manager of refugees. Their duties are educating children, soothing the elderly and ensuring everyone's safety. Second, in places without sufficient crops, the organizations will also help them. However, they do not only send food to them, but also teach them the technique to develop agriculture so they can become independent on feeding themselves. Third, to support orphans and refugees, charities will raise fund from people, which we mostly see on the streets. Fourth, to cure cancer patients, nonprofit organizations will also collaborate hospitals to help patients find appropriate organs for them. Information will be sent worldwide to ask for medical tests. With our love, these services have saved over thousands of people.
I was deeply inspired by nonprofit organizations' spirit, so I would like to do something for our planet. I would be an volunteer to clean the coastlines in that the garbage and toxic waste have polluted the marine ecosystem, causing some marine species extincted from the earth. With the help from nonprofit organizations, the world has become better than before.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, it become a trend for nonprofit organizations to recruit volunteers around the world to help people in need. To help these people who are in suffering, these nonprofit organizations not only supply food but also help the natives buit school to insure they would have a proper education. In my point of view, I agree the idea of building school in developing countries. Obviously, when people get more knowledge about something, they would have an ability to ponder what makes their country in such bad circumstances. Then, they would intend to change these bad circumstances and lead their country to be prosperous one day.
When it comes to volunteer work, I'm going to work as a volunteer in World Game 2009 in KH. It's my pleasure to be a member of this international event. Also, I'm firmly conviced that it's a right thing to do as an volunteer. All volunteers in the World Game with the hope that people around the world would know much more things about Taiwan through this international event and the event will go smoothly then.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the warm and lovely society, we can always see people care about this world and like to do something better to help with other whom involved in the poor life condition. Their kindness help sometimes takes without any benefit and might to collect to be a group, that is, we called nonprofit organizations.
The nonprofit organization might include different field of people, and everybody cares to devote their love and act to improve some remote areas. The services include donating money or clothes, teaching less-educated children, giving medical helpness, and etc.
Seeing these moving examples really affects me a lot, I believe I would also like to help with others. In deed, I had tutoring a student to strengthen her English oral speaking. Although this is no profit, I realize the most important is the spirit I desire to give and help, but not how much money that I earn. Helping somebody makes me feel I can also change and affect the others. This experience keeps me a good memory and wants to do more in the near future. I would and I believe.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations play an important role in nowadays society. They provide many services that are needed. For instance, they recruit volunteers to teach children in remote areas. The resource in these areas is not sufficient even poor. The phenomenon cause a terrible influence to the children's future. The help of nonprofit organizations can avoid it happens from generation to generation. These organizations also provide some medical care for those sicked elders. These elders get sick and feel lonely because their children don't live with them or even abandon them. They need not only medical care but also accompany. Nonprofit organizations provide safe shelter for them.
I would like to offer some good services about taking care of elders. When I see those lonely and sorrowful elders, I would remind my grandfather, who has been dead for five years. subject: HW0901
content:
Needless to say, the member of nonprofit organizations has a kind heart not only to the poor but also to the mother nature. An organization like the Red Cross will provide emergency medical aid, wherever it is needed and whoever needs it. They help people in Africa to escape from famine as well as do sanitary work for them, so that the diseases won't spread away that fast. Adding to that, they also raise money for the refugee and the poor children, so that they can go to school and expand their horizons. On the other hand, some organizations give a helping hand to the nature. They help expand the area of forest and are against the deforestation.
As for me, I plan to go to the east of Taiwan after I graduate from senior high school. I want to help the children there not only by raising money but also by tutoring them. In my opinion, what I have learned is not only for my own success, but also for others. After all, helping others who are really in need is the source of true happiness, isn't it? In addition, it can release me from stress and enrich my spiritual life. Let's work together to make the world a well-being family.

subject: HW0901
content:
Speaking of nonprofit organizations, people must come up a number of well-known organizations. Love Life, which is founded by a celebrity, is a new organization to help people whose life are too depressed to live. I totally agree everyone must have to take part in an nonprofit organizations. To sum up, do not look down yourselves power. We should help anyone although we do not join any nonprofit organization. To give is more splendor than to receive, doesn't it?

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have boomed in recent decades. Though their goals might be a bit different from one to one, they all organize volunteers to reach out for those in need. Some nonprofit organizations may focus on medical aid and supplies in countries that are torn by wars or suffering from natural disasters, such as the Red Cross or the MSF, while others may concern the problems of children in developing nations, such as the World Vision that provides medical care, food supplies and education for the children in need.
I would like to become a full-time volunteer after retirement. I hope I can join the Red Cross and do my best to aid those who are suffering. I have been concerned about the issue of wars and starvation in Africa for several years. Everytime I watch the news about those topics, I always feel pain for the refugees that are being starved and torn. Therefore, I set the goal in mind and I will pursue it in the future.
An old saying goes that "To give is better than to receive." I definitely agree with that. Volunteer work can teach us many life lessons and help us learn what is the most important thing in our lives. I hope there will be more and more people participating in volunteer work.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan. These services which are provided by such organizations are really helpful and they are also necessary. The statistics show that some children are not able to have good learning environment they should have had due to the financial difficulties, especially those who live in the remote areas, therefore it would be a great help if there are any volunteers willing to go to those areas to tutor those children. Speaking of children, I love children, they are angels. Mother Teresa had ever said, "Kids belong to everyone." So if I have the chance to participate in the volunteer work in the future, the child care will be what I am to step my feet in.

subject: HW0901
content:
Due to the high technologe, it seems that, for most people, full eating and easy life are normal. However, there are still some people who can't lead their life as their wish. For example, children who live in remote areas so that they can't get enough information and things to expand their knowledge.
It's helpful that we have some organizations that are willing to offer assistances to these children. In my opinion, children who live far from the city are lack of computers, which are available easily in city, and we can provide them with computers and teach them how to get more information they need online. Furthermore, the volunteers can take the children to some cities to visit some exhibitions so that they can have more experiences that are different from theirs in their eara.
Life is like a coin: you can spend it in any way you wish, but you can only spend it once. As for me, I'd like to spend my life to help people as well as I can. I'm willing to go to these remote earas to teach children English and Franch. I'll do my best to show them how interesting learning language is and increase their motivation to learn it happily. Hopefully, I'd like to do it with my family and my friends. I hope that they also can have the same joy to help these children.

subject: HW0901
content: Buddish groups in Taiwan give me an unforgetable empression. They hold camps and activites for children every year. Also, after the destroying from natural disasters, volunteers deliver the necessaties as fast as they can to the poors. I want to be a volunteer in children's camp.
