subject: HW0901
content:
In the past, we probably were not willing to do the voluntary works because we couldn't get any payment. However, things have been changed in the recent years that more and more people start to respect their spiritual lives instead of the profitable, superficial ones.
There are lots of voluntary organizations provided to people to join in. The most common ones are to help the poor, the sick, or the young. Volunteers would visit their houses and their families to understand their living environments and difficulties, and give them amount of money or something they have to use everyday. Besides, they also help those people or their families find a job so that they can make a living by themselves.
I'm looking forward to being a volunteer in children-helping organization. If I were a volunteer, I could teach those children and play with them. I would look them just as my own younger brothers or sisters. I think childhood is the most initial part during the human life, I want each child having a good childhood and memory.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there have been many organizations established to help those who need helps. For instance, the Tsu-Zi () foundation is well-known for its philanthropy in Taiwan. Based on the buddist backgrounds, the members in the foundation are all volunteers, and they raise money for those who are in poor or disabled. In addition, they even visit the poor family and give those family some necessary things in life. Furthermore, they may volunteer to take care of the elders and the disable with no family accompanied. To my awesome, they established an university and hospitals to educate and help people. It is adorable for them to devote them to charities in Taiwan.
As for me, I have been a volunteer in the hospital. During volunteering, I helped patients who need helps. I directed them a right way to do examinations, and I sent them to the residency. Although the works I have done seem so simple, however, I learn a lot of things in that time. I learn how to serve patients better and I appreciat the hardship of medical people. I think the experience is the most valuable and unforgettable that I have ever had. Maybe, in the future, I will be a volunteer overseas to help those who need more helps.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are lots of nonprofit organizations all over the world. They provide many services to help people. Some of them recruit volunteers to protect the environment. They also raise and hold flea markets for someone who need help. There are still some organizations educate students by making speeches. When a hizzard such as earthquake happens, no matter how far it is, the organizations go there to save people and run refugee camps.
Because I will study medicine in college, I would like to join the International Doctor Organization after I finish my intern time. I will use what I learn to save people, especially, by my hands. I will help them overcome the diseases and ease their pain. What's more, I will not only ease their bodies' pain but also the pain in their mind. I will be a volunteer in remote areas in Taiwan or other developing countries.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, there are many nonprofit organizations which make our world a better world. Some of them care about environmental issues, they remind the public of the importance of recycling amd not producing so much garbage. Some of them care about human rights, they help homeless people, the elderly, women or children tortured by violence to gain justice. And even some of the nonprofit organizations care about stray animals. No matter what kind of work do they engage in, they just want to help others without getting any fame or wealth.
During high school, I attended a volunteer club. We recycled the garbage in our school, kept some homeless dogs and treated them reall well, and we often went to some nusing homes to take care of the elderly. Every person in the club got the quality of love. It was great to be with those people and I got a lot of valuable experiences in the volunteer club that I will never forget. Needless to say, I would like to do more volunteer work in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, the numbers of nonprofit organizations are growing. In the mean time, they require more people to be the volunteers to help others. Anyone would be welcomed to join those organizations if he/she is glad to offer some help.
I think nonprofit organization take an important role in our society. In Taiwan, many people lead comfortable lives, but there are still some people can't afford their lives. Some families can't pay tuition for their kids or have no money to buy food. Also, in some of developing countries, people don't even have places to stay or have troubles to maintain their lives. They all need help. Many nonprofit organizations are offering their help to the poor.
They have volunteers to get donation from people. They use the money to pay for poor kids' tuition and their lunch. They collect people's old clothing. After cleaning, the clothing can be worn by people who need. Not mention, they help to build refugee camps in developing countries. As I can do, I donated the clothes to orphens.
Once I helped a poor kid with learning some English for a year. I don't have much time now, but I still do my best to donate some money to help those people who really need our help. In the future, I'll teach my kids to help others and be good volunteers.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, with the growing of the nonprofit organizations and voluntary groups rising up, more and more isolated and remote areas have received some help from every corners around the world. What they majorly provided include medical service, enough food, clean water and some basic facilities such as the use of electricity to make their lifes better. Teaching people how to grow agriculture is equally the important part of it so that they can raise themselves without worried and hungry.
As far as I'm concerned, I've been to a shelter for volunteer work once to play with the children who were homelsss or hopeless, reading books and singing along with them. Besides, I've ever gone to a village to visit every old people to give them warm-clothing and foods in winter.
After these experiences that I've gone through, I truly realized the importance of sending our loves and giving helps to others. And, the more you give, the more you'll get.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, women have better education than before so they can have jobs and economical independance. With economical independence, some women would rather choose not to marry, but this has cause a lot of men can't marry, and turn to marry foreigner from poor countries such as Vietnan, Thailand and etc. However, the children born by those families can't get a good education.

If I have time in the future, I would like to join the organization offering free education to people. By doing so, I can help people; learn something from teaching, and do some contribution to our societies.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are plenty of nonprofit organizations around the world nowadays. They all do many meaningful jobs to help the world as well as the poor.

Often in Africa, they establish refugee camps for those who suffer from civil wars, and they also distribute clothes, foods as well as toys to the residents. subject: HW0901
content:
There are more and more nonprofit organizations all over the world; they recruit volunteers to help with their work. Those organizations provides many services to help people who are in need. They usually go to remote areas to provide some resources, such as food, clothing, and learning resources. In addition, some organizations will go to Africa or other developing countries. They provide medicial resources and find ways to improve their living environment.
Although I have not done these kind of volunteer works, I still hope that I can do it in the future. In my opinion, helping people who are in need is a satisified thing. By educating those people, they may have abilities to change their lives. What's more, I also want to induce medical resources. People should be treated equally on earth. All we have to do is take seriously attitude to solve those problems. And we can support those problems. And we can support those nonprofit organizations, doing more volunteer works in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In the past decades, the life pace for modern people has becoming faster and faster. It is said that people are becoming busier, and more selfish. Fortunately, there are still people who care about others and volunteer to help people in need. They also fund lots of nonprofit organizations and recruit more volunteers to take care of people in need. These organizations, including International Red Cross, religious groups, turn their charity into actions. Also, their important services are provided not only in Taiwan, but also for the people in need in other countries.
No one will deny that when natural disaster happens, nonprofit groups always do the best to try help the refugees as soon as possible. They provide food, clean water, temporary houses, and medical services. They do these out of their wills, not out of duty. This is the humanity. Other good things they have alway been doing also including tutoring children in remote areas, helping the elderly and taking care of them.
Doing charity does mean that you have to do it all by yourself. These nonprofit groups also welcome people to donate money. By using the money, these groups can not help the people in Taiwan, but also the people in other country. For example, there are lots of kids in Africa suffering from diseases and hungry, not to mention to have a dream to go study. Thanks for these nonprofit groups, the conditions of these children have been getting better because of the help of nonprofit groups from all over the world.
Last, if I have a chance to be a volunteer in a nonprofit group, I'd like devote myself to tutor children in remot areas. I majored in Education during my college time, therefore, I believe education have the most profound impact on a person. I will also teach the children I meet in the future to care about others and contribute themselves to the society.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are a lot of non-profit organizations in Taiwan these days, they provide all kind of service, such as providing foods to the poor, giving money to the family who is in emergency, tutoring children in remote area..etc.
Why these people doing these thing in volunteer? I say is because the good of humanity, it's the sprit that helping the poor and the weak, and it is very happy to see people taking their aid. And some service, like tutoring children in remote area, can change our society. By giving these children better education than before, they can have more chance, giving everyone a better future.
But all of these service require an important thing, volunteers. It is the major building blocks of every non-profit organizations. Because these people spend their time and passtion on these service, other can have a better life. I am a volunteer, too. I tutoring children who can't afford cram schools. I choose this job because I used to help teaching in cram schools. Also, I recycle my old cloth about once a year. By recycle old cloth, we can help poor people by giving them these clean old cloth. Being a volunteer is a happy thing, because you know what you are doing can create a better tomorrow.

subject: HW0901
content:
The main purposes of different kinds of nonprofit organizations all boil down to handling the proplems that can't be solved only by the government. Fighting for animal rights, helping disabled children live independently, protecting Mother Nature are some important and common services provided by such organizations.
Last year, my classmate and I held a English learning camp for kids who live in mountains and have no proper English education provided in their school. During the camp, I realized that those children are basically the feature of our country, and there's no way they should be treated unfairly because of some unresistable reasons, such as poor financial conditions. It goes without saying that we cannot be too careful with the education we provided to our future leaders.
In the future, I'll keep putting my heart in social problems like this and participating volunteer work that help against the unfair education conditions some children are faced with. I really hope more and more attention can be drawn by our efforts. Their right should never be neglected and we should help them to fight for it.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, more and more nonprofit organizations have been run in our society. As the student of Fujen University, I'm proud to say we have this kind of organization in our own. Not only the children in Taiwan but also those overseas have we provided our services.
Actually, last summer I applied to teach some kids living far away from city. In my oppinion, they were the children who were eager to study, but had too poor environment to do so. Therefore, I was glad that I could teach them and got along with such hard-working and cute children. In the future, I would like to do so overseas. After all, there are still so many people needing some help.
In my view, with the developing of the society, more and more people only care about themselves. Nonetheless, these nonprofit organizations provide their money, services, and help with no reward. That's the reason I would like to join them to be a volunteer with no hestate. Undoubtedly, it takes lots of my free time and I'm always busy working on this. However, I believe that giving is better than receiving.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nonprofit organizations have risen to provide aid for people in need around the world in recent years. These organizations can be big, such as The World Vision Organization or the Red Cross. They raise funds and food from developed countries and send the supply to poor countries, mostly in Africa. In addition, they look for physicians willing to join the volunteering team and caring about those who's suffering from diseases.
However, nonprofit organizations can exist just between you and me. Usually, those groups of people care about certain groups of powerless people in the society. For example, some organizations care about the rights of women, children, or even prisoners, and they oversee the government whether its policy will damage the benefits of the inferior people or not. But no matter how the size of organization is, they have the same main idea -- we're working for people, not profits.
In the busy periods of school life, I'm afraid I have few opportunities to join the activities held by these organizations. But I do hope to offer help if I have the ability and time. I would like to visit the elderly in the nursing home, or even use my professional knowledge to solve some problems in the society. I think I can start on a smaller area first so that I'll have more experiences if I join the bigger activities in the future. I believe with my one little help, there's always a positive influence, no matter how big it is.

subject: HW0901
content:
Today's nonprofit organizations have already contributed several services to help the provety; in fact, this is happened not only in Taiwan but all over the world.
There are several important services that are be done, such as, building schools and hospitals for the refugees and orphans. Moreover, if some rural areas are destroyed by the natural disasters, like flood and drought. They are capable to provide some aids to help them rebuild their homes as well. However, I believe that every Taiwanese, nowadays, should still remember one of the most serious disaster that has ever happened, which is the 921 earthquake, that caused a vast number of families and homes are destroyed. Due to this, there are lots of orphans who can not afford themselves to complete their education. Thus, if I have any chance to be a volunteer, I would devote my love to those kids to teach them English or even other subjects that be needed. At least, helping them have abilities to find jobs to raise themselves in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
Nowadays, nonprofit organizations have grown bigger in three ways: free lunch at school, collecting second-hand books or toys for children from poor families, and providing free medical care.
Recently, the government is promoting a project which is about free lunch for all elementary school students. However, some nonprofit organizations have already started it. They give those who are qualified free lunch at school. These organizations not only help people but also gain good reputation for themselves by doing this.
Besides, as far as I know, some organizations are also collecting used books or toys for those who can't afford it. Although those books and toys are not brandnew, children are still glad to have them which they have longed for for a long time.
Furthermore, some nonprofit organizations also provide free medical care in some hospitals. People who are over a certain age or aren't able to pay their medical fees can get the welfare subsidies and services from these organizations. The most common one is the service of physical examination.
I haven't deserved the above three services from those nonprofit organizations, nor do I need them. However, if I had a chance to be a volunteer, I would be an English teacher to tutor those who are interested in English but don't have a chance to learn it. I think that would be a rewardable job and I will enjoy it.

subject: HW0901
content:
There are many nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help people in need. As I know, there are three organizations I have heard or involved. The first one is World Vision, which is an international nonprofit organization, tries to help the poor people of the undeveloped country to get food and financial support. The second one is Rainbow organization, which works to help the teenagers in remote areas to be tutored freely. The last one is the World Peace organization which is dedicated to help the children in poverty by offering free breakfast for a whole year.
Although I have never joined the Hunger 30 Camp held by World vision, but I have ever watched the video provided by them to describe the miserable situation in some countries, and I have donated some money to help the work.
In some campuses, there are many children go to school without having breakfast, so the vision of World Peace is "to feed your neighbors", and it is practical and helpful to the children among us. Though I never really involve in this charity, I hope it can continue as long as any children need to feed.
I was once a volunteer of Rainbow foundation when I was a sophomore. I was sent to a remote village in Ping-Don County to tutor fifty grade school children in summer vacation for two months with another twenty volunteers.
We taught them English and held an English camp at the end of the vacation. We were deeply in love with the wonder scenery and because good friends with the co-workers and the native children.
Even after years, the satisfied and innocent smiles of the students are still in my mind, and I can heartily say "Giving is better than receiving." So, I hope to be a nonprofit organization volunteer in my future life as long as possible.

subject: HW0901
content:
In this issue I would contend that lots of these nonprofit organizations have devote themselves helping improving the society in Taiwan and ask for no return but the attention of everyone to some isolated childen and family. Some of these organization focus on helping and taking care of vegetable people and poor families. They hire volunteers to serve the vegetable people such as taking shower, switching their clothes, massaging them. These poor people lost their basic ability to take care of themselves. Besides, lots of families are facing lack of financial support and lots of childen can not even deserve their lunch in school or even their tuition. Since the government cannot help them properly. these kind of organization will take action raising the money for them. What they have done have greatly improve all of the country.
I used to join one of these organization as a volunteer to serve the vegetable people in the hospital. By taking care of them, I realized how lucky I am to have a healthy body. Since I am able to help people I should appreciate this and do the best I can to serve my loved ones even the whole society.
By way of conclution, I want to reaffirm my position of supporting non-profit organization. Without them, the society will turn to another chaos that we would never know.

subject: HW0901
content: Although the civilization has been highly developed so far, there are still some problems to solve. Most people in some countries live a high quality life, while others live in poverty and hunger. So those nonprofit organizations have tried their best to give those in need a hand. The international organizations supply food to victims of natural disasters and provide refugees with short-term shelters during the period of war. They also offer free medical aids to the injuries and doctors in volunteer go to remote areas to give patients proper treatments. Some organizations even help the local residents with their poor agricultural skills, teaching them the efficient and effective ways to raise crops. They give out all what they can provide, raising money for developing countries. As for me, I would like to join at least one of the organizations to help those people in need. If I could become a teacher, I would like to tutor children in distant areas in Taiwan first. Give those children such as aboriginals sufficient instructions and education. And I also want to go to different countries in Africa or South America to take care of the victims. We should support these meaningful activities in order to make a better world.

subject: HW0901
content:
In those days, several nonprofit organizations recruit volunteers to help with their work to contribute to the society. They have done many things to assist those who are in need all over the world.
To begin with. Some of nonprofit organizations hold the donation activities to gather used stuff such as books, clothes, shoes and other daily products to make those resources be reused and then take advantage of these material to give people in poverty. Besides, other nonprofit organizations take the environmental issues seriously. They buy some abanded lands in remote areas to keep them intact instead of being destroyed or developed by businessmen. Moreover, some of this organizations provide citizens with free courses to educate them on positive concepts.
To me, I have been a tutor to teach children in poor family who are not able to go to cram schools. I am interested in this work and I feel satisfied when those kids do well at their schoolwork. Although those nonprofit organizations have finished several things, to live in a better life, there are a lot left for us to do. It would be, by no means, only the job of the government or the nonprofit organizations, but everyone's duty.

subject: HW0901
content:
The main purpose of these nonprofit organizations is trying their best to help anyone needs their helps. They provide almost any kinds of surports, such as foods, protecting, even educations. subject: HW0901
content:

Such organizations donate money or assist in handling their problems, furthermore, giving them comfort and helping those in need get through the difficulties. Those who work for nonprofit organizations inspire me to be more willing to do this sort of work in the future, such as helping the disabled find a job or give them support when they are down.

subject: HW0901
content: There are various activities hold by nonprofit organizations in the purpose of help those people in need, such as raising money, blood donation1, free medical treatment, and rescue tasks, etc. In my views, there are advantages and disadvantages toward these activities. Helping people in need should be performed by each person when he or she see someone who needs help, this does not necessarilly execuite only by certain nonprofit organizations, although by organized groups could do better jobs in many ways. subject: HW0901
content:
All the nonprofit organizations established for almost the same purpose: to help those who are in need. Those volunteers in the nonprofit organizations care not only themselves or their countries but also the whole world. They're willing to go to remote areas to teach poor children whose families cannot afford the tuitions; they run refugee camps to accommodate people in need; they take good care of those lonely elder people who have no child or even being abandoned by their children; they bring food to those developing countries; they teach those who suffer from starving to grow plants, vegetables, wheat or rice...These are just some easy things they've done for our society, and even for our world. They show their great love when there is a disaster. They risk their lives to save people who suffer from earthquakes, tsunami, and even wars.
I hope one day I can be one of those volunteers in a nonprofit organization. I'd like to show my sympathy and love for those who are in need. I want to teach children and keep the elder people accompany. I also want to rescue those who suffer from disasters. I'm willing to listen to their needs and do whatever I can to help them. I can only donate some money to those nonprofit organizations now, but I'll be one of those who show their sympathy, humanity and great love in the future.

subject: HW0901
content:
In today's prosperous and rich society, everyone leads a joyful life. However, there are some minorities waiting people to lend them a helping hand. So, nonprofit organizations take the responsibility to rescue them. First, when a typhoon rages in Taiwan, some areas flooded and some has out of electricity. Without water, food and electricity, residents face tough hardships and have no idea how to solve problems. Nonprofit organizations will send groceries to the inhabitants in need. Also, when a earthquake strokes Taiwan, these organizations will offer tents to the people whose houses were destroyed. In some developing countries, they provide the people with medical care, food, clothes.......to help them live more smoothly.
I have done some volunteer work in my high school. In weekdays, my members and I are responsible for the environmental cleaning of surroundings in campus. For instance, sweep the leaves, mop the floor, paint the wall white and etc. But in the weekends, we clean up the neighborhoods near our school, pick up the trash besides beaches, maintain the clear, natural environments of streams and rivers. In the future, I would like to volunteer in hospitals because I am a kind-hearted person and I am willing to help patients and their family members overcome their problems. Also, I can chat with them and encourage them to look on the bright side. I think it's my essential duty of volunteering.

subject: HW0901
content:

These organizations are all for free. They provide services such as dedicating themselves to help the ill in developing countries, donating supplements to the poor, devoting themselves to tutor the children in remote areas and so on. They do great things making the world better, and I've always wanted to be one of them.
As for myself, I'm also a member of a nonprofit organization in my school. We do lots of things in order to turn our city into a better one. We always sweep the sidewalk at about six o'clock every weekend, after doing this, we visit lonely old men who don't have children or was abandoned by their children. We help them clean the surroundings, chat with them and keep them company. I always feel happy to be a volunteer to help people who are in need, because I can help changing the world little by little.
All in all, I hope the world can become a better living place, and I believe the world will be full of love if everyone participates in volunteering jobs.

subject: HW0901
content: Nowadays, nonprofit organizations recuit volunteers to help with their work, such as tutoring children in remote areas in Taiwan, or running refugee camps in developing countries. subject: HW0901
content:
The number of nonprofit organizations is growing rapidly now. I always see this kind of organization trying hard to give a better standard of life to people who live in developing countries on the TV news.

subject: HW1001
content:
Physical punishment has been a hot issue recently in Taiwan. Some teachers believe that punishment is a useful way to control students' behavior and motivate them to learn. As for me, I am totally disagree with their oppinions.
Whether physical punishment or other kinds of punishments could be dangerous if the teacher use it in a wrong way. For instence, the punishment could be too harsh if the teacher is happend to be extremely angry. Secondly, punishment itself would make students refuse to learn. Some of the students even be dismissed from school and become gangsters or thievs, which cause more social problems. By the way, teachers who use punishment as a way to control their students creat a serious atomosphere in their classroom. Student can't enjoy learning and they feel that they are forced to receive those knowledge. Most of time, these students won't continue learning after school, and they are tend to be shy and they are not capable of expressing their opinion properly.
On the contrast, rewarding students for learning can lead to better results. School is a place that allow students to make mistakes. According to the research, praising the children for the good things they did is the best way to prevent them from doing bad things. For example, when I was in junior high school, my teacher bought me a book because the grade I got was the best in my class. Since then, I studied even harder for that subject. The book is still with me now. I regard it as a motivation for me to keep going in my life.
To sum up, if teachers are willing to spend their time and teach students with love, the student will appreciate it and try their best to fulfill the teachers' expectation. It is how it should work at school.

subject: HW1001
content:
As far as I am concerned, violence has become useless when it comes to education nowadays. In our democratic society, we put emphasis on the education of all kinds of rights people were born with. Thus, the children don't want to obey the elders' order blindly. They now have their own thoughts that should be respected.
There was once a movie about a priest that made up his mind to educate those mischievous children who had already been given up by their parents. While other teachers were still punishing their students with sticks, he decided to move those children with the love he expressed. His life-long mortal, "spare the rod and melt the rock," helped him fulfilled his dream. Those children not only grew into promising young men, but also became world-renowned musicians. This was a proof that students can still be educated without punishment.
To sum up, I would like to indicate that punishing is not the only way to cultivate one's ability. Determination, love and enthucism from educators also have the same effect.

subject: HW1001
content:
Use punishment to motivate students are not good for students to grown up. They will live in a world with fear, and always think about what they did is wrong or right, they can't make their own decision.
Rewarding students is better then punishing. When the students do the right thing, teachers should encourage them, and give them more advises, this can motivate students to do better in the futur.
It's better rewarding and punishing in the same time. If you always rewarding, students may think they are perfect, they might go to the wrong direction, so sometimes we need to give the a little bit punishment to control their behavior.
When I was a child, I used to study in France for 3 years. The first year I really got upsad as my notes always in the bottom. But my teacher, she always encourage me, and gave me extra lesson for free. This make me study hard, as I want to let her to be proud.
So rewarding students learning can lead to better results.

subject: HW1001
content:
"Sixty! What a bad score! Come here, come here and stand besides the black board! You stupid little girl!" Every time the girl got her exam paper, she was really afraid of what would happen next. Her mother died when she was six. She felt so helpless during her first day of school, just like the end of the world.
During her elementary school days, all teachers dislike her due to her bad performances on tests. The worst thing was that she always got punishments when she failed on the exams. She hate to go to school and she hate teachers. The girl told herself that she was a useless person. However, when she got into junior high school, she met her teacher, a person who changed her life. The teacher always encouraged the girl whether she did bad on test or not. She always smiled to the girl and concerned about her life. Finally, the girl found her value of life and the confidence of herself! Three years later, she got into the best high school. Her life was totally changed!
I am that girl, and I really think that education should not use punishment. Education is about love. You have to concern your students with love. Punishments can make things worse. But reward can make a big difference to you students.

subject: HW1001
content:
Nowadays, teachers tend to reward students rather than punish students to motivate them to improve their acedemic performances. However, I think giving appropriate punishment is crucial to any educator.
Fortunately, I experienced both kinds of teachers in my student career, so I can clearly tell you the diferences.
First, I would like to talk about the "friendly" teacher. He gives us a luxorous meal of Burgerking whenever we made a step forward in the mothly exam. One day, the teacher told the class that due to some private problems, he had to move away. Receiving the shocking news, all of a sudden, everyone seemed to lost the power of moving forward and then everything was back to normal, goods are still goods, bads became worse.
Let's talk about the "mean" teacher. He made us copy questions that we made mistakes on for three times on a paper. I have to say, I really hate him by then, but days over, I found out that the corrections I made actually became a seal that sets upon my heart, and I never did the same mistake again. This really gave me the thought of punishment is the most efficient way to push ourselves forward.
Afterall, rewarding students does have a short-term effect, but if you want it to last long, some appropriate punishment is definitely required.

subject: HW1001
content:
In my opinion, rewarding students for learning is more effective. There are two reasons why I think to reward students for learning is better than to use punishment to motivate them.
First, everyone needs confidence to do things; whenever he/she receives a sense of achievement from it, he/she is more willing to continue. Take my experience for example; when I was in junior high school, my Chinese teacher seperated the class into groups. When one answered the question asked by teacher correctly, the whole group could get a credit. Because of the rewarding, the class studied Chinese even harder to get more scores during class. As a result, the Chinese final score of our class was higher than other classes at the end of semester. What's more, many classmates of mine even began to be interested in Chinese since our teacher used rewarding to encourage us to study.
Sencond, using punishment to motivate students may make them fear of learning and result in losing interest toward school. Take my cousin for example; he is not good at math, and whenever he makes mistake in his math homework, he will be punished by my uncle. Since he is scared of being punished, he doesn't like the time of doing math which makes him nervous. At the end, he begins to hate math.
From the two examples, I think it is better to reward students for learning. When they are encouraged, they are more willing to learn and to try. Otherwise, using punishment may make them feel under pressure and may lose interest toward learning gradually.

subject: HW1001
content:
In order to influence the students' behavior and attitudes towards learning, I think that using the way of rewarding may be a good example in their life. When they do something right or is beneficial to every one, they deserve the appropriate rewards to encourage them to keep these behavior go on. By way of this, they can realize their own value in this learning environment and stay optimistic about the future of learning new information and self-cognition.
When I was a senior high school student, one of my classmates didn't like to stay in school to learn and his role in our class was just like a bully, so many of us didn't like him, so the teachers did. Because of his behavior and bad temper, lots of teachers treated him not very polite, some intended to use punishment to correct his behavior, but the results of this way turned this situation more badly. Others use the encouragement to influence him, the results seemed to be very well. In the end the student knew something he had done wrong during the school life and were willing to spend more time and energy to help these needed tudents, no matter how difficult it would be.

subject: HW1001
content:
In school, teachers either punish students or reward them to motivate pupils. Both ways can push students to study harder. Of course there are pros and cons of each treatment. Which one do you prefer? If I were a teacher, rewarding is definitely my priority.
Compared with punishment, rewarding is more effective to make students better. Students make progress because of punishment might not be a good phenomenon in education. In that way, students study hard probably because they are afraid of being punished. They study without their whole heart and aim at getting high grades so that teachers won't punish them. On the other hand, rewarding students will be a more effective way. Not because of being afraid of punishment, students study wholeheartedly and make a lot of progress.
When I was a junior high school student, my teacher set a strict policy on grades. Those students who didn't get high scores would be beated. I was afraid and studied hard to live up to the expectation of good grades. But I was always beated because that way of studying was not out of heart. After I entered senior high school, my teacher told me that so long as I worked hard, grades didn't matter. But if students made a lot of progress, the teacher woud give them an English magazine as a reward. Not being afraid any more, I started to find interest in studying. In the long run, I became one of the top three students in the class.
In order to push students to study harder, teachers can choose either to punish them or to reward them. However, rewarding is always the better method which is also more effective. By rewarding pupils, they will not be frightened as they are punished. Rewarding students means to encourage them, so that pupils will be more willing to study wholeheartedly. Rewarding students is definitely an effective way to lead students to better results.

subject: HW1001
content:
Forty years ago, teachers in Taiwan always punished students when students did not behave well or get poor grade. Now, teachers can not punish students in any reason. It is a huge different between the two ages. We can say that two methods are useful to the students. However, punishment is not the best way to make students behave well or perform well in the exam.
Our parents always talking about how their teachers punished them in the past, and they all look like that they do not like their teacher. The punishment can force students to behave well; however, it is just a short period that they behave like an angel. They will continue doing bad after teachers leave the classroom. It is quite obviously in the school that punishment is useless and meaningless.
Famous phycologist, Vygotsky, prove that rewarding is much useful for teaching students. In his theory rewarding is a positive forcement for students to perform well in daily life. Teacher give students some candy or praise after students doing well on their test can make students want to do well on the next time and so on. The famous examination about mouse prove this theory. We have a machine which will release food when mouse push the button, which is difficult to find for mouse. When mouse occasionly push the button once or twice and get the food they want, they will make their effort to get the food by pushing the button. Giving foods is the positive forcement in this examination. Mouse perform better and better after trying again and again. From this examination, we can say that rewarding is useful and meaningful for students.
As the result, punishment not only give students negative experience but also useless and meaningless. Compare with punishment, rewarding can make students really perform well and keep doing will in the future. Vygotsky can prove that rewarding students can lead to better results.

subject: HW1001
content:
In the last generation, teachers thought that the only way to motive students to learn and to control their behavior was by using punishment. But now, I think the more effective way is rewarding the student.
As far as I am concerned, no one likes to be punished, and you will be very upset if you were punished, so how can you learn well in such a bad mood? In my opinion, I think rewarding students when they do something right is much better. When the students are happly, they will be more willing to learn things and behave well.
For example, when students do well in tests, they will get a hundred dollars as a reward. So next time, they will try their best to study because they know that they can get some rewards.
To sum up, rewarding students is much eaiser and more effective than using punishment.

subject: HW1001
content:
To my opinion, I think it is case by case. There is no teaching method can be applied to everyone. Instead, teachers should teach students according to their personality, background, temperament and so on, just like what con-fu-cious practiced.
However, in terms of cultivating a student who positively grab any chances to learn rather than one who only passively receives the knowledge, I think rewarding is a much more effective method. For rewarding can bring the sense of achievement and fulfillment to the students rather than the negative emotions which punishments may trigger. And through the positive emotions, it will be much easier for students to be fond of learning.
Take myself as example, I was once scolded as an idiot for my poor academics performance which discouraged me to seek for further studies. However, not until my art teacher told me that I had potential in art did I realized that I still could be somebody. And thus, I enjoy in the field of art there after, and even have held a small exhibit of my works.
So, I think rewarding may be a much effective way to cultivate a student.

subject: HW1001
content:
Some people say that children without punishment would never succeed when they grow up, but I think giving praise would be more helpful. Punishment might make little children scared and work hard to get good grade, but they still feel reluctant to study. It would be efficient at first, but cannot last long to motivate students. On the other hand, rewarding students when they have a good achievement can give them an reinforcement to do things better next time.
Taking my sister for example, punishment just make things worse when she practicing piano in her childhood. The piano teacher often punished her by beating her hands or arms with pen when she made mistakes. Then she become hostil to the teacher and the piano. In the end, she quit learning piano. However, when she went to college, she joined a piano club and started to play piano again. She did love playing piano, and the teacher in the club always encourages her to practice more. She enjoys playing piano until now, and I think it would be never come true without the praise given by the teacher and her friends in the piano club.

subject: HW1001
content:
In recent years, whether teachers should punish or reward students to motivate them to perform better has been a controvercial topic. This directly impacts the teachers' teaching methods as well as the students' learning efficiency. In addition, physical punishment on students has been banned by law.
As far as I am concerned, I disagree about using merely punishment to rule students. In spite the fact that students will probably behave better for fear of being punished, they don't want to do so actually. This negative thinking won't push them to create higher achievements in the future.
On the contrary, I think rewarding student is much more effective. Students will do their best to gain the reward when they behave well. They will think positively and at the same time they are more likely to gain more valuable experiences in their lives. Take myself as an example, when the teacher promised me to treat me a meal as long as I get good grades, I would study harder than ever to win my award. Moreover, it not only motivated me but also lead me to better achievement.
To sum up, I think both punishment and reward should be given to students. The punishment should be resonable and never be too serious. Awarding should be used more frequently to encourage the students. Last but not least, always listen to the students advice to improve the teaching methods. By doing these, I believe that everyone will be satisfied with the result.

subject: HW1001
content:
To make students study their schoolwork, or to control students' behavior, more and more teachers inflict punishments on students as a method of education. However, is that really a good or effective way to motivate students to learn? As far as I am concerned, rewarding students for learning may be a better way.
In the first place, inflict punishments on students sometimes may lead to an opposite result. It is likely for students to rebel teachers after being punished, especially corporal punishment. In this way, it may not only bring to negative result, but also influence students' behavior.
Besides, if teachers do not punish students appropriately, it may also result in mental trauma of students. On the contrary, if teachers use rewarding for students, they are likely to think more positive and are willing to do better next time.
Based on the above two reasons, teachers should reward or accomplish students rather than punish them.

subject: HW1001
content:
As a student, I support the idea of rewarding students for them to do better. There are some reasons, one of which is that in a young age we tend to be lack of confidence and are eager to perform in activities we do the best. Another is that encouragement and support plays a significant role in our process of maturing. Lastly, I think it is better for our mental health, being rewarded can change our perspective and the way we look at our surroundings, it may guide us to be more positive-thinking.
For instance, there is a teacher I am most grateful of in junior high school. Even when I failed in winning an award in the city's English speech competition, my English teacher still constantly reminds me not to deny on my potential and encourages me to keep going on attending more competitions. In high school I did continue to participate in English speech contests and I won a first place in school.
In sum, I think rewarding can keep oneself to move on with optimism and confidence and advance their skills in whatever they do best.

subject: HW1001
content:
Rewarding students for learning absolutly lead to better results. Although, some teachers use punishment to motivate students to learn, most teachers disagree using punishment to control students' behavior. Teachers use rewardings to motivate students for three main reasons, one is punishment lead bad mood, two students feel depress won't lead to a good realtionship between teachers and students, three punishment doesn't work eveytime one students are use to be punish they won't change at all.
Due to these reasons, teachers are willing to give positive thoughts and give positive gift. For example, for kids 7-year-old, teachers will say "You are great!" "You are the best!" to students. Little child will be happy by teachers rewarding. For the students 9 to 10-year-old, sometimes language rewarding not really work, so teachers will give students stickers or small gifts. For the kids above 12-year-old, the would want teacher plus to score. In short, rewarding students for learning is good and better, but there are still different way to encourage students. Different age's kids have different ways. All teachers have to review what they learn in college, and I guess they will know punishment isn't the only way to motivate students. By the way, we shouldn't say the world "control" students' behavior, they are not toys or robots. To sum up, rewarding students for learning always lead to better results. Just pay attention, different ages' kids need different ways to be encouraged.

subject: HW1001
content:
I think rewarding students is more effective for learning than punishment. Through rewarding, students will be more willing to learn, not just do what teachers say, and turn out learning more than they thought. But this does not mean that we should prohibit teachers to punish their students. When students make big mistake, some punishment can be effective to make them remember the mistake, keep them away from doing it again.
Take my friend, Alice, for example. Alice was the most special one in my junior high school friends. She was not good at studying, and usually got poor grades in most classes. One day our teacher told her that she had potential to get good grades. All she needed was working harder. Alice tried very hard after that, and she finally got 100 on the test.
Poor grads is not Alice's only problem. Although she's still in junior high, she made some bad friends and even smoked with them. Our teacher punished her after knowing this. It's a terrible experience for her. Every time she wanted to smoke again, the experience stopped her. And she never smokes after that.

subject: HW1001
content:
Teachers from earlier generations often used punishments to control their students. As a result, students hated their teachers and behaved even worse. In nowadays, teachers usually rewarded and praised their students in the hope of making them better and giving them more confidence. However, this method spoiled some students because they think they wouldn't be punished no matter how naughty they were.
I think the best solution is to combine the two methods by punishing when needed and rewarding when students did good jobs. When I was in kindergarden, the teacher I had was very nice. She never punished anyone, just talked to the kids that did wrong. It was effective for most of us, except one boy. The boy never behaved, didn't listen to any of the teachers, and there was no way he would sit down quietly. At last, he made a teacher cry and his parents finally sent him away. I still feel now that if he was punished he wouldn't have to be sent away.
Another teacher in my elementary school later on was far better. She constantly praised us, but still punished the students who couldn't behave. She made a list of rules we couldn't break, and a list of things we could do to get a reward. This really worked because we worked harder for prizes and watched ourselves so we wouldn't get punished.
Praises are good for students who lack confidence, but we can't deny that sometimes punishments are also neccesary. Therefore, if we can put them together and make use of both of them, it would be more effective.

subject: HW1001
content:
In my opinion, rewarding students for learning is a better way because most students who have bad behavior are people who need a lot of help. If we use punishment, they may feel themselves valueless and nobody loves them in the world. Thus, they may use bad behavior to attract others' attention, which makes them feel they are truely alive. Although punishment may have immediate results, it is not the correct way to educate a child. The true meaning of education is to help children have better life in the future. If such punishment makes them not love themselves, how can we expect they will have good life?
Rewarding students, however, is a soft and correct way to help students. Who doesn't love to be rewarded? If we can use rewarding to let students know they do a correct thing, they will be willing to find other correct things to do, and they will be more confident on themselves. After having confidence, they will love themselves more and they will no longer want to make others trouble. So I believe, rewarding is indeed a better way to make student learn.

subject: HW1001
content:
I believe that rewarding students is more effective for their learning.
When it comes to rewards, everyone is happy about it. I'm a senior high school student now, and next year I'm going to take the extrance examination for university. Therefore, good grades is a very important thing. I still remember the first section test, I studied hard every day for the test and got the third place in our class. I was so excited that I almost couldn't sleep that night!
The next day in class, our homeroom teacher came in with three bags of cookies. To our surprise, she said that was the reward for the top three students in the first section test. She also said they she would take the whole class to see a movie because we did well on the test. Everyone was so happy and together we promised that we will do better next time so that we have a second chance to watch a movie.
Because of the reward which were given by my homeroom teacher, I become more confident and try my best in every learning. That is why I prefer rewarding rather than punishment. Giving punishments seems to be useful in a short period of time. However, when time gets longer, students will gradually lose their interest in learning and sometimes they will even act disobediently.

subject: HW1001
content:
How to let students learn better is always a main question for many teachers. Most teachers use two different kind of method to teacher their students. Some teachers use punishment to motivate students to learn, others reward their students for learning.
In these methods, I prefer the secound one, because I think that learning should be a thing that could be enjoy, and if we want to let students can learn by theirself, this is the only way, punishment learning will let students put learning and punishing together, for these students learning isn't happy at all, it's full of pain.
When I was still a student, I found that I will learn fest when I like the subject, since then I will try to found out which part of this subject if fun or intresting to let myself learn more and learn better.
For me, learning should be a thing that could be enjoy, and only be this way, we can let learning become a habit.

subject: HW1001
content:
In my opinion, I believe that rewarding students for learning is more effective. First, rewarding make students willing to study because they want to achieve a goal. If teachers use punishment to motivate students, students would be scared and afraid of teachers. They study because they afraid of punishing. One day when there are no punishment, they won't study anymore. But if teachers reward students and teach them the important of study and then decrease reward steps by steps. In the end, students would unerstand that study is their responsibilities and study by their own. For examples, my junior high school teacher gave me a book when I got the first place, he always taught me I should study for myself.
Second, rewarding is better for students' mental condition. Punishment would put students in pressure. Maybe they would become sentimental and sad or have head ache or ill. A class full of pressure and unhappy can't be a good environment for students. Rewarding can make students more effective to achieve the goals and are willing to compete with other classmates. They are in a happy surronding which is better for their phyicological. For instance, my mother used to punish my sister when she got bad degrees. My sister didn't want to talk to anybody and always unhappy. But now my mother reward her if she gets good degrees. She becomes talktive and pleased.
Therefore, if I were a teacher, I'd like to reward students instead of punishing them.

subject: HW1001
content:
Both of the methods are needed. As far as I am concerned, only with both punishment and praise would end up a successful child. All punishment and no praise would cause a child lacking confidence. On the contrary, all praise but no punishment would spoil a child. He may give up at once when facing failure in the future. As a result, I think half punishment and half praise is more proper.
Take my friend, Johnny, for example. He proforms finely on schoolwork. Never has he gotten his transcripts without being the best on scores. However, because of his parents' expectation and the method of punishment they take, Johnny is a shy, stammering boy in front of strangers. Nevertheless, too much rewarding is not good as well. Like me, although I am outgoing and friendly, yet I don't proform that well, which always disappoint my parents.
Considering those who are on the top of the society, they could not only be outstanding when working but also be superior to others in many other aspects. All in all, punishment and praise are equally important when educating a child.

subject: HW1001
content:
The way to use punishment to motivate students to learn and control their behavior is out-of-fashion and may be useless. In the contrary, students might offend to the teachers or the things what teachers ask them to do deliberately. Because theres no one who was born to be punished or controlled. Instead, the proper and timely rewards in any forms to students can lead to better results. Most people prefer being praised to being punished. If teachers reward students by saying that "Youre the best", students can build up their confidence and have more potential to do better.
In my opinion, rewarding students always outweighs using punishment. To tell the truth, Im a positive and dedicating students, so I would do things as perfect as possible on my own without using any punishment.

subject: HW1001
content:
I think the method that rewarding students for learning can lead to better results. However, I also agree that punishment can motivate students to learn. The main reason I think rewarding students is more effective is because I believe praises and compliments can help people face the challenges in a positive, yet optimistic attitude. Students will not be afraid to face their frustrations and can conquer them easily if they have the right attitude. On the other hand, punishment gives student forces that be too strong, and they'll not face their challenges in a positive way. Instead, they'll think that the reason for them to conquer the tasks is because they have to avoid the punishments. This way, they won't learn from what they've done and they will not want to face new challenges because they'll suffer too much pressure and fear in the process. In a word, challenges are like their nightmares.
I remembered when I was in elementary school, there were two students in my class that always got good grades. However, one of them was easy to get along with and always wore a smile on her face. On the other hand, the other one was always sad and didn't have any friend. I tried to talk to the latter, and I showed my concern. However, whenever I asked her why she could get such good grades, her answer was always like this:"If I got bad grades, my parents would hit me and my brother would tease me." I felt really sorry for her, but I really didn't know how to comfort her. On the other hand, the other student's situation was totally different. She tend to say that her parents gave her compliments and they were always proud of her, so she'll work harder to make her parents happy. Both of them were great in studies and they also did awesome jobs in other activities. However, they shared extremely different attitudes toward the things they should do.
Through the explainations and example, I think I've conveyed my thoughts and reasons clearly. I really think praising and compliments can help people learn the correct attitude, and they'll also give us a healthier mind. All the people in the world deserves a praise, and everyone has their own special talents. By giving compliments, we'll build up our confidence and optimistic mind. If you're still punishing your kids or yourself, tried to make a change. It'll help you change the way you see the world.

subject: HW1001
content:
In motivating students to learn in a more effective way, I consider it a better idea by rewarding.
The reason why rewarding is more effective in teaching is based on the mutual respect between teachers and students. Nowadays, we can often see some unproper punishments in news. In those cases, students punished by their teacher are likely to get bad influence when the grow up. These experiments might influence the establishment of appruvals to themselves. However, it's not always right to constantly rewarding students. Reward should be a way light up the motivation of students to learn. In my opinion, the best rewarding should be balanced with sort of punishment constractly.

subject: HW1001
content:
And punishments will leave some bad relationships, broken relationships between students and teachers. On the other hand, some teachers insists in "love education." Using encouragement and consultments, they believe they can change kids' heart by moving their rebellious minds. Some teachers are so affectionate that they turn misbehaved students into loyal and intrigate humen.
I prefer punishments than rewards. Punishments can let us know how the teachers think about us and what orders they are conveying to us. To attend schools is like serving country (oops, never mind. I think this is an imappropriate comparison), anyway, you have to follow rules and move on with disciplines. Once we are left behind, we might then be kicked out. If we can follow the march and comply with the set (statuted) regulations, we will be able to live a meaningful life without breaking laws. And teachers are the ones to told us with the corrective opinions that will rule us and help us classify right and wrong. If we are to be in a society that is complicated and mult-faced, we need to equip ourselves with justice and honor. And first of all, we need school education to lead us on the righteous road of knowledge and virtue. Punishments better reminds us of the bad crafts happening in our daily lives, like robberies, thefts and murders. Moderate punishments will warn us of the potential danger in life, as well as the consequence of nonpermitted decisions or actions. Once we wered not following the given routes, we will not only be lost but also be dispeised of the failure we are stepping towards. So to become a successful man, we have to always convict ourselves to the generally-accepted cruise and journ on a wonderful trip of life.
I am kind of an adultery-entered man, so I think punishments are more realistic than rewards. A society with much to be conquered is in need of laws and judements. We have to always think carefully before we act and be a normal person who don't produce problem in the society or break the peace. Hopefully, once the youngsters go into the career competition, they will be thankful of the decent concept, they are inflowed with. And without punishments, nobody can get to the absolution of fairness and standards of to-bes and not-to-bes. Trents are nice, but how can they protect you from taking the wrong way? And who can take you back once you are defined as a criminal or guilty person? Will life promise a second chance? A 20-year-old man best need a life with clear record, and he/she is best be first taught of that.

subject: HW1001
content:
There were many teachers that used punishment to motivate students to learn and to control their behavior in the past, but now, more and more teachers believe that rewarding students for learning can lead to better results. In my opinion, I think that rewarding students is more effective than punishing them.
When I was a junior high student, my homeroom teacher was very nice and always educate us to be good students by rewarding our good behaviors. On the contrary, the homeroom teacher of another class was very strict and often punished his students. The result was my classmates' behavior were much better than the behavior of the students in another class. This is the reason why more and more teachers turn to rewarding their students instead of punishing them.

subject: HW1001
content:
As we all know, education is the very efficient way to improve one's knowledge, and expand the point of view to the changing world. The better the educational system a country has, the stronger the country will be. The key point to the educational system is the ways of teaching that teachers use. In the past, teachers prefer to use punishment, especially corporal punishment, to change and control students behaviors; however, it is forbidden nowadays. It makes teachers think other ways of teaching, and now they prefer to reward students. In my opinion, I think both of the two different methods have their goods and bads, but I think rewarding is more effective.
First of all, no one likes to be punished. Students who are punished will be considerd of doing wrong things. However, most of the them are not on purpose! In this case, teachers are expected to take some more patience to communicate with them, instead of punish them directly, so that students will acquire not only the right ways of doing things, but also the ways of communication.
Secondly, students still have human rights. Most of the time, teachers punish students simply by beating or shouting at them. While doing so, students who with self-respect will be hurt. It will be a shadow to go to school, and even will they reject to learn! That is not the result teachers expect. Therefore, more reward without punishment, that will make the relationship between teachers and students peaceful, and the teaching activities more effective.
Last but not least, rewarding will help student build their self-confidence. Most of the educational experts say, the more positive reinforcement teachers use, the more confident students will be! That's a extremely important factor a successful person has. Nothing is more important than teaching and building students' confidence, and the easiest way is to use reward friquently.
To sum up, teaching with rewarding can make students willing to learning, and build their confidence, and most important of all, make teaching activities more effective.
Why not teacher take that way?

subject: HW1001
content:
Who likes to be blamed and punished every time? Who likes to be controled by their parents and teachers? In my viewpoint, rewarding students for learning can lead to better results.
There was an invention about this topic. An expert picked a group of elementary school students and devided them into two groups. The first group of children were blamed for whatever they had done and teachers and parents helped them decided everything while the second group had more independent and teachers and parents encouraged them to do what they wanted to do. Also, they received lots of compliments after doing things.
Few months later, the first group of students tended to be more unsure of themselves. They never started a task before others asked them to. On the other hand, the second group became more positive toward things, and felt self-confident while doing things which were difficult to them. Moreover, they relied on their own most of time. And they were said to be more successful in the future.
To me I would like the teachers reward me for learning. Because it will make me fill with energy to face the problems and mistakes that happened to me. Instead of being blamed and controled, receiving complements and controling most of things by myself will make me feel more cheerful and effective to deal with my work.

subject: HW1001
content:
In my opinion, rewarding students for learning is more effective than punishing them. An Approprieate reward giving can delight students. In the other hand, punishment may cause students being afraid of it.
I had heard an example. Mary was an Chinese teacher in high school. She was the best teacher I had ever seen. However, she was not popular among students. I was surprised and curious about the reason. The answer from students was that she was too cruel. She used punishment instead of giving complements or rewards. Mary personally was depressed about this situation so she decided to do some changes. She replaced punishment with complements and rewards. After a month, she became a popular teacher in her school.
According to the example, we can realize that students prefer rewarding than punishment. Rewards can push students to do their best to get it, while punishment is just preventing students from doing bad things. Moreover, punishment may stop their unapproprieate behaviors, but can not stop their complains. Therefore, I would suggest that using rewards or complements can lead better results!

subject: HW1001
content:
In this modern paced world, new ideas are being formed and old concepts are being banished. In this instance, physical punishment towards children is considered unappropriate. However, a lot of teachers still verbally abuse their students. As a student, I see these actions every day and I am sick of it. Therefore, I think rewarding students for learning can certainly lead to better results.
Take my mother for an example. My mom could have become a great pianist if her piano teacher had not struck her fingers with a wooden stick whenever she stumbled on a wrong note. These daily punishments soon got onto my mother's nerves and she decided never to touch the piano again. Now my mother is a woman in her late forties. Whenever she sees my hands dance across the piano keys, her face always lights up proudly but hints a thread of longing and sadness. If only my mother's piano teacher had encouraged her...she would have been able to understand the notes and melodies I played.
If there are any teachers out there who is reading this essay, I plead them to understand that every word a teacher utturs can change a student's idea towards a subject or an activity. Even though we students struck up an expressionless face whenever we are been given a scolding, please understand the heart underneath that is breaking.

subject: HW1001
content:
Human beings, in some ways, are lack of confidence. We like to be recognized and rewarded whenever we achieved something. Therefore, teachers who rewarding students for learning can indeed lead to better results.
Personally, I like being praised. Any warm-hearted encouragement can bring confidence to my learning. In school, the tests' results are like certificates to courage me. In other hand, while at home, my parents always reward me by giving me possitive thoughts such as, "You have done great job," which really attribute to my success.
I remembered getting the lowest points in class for a math test. It was liking the world fallen apart and, suddenly, I lost my only faith. However, to my surprise, my math teacher transformed her serious face into a big smile, telling me that it was nothing but a small test and I would never be defeated unless I gave up. It was then that I realized how a small courge can change our entire mood.
As mentioned above, teachers who rewarding students can make a difference to them and lead to a better result.

subject: HW1001
content:
Teachers need different methods to motivate students' learning, but which way is more efficient, Carols or Sticks? In my opinion, giving students positive feedbacks when they do something nice is more efficient to build up their personal traits and knowledge. Teachers are not training a group of animals to perform; instead, they are teaching students to think, to trust, and to learn. If students have senses of safety in school, they are more willing to show their gratitudes by achieving better results. A professor called Krashen proposed an idea "affective filter" which means the negative feeling caused by punishment may block out most of the input from teachers. I totally agree with this theory, and I will support my ideas with some examples.
In Chinese "Ching Dynasty", the first emperor controlled his people with cruel punishment; however, he was betrayed by people around him. Punishment can control a man's behavior in short term but cannot win a person's heart. On the other hand, when the late American President Dwight D. Eisenhower became the Principal of Columnbia University, he told his employees that he only needed to read four papers a day and left others to his subordinates He also provided extra bonus to those who worked harder or behaved more nicely to students. Not before long, more and more students wanted to enter this school. Eisenhower then had became a successful manager and his employees worked efficiently and happily.
According to Meslow, people want to be loved and needed. Teachers should provide students with positive feedbacks, and students will feel that they are loved, trusted, and tolerated. Students with senses of safty would like to show the goodness inside their mind and help each other by sharing in order to achieve better results of learning.

subject: HW1001
content: In Chinese culture, parents and teachers use punishment most of the time because it can tell students what is right or wrong immediately. In my opinion, I am really against the usage of punishment. If teachers want to motivate students, rewarding them is much better than punishing them. When students get reward, they will feel more confident in learning, and eventually lead to better results. On the other hand, students who are punished will just resist to learn. Take my high-school math teacher for example, he never rewarded us for getting right answers but always punished us for answering wrong. My class start to feel bad about our math ability, and our grades droped instead of getting better. Looking back the experiences during my school life, I think using rewards is more effective than punishment.

subject: HW1001
content:
The educational approaches that one teacher takes can have a great influence to the students. As far as I am concerned, I think that the "rewarding" one will be a better and more efficient method for the following reasons. First, everyone likes to be praised when they do something good. On the contrary, no one likes to receive harsh punishment when doing wrong. Second, we shouldn't devastate one student's confidence and willingness for learning by harsh punishment. Moreover, according to a wisdom ancestor's saying, everyone is innate goodness. For the reasons above, what side effects we will receive when we educate students with harsh punishment is obvious.
Take my personal studying experience for example. I once have a teacher treating students with punishments all the time. He flew into rage when we performed badly on accademic performance or did something bad. However, no one likes the way he uses and we all hate him very much. Surprising, he changed the way he uses at that time one day. We performed better than what we were before. The thing which I want to say is that the influence of using "love education" is beyond doubt.
If you try to correct one student's behavior with harsh method, you will find that it will be in vain in the end. Trying what we say for "love educating" is a more preferable choice.

subject: HW1001
content: Punishment and reward are two different ways to motivate students to learn and to control their behavior. Some tearchers prefer punishment, but the others like reward. Either one has its benefits and disadventages. How to choose the method depends on the students' characteristics and the situations. In general, I think that reward is more effective than punishment is for most students. When the students usually receive reward the learning is happy. They like to go to school. If students are punished frequently, they may be afraid of learning and may have anxiety or many somatic complaints before going to school That would be a suffering and horrible expenence for students. I am a teacher in a medical school. Students like my teaching activity. I always give them rewards even though they can not or do not like to answer questions or present their work. I encourge everybody to express himself, or introduce them to be involved in the class by simple questions step by step. Therefore, everyone can get reward just answering a simple question. Then I given them more difficult questions, they can hadle them without any problem. After a while, students become active in the teaching activity. When we were in Canada, my son prefered the learning in Montreal than what he did in Taiwan. He was happy because he always got reward even he could not speak English well. Therefore, generally reward is a more effect teaching method than punishment is.

subject: HW1001
content:
Psychologists would tell you that both punishment and reward are effective means of behavior change. Punishment may be more useful to deter the bad habits and decrease the behaviors you don't want while reward is more effective to increase the behaviors you do want. In a school setting, since the goal of education has more to do with bringing about positive behaviors, I am of the opinion that reward is the more effective method between the two.
One simple and yet very effective as well as efficient way of reward is praise. For students, particularly elementary school students, praise from the teachers is a strong incentive for them to behave themselves. Positive feedbacks from the teachers can also do wonders in higher education. For example, in a seminar course a professor can invite more discussion by praising those who contribute than criticizing them.
Another benefit of reward is that punishment and reward are actually different side of the same thing. By this I mean if you use reward carefully, the lack of reward becomes a punishment for those who are not behaving well. So it can have the effect of decreasing their unwanted behaviors without actually punishing them.

subject: HW1001
content:
I believe that rewarding students when they accomplish something good is more effective in controlling their behavior and motivating them to learn, as opposed to punishing them. By rewarding a good student in front of everybody, you are actually motivating everyone else to work harder through their jealousy, and at the same time, you're also motivating the student that you rewarded by giving him a taste of success.
